title: The Fed Put and Bank Risk-Taking: Evidence from the Loan Book
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, University of Münster, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and

detail.title: The Fed Put and Bank Risk-Taking: Evidence from the Loan Book
detail.abstract: This paper shows that monetary policy influences bank credit policy through the risk taking channel. Using option prices on FOMC announcement days, we measure the impact of monetary policy on bank equity tail risks and link them to loan-level regulatory data. Banks that experience a decline in tail risk lend more to riskier firms and ease loan terms in the three weeks after the FOMC. These effects are concentrated among banks with short-term compensation structures and in competitive credit markets. Our results isolate the impact of bank risk-taking in loan supply from confounding forces such as endogenous credit demand and highlight how institutional frictions mediate the risk-taking channel of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过FOMC公告日的期权价格分析，发现货币政策通过风险承担渠道影响银行信贷政策。银行尾部风险下降会导致其向风险更高企业增加贷款并放宽贷款条件，这种效应在短期薪酬结构的银行和竞争性信贷市场中更为明显。

AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策的风险承担渠道理论，银行风险偏好理论，机构摩擦理论

title: Management Disclosure and Media Coverage
affiliations: EDHEC Business School and University of Groningen - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Management Disclosure and Media Coverage
detail.abstract: We examine how management disclosure affects media coverage by analyzing firms' responses in earnings call Q&A sessions. Using a machine-learning-based "non-answer" score, we find that evasive managerial responses reduce subsequent media attention, particularly from professional outlets generating original content. This supports a supply-driven view of media coverage: poor disclosure limits journalistic content creation. Reduced coverage, in turn, is associated with lower investor engagement and weaker stock performance. Our findings highlight the critical role of a firm's information environment in shaping the level and nature of subsequent media coverage, with implications for broader financial market outcomes.

AI.tldr: 管理层在财报电话会议中回避问题的回答方式会减少后续媒体报道，特别是专业媒体的原创内容，进而降低投资者参与度和股票表现
AI.research_question: 管理层披露行为如何影响媒体报道？具体而言，回避性回答是否以及如何影响后续媒体关注度
AI.motivation: 理解企业信息披露质量对媒体报道的影响机制，检验是需求驱动还是供给驱动的媒体覆盖模式
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息供给理论，认为管理层披露质量直接影响媒体内容创造能力，而非单纯由读者需求驱动
AI.method: 使用机器学习方法构建"非回答"评分指标，分析财报电话会议Q&A环节的管理层回答回避程度与后续媒体报道的关系
AI.findings: 回避性管理回答显著减少后续媒体报道，特别是专业媒体的原创内容；减少的媒体报道与较低的投资者参与度和较弱股票表现相关
AI.theory_contributions: 支持媒体覆盖的供给驱动观点，强调企业信息环境在塑造媒体报道水平和性质中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业改善信息披露实践提供依据，帮助投资者理解媒体报道背后的信息供给机制，对金融市场结果具有重要启示

title: Contracting against Non-contractible Outsider
affiliations: Yale University, Department of Economics

detail.title: Contracting against Non-contractible Outsider
detail.abstract: This paper studies contracting in the presence of externalities with a non-contractible outsider. Multiple equilibria arise from strategic symmetry between the insider agent and the outsider. To address strategic uncertainty, the principal guarantees their actions in a unique equilibrium. A novel duality approach reformulates her problem as a series of problems in which she selects agent expectations. The key constraint is that the principal cannot convince the agent to expect non-guaranteed response from the outsider. Due to strategic rents, the principal optimally induces attenuated agent incentives. With completely symmetric strategic dependence, her coordination and commitment power become perfect substitutes; in addition, public contracting can strictly decrease her surplus compared to private contracting, in sharp contrast with the case where she ignores robustness. Applications include regulating international competition, platform design, and labor union contracting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究存在外部性和不可签约外部参与者的契约设计问题，通过新颖的对偶方法解决多重均衡问题，发现委托人通过保证行动来应对策略不确定性，最优激励会减弱，且公开契约可能比私下契约产生更低收益
AI.research_question: 在存在外部性和不可签约外部参与者的情况下，委托人如何设计最优契约来应对策略不确定性并实现唯一均衡？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中许多契约设计问题都涉及外部参与者和外部性，但现有研究往往忽略策略不确定性带来的多重均衡问题，需要新的理论框架来解决这一问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 契约理论、博弈论、外部性理论、对偶方法、策略不确定性理论
AI.method: 理论建模和数学分析，采用新颖的对偶方法将委托人问题重新表述为选择代理人期望的一系列问题
AI.findings: 1) 多重均衡源于内部代理人和外部参与者的策略对称性；2) 委托人通过保证行动来实现唯一均衡；3) 由于策略租金，最优激励会减弱；4) 在完全对称策略依赖下，协调能力和承诺能力成为完美替代品；5) 公开契约可能比私下契约产生更低收益
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了处理外部性和不可签约参与者的新理论框架；2) 发展了应对策略不确定性的对偶方法；3) 揭示了协调能力和承诺能力的替代关系；4) 挑战了传统关于公开契约优于私下契约的认知
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为国际竞争规制提供理论指导；2) 为平台设计提供决策依据；3) 为工会契约设计提供参考；4) 帮助决策者更好地处理存在外部参与者的契约设计问题

title: Tipping Points: Fear, Nonlinear Comovement, and the Global Pricing Kernel
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Finance

detail.title: Tipping Points: Fear, Nonlinear Comovement, and the Global Pricing Kernel
detail.abstract: We find that the asset pricing literatures generally accepted positive relation between fear measures and international correlations masks strong nonlinearities. Using daily data for 37 countries, we find this relationship is, on average, convex (U-shaped), with correlations decreasing before an economically important "tipping point." Cross-sectionally, this convexity is more pronounced in countries with higher inflation and deeper financial integration, linking it to intermediary and macroeconomic channels. Furthermore, time-varying Markov-switching models confirm that fear nonlinearly increases the probability of entering a high-correlation regime. These patterns provide evidence on state-dependent exposures to the global pricing kernel, consistent with a unified structural model.

AI.tldr: 研究发现恐惧指标与国际市场相关性之间存在U型非线性关系，而非传统认为的简单正相关。相关性在达到经济重要'临界点'前会下降，这种凸性在通胀率高、金融一体化程度深的国家更明显，与中介机构和宏观经济渠道相关。
AI.research_question: 恐惧指标与国际市场相关性之间是否存在非线性关系？这种关系的特征和驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 资产定价文献普遍接受恐惧指标与国际相关性之间的正相关关系，但这种关系可能掩盖了重要的非线性特征，需要更深入的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球定价核的状态依赖性暴露理论，通过中介机构和宏观经济渠道解释非线性关系。
AI.method: 使用37个国家的日度数据，采用时变马尔可夫转换模型分析非线性关系。
AI.findings: 恐惧与相关性之间呈现凸性（U型）关系，相关性在达到经济重要临界点前下降；这种凸性在通胀率高、金融一体化程度深的国家更明显；恐惧非线性地增加了进入高相关性状态的概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的线性正相关假设，提出了状态依赖性暴露的统一结构模型，为理解国际市场联动性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了更准确的风险管理工具，特别是在高恐惧环境下识别临界点和状态转换概率，有助于制定更有效的跨境投资和风险防控策略。

title: Pricing Fiscal Gains and Externalities: The Effects of Shale Booms on Municipal Finance
affiliations: Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business, Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business and

detail.title: Pricing Fiscal Gains and Externalities: The Effects of Shale Booms on Municipal Finance
detail.abstract: Using geographic and temporal variation in shale discoveries and drilling incentives, we show that municipalities exposed to shale booms experience lower municipal borrowing costs and improved creditworthiness. Four mechanisms explain these effects: tax revenues, municipal expenditure, environmental costs, and public safety. Revenue surpluses enable local governments to reduce reliance on bond markets to finance capital. The fiscal benefits are more pronounced in economically disadvantaged municipalities, where the marginal value of resource windfalls is greater. Our findings suggest that investors perceive the fiscal gains from fracking as outweighing its negative externalities, and these opposing forces are capitalized into municipal bond markets.

AI.tldr: 页岩气开发通过增加税收收入、改善市政支出、环境成本和公共安全四个机制，降低了市政借贷成本并提升信用评级，财政收益在经济弱势城市更为显著
AI.research_question: 页岩气开发热潮如何影响市政借贷成本和信用评级？
AI.motivation: 探究页岩气开发对地方政府财政状况和资本市场表现的影响，特别是财政收益与负面外部性之间的权衡
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源诅咒理论、财政联邦制理论和资本市场定价理论，分析资源开发对地方财政和信用的影响机制
AI.method: 利用页岩气发现和钻探激励的地理和时间变化进行实证分析，采用差分方法识别因果效应
AI.findings: 暴露于页岩气热潮的城市市政借贷成本降低、信用改善；通过税收收入、市政支出、环境成本和公共安全四个机制发挥作用；财政收益在经济弱势城市更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了资源开发对地方政府财政影响的理论框架，揭示了财政收益与负面外部性在资本市场中的权衡机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府制定资源开发政策提供参考，帮助投资者理解页岩气开发对市政债券市场的影响

title: A Realistic, Heterogeneous (Principal-) Agent Asset Pricing Model: With Asset Allocation and Risk-Adjusted Performance
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business

detail.title: A Realistic, Heterogeneous (Principal-) Agent Asset Pricing Model: With Asset Allocation and Risk-Adjusted Performance
detail.abstract:
The Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM), based on investors/principals, maximizing their expected utility of wealth, assumed a single representative investor and a deterministic goal/liability. Subsequent heterogenous agent asset pricing models (HAPMs) were based on trivial variations to utility functions/preferences, and market frictions, but, in reality, there are no well-specified "utility functions", or "risk-aversion" parameters (and probably HAPMs incorrectly use "agent" instead of "participant" or "principal"). Prof. Cochrane has suggested that, "Switching to a payoff perspective may change lots of procedures in finance", and we use his approach to propose a realistic HAPM that corrects for these challenges.

Three variations of realistic heterogeneity in markets are explored instead in this model: (i) heterogeneity of cash flows of different investment goals (retirement; kid’s education, buying a house, etc.); (ii) heterogeneity of cash flows within a goal, based on different ages of investors that impact cash flow start/end dates and duration; and (iii) heterogeneity of clearly articulated relative risk targets for delegation. The proposed model incorporates four realities of investing; (i) that investors/principals have many stochastic goals (i.e., cash flows or payoffs they desire), and that is the primary example of real-life heterogeneity; (ii) they seek to delegate to skillful agents (in the true academic sense of the word); (iii) explicitly specify risk preferences (adding in an additional layer of heterogeneity); and (iv) maximize risk-adjusted relative returns. In this HAPM, assets are priced with just two goal-replicating assets (issued by Brazil in 2023), and the absolute risk-free asset. The pair-wise equilibrium model uses observable assets and risk preferences parameters, eliminates "free parameters", and lends itself to a general equilibrium model of assets and wages too. Critical to investment practice, it provides asset pricing, asset allocations and risk-adjusted performance measures that are consistent. It offers a new pathway to a realistic HAPM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于支付视角的异质代理人资产定价模型，通过考虑投资目标的现金流异质性、投资者年龄差异导致的现金流时间异质性，以及明确的风险目标异质性，来修正传统CAPM和HAPM模型的缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更现实的异质代理人资产定价模型，以解决传统模型在效用函数、风险厌恶参数和市场摩擦假设方面的不现实问题？
AI.motivation: 传统CAPM假设单一代表性投资者和确定性目标，而后续的异质代理人模型仅对效用函数偏好和市场摩擦进行微小变动，但这些模型缺乏现实基础，没有明确定义的"效用函数"或"风险厌恶"参数。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cochrane教授的支付视角方法，构建包含投资目标现金流异质性、投资者年龄差异导致的现金流时间异质性，以及明确风险目标异质性的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用巴西2023年发行的两种目标复制资产和绝对无风险资产进行资产定价，采用配对均衡模型，使用可观察资产和风险偏好参数，消除"自由参数"。
AI.findings: 提出的模型能够提供一致的资产定价、资产配置和风险调整后绩效衡量，适用于资产和工资的一般均衡模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为异质代理人资产定价理论提供了新的现实路径，修正了传统模型在代理人定义和参数设定方面的缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了实用的资产定价、资产配置和绩效评估工具，具有直接的应用价值。

title: The Economic Costs of Mass Shootings: Evidence from U.S. Housing Markets
affiliations: Stevens Institute of Technology and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: The Economic Costs of Mass Shootings: Evidence from U.S. Housing Markets
detail.abstract: We study the impact of mass shootings on local housing markets using ZIP-level monthly data from 2017-2023 and a matched-control design. Following an incident, markets cool as buyer interest diminishes and sellers respond with slower listings, longer time on market, and greater price concessions. Listing prices decline, showing that weaker demand outweighs any temporary supply pullback. These effects extend the household finance literature by demonstrating that highly salient, extreme forms of gun violence trigger immediate demand-supply adjustments that erode housing-market liquidity and home values. Mass shootings thus impose significant economic costs, reducing household wealth and weakening local resilience beyond their human toll.

AI.tldr: 大规模枪击事件通过降低买家兴趣和卖家反应导致当地住房市场冷却，表现为挂牌价格下降、上市时间延长和价格让步增加，对家庭财富和当地经济韧性造成显著经济成本
AI.research_question: 大规模枪击事件对当地住房市场的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究高度显性的极端枪支暴力事件如何影响住房市场的需求和供给调整，以及这些事件对家庭财富和当地经济韧性的经济成本
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房市场供需理论，分析极端暴力事件对市场流动性和资产价值的影响
AI.method: 使用2017-2023年ZIP级别的月度数据，采用匹配控制设计进行研究
AI.findings: 枪击事件后市场冷却，买家兴趣减少，卖家反应为更慢的上市、更长的在售时间和更大的价格让步，挂牌价格下降
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了家庭金融文献，证明高度显性的极端枪支暴力会触发即时的供需调整，侵蚀住房市场流动性和房屋价值
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示大规模枪击事件除了人员伤亡外，还通过减少家庭财富和削弱当地经济韧性造成显著经济成本

title: Do Monetary Policy Rules and Inflation Influence Tariff Dynamics in Sahel and Sahara Countries? A Tobit Model Approach
affiliations: Sudan University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Do Monetary Policy Rules and Inflation Influence Tariff Dynamics in Sahel and Sahara Countries? A Tobit Model Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: approval
declarations.ethicsApproval: approval
declarations.funderStatement: approval

detail.abstract: This paper looks at the relationship between monetary policy rules, inflation, and tariff dynamics in Sahel and Sahara countries from 1980-2024. Using a Tobit panel regression methodology to account for the censored character of tariff data, the analysis analyzes how macroeconomic stabilization programs affect trade policy outcomes. The findings show that tariffs respond considerably to monetary and inflationary situations. Tariffs increase in response to exchange rate depreciation and inflation (CPI), emphasizing both defensive and revenue-generating responsibilities. Monetary expansion (M2), government consumption, and interest rates are all positively associated with higher tariffs, indicating fiscal reliance on trade taxes and the complementary nature of monetary tightening and protectionist measures. Improving the current account reduces reliance on tariffs, which is consistent with their counter-cyclical usage in balance-of-payments management. The findings highlight tariffs' dual significance as trade policy instruments and macroeconomic stabilizers in Africa's fragile and shock-prone economies. Policy recommendations focus on improving currency rate management, minimizing inflationary pressures, diversifying fiscal revenue sources, and aligning tariff reforms with regional integration initiatives under the AFCFTA.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Tobit面板回归分析发现，萨赫勒和撒哈拉国家(1980-2024)的关税政策对货币政策和通胀状况反应显著，关税在汇率贬值和通胀时上升，具有防御性和财政收入双重功能。
AI.research_question: 货币政策规则、通货膨胀与关税动态之间的关系是什么？特别是在萨赫勒和撒哈拉国家背景下，宏观经济稳定计划如何影响贸易政策结果？
AI.motivation: 研究非洲脆弱且易受冲击的经济体中关税作为贸易政策工具和宏观经济稳定器的双重作用，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于关税作为财政收入工具和宏观经济稳定器的理论框架，结合货币政策传导机制和贸易政策互动理论。
AI.method: 使用Tobit面板回归方法，考虑关税数据的删失特性，分析1980-2024年期间的数据。
AI.findings: 关税对汇率贬值和CPI通胀反应显著上升；货币扩张(M2)、政府消费和利率与更高关税正相关；经常账户改善降低关税依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了关税在非洲经济体中的双重角色理论，丰富了货币政策与贸易政策互动关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改善汇率管理、减少通胀压力、多元化财政收入来源的政策建议，支持AFCFTA区域一体化进程中的关税改革。

title: Total Returns of US Treasury Index Funds Derived from Bond Prices Between 1941 and 1982
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Total Returns of US Treasury Index Funds Derived from Bond Prices Between 1941 and 1982
detail.abstract: The prices and amounts in issue of US notes and bonds recorded in the Treasury Bulletin between the end of 1941 and 1982 have been used to calculate the returns, weighted yields, and weighted durations of various indices (e.g., maturities of 1 to 3 years, 1 to 5 years, etc.). Changes in the tax status of treasuries across these four decades meant that three different versions of each index, all bonds, fully taxable only, and tax exempt only were calculated. The annualised returns over the four decades differed by no more than 25 bp from those in existing datasets, while the median magnitude of differences in annual returns lay between 0.2 and 1.2 percentage points depending on the dataset being compared. However, in some years the differences in the annual returns were up to 5 pp, the reasons for which have been explored in detail. The annual returns were also compared with those derived from yield curves with median differences of less than 1 pp, although much larger differences of up to 6.5 pp occurred when the synthetic bond market derived from the yield curves was at variance with the historical bond market.

AI.tldr: 基于1941-1982年美国国债数据构建了三种税收状态下的债券指数，与现有数据集年化回报差异不超过25bp，但某些年份差异达5个百分点，并与收益率曲线推算的回报进行了比较。
AI.research_question: 如何基于美国国债数据构建不同税收状态的债券指数，并与现有数据集和收益率曲线推算的回报进行比较分析？
AI.motivation: 现有国债回报数据集存在差异，且国债税收状态在四十年间发生变化，需要构建更准确的债券指数来衡量不同税收条件下的投资回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债券定价理论、收益率曲线理论、税收影响债券定价理论
AI.method: 使用1941-1982年美国财政部公报中的国债价格和发行量数据，计算三种税收状态（全部债券、完全应税、完全免税）的加权收益率和久期，构建不同期限的债券指数。
AI.findings: 年化回报与现有数据集差异不超过25bp，但某些年份年度回报差异达5个百分点；与收益率曲线推算的回报中位数差异小于1个百分点，但在合成债券市场与历史市场不一致时差异可达6.5个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了考虑税收状态变化的债券指数构建方法，揭示了税收政策变化对债券回报测量的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和研究人员提供了更准确的国债历史回报数据，有助于资产配置和投资策略制定。

title: Computational Learning Mechanisms of Information Propagating in Social Networks
affiliations: , Dartmouth College - Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences, EMLYON Business School and Claude Bernard Lyon 1 University

detail.title: Computational Learning Mechanisms of Information Propagating in Social Networks
detail.abstract: What mechanisms underlie how individuals integrate disparate and redundant information that spreads in social networks? The DeGroot (DG) model suggests that we adjust our beliefs according to the weighted average opinions of our social connections. In contrast, reinforcement learning (RL) models assume that learning occurs sequentially, depending on error-driven belief updating. Here, we compare these models directly using two datasets of information propagating in social networks, and determine which learning rule best accounts for the integration of information spreading in social networks. We found that variants of the DG model provide a better overall fit across participants, and are more effective in building consensus, and generating accurate estimates of the true state of the world. Furthermore, simulated models show how social network topology affects choice accuracy and consensus, depending on the learning rule. Together, our findings characterize the computational mechanisms used by individuals to propagate information in social networks.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了DeGroot模型和强化学习模型在社交网络信息传播中的表现，发现DeGroot模型变体在整体拟合度、建立共识和生成准确世界状态估计方面更优，并揭示了社交网络拓扑结构如何影响学习规则的选择准确性和共识形成。
AI.research_question: 个体如何整合社交网络中传播的不同和冗余信息？DeGroot模型和强化学习模型哪种学习规则能更好地解释社交网络中信息传播的整合过程？
AI.motivation: 理解社交网络中信息传播的机制对于解释群体决策、共识形成和信息准确性至关重要，但目前缺乏对DeGroot模型和强化学习模型的直接比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: DeGroot模型（基于加权平均意见调整信念）和强化学习模型（基于错误驱动的顺序学习更新信念）的理论框架对比。
AI.method: 使用两个社交网络信息传播数据集直接比较两种模型，通过模型拟合度、共识建立能力和准确性评估来验证模型效果，并进行模拟实验分析网络拓扑结构的影响。
AI.findings: DeGroot模型变体在参与者整体拟合度、共识建立和真实世界状态估计准确性方面表现更优；模拟显示社交网络拓扑结构会根据学习规则影响选择准确性和共识形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了DeGroot模型在社交网络信息传播中的优势地位，揭示了不同学习规则在信息整合过程中的计算机制差异，为理解社交学习提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交网络平台设计、信息传播策略优化和群体决策支持系统提供了实证依据，有助于提高信息传播的准确性和共识形成效率。

title: Human Capital Accumulation, Chapter 6, The Making of Korea’s Liberty and Prosperity
affiliations: Yeungnam University

detail.title: Human Capital Accumulation, Chapter 6, The Making of Korea’s Liberty and Prosperity
detail.abstract: This chapter clarifies the interaction between human capital accumulation and economic growth and between public provision of education and private demand for learning, focusing on the rise of Korean literacy and primary schooling up to 1960. The first section begins by outlining the path of Korean human capital accumulation to highlight that it sped up significantly with the 1945 decolonization. The second and third sections analyze the literacy improvement and the advance of primary schooling in the half century leading up to 1945. Section 4 discusses how the 1945 de-colonization caused literacy and primary education to surge in South Korea. The last section concludes by highlighting that the rapid accumulation of Korean human capital occurred against the backdrop of the transition from limited to open-access order.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1945年去殖民化前后韩国人力资本积累与经济增长的关系，重点关注识字率和初等教育的发展，发现去殖民化后人力资本积累显著加速。
AI.research_question: 韩国人力资本积累与经济增长之间如何相互作用？公共教育供给与私人学习需求之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 理解韩国在1945年去殖民化前后人力资本积累的加速现象，以及这一过程与从有限准入秩序向开放准入秩序转型的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、经济增长理论、制度变迁理论（从有限准入秩序到开放准入秩序的转型）
AI.method: 历史分析方法和实证研究方法，分析1945年前后半个世纪的识字率改善和初等教育发展数据
AI.findings: 1945年去殖民化导致韩国识字率和初等教育显著激增，人力资本积累在制度转型背景下加速发展
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了人力资本积累与制度环境转型之间关系的理论理解，为发展经济学提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家的人力资本积累政策提供了历史经验，强调了制度环境对教育发展的关键作用

title: Incentives in Competition: The Role of Money, Recognition, and Perception in Performance
affiliations: State Bank of Pakistan and Akhuwat University

detail.title: Incentives in Competition: The Role of Money, Recognition, and Perception in Performance
detail.abstract: This study examines the comparative effectiveness of monetary and non-monetary incentives in competitive tournament-based remuneration structures. While prior research has demonstrated the superior efficiency of non-monetary incentives in cooperative or gift-exchange settings, our experimental results show that their relative advantage diminishes under competitive tournament conditions. Average output levels did not differ significantly between monetary and non-monetary treatments, suggesting that the social-relational benefits of non-monetary rewards are less effective when embedded in market-oriented competition. However, the analysis of shirking behavior reveals a contrasting dynamic: monetary tournaments generated significantly higher shirking, whereas non-monetary tournaments reduced it. Moreover, labor supply decisions in monetary treatments were strongly shaped by participants' perceptions of relative competitiveness, leading to polarized performance outcomes. Perception was found to be primarily skill-based, but psychological responses also played a crucial role. Non-monetary incentives, while equal in productivity, offered advantages in reducing shirking, lowering expected disappointment, and enhancing job satisfaction. These findings highlight that incentive effectiveness depends not only on the type of reward but also on the structure in which it is implemented.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了竞争性锦标赛薪酬结构中货币与非货币激励的效果。实验发现，在竞争环境下，非货币激励的相对优势减弱，两者生产力相当，但非货币激励能显著减少偷懒行为、降低失望预期并提高工作满意度。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性锦标赛薪酬结构中，货币激励与非货币激励的相对效果如何？
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明非货币激励在合作或礼物交换环境中更有效，但在竞争性市场环境中的效果尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于锦标赛理论和激励理论，探讨不同奖励类型在竞争环境下的行为反应机制。
AI.method: 实验研究方法，比较货币与非货币激励在竞争性锦标赛设置下的表现差异。
AI.findings: 1. 平均产出水平无显著差异；2. 货币激励导致更高偷懒行为；3. 非货币激励减少偷懒、降低失望预期、提高满意度；4. 货币激励中相对竞争力感知导致绩效两极分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了激励理论，证明激励效果不仅取决于奖励类型，还受实施结构影响，揭示了竞争环境下心理反应机制的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计竞争性激励方案提供实证依据，建议在需要减少偷懒行为和提升员工满意度的场景中优先考虑非货币激励。

title: The fire that does not go out: the neglected costs of gas flaring in Nigeria
affiliations: World Bank Group and The University of Waikato

detail.title: The fire that does not go out: the neglected costs of gas flaring in Nigeria
detail.abstract: Gas flaring, the burning of gas coming out of oil wells is a common practice in oil-producing developing countries. This practice is harmful to human health, especially because of pollutants. This research focuses on Nigeria, where over 10 percent of all gas produced is flared and about two million people are estimated to live within four kilometres of a flare site. This paper uses infant health data from Demographic Health Surveys, and satellite-detected data on gas flaring to examine the effects of flaring on disease incidence and infant mortality in oil-producing regions. The findings show a strong positive association between flaring and the incidence of respiratory diseases and fever among children under five years old. The study contributes to the literature measuring the wider cost to society of oil and gas production and adds to the body of work using satellite data to understand well-being in places where conventional data sources are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用卫星数据和健康调查数据，发现尼日利亚天然气燃烧与儿童呼吸道疾病和发热发病率存在显著正相关，揭示了石油生产对社会的额外成本。
AI.research_question: 天然气燃烧对尼日利亚产油地区疾病发病率和婴儿死亡率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 天然气燃烧是石油生产发展中国家的常见做法，对健康有害。尼日利亚10%以上的产气被燃烧，约200万人生活在燃烧点4公里范围内，急需评估其健康影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境健康经济学、污染暴露与健康结果关系理论
AI.method: 使用人口健康调查的婴儿健康数据和卫星检测的天然气燃烧数据，分析产油地区燃烧对健康的影响
AI.findings: 研究发现燃烧与5岁以下儿童呼吸道疾病和发热发病率存在强烈正相关关系
AI.theory_contributions: 为衡量石油天然气生产社会成本的文献做出贡献，扩展了使用卫星数据理解福祉的研究体系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，支持减少天然气燃烧的政策措施，改善产油地区居民健康水平

title: Juxtaposing the Global Citizenship Competencies of Senior High School and College Students: Input for a Contextualized Learning Plan
affiliations: Department of Education, Republic of the Philippines and Bataan Peninsula State University, Bataan, Philippines

detail.title: Juxtaposing the Global Citizenship Competencies of Senior High School and College Students: Input for a Contextualized Learning Plan
detail.abstract: Education and globalization, as tools empowering learners to think and act globally, are driving forces for producing the competent and humanized citizens that the world needs today. The present study explores the global citizenship competencies of senior high school (SHS) and college students as the baseline for a contextualized learning plan premised on that. The study employs the descriptive survey design of quantitative research, wherein the needed data are gathered through a questionnaire to select students with leadership positions in various student organizations in their respective institutions. The data gathered are analyzed using descriptive statistics (mean and standard deviation) and inferential statistics (Independent Samples t-test). The findings reveal that both SHS and college students show strong agreement in possessing global citizenship competencies across knowledge, skills, values, and attitudes, with college students exhibiting slightly higher levels. College students demonstrate significantly more vital global citizenship competencies in knowledge, values, attitudes, and overall domains than SHS students, while no significant difference is observed in the skills domain. A contextualized learning plan is developed to address the learning needs of SHS and college students, aiming to sustain and enhance their global citizenship competencies in knowledge, values, and attitudes through various tailored activities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨高中和大学生全球公民能力，发现大学生在知识、价值观、态度和整体领域显著高于高中生，为此开发了情境化学习计划。
AI.research_question: 高中和大学生在全球公民能力方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 教育和全球化作为培养全球思维和行动能力的工具，需要培养具备全球公民能力的人才。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球公民教育理论，包括知识、技能、价值观和态度四个维度。
AI.method: 定量研究的描述性调查设计，通过问卷调查收集数据，使用描述性统计和独立样本t检验分析。
AI.findings: 高中和大学生在全球公民能力各维度都表现出强烈认同，大学生在知识、价值观、态度和整体领域显著高于高中生，技能领域无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了全球公民能力理论框架在不同教育阶段的适用性，揭示了教育水平对全球公民能力发展的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了针对高中和大学生的情境化学习计划，通过定制活动维持和提升其全球公民能力。

title: Movement Lawyers: Henry L. Marsh's Long Struggle For Educational Justice

detail.title: Movement Lawyers: Henry L. Marsh's Long Struggle For Educational Justice
detail.abstract:
Even with Virginia’s critical importance to the national Civil Rights Movement, there remains little legal scholarship that centers the humanist social histories of Virginia’s civil rights lawyers. Existing work on civil rights, education, and Massive Resistance has emphasized state-level politics, judicial rulings, and a handful of prominent figures. Historians have analyzed Virginia’s legal approach to desegregation and key leaders, but they have largely overlooked the everyday experiences and strategies of Black Virginia lawyers who fought Massive Resistance on the ground.

This Article seeks to fill that gap by documenting the lived experiences and legal practices of these lawyers, focusing in particular on Henry L. Marsh. Scholarship on the NAACP’s school desegregation litigation is well established, but less attention has been paid to what that work looked like in day-to-day practice, the methods lawyers employed, and the continuing significance of those methods today. Marsh’s professional and personal life provides a rich site for this inquiry. By offering a nuanced analysis of his career and commitments, this Article expands our understanding of Virginia’s civil rights history and highlights the enduring relevance of movement lawyering to contemporary struggles for educational justice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过聚焦黑人律师Henry L. Marsh的日常实践，填补了弗吉尼亚州民权律师人文社会史的研究空白，揭示了基层反种族隔离斗争的法律策略及其对当代教育正义运动的持续意义。
AI.research_question: 弗吉尼亚州黑人律师在反对大规模抵制运动中的日常经验和法律实践是什么？这些实践对当代教育正义斗争有何持续意义？
AI.motivation: 现有研究过于关注州级政治、司法裁决和少数知名人物，忽视了基层黑人律师的日常经验和策略，需要填补这一人文社会史的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运动律师理论、民权运动史、法律实践研究
AI.method: 个案研究法，通过对Henry L. Marsh职业生涯和个人生活的细致分析， documenting其法律实践和 lived experiences
AI.findings: 揭示了基层民权律师在反对大规模抵制运动中的具体策略和实践方法，展现了运动律师工作的日常面貌
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了民权运动史的研究视角，从精英叙事转向基层实践，深化了对运动律师理论的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代教育正义斗争提供了历史经验和实践借鉴，强调了基层法律策略的持续相关性

title: Challenges in Scope Management: Trends, Gaps, and Implications for Project Success
affiliations: University of Johannesburg, Johannesburg, South Africa and University of Johannesburg, Johannesburg, South Africa

detail.title: Challenges in Scope Management: Trends, Gaps, and Implications for Project Success
detail.abstract: Scope management is widely recognized as a critical determinant of project success, yet its practices, applications, and outcomes vary significantly across industries and project types. Existing literature provides fragmented insights, with limited emphasis on methodological consistency and emerging technological solutions. This review synthesizes evidence from 2015 to 2025 to (i) identify prevalent approaches to scope management, (ii) assess their impact on project success, (iii) examine variations across industries and regulatory frameworks, and (iv) highlight methodological gaps and future research opportunities. A systematic search of Google Scholar, Web of Science, and Scopus retrieved 1,180 records. After duplicate removal and screening, 46 studies were included. Study characteristics, methodological quality, regulatory frameworks, and technological applications were analyzed. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. The final pool comprised literature reviews (43.48%), journal papers (17.39%), surveys (17.39%), systematic reviews (10.87%), interviews (6.53%), case studies (2.17%), and academic journals (2.17%). Most studies (82.61%) achieved moderate-to-high quality ratings. Project management software dominated (58.70%), strongly associated with cost reduction, quality assurance, and timeline adherence. Digital collaboration tools (28.26%) enhanced stakeholder involvement and interdepartmental coordination, while AI-driven risk assessment (10.87%) showed promise in predictive and preventive project management. Sectoral imbalances were evident, with infrastructure overrepresented and healthcare/IT underrepresented. Regulatory adoption was uneven, with PMBOK frequently applied, while ISO 21500 remained underutilized. Scope management practices contribute significantly to project success, but gaps persist in methodological rigor, sectoral diversity, and the exploration of emerging technologies. Future studies should expand beyond infrastructure, adopt standardized frameworks, and test digital and AI-enhanced tools. Practitioners are encouraged to integrate traditional documentation approaches with collaborative and predictive technologies to improve project outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文对2015-2025年范围管理研究进行系统综述，发现项目管理软件主导应用（58.70%），显著关联成本降低和质量保证；数字协作工具（28.26%）提升利益相关者参与度；AI风险评估（10.87%）在预测性项目管理中展现潜力。存在行业不平衡（基础设施过度代表，医疗/IT不足）和监管框架应用不均问题。
AI.research_question: 范围管理的普遍方法是什么？它们对项目成功的影响如何？不同行业和监管框架下存在哪些差异？存在哪些方法论差距和未来研究机会？
AI.motivation: 范围管理被广泛认为是项目成功的关键决定因素，但现有文献提供碎片化见解，缺乏方法论一致性和对新兴技术解决方案的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于项目管理理论框架，特别是PMBOK和ISO 21500标准，结合系统综述方法论。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，检索Google Scholar、Web of Science和Scopus数据库（2015-2025年），最终纳入46项研究，使用Newcastle-Ottawa Scale评估偏倚风险。
AI.findings: 1) 项目管理软件主导应用（58.70%），与成本降低、质量保证和时间表遵守强相关；2) 数字协作工具（28.26%）增强利益相关者参与和部门间协调；3) AI驱动风险评估（10.87%）在预测和预防性项目管理中显示潜力；4) 行业不平衡明显，基础设施过度代表，医疗/IT代表不足；5) 监管采用不均，PMBOK常用而ISO 21500未充分利用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统整合了范围管理领域的碎片化知识；2) 识别了方法论严谨性方面的差距；3) 提出了行业多样性不足的问题；4) 强调了新兴技术探索的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为从业者提供了范围管理最佳实践的证据基础；2) 鼓励整合传统文档方法与协作预测技术；3) 指出了需要超越基础设施行业扩展研究；4) 建议采用标准化框架测试数字和AI增强工具。

title: Transforming UAE's Supply Chain Management through Artificial Intelligence: Case Studies and Insights
affiliations: Symbiosis International University - Symbiosis Centre for Information Technology (SCIT) and Independent author

detail.title: Transforming UAE's Supply Chain Management through Artificial Intelligence: Case Studies and Insights
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integral to the United Arab Emirates' (UAE) vision of a diversified, high-tech economy. This research examines how AI is transforming supply chain management (SCM) in the UAE, driven by ambitious national strategies and multi-billion-dollar investments. We review the UAE's AI Strategy 2031 and its emphasis on logistics, then analyze several case studies-both government-led and private-to illustrate core AI applications in supply chains. Key use-cases include predictive demand forecasting, route optimization, predictive maintenance, and automation in logistics and retail. For example, AI-driven demand forecasting helps firms avoid under-or over-stocking, while autonomous logistics platforms like Dubai's Blink optimize routing and trade flows. Abu Dhabi's Advanced Trade and Logistics Platform (ATLP) integrates AI for real-time tracking and predictive analytics, cutting documentation by 90% and halving processing times. We find that AI implementations have yielded significant efficiency gains-from inventory cost reductions to faster deliveries-and are projected to add around AED 335 billion (~$91 billion) to the UAE economy by 2031. However, challenges persist in technology procurement, talent acquisition, data governance, and aligning with evolving geopolitical constraints. Using a qualitative case study methodology (with a Gioia coding approach for thematic analysis), we identify critical success factors such as clear needs assessment in public AI procurement and robust public-private partnerships. This paper offers insights and recommendations for UAE policymakers and industry leaders: pursue pilot-first implementations, strengthen the local AI talent pipeline (e.g. via MBZUAI), and ensure ethical and sustainable AI adoption. In conclusion, while AI is demonstrably transforming the UAE's supply chain landscape through enhanced efficiency and innovation, continued strategic oversight is required to address challenges and fully realize AI's potential in driving economic growth and competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI如何改变阿联酋供应链管理，通过案例研究分析AI应用如需求预测、路径优化等带来的效率提升和经济贡献，同时识别技术采购、人才获取等挑战，并提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变阿联酋的供应链管理？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋将AI作为经济多元化战略的核心，通过AI战略2031和数十亿美元投资推动供应链转型，需要研究其实际应用效果和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国家创新系统和数字化转型理论，结合供应链管理理论框架。
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，采用Gioia编码方法进行主题分析，分析政府和私营部门的多个案例。
AI.findings: AI实施带来显著效率提升：库存成本降低、交付时间缩短；预计到2031年为阿联酋经济贡献约3350亿迪拉姆；但面临技术采购、人才获取、数据治理等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家AI驱动的供应链转型理论，提供了国家战略与产业实践结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋政策制定者和行业领袖提供具体建议：试点优先实施、加强本地AI人才培养、确保AI采用的伦理和可持续性。

title: The Promise and Perils of Enterprise Data as Trade Secrets
affiliations: School of Law, City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: The Promise and Perils of Enterprise Data as Trade Secrets
detail.abstract:
Various types of information, whether physically embodied or existing purely in digital form, can subsist as data, ready for collection and use by relevant actors. A broad distinction, however, may be drawn between personal data, derived from individuals, and enterprise data, which typically comprises large-scale collections generated or acquired by firms during business operations. Enterprise data may include proprietary business information as well as personal and non-personal data collected from external sources such as customers or the public. A growing body of literature explores legal frameworks for protecting enterprise data, though the approaches vary. Jurisdictions worldwide have not reached a consensus on whether or how enterprise data may receive legal protection, despite vigorous debates. An emerging viewpoint across jurisdictions is protecting enterprise data as trade secrets. However, acceptance of the concept of enterprise data as trade secrets remains uncertain.

This article engages with this debate and contributes to the current literature on enterprise data as trade secrets from three perspectives. First, it reiterates the potential promise of trade secrets law by offering a doctrinal analysis showing how trade secrets law is resilient to protect diverse forms of enterprise data in the data economy, including three key categories in the form of purely confidential enterprise data, private data compilations, and “semi-public” enterprise data compilations. Second, this article, filling the literature gap, explores current cases, laws, and regulations in representative jurisdictions, the US, China, and the EU, documenting the extent to which the concept of enterprise data as trade secrets has been recognized. This positive analysis  highlights the status quo: the role of trade secrets law in protecting the first two categories of enterprise data has gained growing and continuous recognition, but its application to “semi‑public” enterprise data compilations remains limited. Third, based on the positive exploration, the article unpacks the challenges and risks associated with applying trade secrets law to “semi-public” enterprise data compilations, offering explanations for its limited acceptance compared to the other two types. It argues that protecting most “semi-public” data compilations as trade secrets does not serve the core theoretical aims of trade secrets law. This is because extending protection to these compilations fails to yield the business efficiency necessary to justify the associated costs. Thus, normatively, the article argues that trade secrets law should only protect the type of “semi-public” data compilation whose front-end access is meaningfully restricted to a limited number of users. At the same time, trade secrets law cannot be used to sanction data scraping activities that do not involve intrusion into a data holder’s system or direct circumvention of genuine access restrictions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将企业数据作为商业秘密保护的法律框架，分析了三种企业数据类型（纯机密数据、私有数据汇编和半公开数据汇编）在商业秘密法下的保护现状，指出对大多数半公开数据汇编适用商业秘密保护不符合该法的核心理论目标。
AI.research_question: 企业数据能否以及如何在法律上作为商业秘密获得保护？
AI.motivation: 随着数据经济的发展，企业数据的法律保护框架存在争议，各国对企业数据作为商业秘密的保护尚未达成共识，需要系统分析现有法律实践和理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业秘密法理论、数据经济学理论、法律实证分析和规范分析框架
AI.method: 教义分析法、比较法分析（美国、中国、欧盟）、案例研究、实证分析和规范分析
AI.findings: 1）商业秘密法能够灵活保护多种形式的企业数据；2）前两类企业数据的商业秘密保护获得持续认可；3）半公开数据汇编的商业秘密保护应用有限，因其无法产生必要的商业效率来证明相关成本；4）只应对前端访问有实质限制的半公开数据汇编提供保护
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了企业数据作为商业秘密保护的理论分析框架；2）揭示了商业秘密法保护不同类型企业数据的理论边界；3）提出了半公开数据汇编保护的规范性标准
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为立法者和司法实践提供参考；2）为企业数据保护策略提供指导；3）明确了数据抓取活动的法律边界

title: The Relationship between IoT-Based Information Integration, Decision-Making Uncertainty, and Supply Chain Performance
affiliations: Cranfield University - School of Management, Cranfield University - School of Management and Cranfield University - School of Management

detail.title: The Relationship between IoT-Based Information Integration, Decision-Making Uncertainty, and Supply Chain Performance
detail.abstract: This paper explores the interplay between the Internet of Things (IoT)-based information integration and decision-making uncertainty and their combined impact on supply chain performance. Survey data on 275 supply chain managers is analysed using partial least squares structural equation modelling to illustrate these relationships. IoT-based information integration and decisionmaking uncertainty is found to be a complex interaction between information accuracy, quality and efficiency; environmental complexity and richness; and demand distortion. The interactions between these factors partially mediate supply chain performance on cost management and production operations. This study provides empirical evidence for the information processing theorybased conceptualisation of the interaction between IoT-based information integration and decision-making uncertainty, and their interactions have a partial mediating role in improving supply chain performance. The research findings help supply chain managers develop a performance-oriented supply chain evaluation system to forecast the outcomes of implementing IoT-based information integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过PLS-SEM分析275名供应链管理者的调查数据，发现物联网信息集成与决策不确定性之间存在复杂互动关系，这些互动对供应链成本管理和生产运营绩效具有部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 物联网信息集成与决策不确定性如何相互作用，以及它们如何共同影响供应链绩效？
AI.motivation: 探索物联网技术在供应链信息集成中的应用，以及由此产生的决策不确定性对供应链绩效的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理理论，用于概念化物联网信息集成与决策不确定性之间的互动关系。
AI.method: 采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析275名供应链管理者的调查数据。
AI.findings: 物联网信息集成和决策不确定性涉及信息准确性、质量和效率；环境复杂性和丰富性；需求扭曲等因素的复杂互动，这些互动部分中介了供应链在成本管理和生产运营方面的绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基于信息处理理论的物联网信息集成与决策不确定性互动概念化提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助供应链管理者开发以绩效为导向的供应链评估系统，预测实施物联网信息集成的结果。

title: Budget Allocation for Utility Loss Minimization in Social Welfare Programs
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management

detail.title: Budget Allocation for Utility Loss Minimization in Social Welfare Programs
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Social welfare programs (e.g., healthcare insurance, social security assistance) play an indispensable role in modern societies. In these programs, a social planner needs to allocate limited budget to minimize agents' utility loss associated with adverse events. We formulate this as an optimization problem and solve the optimal allocation policy.

Methodology/results: We find that the optimal allocation policy has a cap structure, in which all excess loss above a universal threshold is covered. We also solve the optimal ratio allocation policy by developing a priority index for each loss event. We explore two practically relevant issues in the budget allocation: horizontal heterogeneity across groups and intertemporal trade-off across periods. For the first issue, we investigate the effects of pooling when there are multiple groups. We find that with the optimal cap policy or under homogeneous loss distributions, it is optimal to integrate all groups with a common policy. For the second issue, we develop a dynamic model in which the social planner balances between spending for current period and saving for the future.  We reveal a piecewise-concave pattern of the optimal spending amount: the marginal spending rate for current period decreases in the fund level when the coverage scope is fixed, but experiences upward jumps when the coverage scope is expanded. The managerial insights are illustrated by numerical experiments and a case study based on actual data.

Managerial implications: We develop a unified framework for the budget allocation decision in social welfare programs, which are essential to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Our analytical results provide actionable insights for the integration and sustainability of welfare programs, which are major reform goals of many developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了社会福利项目中的预算分配优化问题，提出了最优分配政策具有上限结构的特点，并探讨了群体异质性和跨期权衡两个实践问题。
AI.research_question: 社会福利项目中如何最优分配有限预算以最小化代理人因不利事件造成的效用损失？
AI.motivation: 社会福利项目在现代社会中扮演着不可或缺的角色，但预算有限，需要优化分配以实现最大效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于优化理论和社会福利经济学，构建预算分配的最优化模型。
AI.method: 采用数学优化方法，开发优先级指数，建立动态模型，并通过数值实验和实际案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 最优分配政策具有上限结构；在群体异质性情况下，整合所有群体采用共同政策是最优的；跨期分配呈现分段凹模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会福利预算分配的统一理论框架，发展了优先级指数和动态优化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家福利项目的整合和可持续性改革提供了可操作的决策见解，支持联合国可持续发展目标的实现。

title: Rushed Justice: The Value of Fast-Track Dispute Systems on Second-Hand Platforms
affiliations: Rice University and Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Rushed Justice: The Value of Fast-Track Dispute Systems on Second-Hand Platforms
detail.abstract: Problem Definition: Buyers on secondhand platforms often face uncertainties related to product quality, which frequently leads to disputes with sellers. Therefore, online dispute resolution systems (ODR) play a critical role not only in facilitating transactions, but also in influencing how sellers manage product quality. This paper investigates how different ODR system designs affect the users and the overall platform performance. Methodology/Results: We utilize a game-theoretic model to analyze two prevalent ODR system designs: Swift ODR, which streamlines dispute resolution with minimal seller involvement, and Comprehensive ODR, which requires active participation from both the seller and the buyer in resolving dispute. Our results demonstrate that Swift ODR can incentivize sellers to maintain higher product quality, which improves consumer welfare, even when its accuracy in resolving disputes is lower than that of Comprehensive ODR. Moreover, we find that the platform benefits more from Swift ODR if there is a sufficiently high proportion of honest sellers. Interestingly, we also find that Swift ODR can be preferable in a platform with fewer honest sellers under certain combinations of commission rates and judging accuracy. Managerial Implications: Our findings suggest that a simpler and less accurate dispute system can have the potential to deliver higher product quality, greater platform profit, and improved consumer welfare. Platforms should strategically design their ODR systems by closely evaluating the market compositions, the accuracy of dispute resolutions, and commission structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，相比复杂的全面ODR系统，虽然简单快速的Swift ODR系统在争议解决准确性上较低，但能激励卖家维持更高产品质量，提升消费者福利和平台利润，特别是在诚实卖家比例较高的平台上效果更佳。
AI.research_question: 不同在线争议解决系统（ODR）设计如何影响用户行为和平台整体表现？
AI.motivation: 二手平台买家面临产品质量不确定性，容易与卖家产生争议，ODR系统不仅促进交易，还影响卖家质量管理策略
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型分析
AI.method: 使用博弈论模型分析两种主流ODR系统设计：Swift ODR（简化流程，卖家参与度低）和Comprehensive ODR（买卖双方积极参与）
AI.findings: Swift ODR能激励卖家维持更高产品质量，改善消费者福利，即使其争议解决准确性低于Comprehensive ODR；平台在诚实卖家比例较高时从Swift ODR获益更多；在某些佣金率和判断准确度组合下，Swift ODR在诚实卖家较少的平台也可行
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ODR系统设计对卖家质量管理和平台绩效影响的理论框架，挑战了"准确性越高越好"的传统认知
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了ODR系统设计的战略指导：评估市场构成、争议解决准确性和佣金结构，选择适合的ODR系统类型

title: Loglinear and Linear Approximate Solutions for Finite-Time Consumption-Investment Problem
affiliations: Shiga University and Shiga University

detail.title: Loglinear and Linear Approximate Solutions for Finite-Time Consumption-Investment Problem
detail.abstract: Assuming a quadratic security market model and homotopic robust utility in the finite-time consumption-investment problem, a secondorder nonhomogeneous nonlinear partial differential equation is derived. This study introduces two types of time-dependent loglinear approximation methods related to the nonhomogeneous term and four types of time-dependent linear approximation methods for the nonlinear term. The study derives loglinear approximate solutions and showcases the results of linear approximate solutions. The study then compares the approximation accuracies of the approximate optimal portfolios based on these approximate solutions. The numerical analysis indicates that the accuracies of both loglinear approximate optimal portfolios are very low, whereas those of all linear approximate optimal portfolios are very high.

AI.tldr: 该研究在二次安全市场模型和同伦鲁棒效用下，推导了有限时间消费投资问题的二阶非齐次非线性偏微分方程，提出了多种时间依赖的近似方法，并通过数值分析比较了不同近似最优投资组合的精度。
AI.research_question: 在二次安全市场模型和同伦鲁棒效用框架下，如何有效求解有限时间消费投资问题中的二阶非齐次非线性偏微分方程？不同近似方法的精度表现如何？
AI.motivation: 有限时间消费投资问题中的非线性偏微分方程求解困难，需要开发有效的近似方法来获得可行的最优投资策略解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二次安全市场模型、同伦鲁棒效用理论、非线性偏微分方程理论、近似方法理论
AI.method: 提出了两类时间依赖的对数线性近似方法（针对非齐次项）和四类时间依赖的线性近似方法（针对非线性项），推导近似解并比较最优投资组合的近似精度
AI.findings: 数值分析显示，对数线性近似最优投资组合的精度非常低，而所有线性近似最优投资组合的精度都非常高
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了针对非线性偏微分方程的多类时间依赖近似方法，丰富了金融数学中消费投资问题的求解理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际投资决策提供了高精度的线性近似方法，可用于构建有效的投资组合策略

title: AI vs AI: The Battle Between Artificial and Artistic Intelligence to Shape Human Creativity
affiliations: ESCP Business School and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: AI vs AI: The Battle Between Artificial and Artistic Intelligence to Shape Human Creativity

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence is advancing across multiple fields and raising questions about the role of human creativity. Has our innate artistic innovation become obsolete and outdated? We present the potential upside and limits of Artificial Intelligence by proposing another "AI" lens to look through "Artistic Intelligence." We highlight the importance of blending Artificial Intelligence and Artistic Intelligence, AI & AI, while acknowledging the pitfalls in trying to use algorithms to create subversive forms of art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过"艺术智能"视角审视人工智能在艺术领域的潜力与局限，强调需要融合人工智能与艺术智能(AI & AI)，同时指出算法创造颠覆性艺术的陷阱
AI.research_question: 人工智能是否使人类与生俱来的艺术创造力变得过时？人工智能在艺术创作中的优势和局限是什么？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在多个领域的快速发展引发了对人类创造力角色的质疑，需要重新审视AI在艺术领域的应用潜力和边界
AI.theoretical_framework: 艺术智能(Artistic Intelligence)理论框架，作为审视人工智能艺术创作的新视角
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过提出"艺术智能"视角来对比分析人工智能的艺术创作能力
AI.findings: 人工智能在艺术创作中既有潜力也有局限，需要与人类艺术智能相结合，算法在创造颠覆性艺术形式方面存在固有缺陷
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"艺术智能"的理论概念，为理解AI与人类创造力关系提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为艺术创作领域提供了AI应用的指导原则，强调人机协作而非替代的重要性

title: Accelerating the Deployment of China's National Standard and Industrialisation of Quantum Resistant Cryptography (PQC) Proposal for Building National Security "Double Insurance" in Quantum Era
affiliations: Dhurakij Pundit University

detail.title: Accelerating the Deployment of China's National Standard and Industrialisation of Quantum Resistant Cryptography (PQC) Proposal for Building National Security "Double Insurance" in Quantum Era
detail.abstract: Under the threat window of ‘interception first, decryption later’ in quantum computing, national security and industrial sovereignty face new systemic challenges. This paper proposes a dual-track approach of ‘PQC baseline + QKD enhancement’ to comprehensively compare the standard systems, governance models, and engineering progress of China and the United States in post-quantum cryptography (PQC) and quantum key distribution (QKD). The study employs a three-tier evidence integration framework of ‘policy-standards-engineering,’ combining authoritative documents from NIST, OMB, CISA, and other sources with China's national standard platform and industry announcements. It constructs an analysis model of ‘standard hierarchy-migration ecosystem-international interoperability’ and evaluates the feasibility of the scheme through gap-risk mapping, roadmap design, and KPI matrix assessment. The results show that the United States has established a closed-loop system of ‘primary standards + redundancy’ based on FIPS 203/204/205 and HQC backup algorithms, and has entered an auditable implementation phase driven by mandatory migration and toolchain initiatives from OMB and CISA; China maintains an advantage in QKD engineering and standardisation, but national standards for PQC have not yet been solidified, and the migration governance system lags behind, resulting in a structural shortfall of ‘engineering leading the way while algorithm standards lag behind.’ Based on this, this paper proposes a ‘three-year-five-year-ten-year’ national roadmap: establish a standardised baseline within three years, achieve large-scale migration and verification within five years, and complete consolidation and internationalisation within ten years. This will be supplemented by protocols, PKI/certificates, key lifecycle management, testing and certification, and algorithm switching mechanisms, in conjunction with a five-tier governance structure led by the State Cryptography Administration, with TC260/TC485 as the technical focal points, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/ the Cyberspace Administration of China/People's Bank of China, operator and critical infrastructure implementation, and research institutes. The conclusion states that PQC must be established as the ‘basic defence line’ in the quantum era, while QKD should serve as the ‘enhanced defence line’ for critical links; China must complete the construction of PQC national standards and migration governance capabilities within a three-year standardisation, five-year consolidation, and ten-year internationalisation timeline, and achieve dual-track integration and international interoperability with the QKD standard suite, thereby safeguarding national security, consolidating industrial resilience, and enhancing international influence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'PQC基线+QKD增强'的双轨方案，比较中美在后量子密码和量子密钥分发领域的标准体系、治理模式和工程进展，为中国制定三年标准化、五年规模化、十年国际化的国家路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何在量子计算威胁下通过'PQC基线+QKD增强'双轨方案构建国家密码安全体系，并比较中美两国在该领域的发展差异？
AI.motivation: 量子计算'先截获后解密'威胁窗口下，国家安全和产业主权面临新的系统性挑战，需要建立抗量子密码防御体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策-标准-工程三层证据整合框架，标准层级-迁移生态系统-国际互操作性分析模型
AI.method: 结合NIST、OMB、CISA等权威文件与中国国家标准平台和行业公告，通过差距-风险映射、路线图设计和KPI矩阵评估方案可行性
AI.findings: 美国基于FIPS 203/204/205和HQC备份算法建立了'主标准+冗余'闭环系统，进入可审计实施阶段；中国在QKD工程和标准化保持优势，但PQC国标尚未固化，迁移治理体系滞后
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了'标准层级-迁移生态系统-国际互操作性'分析模型，提出了双轨防御理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了中国'三年标准化、五年规模化、十年国际化'的国家路线图，设计了五层治理结构和配套机制方案

title: La justice organisationnelle comme levier de performance individuelle: une étude qualitative exploratoire
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: La justice organisationnelle comme levier de performance individuelle: une étude qualitative exploratoire
detail.abstract: Cette étude explore la relation entre justice organisationnelle et performance individuelle à travers une approche qualitative. Si les recherches antérieures ont largement démontré des corrélations positives entre la perception de l'équité et les résultats des employés, la plupart des études ont adopté des méthodes quantitatives, négligeant souvent les expériences subjectives et contextualisées des employés et des managers. Cette recherche vise à mieux comprendre comment la perception de la justice influence la satisfaction au travail, l'engagement professionnel et, in fine, la performance individuelle.L'étude repose sur 20 entretiens semi-directifs menés auprès de cadres d'organisations du secteur privé au Maroc. Les données ont été analysées thématiquement à l'aide de NVivo 10, combinant une approche déductive (basée sur les dimensions théoriques de la justice distributive, procédurale, interactionnelle et informationnelle) et une approche inductive pour permettre l'émergence de nouvelles perspectives à partir des récits des participants.Ces résultats soulignent l'importance de promouvoir l'équité, la transparence, la reconnaissance et une communication claire au sein des organisations. En favorisant la justice organisationnelle, les managers peuvent améliorer le bien-être et la performance individuelle des employés, créant ainsi une valeur durable pour l'organisation. Contrairement aux recherches antérieures s'appuyant principalement sur des analyses quantitatives, cette étude qualitative offre une compréhension nuancée et expérientielle de l'impact de la justice organisationnelle sur la satisfaction, l'engagement et la performance. Elle contribue à la littérature en mettant en évidence les mécanismes subjectifs par lesquels les perceptions d'équité se traduisent en résultats professionnels individuels.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性方法探讨组织公平感与个人绩效的关系，基于20位摩洛哥私营企业高管的半结构化访谈，发现公平、透明、认可和清晰沟通对员工满意度和绩效有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 组织公平感如何影响员工的工作满意度、职业承诺和个人绩效？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要采用定量方法证明公平感与员工结果的正相关关系，但忽视了员工和管理者的主观体验和情境化经历。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分配公平、程序公平、互动公平和信息公平四个理论维度
AI.method: 对摩洛哥私营企业20位高管进行半结构化访谈，使用NVivo 10进行主题分析，结合演绎和归纳方法
AI.findings: 促进公平、透明、认可和清晰沟通能提升员工福祉和个人绩效，为组织创造持续价值
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对组织公平感影响满意度和绩效的细致化、体验性理解，揭示了公平感知转化为个人职业结果的主观机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了通过提升组织公平来改善员工福祉和绩效的具体实践建议

title: AI Imaginaries: A Critical Lens for Managerial Action
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: AI Imaginaries: A Critical Lens for Managerial Action

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is often presented in binary terms: either as a threat to humanity or as a miracle solution to all our problems. This opposition-between fear of a dystopian future and hope for an ideal one-is amplified by the media, yet it oversimplifies a much more complex reality. To make informed decisions in response to the transformations driven by AI, it is essential to understand that this technology is not fixed: it is a "technologyin-the-making," shaped by the discourses we produce about it. Analysing these discourses is therefore crucial, as they actively contribute to constructing what we refer to as "AI." In this context, we propose a critical reading of public discourse on AI through the lens of social imaginaries. This concept sheds light not only on the moral dimension of such discourse, but also on the worldview, or cosmology, it conveys, while emphasizing the central role of imagination in shaping our collective understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文通过社会想象理论批判性分析AI公共话语，揭示其不仅包含道德维度，还传达世界观，强调想象在塑造集体认知中的核心作用，超越AI威胁与奇迹的二元对立。
AI.research_question: 如何通过社会想象理论来批判性分析人工智能的公共话语？
AI.motivation: AI常被简化为威胁或奇迹的二元对立，这种媒体放大的对立忽视了更复杂的现实，需要通过分析话语来理解AI作为"进行中的技术"的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会想象理论（social imaginaries），强调话语在构建技术现实中的作用，关注道德维度、世界观和集体想象。
AI.method: 批判性话语分析，通过社会想象理论视角分析AI公共话语。
AI.findings: AI公共话语不仅包含道德判断，还传达特定的世界观和宇宙观，想象在塑造集体对AI的理解中扮演核心角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会想象理论应用于AI话语分析，提供了超越技术决定论的理论框架，强调话语在技术建构中的积极作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、媒体和公众提供更细致的AI理解框架，帮助做出更明智的决策，避免简单二元对立的思维陷阱。

title: AI Capabilities and Strategic Agility in Emerging Markets: A Systematic Review and Integrative Framework
affiliations: University of the West of Scotland - University of the West of Scotland, School of Business & Enterprise, Students

detail.title: AI Capabilities and Strategic Agility in Emerging Markets: A Systematic Review and Integrative Framework
detail.abstract: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping strategy, yet its capacity to foster strategic agility in emerging markets remains underexplored. This Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA)-guided review synthesizes evidence from 37 peer-reviewed studies (2020-2025), appraises their quality using Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) and Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) criteria, and, drawing on the resource-based view, dynamic capabilities, and institutional theory, proposes a context-sensitive framework explaining how AI capabilities translate into strategic agility through sensing-seizing-reconfiguring routines, with effects contingent on organizational mediators and contextual moderators, underscoring the need to align AI initiatives with local conditions. While acknowledging limitations related to construct heterogeneity, sectoral and geographic biases, and the rapid evolution of AI, the review offers nine testable propositions, practical recommendations for managers and policymakers, and a robust agenda for future research.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过系统文献综述，基于资源基础观、动态能力和制度理论，提出了一个情境敏感框架，解释AI能力如何通过感知-把握-重构机制转化为战略敏捷性，并受到组织和情境因素的调节。
AI.research_question: 人工智能能力如何在新兴市场中促进战略敏捷性？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在重塑战略，但其在新兴市场中促进战略敏捷性的能力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观、动态能力理论、制度理论
AI.method: PRISMA指导的系统文献综述，分析了37篇同行评审研究（2020-2025），使用CASP和JBI标准评估质量
AI.findings: 提出了一个情境敏感框架，解释AI能力通过感知-把握-重构机制转化为战略敏捷性，效果受组织中介因素和情境调节因素影响
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了9个可检验的命题，为未来研究提供了稳健的研究议程
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和政策制定者提供了实践建议，强调需要将AI计划与当地条件相匹配

title: How involvement in healthcare relates to attitudes towards the healthcare system: A participatory panel survey in Fryslân, the Netherlands
affiliations: University of Groningen, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Groningen

detail.title: How involvement in healthcare relates to attitudes towards the healthcare system: A participatory panel survey in Fryslân, the Netherlands
detail.abstract: Background The Dutch healthcare system faces significant pressure from population ageing, resource constraints, and provider shortages, particularly in peripheral regions like Fryslân. Public attitudes toward healthcare reforms are crucial here as they affect the acceptability and sustainability of systemic changes, yet the influence of direct involvement (as patients or providers) on these attitudes remains underexplored. Methods We conducted a participatory panel survey among 3,230 residents of Fryslân to examine how direct involvement in healthcare, as a patient, provider, or both, relates to attitudes toward the healthcare system. The survey was co-developed and interpretated with Experts by Experience (EbE). Data were weighted to reflect the population, with missing values imputed. We used linear regression and post-hoc interaction analyses to assess how healthcare involvement and demographic factors (age, income, education) shaped views on satisfaction with the healthcare system and support for reform. Results Inhabitants generally had neutral attitudes towards the healthcare system, expressing moderate satisfaction and mild support for reforms. Direct involvement had a limited overall impact; however, healthcare providers showed more negative attitudes. Age was a significant predictor, with younger inhabitants (especially healthcare providers) showing greater dissatisfaction. The EbE involvement notably enhanced survey clarity and contextual relevance while fostering mutual learning. Conclusions This study highlights the necessity for a nuanced understanding of attitudes towards healthcare systems, emphasizing the interplay of demographic characteristics. They also underscore the need for both general and tailored reform strategies that incorporate diverse perspectives when strengthening healthcare systems, including those beyond patients and providers alone, to achieve legitimate and sustainable healthcare reforms.

AI.tldr: 荷兰弗里斯兰地区医疗系统面临老龄化等压力，研究发现居民对医疗系统态度中性，直接参与（患者/提供者）影响有限，但医疗提供者态度更负面，年龄是重要预测因素，年轻提供者更不满意。
AI.research_question: 直接参与医疗（作为患者、提供者或两者）如何影响居民对医疗系统的态度？
AI.motivation: 荷兰医疗系统面临人口老龄化、资源限制和提供者短缺的压力，公众态度对医疗改革的接受度和可持续性至关重要，但直接参与对态度的影响研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公众态度与医疗改革接受度的关系理论，参与式研究框架，专家经验（EbE）参与的理论基础。
AI.method: 对弗里斯兰3,230名居民进行参与式面板调查，与经验专家共同开发和解释调查，数据加权和缺失值填补，使用线性回归和事后交互分析。
AI.findings: 居民对医疗系统态度总体中性，满意度中等，对改革支持温和；直接参与影响有限，但医疗提供者态度更负面；年龄是显著预测因素，年轻居民（特别是提供者）更不满意。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对医疗系统态度形成机制的理解，强调了人口特征与直接参与的交互作用，验证了经验专家参与研究方法的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗改革政策制定提供了实证依据，强调需要兼顾普适性和针对性策略，建议纳入患者和提供者之外的多元视角以确保改革的合法性和可持续性。

title: Developing IFRI: An AI- and Quantum-Augmented Framework for Accounting-Based Financial Resilience

detail.title: Developing IFRI: An AI- and Quantum-Augmented Framework for Accounting-Based Financial Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or patient data, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Prevailing measures of financial resilience—such as the Financial Resilience Score and Index—remain methodologically constrained, relying on static, backward-looking ratios and neglecting the interpretive and predictive value of narrative disclosures, sustainability semantics, and systemic volatility. This study introduces the Integrated Financial Resilience Index (IFRI), a novel, AI-augmented, IFRS-consistent framework that reconceptualizes resilience as a multidimensional, forward-looking construct. IFRI integrates structured financial ratios, sentiment-adjusted narrative analysis, quantum-inspired asset valuation under entangled macroeconomic shocks, ESG–NLP alignment, and macroeconomic uncertainty scaling. Its architecture comprises five interdependent modules: Stability Score, Sentiment-Adjusted Cash Flow, Quantum-Adjusted Valuation, ESG–NLP Alignment, and Economic Uncertainty Index. By unifying neural, linguistic, and quantum-computational modeling within an accounting-anchored measurement system, IFRI advances methodological precision, bridges structured–unstructured analytics and establishes a rigorous basis for empirical validation. This framework expands the frontier of resilience assessment in accounting research, enabling systematic, integrated, and predictive evaluation of corporate stability under complex global risk dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了集成财务弹性指数(IFRI)，这是一个AI增强的、符合IFRS的多维度前瞻性框架，整合了财务比率、情感调整叙事分析、量子启发资产估值、ESG-NLP对齐和宏观经济不确定性缩放，以提升企业财务弹性评估的方法论精度和预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个集成结构化财务数据和非结构化叙事信息的多维度前瞻性财务弹性评估框架？
AI.motivation: 现有财务弹性衡量方法（如财务弹性评分和指数）存在方法论局限，依赖静态、后向的比率分析，忽视了叙事披露、可持续性语义和系统性波动的解释和预测价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维财务弹性理论，整合结构化财务分析、情感分析理论、量子计算启发估值模型、ESG-NLP对齐理论和宏观经济不确定性理论。
AI.method: 开发IFRI框架，包含五个相互依赖模块：稳定性评分、情感调整现金流、量子调整估值、ESG-NLP对齐和经济不确定性指数，采用神经计算、语言学和量子计算建模方法。
AI.findings: IFRI框架能够提供更精确、集成和预测性的企业稳定性评估，在复杂全球风险动态下具有优越的方法论表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了会计研究中弹性评估的前沿，统一了神经、语言和量子计算建模，建立了结构化与非结构化分析之间的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者提供了系统化、集成化和预测性的企业稳定性评估工具，支持在复杂风险环境下的决策制定。

title: Bitcoin and Cryptocurrency Standards Document a Comprehensive Framework for Secure Digital Asset Operations
affiliations: Blockchain Technology & Digital Asset Standards

detail.title: Bitcoin and Cryptocurrency Standards Document a Comprehensive Framework for Secure Digital Asset Operations
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of digital assets has outpaced the development of standardized operational, security, and compliance frameworks. While cryptocurrencies have achieved widespread adoption, the absence of institutional-grade standards poses systemic risks to exchanges, custodians, and regulators alike. This paper introduces a comprehensive 50-standard framework across 10 critical domains of cryptocurrency operations, including node infrastructure, wallet security, mining, exchange integrity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and interoperability. Unlike prior academic or policy treatments, this framework is designed to be both theoretical and implementable, providing phased adoption roadmaps and real-world case studies (Coinbase, Binance, Ethereum Merge, Ledger, MicroStrategy, El Salvador).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含50个标准的加密货币运营框架，涵盖10个关键领域，旨在解决数字资产快速发展中缺乏机构级标准的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个既具有理论深度又具备实践可行性的加密货币运营标准框架？
AI.motivation: 数字资产的快速增长超过了标准化运营、安全和合规框架的发展速度，缺乏机构级标准给交易所、托管机构和监管机构带来了系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于加密货币运营的10个关键领域构建的理论框架，包括节点基础设施、钱包安全、挖矿、交易所完整性、监管合规、隐私和互操作性等。
AI.method: 开发包含50个标准的综合框架，提供分阶段采用路线图和真实案例分析（Coinbase、Binance、以太坊合并、Ledger、MicroStrategy、萨尔瓦多）。
AI.findings: 成功构建了一个既理论又实用的加密货币运营标准框架，为行业提供了可实施的指导方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了加密货币领域标准化理论框架的空白，为后续学术研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所、托管机构、监管机构等提供了具体的实施路线图和案例参考，有助于降低系统性风险并促进行业规范化发展。

title: The Daughter Effect in CEO Appointments: Evidence from Swedish SMEs
affiliations: Royal Institute of Technology (KTH)

detail.title: The Daughter Effect in CEO Appointments: Evidence from Swedish SMEs
detail.abstract: Appointing a female CEO is an endogenous decision shaped by firm-specific preferences and organizational characteristics, which makes it challenging to identify the causal drivers of gender diversity in executive leadership. This paper examines whether male board directors with daughters are more likely to support the appointment of female CEOs. Drawing on matched employer-employee data from approximately 7,000 Swedish SMEs, I find that firms with a higher share of daughter-having male directors are significantly more likely to appoint a female CEO. To mitigate concerns about reverse causality, the analysis includes robustness checks focusing on directors whose daughters were born after their board appointment. These findings suggest that the gender composition of directors' children may serve as a quasi-exogenous predictor of CEO gender and could be leveraged in future research. However, limitations remain, particularly concerning residual endogeneity and the specificity of the Swedish context.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，拥有女儿男性董事比例较高的瑞典中小企业更可能任命女性CEO，这表明董事子女性别构成可作为CEO性别的准外生预测因素。
AI.research_question: 男性董事会成员拥有女儿是否更可能支持任命女性CEO？
AI.motivation: 任命女性CEO是受企业特定偏好和组织特征影响的内生决策，这使得识别高管领导层性别多样性的因果驱动因素具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会认同理论和接触理论，研究探讨董事个人家庭经历（拥有女儿）对其支持女性领导的态度影响。
AI.method: 使用约7,000家瑞典中小企业的匹配雇主-雇员数据，采用回归分析方法，并通过董事在董事会任命后生育女儿的样本进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 拥有女儿男性董事比例较高的企业显著更可能任命女性CEO，即使在控制内生性问题后结果仍然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为高管性别多样性研究提供了新的准外生识别策略，拓展了个人家庭经历如何影响组织决策的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会多元化实践提供实证依据，表明董事的个人生活经历可能影响其对女性领导的支持态度。

title: Using Labels, Not Law, to Justify Lethal Force: Inside the Venezuelan Boat Strike
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: Using Labels, Not Law, to Justify Lethal Force: Inside the Venezuelan Boat Strike

publicationDetails.journalName: Emory University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: President Donald Trump announced on Tuesday that the U.S. military had attacked an alleged drug vessel in international waters, killing what he described as 11 "terrorists" who he claimed were members of the Tren de Aragua gang from Venezuela. The strike, which appears to be unlawful under international and domestic law, marks a sweeping escalation and departure from the U.S. military's approach to drug interdiction. Borrowing language from the post-9/11 "Global War on Terror," the Trump administration is attempting to turn counternarcotics missions into counterterrorism operations. But applying a new label to an old problem does not transform the problem itself, nor does it grant the U.S. president or the U.S. military expanded legal authority to kill civilians.

AI.tldr: 特朗普政府试图将禁毒任务重新定义为反恐行动，以扩大军事行动的法律权限，但这种标签转换并不能改变问题的本质或赋予额外的法律权力
AI.research_question: 将禁毒行动重新定义为反恐行动是否能赋予美国总统和美军扩大的法律权限来杀害平民
AI.motivation: 分析特朗普政府将禁毒任务转变为反恐行动的法律和政治含义，以及这种标签转换对国际法和国内法的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法框架、反恐战争理论、禁毒政策理论、行政权力理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策比较分析、案例研究（特朗普政府对委内瑞拉毒贩的军事打击）
AI.findings: 将禁毒行动重新标签为反恐行动并不能改变行动的本质，也不能为杀害平民提供额外的法律依据，这种做法违反了国际法和国内法
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了标签转换理论在军事行动中的局限性，丰富了反恐战争与禁毒政策交叉领域的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律学者提供了关于军事行动合法性的重要参考，警示滥用反恐标签的法律风险

title: Surplus Food Retailing with Pay-What-You-Want Pricing
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Paul Merage School of Business, University of California, Irvine - Paul Merage School of Business and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: Surplus Food Retailing with Pay-What-You-Want Pricing
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Surplus food retailing is a rapidly expanding sector that specializes in selling wholesome leftover food items from regular retailers at substantially discounted prices, thereby reducing food waste and improving access for food-insecure populations. Surplus retailers are increasingly embracing a "pay-whatyou-want" (PWYW) selling scheme where consumers determine the price they pay for surplus food. In this paper, we examine the impact of such a practice on food supply chains. Methodology/results: We develop a game-theoretic model that captures strategic interactions among a regular retailer, a surplus retailer, and consumers with varying budgets. We show that, although the payment flexibility of PWYW enables more consumers to afford food that would otherwise be wasted, a PWYW scheme at the surplus retailer can increase food waste or reduce access for the food-insecure community relative to a posted-price scheme. This is because PWYW can also influence the regular retailer's procurement quantity and in turn, the supply to the surplus retailer. In particular, reduced access can occur in bargain-hunting markets where consumers treat PWYW as a freeloading opportunity, or in prosocial markets where consumers pay their fair share. Increased food waste, on the other hand, can arise in markets that display neither inclination. Further, in the absence of a donation mandate, the regular retailer may be more reluctant to donate surplus food if the surplus retailer adopts PWYW rather than a posted-price scheme. Nevertheless, under the right circumstances, PWYW can be a triple win that reduces food waste, improves access, and boosts the surplus retailer's profit. Managerial implications: Our paper tells a cautionary tale about PWYW in surplus food retailing and highlights the importance of accounting for market and regulatory conditions in evaluating the environmental and social implications of different pricing mechanisms for selling surplus food.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析剩余食品零售中"随你付"(PWYW)定价策略的影响，发现虽然PWYW能让更多消费者负担得起原本会被浪费的食品，但相比固定价格策略，PWYW可能增加食品浪费或减少食品不安全人群的获取机会，具体效果取决于市场类型。
AI.research_question: 剩余食品零售商采用"随你付"(PWYW)定价策略对食品供应链（包括食品浪费和食品不安全人群获取）的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 剩余食品零售是一个快速发展的领域，专门以大幅折扣销售正规零售商的剩余食品，既能减少食物浪费又能帮助食品不安全人群。PWYW定价策略在该领域日益流行，但其对整体供应链的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，包含正规零售商、剩余零售商和具有不同预算的消费者之间的战略互动
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型，分析不同市场条件下（讨价还价型市场、亲社会型市场等）PWYW与固定价格策略的比较
AI.findings: 1) PWYW可能增加食品浪费或减少食品不安全人群的获取机会；2) 在缺乏捐赠强制要求时，正规零售商更不愿意捐赠剩余食品；3) 但在适当条件下，PWYW可以实现减少浪费、改善获取和提高利润的三赢局面
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析PWYW在剩余食品零售中的供应链影响，揭示了定价策略与食品浪费、社会公平之间的复杂关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为剩余食品零售商提供定价策略选择指导，强调需要根据市场特征和监管环境来评估不同定价机制的环境和社会影响

title: AI Transparency's Double Edge: Consumer Data Monetization and Privacy Regulation in Online Retail Supply Chains
affiliations: Hunan University, University of Bristol Business School, Hunan University, Hunan University and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: AI Transparency's Double Edge: Consumer Data Monetization and Privacy Regulation in Online Retail Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) transparency enables online retailers to enhance product and service offerings, thereby reducing consumer inconvenience costs. However, it simultaneously amplifies privacy concerns, prompting regulatory responses such as the GDPR. This study develops a gametheoretic model of a decentralized two-tier online retail supply chain, comprising a supplier and a retailer, to examine how privacy regulation-mandated AI transparency reshapes consumer data monetization strategies. We compare two regimes: (1) AI transparency without regulation, which allows both direct monetization (selling consumer data) and indirect monetization (improving services), and (2) privacy regulation with mandated transparency, which restricts monetization to the indirect channel and diminishes its efficacy according to regulatory stringency. Our analysis reveals that, under AI transparency, indirect monetization consistently serves as the retailer's dominant profit driver, with direct monetization playing a secondary role. When considering privacy regulation, weak privacy regulation universally improves welfare for consumers, retailers, and suppliers. In contrast, strong regulation yields welfare gains only in price-insensitive markets, but harms all parties when consumers are price sensitive. Across scenarios, stakeholders preferred regulatory intensity emerges endogenously: price-sensitive consumers favor weaker regulation, whereas price-insensitive consumers prefer stronger protections. Further model extensions, including centralized supply chain scenarios and democratization of consumer inconvenience costs, confirm that the main model's findings are robust. Our research offers novel theoretical insights and actionable managerial guidance for data governance in digital supply chains, highlighting the nuanced interplay between AI transparency, privacy regulation, and market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过博弈论模型分析AI透明度和隐私监管对在线零售供应链数据货币化策略的影响，发现在AI透明环境下间接货币化是主要利润来源，隐私监管强度需根据市场特性（价格敏感度）进行差异化设计
AI.research_question: 隐私监管要求的AI透明度如何重塑消费者数据货币化策略？
AI.motivation: AI透明度在提升服务的同时加剧隐私担忧，促使GDPR等监管出台，需要研究监管对数据货币化策略的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分散式双层在线零售供应链（供应商+零售商）
AI.method: 构建博弈论模型，比较两种制度：无监管AI透明度（直接+间接货币化）和监管要求的透明度（仅间接货币化且效率降低）
AI.findings: 1. AI透明下间接货币化是主要利润来源；2. 弱监管普遍提升各方福利；3. 强监管仅在价格不敏感市场有利，价格敏感市场损害各方利益；4. 不同利益相关者偏好不同的监管强度
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字供应链数据治理提供新的理论见解，揭示AI透明度、隐私监管与市场动态之间的微妙相互作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字供应链中的数据治理提供可操作的管理指导，帮助制定差异化的隐私监管策略

title: From Legal Experimentation to Regulatory Sandboxes: The EU's Pioneering Approach to Digital Innovation and Regulation
affiliations: University of Macerata, Department of Law and IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca

detail.title: From Legal Experimentation to Regulatory Sandboxes: The EU's Pioneering Approach to Digital Innovation and Regulation
detail.abstract: This contribution explores the concept of regulatory experimentation as a strategic response to the challenges of regulating emerging technologies within conventional regulatory frameworks. The rapid pace of technological innovation often outpaces traditional regulatory approaches, necessitating a more agile and adaptive framework. Regulatory experimentation, particularly through the use of regulatory sandboxes, has emerged as a promising solution. These controlled environments allow companies to develop, test and refine innovative products and services under regulatory oversight, while regulators refine their frameworks in real time to ensure adaptability, market safety and compliance with public interest objectives. This contribution constitutes the introduction to a broader study that examines the theoretical underpinnings, design and practical implementation of regulatory sandboxes, highlighting their dual role in fostering innovation and ensuring compliance with public interest objectives. By examining the interplay between innovation, regulation and societal safeguards, this research contributes to the ongoing discourse on the governance of emerging technologies. It highlights the potential of regulatory sandboxes to strike a balance between technological progress and a safe, well-regulated internal market, ultimately informing the development of more effective and responsive regulatory frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨监管实验作为应对新兴技术监管挑战的战略方法，重点分析监管沙盒在促进创新与保障公共利益之间的平衡作用。
AI.research_question: 监管沙盒如何作为战略性监管实验工具，在传统监管框架无法适应快速技术创新的情况下，平衡技术创新与公共利益保护？
AI.motivation: 传统监管方法无法跟上技术创新的速度，需要更灵活、适应性强的监管框架来应对新兴技术带来的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管实验理论、适应性监管框架、创新与监管平衡理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，考察监管沙盒的理论基础、设计原则和实践实施机制
AI.findings: 监管沙盒通过受控环境允许企业在监管监督下开发和测试创新产品，同时使监管机构能够实时调整框架，确保适应性、市场安全和公共利益目标的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对监管实验理论的理解，提出了监管沙盒作为创新与监管平衡机制的理论框架，为新兴技术治理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计实施监管沙盒提供了实践指导，有助于开发更有效和响应迅速的监管框架，促进技术创新同时保障市场安全和公共利益。
