title: An Evaluation of Job Satisfaction of Women Employees in Commercial Banks of Bangladesh
affiliations: Canadian University of Bangladesh, Assumption University - Department of General Management and Khulna University

detail.title: An Evaluation of Job Satisfaction of Women Employees in Commercial Banks of Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study attempts to evaluate the level of job satisfaction and overall socioeconomic satisfaction of women bank employees in Bangladesh' It focuses on there relative importance of job satisfaction factors and their relationships with the overall satisfaction. It reports that the level of job satisfaction of women depends on the factors including salary' better job' supervisor recognition, co-employee recognition' better work' colleagues' preferences' and quality of supervision have found to be the most important among these factors. The factors such as salary, better job, supervisor recognition better work, supervisor, colleagues preferences and quality of supervision have significant influence on the overall satisfaction of the women employees. These factors are identified as the prime determinants of both job satisfaction and the overall satisfaction of women bank employees in Bangladesh' The negative relationship of better job with overall satisfaction indicates that the higher chances of getting job outside would result in much less positive overall satisfaction on women bank employees.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估孟加拉国女性银行员工的工作满意度和整体社会经济满意度，发现薪资、工作质量、上司认可、同事关系等因素是影响满意度的主要决定因素，其中外部工作机会与整体满意度呈负相关
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国女性银行员工的工作满意度水平及其与整体社会经济满意度的关系是什么？影响满意度的关键因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 了解女性银行员工的工作满意度状况，识别影响其满意度的关键因素，为改善女性员工工作环境和提升满意度提供依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作满意度理论、社会经济满意度理论、员工激励理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法，通过调查问卷收集数据，统计分析各因素与满意度的关系
AI.findings: 薪资、更好的工作、上司认可、同事认可、工作质量、同事偏好和监管质量是影响工作满意度的最重要因素；这些因素对整体满意度也有显著影响；外部工作机会与整体满意度呈负相关
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家女性员工工作满意度研究，验证了工作满意度因素在银行行业的适用性，发现了外部就业机会与满意度的负向关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国银行业提供改善女性员工工作环境的实践建议，帮助银行管理层制定有效的人力资源政策，提升员工满意度和 retention

title: Understanding China 2001-2025, Policy Endogeneity and Growth
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Understanding China 2001-2025, Policy Endogeneity and Growth
detail.abstract: Dong Xian’an’s unique role during the Hu-Wen era (2002-2012) can be seen as a limited success as an "out-of-system technocrat." Though he did not directly engage in power operations, he achieved a subtle form of "co-governance between court and wild counterweight” through academic critique and policy warnings. The nuance of this process requires analysis through the lens of the era’s context and his strategic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文分析董贤安在胡温时期作为"体制外技术官僚"的有限成功，探讨他通过学术批评和政策警告实现"朝野制衡共治"的微妙过程。
AI.research_question: 董贤安作为体制外技术官僚在胡温时期如何通过非权力运作方式实现朝野制衡共治？
AI.motivation: 理解非传统政治角色在中国政治体系中的独特作用及其对政策制定的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 体制外技术官僚理论、朝野制衡共治概念、中国政治精英研究
AI.method: 历史语境分析、战略方法解析、案例研究
AI.findings: 董贤安虽未直接参与权力运作，但通过学术批判和政策预警实现了有限的政治影响力，形成了独特的朝野互动模式
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了体制外政治参与者的理论框架，丰富了技术官僚在中国政治中的角色理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国政治体系中非传统参与者的作用提供实践启示，对政策制定过程有参考价值

title: Credibility of Group Manipulation in Random Assignments
affiliations: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (FUM) and Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, Iran

detail.title: Credibility of Group Manipulation in Random Assignments

declarations.funderStatement: Mehdi Feizi gratefully acknowledges support from the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNFS) through Project 100018_212311.

detail.abstract: For the random assignment problem, we introduce the notion of collusion-proofness that happens if the rule is immune to any collusion on misreporting preferences, as it is either not profitable to form or profitable to betray. We characterize collusion-proofness and prove that an assignment rule is collusion-proof if and only if it is strategy-proof and non-bossy. Therefore, the random serial dictatorship rule is immune to any collusive agreement between agents on preference misrepresentation, though it is not (weakly) group strategy-proof. This result gives us a possibility between collusion-proofness, ex-post Pareto efficiency, and equal treatment of equals. Furthermore, we proved that a large family of strategy-proof mechanisms called rank exchange mechanisms, à la Shende and Purohit (2023), are collusion-proof but group manipulable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机分配问题中的合谋抗性概念，证明了分配规则具有合谋抗性当且仅当它是策略证明且非霸道的。随机序列独裁规则虽然不满足弱群体策略证明，但对偏好误报的合谋协议具有免疫力。
AI.research_question: 随机分配问题中，什么样的分配规则能够抵抗代理人之间关于偏好误报的合谋行为？
AI.motivation: 现有的策略证明机制可能无法抵抗群体合谋行为，需要研究更强的合谋抗性概念来确保分配机制的稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合谋抗性理论、策略证明机制、非霸道性、随机序列独裁规则、秩交换机制
AI.method: 理论证明和特征化分析，通过数学推导证明合谋抗性与策略证明及非霸道性的等价关系
AI.findings: 分配规则具有合谋抗性当且仅当它是策略证明且非霸道的；随机序列独裁规则对合谋具有免疫力；秩交换机制是合谋抗性的但可被群体操纵
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了合谋抗性的新概念，建立了合谋抗性与现有机制属性的等价关系，扩展了机制设计理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际分配问题提供了抵抗合谋的设计原则，指导设计更稳定的分配机制

title: Blending Discretionary and Quant: Nearest-Feasible Projection of Long-Only Portfolios under a Tracking-Error Constraint
affiliations: Pictet Asset Management

detail.title: Blending Discretionary and Quant: Nearest-Feasible Projection of Long-Only Portfolios under a Tracking-Error Constraint
detail.abstract: We study a rigorously defined projection problem that turns a discretionary "candidate" portfolio into the closest long-only, fully invested portfolio whose tracking error (TE) versus a benchmark does not exceed a cap. The framework provides a coherent way to blend active discretionary views (candidate weights) with quantitative risk controls (tracking error). We treat two cases: (i) the portfolio invests only in a subset of benchmark constituents; (ii) the portfolio admits off-benchmark names. In the subset case, TE-squared is a homogeneous quadratic in deviations from the restricted benchmark; in the general case it becomes a shifted quadratic with linear and constant terms. For both cases we derive the KKT systems, prove convexity and uniqueness, provide geometric intuition, and outline practical active-set and convex-solver implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个严格的投影问题，将自由裁量的候选投资组合转换为最接近的纯多头、完全投资组合，其相对于基准的跟踪误差不超过上限。该框架提供了一种将主动自由裁量观点与量化风险控制相结合的一致方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将自由裁量的候选投资组合转换为满足跟踪误差约束的最接近的纯多头、完全投资组合？
AI.motivation: 需要一种系统性的方法来融合主动投资观点和量化风险控制，确保投资组合在满足风险约束的同时尽可能接近投资经理的原始意图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于凸优化理论和KKT条件，利用二次规划方法解决带约束的投影问题。
AI.method: 采用KKT系统分析，证明凸性和唯一性，提供几何直观解释，并开发实用的active-set和凸优化求解器实现。
AI.findings: 在子集情况下，跟踪误差平方是相对于受限基准偏差的齐次二次函数；在一般情况下变为带有线性和常数项的偏移二次函数。两种情况都具有凸性和唯一解。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了将自由裁量投资观点与风险控制相结合的严格数学框架，证明了问题的凸性和解的唯一性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的active-set算法和凸优化求解器实现，为投资组合经理提供了将主动观点与风险约束相结合的系统化工具。

title: Global Economic Analysis in Multiple Dimensions using ABE
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global Economic Analysis in Multiple Dimensions using ABE
detail.abstract:
A mathematical theory is presented for the dynamic modeling of economic systems composed of multiple structurally dependent events. The foundation of the approach is the Acceleration Balance Equation (ABE), which describes the temporal evolution of “n” economic events “x(t)” through a third-order differential equation.

Where represent the acceleration observed, “ap(t)” it represents the potential acceleration induced by internal and external forces, where “μ” is a structural damping or diffusion coefficient, and “m” is a relative mass that weights the relative importance of the economic phenomenon. The presence of the term proportional to the “jerk” makes it possible to capture delayed and oscillatory dynamic effects, which are characteristic of economic complexity. This model naturally extends to coupled multivariate systems, where a vector of economic variables x(t) ∈ Rn evolves according to a system of coupled differential equations with interaction terms between dependent events. The mathematical formulation incorporates a metric derived from a Hamiltonian functional, which gives the temporal trajectories a variational interpretation as geodesics in a space endowed with a potential field. The model is validated through applications to real economic data, demonstrating its ability to infer latent structures and to accurately predict the future dynamics of economic variables, surpassing classical linear models. The physical–mathematical structure of the “ABE” model provides a solid foundation for analysis and forecasting in economics, enabling the study of complex phenomena such as synchronization, the propagation of shocks, and systemic stability. It is capable of modeling the natural dynamics of the economy—namely, the dynamics that emerge in the absence of instabilities not generated by its own structure.

This work presents the Acceleration Balance Equation (ABE) as a new framework for time series modeling. “ABE” makes it possible to address both the joint dynamics of multiple series and the isolated evolution of each of them. While comparison and dependence among series remain essential for understanding their context, “ABE” demonstrates that each series also possesses a particular dynamic, with internal laws that determine its response and evolution over time. Thus, a new conception emerges: Time series can be analyzed as systems with individual identity in addition to their relational character. From this novel concept, a metric can be derived to quantify, compare, and classify series originating from economic events. We propose a novel representation of the parameter space governing the dynamics of an economic event, termed the “ABE” Diagram. This construct serves as an analytical phase diagram that systematically organizes and visualizes the relevant parameters, thereby enabling a rigorous characterization of their interrelations and facilitating comparative dynamic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了加速度平衡方程（ABE）作为经济系统动态建模的新数学理论框架，通过三阶微分方程描述多个结构依赖经济事件的时变演化，能够捕捉经济复杂性的延迟和振荡效应，并在实际经济数据应用中展现出优于经典线性模型的预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何建立能够准确描述多个结构依赖经济事件动态演化的数学模型？
AI.motivation: 传统线性模型难以捕捉经济系统中的复杂动态特性，如延迟效应、振荡行为和结构依赖性，需要新的数学框架来更好地理解和预测经济现象的时变演化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加速度平衡方程（ABE）理论框架，基于三阶微分方程描述经济事件的动态演化，包含观测加速度、潜在加速度、结构阻尼系数和相对质量等关键概念，并扩展到多元耦合系统。
AI.method: 建立ABE数学模型，通过哈密顿泛函推导度量，将时间轨迹解释为势场空间中的测地线，使用实际经济数据进行模型验证和预测性能测试。
AI.findings: ABE模型能够准确推断潜在结构并预测经济变量的未来动态，在预测性能上超越经典线性模型，能够有效捕捉经济复杂性的特征动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的经济动态建模理论框架，引入了三阶微分方程来描述经济事件的演化，发展了ABE图示作为分析相图来系统组织和可视化相关参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济分析和预测提供了坚实的物理-数学基础，能够研究同步性、冲击传播和系统稳定性等复杂现象，并提供了量化、比较和分类经济时间序列的新度量方法。

title: AI Agents for Economic Research

detail.title: AI Agents for Economic Research

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The objective of this paper is to demystify AI agents - autonomous LLM-based systems that plan, use tools, and execute multi-step research tasks - and to provide hands-on instructions for economists to build their own, even if they do not have programming expertise. As AI has evolved from simple chatbots to reasoning models and now to autonomous agents, the main focus of this paper is to make these powerful tools accessible to all researchers. Through working examples and step-by-step code, it shows how economists can create agents that autonomously conduct literature reviews across myriads of sources, write and debug econometric code, fetch and analyze economic data, and coordinate complex research workflows. The paper demonstrates that by "vibe coding" (programming through natural language) and building on modern agentic frameworks like LangGraph, any economist can build sophisticated research assistants and other autonomous tools in minutes. By providing complete, working implementations alongside conceptual frameworks, this guide demonstrates how to employ AI agents in every stage of the research process, from initial investigation to final analysis.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在向经济学家介绍如何构建基于大语言模型的AI智能体，即使没有编程经验也能通过自然语言编程和现代框架快速创建自主研究助手，完成文献综述、计量代码编写、数据分析和复杂研究流程协调等任务。
AI.research_question: 如何让经济学家无需编程专业知识就能构建和使用自主AI智能体来进行经济学研究？
AI.motivation: 随着AI从简单聊天机器人发展到推理模型再到自主智能体，需要让所有研究人员都能使用这些强大工具，特别是让经济学家能够利用AI智能体提升研究效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大语言模型的自主智能体理论，包括规划、工具使用和多步骤任务执行能力，以及自然语言编程（vibe coding）概念。
AI.method: 通过工作示例和分步代码演示，使用LangGraph等现代智能体框架，展示如何构建能够自主进行文献综述、编写调试计量代码、获取分析经济数据和协调研究流程的AI智能体。
AI.findings: 经济学家可以通过自然语言编程和现代智能体框架在几分钟内构建复杂的研究助手和其他自主工具，AI智能体可以应用于研究过程的每个阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了让非编程专业人士构建和使用AI智能体的方法论框架，扩展了AI在经济学研究中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完整的可运行实现和概念框架，指导经济学家在实际研究中部署AI智能体，从初步调查到最终分析的各个研究阶段都能受益。

title: VAT Reform via Monopolistic Platformer in Borderless Economy: Price Pass-Though and Efficiency Consequences *
affiliations: The University of Osaka and Osaka Metropolitan University

detail.title: VAT Reform via Monopolistic Platformer in Borderless Economy: Price Pass-Though and Efficiency Consequences *
detail.abstract: In value-added tax (VAT) systems, taxing digital services provided by foreign firms has emerged as a central policy challenge. This paper examines the effects of a recently introduced VAT reform in several countries, which requires online platforms to collect taxes from foreign suppliers of digital content. We develop a model of two-sided platforms in which foreign and domestic developers enter the domestic market endogenously through network externalities. The VAT reform reduces platform commission fees for domestic developers, while raising the price of the network good, since incentives for platforms to internalize network externalities are weakened. This shift improves the competitive conditions for domestic developers and creates a replacement of foreign developers with domestic entrants. However, the market shrinks, which discourages developers from entering. We then demonstrate that the magnitude of welfare effects crucially depends on how responsive the sellers' market entry is to network size. When tax reform yields welfare gains, they increase with the tax rate and decrease with the initial share of foreign developers. Finally, we show that digitalization, interpreted as a shift from direct to indirect network externalities, mitigates both welfare loss and the platform's tax avoidance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了要求在线平台对外国数字服务供应商代收增值税的改革效果，发现该政策通过降低平台佣金和改变网络外部性激励，改善了国内开发商的竞争环境，但会导致市场萎缩。福利效应取决于卖家对网络规模的响应程度。
AI.research_question: 增值税改革要求在线平台对外国数字服务供应商代收税款的政策效果如何？
AI.motivation: 在增值税体系中，对国外企业提供的数字服务征税已成为核心政策挑战，需要研究相关改革的影响。

AI.method: 构建包含国内外开发商通过网络外部性内生进入国内市场的双边平台模型

title: Consumption Sensitivity to Stimulus Payments and Income Nonfungibility
affiliations: University of Melbourne and Academia Sinica - Institute of Economics

detail.title: Consumption Sensitivity to Stimulus Payments and Income Nonfungibility
detail.abstract: We employ a novel identification strategy to quantify the role of income nonfungibility in explaining consumption sensitivity to stimulus payments. It exploits a large-scale stimulus program that converted individuals' own cash into a labeled form, i.e., a small upfront cash payment was required to receive stimulus vouchers for general spending. Not only does income nonfungibility increase the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of the subsidy, but it also accounts for 40%, or 10 percentage points, of the program's overall MPC. It strongly predicts consumers' response to stimulus payments and helps explain why MPCs vary substantially across program designs.

title: The Supplementary Table on Pensions (Table 29) and Actuarial Balance Sheets: Assessing the Solvency of the Spanish Pension System
affiliations: University of Valencia - Department of Financial Economics, University of Valencia - Department of Financial Economics, Universidad de Alcala de Henares and University of Barcelona - Department of Actuarial, Financial and Economic Mathematics

detail.title: The Supplementary Table on Pensions (Table 29) and Actuarial Balance Sheets: Assessing the Solvency of the Spanish Pension System
detail.abstract: The aim of this paper is to advocate for a shift in the management of pension liabilities within social security schemes. The proposed change is from an 'out of sight, out of mind' approach to a more transparent approach that accurately reflects the net worth of the system, i.e. a 'tell it like it is' approach. This involves disclosing all assets and liabilities of the scheme through the use of an actuarial balance sheet (ABS) and its associated income statement (IS). EU regulations since 2017 have required all Member States to disclose their accrued-to-date pension liabilities (ADL) using a standard actuarial cost method and some common assumptions. These pension liabilities have to be disclosed in a supplementary table referred to as Table 29. The ABS can be used to assess the solvency of SS schemes, whereas Table 29 cannot. This paper develops the detailed steps to be followed in order to obtain the ABS, the IS and the information on the solvency of social security schemes from Table 29 and updates the results of Garvey et al. (2023) for the case of the Spanish social security system according to the most recent data from Table 29. The Spanish pension system’s lack of solvency and its continuous decline is very worrying; the indicators for the period 2020-2021 show values that, if they arose in a private pension institution, would lead to immediate intervention by the Spanish authorities. In short, we can say that the Spanish social security system is in a "critical and declining state"

AI.tldr: 本文主张养老金负债管理应从'眼不见心不烦'转向透明化的'实话实说'方法，通过精算资产负债表(ABS)和损益表(IS)披露所有资产负债。基于欧盟Table 29数据，开发了评估社保计划偿付能力的具体方法，并以西班牙社保系统为例展示了其'危急且持续恶化'的偿付能力状况。

title: On the Existence of Recursive Utility
affiliations: University of Rochester

detail.title: On the Existence of Recursive Utility
detail.abstract: Recursive utility functions are often defined implicitly, as the solution of a functional equation known as the Koopmans recursion. As conditions for a unique solution can be demanding, a recent literature has tackled the problem of multiplicity, advocating that one focus attention on either the least or greatest solution, which possess a number of attractive properties. While a least solution can be shown to exist, I show that in the most general formulation of the problem, a greatest solution need not. The goal of the paper is to provide a sufficient condition for the existence of a greatest solution, which I term the weakly contractive property and which generalizes the usual contractive property sufficient for uniqueness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了递归效用函数的最大解存在性问题，提出了弱收缩性条件作为最大解存在的充分条件，推广了通常用于保证唯一性的收缩性条件。
AI.research_question: 在递归效用函数的Koopmans递归方程中，最大解在什么条件下存在？
AI.motivation: 递归效用函数通常被定义为Koopmans递归方程的解，但唯一性条件要求严格。虽然最小解总是存在，但在最一般的问题表述中，最大解可能不存在，因此需要寻找最大解存在的充分条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Koopmans递归方程和递归效用函数理论，运用函数分析和不动点理论。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过数学推导证明弱收缩性条件足以保证最大解的存在。
AI.findings: 提出了弱收缩性条件，该条件比通常的收缩性条件更弱，但足以保证递归效用函数的最大解存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了递归效用函数理论，提供了最大解存在的充分条件，推广了现有理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学和金融学中递归效用模型的应用提供了更一般的理论基础，特别是在存在多重解的情况下如何选择适当解的问题。

title: Quantifying Extent of Deforestation and Forest Degradation Using Multi-Temporal and Spectral Landsat Images with Field Data in Yegof Natural Forest
affiliations: Wollo University and Injibara University

detail.title: Quantifying Extent of Deforestation and Forest Degradation Using Multi-Temporal and Spectral Landsat Images with Field Data in Yegof Natural Forest
detail.abstract:
Tropical forests playing a key role in global carbon flux and containing over half of Earth’s species are important to preserve. They are today threatened by deforestation but also by forest degradation. The aim of this study is to quantifying extent of D&D, and co2e emission of Yegof natural forest in South Wollo Ethiopia. To do so, time series multi-spectral and spatial
resolution Landsat imageries of year 2000, 2015 and 2020 were integrated with field inventory and survey data. To reduce the effect of image distortion as a result of sensor, solar, atmospheric, and topographic effects preprocessing of raw data was employed. The past forest conditions/ cover changes were detected using, digital classification methods of supervised
classification for forest deforestation. By using this image classifier image data, were classified in to four (4) different land classes of agriculture, dense forest, open forest and grazing land classes. To assess accuracy of the classified image data, overall total accuracy was performed. Regarding to forest degradation, quantification of loss (or gain) in AGB, and
comparing two observations in time (t1 and t2) with coincident field data to model change in biomass directly, and by combined field measurement AGB data and Landsat image raster and metric model value of 4 VI and 1 BPVS and develop AGB model by using Arc GIS 10.8 and metric model. The extent of deforestation from past to recent (2000_2020), generally
decreased, that means 274.93ha (18.8%) of the deforested area, only 19.06ha (1.3%) at year 2020. The total amount of AGB of Yegof is estimated at 89,651 tons, 75,215.84 ton and 87,450 ton, from study period 2000, 2015 & 2020 respectively. This results show that, extent of degradation is increase from past to recent, and 2201 ton of AGB were degraded from
2000_2020 and the mean annual rate of 0.075 ton AGB ha-1 year-1 and a mean total of 970.23 ii ton AGB were removed in the case of degradation. Following D&D, 13590.7 ton of co2e and, an approximately 679 ton of CO2e were emitted year-.1 Currently, Yegof forest is under a series problem of fuel wood collection, illegal logging and grazing, so regarding local and
zonal administration institute should be involve with to stop this illegal harvesting & spoliation of the forest and further investigation should be needed in the area.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用多时相Landsat影像和实地调查数据，量化了埃塞俄比亚Yegof天然林的毁林与退化程度及碳排放。结果显示2000-2020年间毁林面积减少但森林退化加剧，年均损失2201吨生物量，排放13590.7吨CO2e。
AI.research_question: 如何量化埃塞俄比亚Yegof天然林的毁林与退化程度及其碳排放影响？
AI.motivation: 热带森林在全球碳循环和生物多样性保护中具有关键作用，但目前面临毁林和退化的双重威胁，需要准确评估其变化程度和环境影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遥感影像处理和生物量估算理论，结合数字分类方法和生物物理变量，建立森林变化监测和碳排放评估框架。
AI.method: 整合2000、2015、2020年Landsat多光谱影像与实地调查数据，采用监督分类方法识别四类土地利用，结合4个植被指数和1个生物物理变量建立生物量模型。
AI.findings: 2000-2020年间毁林面积从274.93ha减少到19.06ha，但生物量从89,651吨降至87,450吨，年均退化2201吨生物量，累计排放13590.7吨CO2e。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了结合多时相遥感影像和实地数据的森林退化量化方法，为热带森林监测提供了可操作的技术框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当地政府提供了具体的森林保护依据，识别出薪柴采集、非法伐木和放牧等主要威胁，提出了管理干预建议。

title: Augmenting David's Slingshot: The Effectiveness of Unjustified Threat Provisions at Protecting Freedom of Expression
affiliations: University of Auckland - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Augmenting David's Slingshot: The Effectiveness of Unjustified Threat Provisions at Protecting Freedom of Expression
detail.abstract: Most trade mark disputes begin with a trade mark owner sending a cease and desist letter, and end with the recipient acceding to the demand to stop using an impugned sign. Where a trade mark owner’s cease and desist letter overreaches in its claim of infringement, this can be of concern from a freedom of expression perspective. In this chapter, I critically examine the statutory provisions in some British Commonwealth countries that provide for an “aggrieved” person threatened with an action for trade mark infringement to bring an action against the threatening party for an “unjustified threat”. I argue that the main benefit of such provisions is that they help create and express a norm against overreach in cease and desist letters. This norm is given some teeth by exposing trade mark owners to the risk of financial cost if they send an abusive cease and desist letter that overreaches. However, the norm additionally provides a valuable reference and rallying point. It expresses that such behaviour is unacceptable and provides something recipients of letters can point to in seeking to “push back” against threatening correspondence or by seeking to publicly “shame” those who abusively threaten infringement. Threat provisions also have drawbacks.  In comparatively examining the sphere of operation of different threat provisions in British Commonwealth countries throughout the chapter, I also examine how certain jurisdictions have sought to mitigate such disadvantages and suggest potential solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了英联邦国家商标侵权威胁条款，认为其主要价值在于建立反对过度维权信函的规范，但同时也存在缺陷，并提出了改进建议。

title: Determinants Of Stakeholders' Adoption of Emerging Technologies in A Global Trade, Global Supply Chain, And Logistics Environment, Explained Through a Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) Model

detail.title: Determinants Of Stakeholders' Adoption of Emerging Technologies in A Global Trade, Global Supply Chain, And Logistics Environment, Explained Through a Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest with anybody pertaining to this research
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human or animal participant has been involved in this research
declarations.funderStatement: No funds have been taken from anybody to conduct this research

detail.abstract: This discourse identifies, analyses, studies and further models the behavioural aspects of stakeholders' adoption of technology in a global trade, logistics and supply chain environment by extending the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology (UTAUT) framework. Review of scholarly literatures primarily identifies that primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary-all the sectors can be affected by emerging technologies like Blockchain, IoT, Sophisticated ICT tools, AI/ML, Robotics etc. It also identifies the determinant factors that positively or negatively influences behavioural adoption of technologies, especially the emerging technologies frequently used in the areas of global trade, logistics and global supply chain by the concerned stakeholders which is presented through the proposed model. The proposed model also identifies and models the moderating factors that directly influences such determinant factors. Thus the discourse extends the UTAUT framework by identification and modelling of the determinants and the moderators that directly influences them. This research suggests that while formulating policy related to global trade, logistics or supply chain the behavioural factors which are identified, analysed and illustrated is the discourse to be taken into account. Also the positive, negative determinants as well as the moderating factors require special attention during implementation of trade and supply chain policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过扩展UTAUT框架，识别、分析和建模了全球贸易、物流和供应链环境中利益相关者技术采纳的行为因素，包括区块链、物联网、AI/ML等新兴技术的影响因素和调节因素。
AI.research_question: 在全球贸易、物流和供应链环境中，影响利益相关者采纳技术（特别是新兴技术）的行为因素有哪些？这些因素如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 新兴技术如区块链、物联网、AI/ML等正在深刻影响全球贸易、物流和供应链的所有部门，但技术采纳的行为因素尚未得到充分研究，需要扩展现有理论框架来理解这一复杂过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一技术接受和使用理论（UTAUT）框架的扩展，包括确定因素和调节因素的建模。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论建模方法，通过分析学术文献识别影响因素并构建理论模型。
AI.findings: 识别了影响技术采纳行为的确定因素（正面和负面）以及调节因素，所有部门（初级、次级、三级和四级）都会受到新兴技术的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了UTAUT框架，增加了针对全球贸易、物流和供应链环境的具体确定因素和调节因素，丰富了技术采纳理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了行为因素的参考框架，在制定贸易和供应链政策时应考虑这些行为因素，特别关注正面和负面确定因素以及调节因素。

title: Bonhoeffer's Principle and the Online Labor Market Perspective Collapse, Two-Sided Dysfunction, and the Architecture of Incoherence in Digital Hiring Systems
affiliations: The Job Applicant Perspective

detail.title: Bonhoeffer's Principle and the Online Labor Market Perspective Collapse, Two-Sided Dysfunction, and the Architecture of Incoherence in Digital Hiring Systems

declarations.ethicsApproval: AI was used to help with citations and cohesive structure but all insight contained within is fully my responsibility and my ideas.

detail.abstract: Digital hiring platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Indeed) mediate a vast share of global employment, yet exhibit profound dysfunction—stagnant hiring outcomes, eroding trust, and deepening opacity—despite high activity volumes. This paper argues these failures are structural, rooted in a “collapse of perspectives” (Bonhoeffer, 2005), where institutional design privileges the employer-centric viewpoint embedded in economic theory and platform architecture while systematically excluding the worker’s perspective. Through a case study of LinkedIn and Indeed, we demonstrate how this collapse produces rationalized irrationality: locally rational decisions that generate systemic instability and mistrust. We conclude by proposing a framework for responsible market design inspired by Bonhoeffer’s ethics, grounded in multi-perspective architectures, algorithmic transparency, and restored feedback symmetry to address the structural causes of labor market decline.

AI.tldr: 数字招聘平台（如LinkedIn、Indeed）虽然中介了全球大量就业，但存在功能失调问题——招聘结果停滞、信任侵蚀和透明度下降。本文认为这些失败是结构性的，源于"视角崩溃"，即制度设计偏向雇主中心视角而系统性地排除了工人视角。通过LinkedIn和Indeed的案例研究，展示了这种崩溃如何产生"理性化的非理性"：局部理性决策导致系统不稳定和信任缺失。最后提出了基于多视角架构、算法透明度和反馈对称性的负责任市场设计框架。
AI.research_question: 数字招聘平台为何在高度活跃的情况下仍出现功能失调，其结构性原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字招聘平台在全球就业市场中占据重要地位，但表现出深刻的系统性功能障碍，尽管活动量很高，但招聘结果停滞、信任度下降、透明度降低，需要探究其根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bonhoeffer（2005）的"视角崩溃"理论，分析平台制度设计如何偏向雇主中心视角而排除工人视角，导致系统性功能障碍。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，以LinkedIn和Indeed为研究对象，分析其平台架构和运行机制。
AI.findings: 数字招聘平台的功能失调是结构性的，源于"视角崩溃"现象，这种设计导致"理性化的非理性"——局部理性决策产生系统性不稳定和信任缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bonhoeffer的"视角崩溃"理论应用于数字平台分析，提出了"理性化的非理性"概念，为理解平台经济中的系统性失败提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于多视角架构、算法透明度和反馈对称性的负责任市场设计框架，为解决劳动力市场衰退的结构性原因提供了实践指导。

title: AI and Operations: A Foundational Framework of Emerging Research and Practice
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Operations Area

detail.title: AI and Operations: A Foundational Framework of Emerging Research and Practice
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to reshape operations across industries. Yet its real-world impact reveals a jagged and uneven implementation frontier. To make sense of this emerging landscape, we develop a foundational framework that synthesizes research and practice at the intersection of AI and Operations Management (OM), anchored in three interdependent pillars: (1) AI for OM, (2) OM for AI, and (3) Human-AI Interaction. First, AI for OM analyzes how AI enhances core operational processes, including design, procurement, production, and delivery. Second, OM for AI argues that scaling AI safely and effectively stands to benefit from core OM principles, including workflow design, capacity management, process control, drift detection, and continuous improvement, all of which are central to AI development and deployment. Third, Human-AI Interaction emphasizes the role of trust, incentives, and organizational design in mediating how humans and machines learn from and collaborate with each other. This triadic framework provides a foundation for organizing research on AI and OM and offers practical guidance for integrating AI into business and societal systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI与运营管理交叉领域的基础框架，包含三个相互依存的支柱：AI赋能运营、运营支撑AI、人机交互，为研究和实践提供系统性指导
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统性框架来理解和整合人工智能与运营管理领域的交叉研究与实践？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在重塑各行业运营，但其实际应用呈现出不均衡的碎片化状态，需要建立一个统一框架来理解这一新兴领域
AI.theoretical_framework: 三支柱框架：1) AI for OM - AI增强运营核心流程；2) OM for AI - 运营管理原则支撑AI规模化应用；3) Human-AI Interaction - 人机协作的组织设计
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，综合现有研究和实践成果
AI.findings: 提出了一个整合性的三支柱框架，为AI与运营管理交叉领域提供系统性的理论基础和实践指导
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI与运营管理交叉领域的首个系统性理论框架，明确了三个关键研究方向的相互依存关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业整合AI到业务系统提供实践指南，包括流程优化、AI规模化部署和人机协作设计

title: The Corporate Governance of Indian Unicorns
affiliations: O.P. Jindal Global University

detail.title: The Corporate Governance of Indian Unicorns
detail.abstract:
Indian companies have traditionally been closely held, controlled and monitored by concentrated shareholding structures, usually within families. Controlling shareholders, referred to in the Indian context as promoters, have usually played an all-pervasive role in the day to day management of the company. As a result, institutional investors such as venture capital and private equity funds, often seen as 'outsiders', would look to contractual measures to curb promoter opportunism. However, the rise of an entrepreneurial culture, coupled with regulatory incentives in India, have led to the creation of a large number of unicorns-startups that have achieved a high level of valuation-within the Indian economy.

This paper seeks to review the shareholding structure of such unicorns, particularly the balance of corporate control between promoters and institutional shareholders. We track and analyse the corporate governance rights contracted between promoters and institutional shareholders through a review of publicly available Articles of Association of such unicorns, which are mandated to include shareholder rights. The primary purpose of this study is to ascertain whether unicorns have ownership structures that are different from other companies, thus creating an exception to the ‘insider’ model of corporate governance seen in most Indian companies.

 

As a result, this paper seeks to analyse modifications in corporate control through contracted corporate governance. We find that increased ‘outsider’ shareholding is directly linked to the creation of more professionally managed unicorns. We also demonstrate that as Indian companies attain unicorn status, they are less likely to maintain a ‘closed’ or an insider model of corporate governance, instead moving to a more dispersed model of shareholding with multiple institutional investors. As unicorns approach a dispersed model, their governance also changes, increasingly resembling public listed companies, including the appointment of independent directors, heightened reporting requirements and affirmative voting rights requiring minority investor support for critical decisions. As a result, we create a corporate governance model for other startups in developing countries to emulate if they are to achieve unicorn status.

AI.tldr: 印度独角兽公司通过契约化公司治理机制，从传统的家族集中控股模式转向更分散的专业化管理模式，为发展中国家初创企业提供了可借鉴的治理模型
AI.research_question: 独角兽公司的股权结构是否与传统印度公司不同，是否创造了公司治理'内部人'模式的例外？
AI.motivation: 印度传统公司由家族集中控股，但创业文化和监管激励催生了大量独角兽，需要研究这些新型企业的公司治理结构变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、代理理论、契约理论，重点关注控股股东与机构投资者之间的权力平衡
AI.method: 通过审查独角兽公司公开的公司章程（Articles of Association）来追踪和分析 promoters 与机构股东之间的公司治理权利契约
AI.findings: 1) 外部股东持股增加与更专业管理的独角兽直接相关；2) 独角兽更可能放弃封闭的内部人治理模式，转向分散持股模式；3) 治理结构逐渐类似上市公司，包括独立董事任命、强化报告要求和少数投资者关键决策投票权
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了发展中国家初创企业实现独角兽地位的公司治理模型，丰富了新兴市场公司治理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他发展中国家初创企业提供了可效仿的治理框架，帮助其实现独角兽地位和专业化管理

title: Beyond Borders: Social Networks, Labor Flows, and Innovation Spillovers
affiliations: City University of New York, Baruch College - Zicklin School of Business - Department of Economics and Finance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen and Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU)

detail.title: Beyond Borders: Social Networks, Labor Flows, and Innovation Spillovers
detail.abstract: We provide new evidence that knowledge flows are less geographically constrained than previously believed, with social ties and labor mobility serving as important channels of transmission. Direct citations between inventors from geographically distant locations are significantly higher when those locations share stronger social connections or more intense labor flows. At the R&D lab level, the innovation activities of distant, but socially connected or labor-linked peer labs strongly predict subsequent innovation outputs in focal labs, with elasticities of 0.124 and 0.118, respectively. These effects are especially pronounced for high-impact technologies and in counties characterized by greater economic connectedness, higher income and education levels, and a larger share of tech workers. By contrast, state court decisions that strengthen the enforceability of non-compete clauses substantially weaken knowledge flows, regardless of whether the rulings occur in the peer or focal lab states. Finally, using tax-induced changes to the effective cost of R&D as instruments, we show that the distant innovation flows are causal and are associated with the channels of social connectedness and labor flows.

AI.tldr: 知识流动的地理约束比先前认为的要弱，社会联系和劳动力流动是重要的知识传播渠道。地理距离较远的发明者之间的直接引用在具有更强社会联系或更密集劳动力流动的地区间显著更高。社会联系和劳动力流动对创新产出的弹性分别为0.124和0.118。非竞争条款的可执行性会削弱知识流动，而税收诱导的研发成本变化证实了这些影响的因果关系。
AI.research_question: 知识流动是否受到地理距离的限制？社会联系和劳动力流动在知识传播中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为知识流动受地理距离限制，但需要重新评估社会联系和劳动力流动在知识传播中的作用，特别是在全球化背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识溢出理论、社会网络理论和劳动力流动理论，探讨地理距离、社会联系和劳动力流动对知识传播的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用发明者引用数据、社会连接指标和劳动力流动数据，采用计量经济学方法分析地理距离、社会联系和劳动力流动对知识流动的影响，并利用州法院关于非竞争条款的裁决和税收政策变化作为工具变量进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1) 地理距离较远的发明者之间在具有强社会联系或密集劳动力流动的地区间直接引用显著更高；2) 社会联系和劳动力流动对创新产出的弹性分别为0.124和0.118；3) 非竞争条款的可执行性削弱知识流动；4) 税收政策变化证实了社会联系和劳动力流动渠道的因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了知识流动受地理距离限制的传统观点，强调了社会联系和劳动力流动作为知识传播渠道的重要性，丰富了知识溢出理论和社会网络理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了通过加强社会联系和促进劳动力流动来促进知识传播和创新产出的实践启示，同时指出了非竞争条款可能对创新产生的负面影响。

title: Audit and Compliance in Supply Chains with Damage Cost Sharing under Supplier's Responsibility Standards
affiliations: Ivey Business School, Western University, University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School and Ivey Business School

detail.title: Audit and Compliance in Supply Chains with Damage Cost Sharing under Supplier's Responsibility Standards
detail.abstract: Governmental and industry standards enforce responsibility in supply chains. However, supplier violations often impose costs on buyers, leading to misaligned incentives. Buyer audits act as proactive measures to ensure supplier compliance, while reactive measures hold noncompliant suppliers accountable for damages. We examine the interaction between buyer audits and supplier safety compliance when reputable buyers and a supplier share damages from non-compliance. Buyers and the supplier set their audit and safety levels, respectively, with the supplier bearing a fraction of the damage cost for under-compliance. Our findings indicate that stricter audits enhance supplier safety when damage costs are low but not when costs are high. Likewise, joint audits can compromise supplier safety at high damage costs but enhance it at lower costs. However, shared audits can result in better supplier safety than joint audits. Finally, with high damage costs, suppliers profit more from joint audits than independent audits, while buyers achieve maximum profits in audit scheme that has audit level sufficiently higher than the others.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了买方审计与供应商安全合规之间的互动关系，发现在不同损害成本下审计策略对供应商安全水平的影响存在差异，并比较了联合审计与独立审计的优劣。
AI.research_question: 买方审计与供应商安全合规如何互动？在不同损害成本下，审计策略如何影响供应商的安全水平？
AI.motivation: 政府和行业标准要求供应链承担责任，但供应商违规往往给买方带来成本，导致激励不一致。需要研究审计措施如何确保供应商合规。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链责任理论、审计理论、激励协调理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，研究买方和供应商在设定审计水平和安全水平时的策略互动，考虑供应商承担部分损害成本的情况
AI.findings: 1) 严格审计在损害成本低时提升供应商安全，但在高成本时无效；2) 联合审计在高损害成本时损害供应商安全，在低成本时提升安全；3) 共享审计比联合审计能带来更好的供应商安全；4) 高损害成本时，供应商从联合审计中获利更多，买方在审计水平足够高的方案中获得最大利润
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了审计策略与损害成本的交互作用，提出了在不同成本环境下最优审计方案的选择理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在不同风险环境下选择审计策略提供指导，帮助平衡审计成本与供应商安全合规的关系

title: Entrepreneurial Orders without the State: DAOs, Blockchain, and the Economic Preconditions for Development
affiliations: RMIT University

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Orders without the State: DAOs, Blockchain, and the Economic Preconditions for Development
detail.abstract: Development programmes continue to fall short because they reproduce the economic calculation problem; administered targets and shadow prices cannot replicate the coordination function of market prices, leading to resource misallocation and weak capability. This paper treats blockchain as an institutional technology that can supply missing pieces of economic and institutional infrastructure where states are fragile or predatory. Decentralised Autonomous Organisations (DAOs) are analysed as voluntary, rule-governed associations that create verifiable domains in which prices and participation signals re-emerge, even when formal enforcement is weak and local knowledge is dispersed. Communities face a comparative choice: rely on the state, persist with informal provision, or adopt a DAO that hardens assets behind explicit rules. DAOs only outperform when conditions allow-outcomes must be verifiable, exit must be credible, and custody and governance must be resistant to capture. Where states supply tolerable stationary protection, DAOs act as complements; where states behave as roving bandits, DAOs can substitute at the margin. The policy lessons are clear: invest in verifiability, lower the costs of lawful exit, and support dispersed governance as a way to preserve surplus and reduce opportunities for predation.

AI.tldr: 区块链作为制度技术可以解决发展项目中的经济计算问题，DAO在特定条件下能够替代或补充脆弱/掠夺性国家，通过可验证性、可信退出和分散治理来改善资源配置。
AI.research_question: 区块链和DAO如何解决发展项目中的经济计算问题和制度基础设施缺失？
AI.motivation: 传统发展项目因无法复制市场价格协调功能而导致资源错配和能力薄弱，需要新的制度技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济计算问题理论、制度经济学、区块链治理理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于制度经济学和区块链技术特性的概念性研究
AI.findings: DAO在可验证结果、可信退出和抗捕获治理条件下表现优异，可作为国家制度的补充或替代方案
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区块链作为制度技术的理论框架，拓展了经济计算问题在新制度环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展政策提供具体建议：投资可验证性、降低合法退出成本、支持分散治理以减少掠夺机会

title: National Symbols, Social Cohesion and Colombian Identity (1887–2025)
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: National Symbols, Social Cohesion and Colombian Identity (1887–2025)
detail.abstract: An analysis of the second verse of the Colombian national anthem, officially proclaimed in 1887, provides an understanding of how a national symbol has consolidated, over generations, a mechanism of social cohesion and political legitimacy. Drawing on the theory of Émile Durkheim and the contributions of cultural transmission, this paper examines the normative and emotional value of the lyrics, which exalt sacrifice and heroism in the nation's history. This study, developed within the framework of the social sciences and humanities, argues that the anthem functions as a symbolic device that reinforces identity and legitimizes decisions in public administration, impacting the relationship between those who govern and those who are governed in the contemporary context.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析哥伦比亚国歌第二段歌词，探讨国家象征如何通过世代传承实现社会凝聚和政治合法化，运用涂尔干理论和文化传播理论解释国歌作为符号装置强化身份认同和公共治理合法性的机制。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚国歌如何作为一个国家象征，通过世代传承来巩固社会凝聚机制和政治合法性？
AI.motivation: 理解国家象征在塑造社会凝聚力和政治合法性方面的作用，特别是在哥伦比亚这样的国家背景下，国歌作为文化符号如何影响统治者与被统治者之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Émile Durkheim的社会团结理论和文化传播理论，强调符号系统在社会整合和合法性建构中的作用。
AI.method: 文本分析方法，对1887年正式宣布的哥伦比亚国歌第二段歌词进行规范性和情感价值分析。
AI.findings: 国歌歌词通过歌颂牺牲和英雄主义，强化了民族身份认同，并在公共行政中 legitimize 决策，影响当代治理关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了涂尔干理论在文化符号研究中的应用，深化了对国家象征在社会整合中机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共管理部门提供了关于如何利用文化符号增强治理合法性的实践启示，对民族认同建构和政策制定具有参考价值。

title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Transformation and Optimization of Drug Launches: How Executives from the Health Industry Perceive the Ongoing Revolution
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Transformation and Optimization of Drug Launches: How Executives from the Health Industry Perceive the Ongoing Revolution

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores the growing impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the transformation of drug launch strategies in the French market. In this strictly regulated environment, where pressure regarding lead times and profitability has increased, AI becomes a lever for operational, organizational and strategic change. Based first on a review of extant literature and trends in the French market, and second on data collected during interviews with ten executives from the pharmaceutical industry, this contribution sheds light on what AI can offer in concrete terms: anticipating medical needs, dynamic targeting, medical and economic simulations, real-time management using key smart performance indicators, adaptive scripting of launch processes. It also highlights emerging new models of integrated governance, as well as a cultural shift towards a "learning launch" form of logic. This article identifies technical, human and regulatory barriers to the adoption of AI, and shows that AI does more than optimize existing processes: it brings about a deep redefinition of value-creating conditions in drug launches. France could be a pioneer in this new reference model, at the intersection of data, ethics and health-related innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能如何深刻改变法国市场的药物上市策略，从流程优化到价值创造条件的重新定义，分析了AI在预测医疗需求、动态定位、实时管理等方面的具体应用，以及面临的技术、人力和监管障碍。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响和改变法国市场药物上市策略的运营、组织和战略层面？
AI.motivation: 在法国严格监管环境下，药物上市面临时间压力和盈利挑战，AI成为推动运营、组织和战略变革的重要杠杆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化转型理论和组织变革理论，探讨AI在药物上市过程中的多维度影响。
AI.method: 文献综述结合对制药行业10位高管的访谈数据收集。
AI.findings: AI能够提供医疗需求预测、动态定位、医疗经济模拟、实时绩效管理、自适应流程编排等具体能力，并推动集成治理模式和文化向"学习型上市"转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI不仅优化现有流程，更重新定义药物上市价值创造条件的理论观点，建立了数据、伦理和健康创新交叉的新参考模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药企业提供了AI在药物上市中的具体应用框架，识别了技术、人力和监管障碍，法国可能成为这一新模式的先驱。

title: Why Artificial Intelligence Cannot Equal Human Consciousness: A Response to Ron Horgan
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Why Artificial Intelligence Cannot Equal Human Consciousness: A Response to Ron Horgan
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the claim that artificial intelligence (AI) may one day equal human consciousness. It argues that AI, while a powerful tool capable of accelerating research and managing vast datasets, remains a human artifact—limited, dependent, and derivative. Unlike human consciousness, which is rooted in freedom, imagination, and lived experience, AI functions through algorithmic processes of data retrieval, probabilistic modeling, and pattern recognition. The paper highlights the dependence of AI on external infrastructure, the biases embedded by its creators, and its inability to generate authentic self-expression. It also challenges the fallacy of equating AI with divinity, emphasizing the ontological distinction between Creator, humanity, and artifact. Finally, it links the debate to the author’s broader project on the “Third Generation of International Relations,” underscoring the importance of treating AI as a tool for amplifying human agency rather than as an autonomous actor.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了AI可能达到人类意识的观点，认为AI虽然强大但仍是人类创造物，受限于算法过程、外部基础设施和创造者偏见，无法产生真正的自我表达，与人类意识存在本质区别。
AI.research_question: 人工智能是否能够达到与人类意识相当的水平？
AI.motivation: 针对当前关于AI可能获得人类意识的流行观点进行批判性分析，澄清AI的本质属性及其与人类意识的根本区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于哲学本体论和意识理论，区分创造者、人类和人工制品的本质差异，强调人类意识的自由性、想象力和生活经验基础。
AI.method: 理论分析和批判性论证，通过对比AI的算法过程与人类意识特征，揭示两者的本质区别。
AI.findings: AI是有限、依赖和衍生的工具，通过数据检索、概率建模和模式识别运作，缺乏真正的自我表达能力，且受到外部基础设施和创造者偏见的制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI与人类意识本质区别的理论框架，挑战了将AI神化的谬误，强调了本体论上的根本差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将AI视为增强人类能动性的工具而非自主行动者，为AI的合理应用和发展提供了实践指导。

title: Machine Learning-Assisted Stochastic Kriging Metamodel for Offline Simulation Online Application
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research, University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Machine Learning-Assisted Stochastic Kriging Metamodel for Offline Simulation Online Application
detail.abstract: For many real-time decision problems in complex stochastic systems, a decision-maker observes the system status online in real time and needs to immediately evaluate the performance of alternative decision choices based on the observed system status. Simulation metamodels can effectively support these needs by constructing a fast-to-evaluate mapping from the system status and decision to system performance, using offline-generated simulation samples. However, when the system status involves high-dimensional information and a large number of simulated samples, classical simulation metamodeling approaches, such as stochastic kriging, may face challenges in terms of model specification, computational complexities, and computer storage demands. To address these challenges, we propose using machine learning models to assist stochastic kriging in building metamodels offline, which then can support online applications. The machine learning models can capture the potential nonlinear dependence of the stochastic kriging parameters on the high-dimensional system status. We analyze standard properties, such as mean squared errors and uncertainty quantification, for the proposed machine learning-assisted metamodel, and show its consistency and asymptotic validity. We demonstrate the comparative advantage of our approach through numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用机器学习模型辅助随机克里金法构建仿真元模型，以解决高维系统状态和大规模仿真样本下的计算和存储挑战，通过数值实验验证了方法的优势。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维系统状态和大规模仿真样本的情况下，有效构建快速评估的仿真元模型来支持实时决策？
AI.motivation: 复杂随机系统中的实时决策需要基于观测到的系统状态立即评估不同决策选择的性能，但传统随机克里金方法在高维信息和大样本情况下面临模型设定、计算复杂性和存储需求的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机克里金（Stochastic Kriging）理论框架，结合机器学习模型来捕捉随机克里金参数与高维系统状态之间的潜在非线性依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出机器学习辅助的随机克里金方法，使用离线生成的仿真样本构建元模型，分析均方误差和不确定性量化等标准性质，证明方法的一致性和渐近有效性。
AI.findings: 通过数值实验证明，机器学习辅助的元模型方法相比传统方法具有比较优势，能够有效处理高维系统状态和大规模样本的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了机器学习辅助随机克里金的理论框架，证明了该方法的一致性和渐近有效性，为高维仿真元建模提供了新的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种实用的仿真元建模方法，能够支持复杂随机系统中的实时决策应用，解决了传统方法在高维场景下的计算和存储瓶颈问题。

title: How did Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and U.S. Statements under Trump Affect France and Germany’s Military Attitude?
affiliations: Aalborg University, Aalborg University and Aalborg University

detail.title: How did Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and U.S. Statements under Trump Affect France and Germany’s Military Attitude?
detail.abstract:
In recent years, two events have taken place, which have significantly altered the global order. The first one of those events was Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, which began on the 24th of February 2022. The second one of those events was Donald Trump's second election as US-President on the 5th of November 2024. These events have severe implications for security and alliances in Europe. This paper will examine how the two biggest countries in the European Union, Germany and France, responded to those challenges. Their responses will be analysed based on both a realist- and constructivist theoretical framework to see which one of those rivalling theories better explains their responses.

The structure of the paper is as follows: (1) the theories of realism and constructivism will laid out and it will be explained how the two countries can be expected to act based on them, (2) relevant literature on the topic will be introduced, (3) the methods used in this paper will be explained, (4) data on the responses of the two countries to the two events will be introduced and analysed, (5) the results will be discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文分析俄乌战争和特朗普再次当选两大事件对欧洲安全秩序的影响，通过现实主义和建构主义理论框架比较德法两国的应对策略，探讨哪种理论更能解释两国的外交政策选择。
AI.research_question: 德国和法国如何应对2022年俄乌战争和2024年特朗普再次当选这两大事件？现实主义和建构主义理论中哪种理论能更好地解释两国的应对策略？
AI.motivation: 近年来俄乌战争和特朗普再次当选两大事件显著改变了全球秩序，对欧洲安全和联盟体系产生严重影响，需要研究欧盟两大核心国家德国和法国的应对方式及其理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实主义和建构主义国际关系理论。现实主义强调国家利益、权力和安全，建构主义关注观念、身份和规范在社会建构中的作用。
AI.method: 理论框架构建、文献综述、数据分析（德法两国对两大事件的具体应对措施）、理论验证比较分析。
AI.findings: 通过对比分析德法两国在两大事件中的具体政策反应，验证现实主义和建构主义理论的解释力，确定哪种理论框架更能准确解释两国的外交政策选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 为现实主义和建构主义理论在欧洲大国外交政策分析中的应用提供实证检验，深化对两种理论解释力的比较研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解欧盟核心国家在重大国际危机中的政策取向提供分析，对欧洲安全政策和联盟战略制定具有参考价值。

title: Does Motivation Predict Performance of Food and Beverages (F & B) Employees? Organizational Culture as a Moderator
affiliations: and Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS) - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Does Motivation Predict Performance of Food and Beverages (F & B) Employees? Organizational Culture as a Moderator
detail.abstract: Employee performance is crucial to an organisation's success, particularly in the dynamic and competitive food and beverage (F&B) sector. This study studies the effect of intrinsic and extrinsic motivation on employee performance with the organisational culture moderating variable in the context of food and beverage sector in Kuching, Sarawak. According to Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory, the study quantitatively processed 168 complete answers. Analysis was performed by SPSS and PLSS-SEM to examine correlations and moderating. The findings demonstrate that the intrinsic and extrinsic motivation have statistically significant influence on employee performance. This revelation that motivated employees are high in productivity, do work in good quality and work fast. Organizational culture serves as the moderating variable that enhances the relationship between motivation and performance. Cultures that encourage and support employees can make motivation more potent, while negative or dictatorial cultures can leave employees disengaged and their performance lower.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于赫茨伯格双因素理论，探讨内在和外在动机对餐饮业员工绩效的影响，并发现组织文化在其中起调节作用。通过168份问卷数据分析显示，两种动机均显著提升员工绩效，而支持性组织文化能增强这种关系。
AI.research_question: 内在动机和外在动机如何影响餐饮业员工绩效？组织文化在这一关系中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 员工绩效对餐饮行业成功至关重要，特别是在动态竞争的环境中。理解动机因素和组织文化对绩效的影响有助于提升组织效能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赫茨伯格双因素理论（内在激励因素和外在保健因素）
AI.method: 定量研究方法，收集168份完整问卷，使用SPSS和PLS-SEM进行相关分析和调节效应检验
AI.findings: 内在动机和外在动机对员工绩效均有显著正向影响；组织文化作为调节变量，支持性文化能增强动机与绩效的关系，而负面文化则会削弱这种关系
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了双因素理论在餐饮业背景下的适用性，揭示了组织文化在动机-绩效关系中的调节机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为餐饮企业提供了提升员工绩效的具体策略：既要关注内在和外在激励，也要培育支持性的组织文化环境

title: ‘The Beauty of Palm: A Haptic Textuality in Kawabata Yasunari’s (1899-1972) Tanagokoro no shôsetsu (1921-1972)’
affiliations: University of Cambridge - Faculty of Education

detail.title: ‘The Beauty of Palm: A Haptic Textuality in Kawabata Yasunari’s (1899-1972) Tanagokoro no shôsetsu (1921-1972)’

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Communication University of China

detail.abstract:
How to approach the notion of technē in the digital era? What are various means to make technē expressive, accessible, and durable? To what extent does the paradox of science intersect with the practice of fine art? How do artists position themselves in the process of making? What will be the future of fine art? Following these questions at present, this talk situates arts and literature in dialogue with sense, haptics, media, and digital aesthetics. 

Among sense, the haptic sense is the most elusive one, which is hard to describe in language, but always multi-sensory. Some culturally-attuned modernist theorists like Walter Benjamin (1892-1940), Siegfried Kracauer (1889-1966) and Filippo Tommaso Marinetti (1876-1944) observed new sensational experiences and the haptic transformation in the early twentieth century. In recent years, film theorists, sociologists, physiologist, computer scientists and geographers have attempted to describe the sense of touch. How does a haptic experience choreograph the feeling between the self and other? Does the haptic always carry an implication of the erotic? How does a text evoke haptic responses from readers? To what extent is the haptic objectified as sensory data?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字时代下技术(technē)的概念，分析触觉感知在艺术中的表达方式，以及科学悖论与美术实践的交叉点，通过多学科视角研究触觉体验的编排和对象化过程。
AI.research_question: 数字时代如何理解technē概念？触觉体验如何编排自我与他者的感受？触觉是否总是带有情色含义？文本如何引发读者的触觉反应？触觉在多大程度上被对象化为感官数据？
AI.motivation: 探索数字时代艺术与技术的融合，理解触觉这一最难以言喻的感官体验在当代艺术实践中的表达和转化方式
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴Walter Benjamin、Siegfried Kracauer和Filippo Tommaso Marinetti等现代主义理论家的感官理论，结合电影理论、社会学、生理学、计算机科学和地理学的多学科视角
AI.method: 理论分析和跨学科对话，将艺术文学与感官、触觉、媒介和数字美学进行对话
AI.findings: 触觉是最难以语言描述但总是多感官的体验，在20世纪早期就经历了感官变革，现代多学科学者正尝试描述触觉感知
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了数字时代technē概念的理论框架，提出了触觉体验编排的理论模型，发展了多学科交叉的感官研究范式
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字艺术创作提供理论指导，帮助艺术家在创作过程中定位自身，为触觉技术的开发和应用提供美学理论基础

title: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
affiliations: INSEAD

detail.title: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
detail.abstract: This paper reevaluates the longstanding debate on capital-labor substitution by examining the role of external inputs: raw materials, intermediate goods and services, imports, offshoring. Both a meta analysis (analyzing existing estimates of substitution) and direct inference (using U.S. data for 1963-2016) indicate that external inputs disproportionately displace labor. These findings imply (1) that the capital-labor ratio responds 40-80% more strongly to the price of labor than to the price of capital, (2) that value added cannot be modeled separably from gross output, and (3) that historical disagreements regarding substitution can be recast as an omitted variable bias involving external inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过考察外部投入（原材料、中间产品和服务、进口、离岸外包）的作用，重新评估了关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论。元分析和美国数据直接推断均表明外部投入不成比例地替代劳动力。
AI.research_question: 外部投入在资本-劳动替代中扮演什么角色？它们如何影响传统的替代弹性估计？
AI.motivation: 重新审视关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论，解决现有研究中可能存在的遗漏变量偏差问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产函数理论和替代弹性理论，将外部投入作为关键变量纳入分析框架。
AI.method: 采用元分析方法（分析现有替代弹性估计）和直接推断方法（使用1963-2016年美国数据）。
AI.findings: 1) 资本-劳动比对劳动力价格的响应比对资本价格的响应强40-80%；2) 增加值不能与总产出分开建模；3) 历史上的替代争议可重新解释为涉及外部投入的遗漏变量偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新的理论视角，将外部投入作为解释资本-劳动替代关系的关键因素，解决了长期的理论争议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了更准确的生产函数建模方法，有助于更好地理解劳动力市场变化和产业组织决策。

title: Competitive Effects of Resale Price Maintenance Through Inventory: Evidence from the Publishing Industry
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Gordon S Lang School of Business and Economics, University of Guelph, Guelph, Canada and Peking University

detail.title: Competitive Effects of Resale Price Maintenance Through Inventory: Evidence from the Publishing Industry
detail.abstract: This paper examines the competitive effects of resale price maintenance (RPM) through inventory decisions under demand uncertainty. We focus on the Japanese publishing industry where printed books are excepted from RPM prohibition. We develop and estimate a model of RPM in which price and inventory are determined before demand is realized. Counterfactual simulations show that the price ceiling due to RPM plays a welfare-enhancing role, whereas the price floor can improve supply-side welfare at the expense of consumer surplus. The parameter region for which price floor can improve consumer surplus exists but is narrow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过库存决策研究转售价格维持（RPM）在需求不确定性下的竞争效应，以日本出版业为例，发现RPM价格上限具有福利提升作用，而价格下限虽能改善供应方福利但通常损害消费者剩余。
AI.research_question: 转售价格维持（RPM）在需求不确定性下通过库存决策产生的竞争效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 日本出版业中印刷书籍豁免RPM禁令，为研究RPM在需求不确定性下的影响提供了独特环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于RPM理论框架，考虑价格和库存决策在需求实现前确定的情境。
AI.method: 开发并估计RPM模型，进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: RPM价格上限具有福利提升作用；价格下限能改善供应方福利但通常损害消费者剩余；价格下限改善消费者剩余的参数区域存在但很窄。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了RPM理论在需求不确定性和库存决策背景下的应用，揭示了价格上限和价格下限的不同福利效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于RPM监管的实证依据，特别是在出版业等特殊行业的应用指导。

title: Carbon Neutrality Uncertainty and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns: Evidence from China
affiliations: School of Finance, Nankai University, School of Finance, Nankai University and University of Akron - Department of Finance, College of Business Administration

detail.title: Carbon Neutrality Uncertainty and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns: Evidence from China

declarations.funderStatement: This work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (72071141).

detail.abstract: Climate change impacts future stock returns, though prior literature offers mixed evidence. In this study, we explore how carbon neutrality uncertainty affects the cross-section of stock returns in the Chinese market. Our dataset includes 3,489 stocks from January 2011 to December 2022. Utilizing keywords generated by ChatGPT, we construct a carbon neutrality uncertainty index and estimate the stocks' sensitivity to this uncertainty. Portfolio-level analyses and cross-sectional regressions indicate a negative cross-sectional relationship between sensitivity to carbon neutrality uncertainty and future stock returns. This relationship remains robust across alternative rolling windows and various measures of the carbon neutrality uncertainty index, and other uncertainty indices cannot account for it. From the perspective of market impediments, arbitrage asymmetry appears to explain this negative relationship. Overall, our results highlight the important role of carbon neutrality uncertainty in determining stock prices.

AI.tldr: 碳中性不确定性对股票收益存在负向影响，中国市场数据显示敏感性高的股票未来收益更低，套利不对称性解释了这一现象
AI.research_question: 碳中性不确定性如何影响中国市场的股票横截面收益？
AI.motivation: 气候变化影响股票收益但现有研究证据不一，需要探索碳中性政策不确定性对股票定价的具体影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场摩擦理论，特别是套利不对称性理论，解释碳中性不确定性对股票收益的影响
AI.method: 使用ChatGPT生成关键词构建碳中性不确定性指数，通过投资组合分析和横截面回归分析3489只股票2011-2022年数据
AI.findings: 碳中性不确定性敏感性与未来股票收益呈负相关关系，这一关系在不同滚动窗口和指数度量下保持稳健，其他不确定性指数无法解释
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究碳中性不确定性对股票定价的影响，丰富了气候变化金融文献，提供了中国市场证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者识别碳中性政策风险提供量化工具，帮助监管机构理解市场对气候政策的反应，促进绿色金融发展

title: Tax Incidence of VAT Enforcement Reform for Foreign Services and Small Businesses in Two-sided Markets
affiliations: The University of Osaka

detail.title: Tax Incidence of VAT Enforcement Reform for Foreign Services and Small Businesses in Two-sided Markets
detail.abstract: Value-added tax (VAT) faces two major enforcement challenges: taxing foreign vendors without local subsidiaries and taxing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with limited tax bases. As a response, several countries have adopted platform-based VAT collection systems, requiring online platforms to remit VAT on behalf of foreign firms and SMEs. We develop a model of a monopolistic online platform that sets commission rates for a relation-specific good and the price of a standard good. We show that taxing foreign content developers via the platform increases the tax burden on the standard good, despite no change in its statutory VAT rate. Moreover, we find that the benefit of closing VAT loopholes through platform taxation critically depends on the elasticity of developer entry with respect to the size of the user network. These insights suggest a non-linear relationship between the tax rates and the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) in platform economies. Due to the simultaneity of price and quantity, a more fully fledged structural analysis may be necessary for the estimation of MVPF. Furthermore, we demonstrate that VAT can function as a Pigouvian tax by mitigating excessive entry, and our results remain robust even under conditions of platform competition. Extending the analysis to the formalization of SMEs, we find that the strength of network externalities determines whether the existing formal sector benefits or suffers from the inclusion of SMEs in the VAT regime.

title: Supplementary Appendix for Structural Change Detection in Panel-MIDAS-ARDL Time Series Regression Models: An Application to Firm Values and ESG Scores
affiliations: , University of California Santa Barbara, Heriot-Watt University, University of Reading - ICMA Centre and University of Reading - ICMA Centre

detail.title: Supplementary Appendix for Structural Change Detection in Panel-MIDAS-ARDL Time Series Regression Models: An Application to Firm Values and ESG Scores
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes an innovative change detection methodology for panel MIDAS models,
where dependent and independent variables are sampled at different frequencies. Detecting
structural changes in mixed-data sampling (MIDAS) models presents a significant challenge
for data analysis, particularly in panel data settings. We propose a three-stage procedure
for a panel MIDAS estimation. To detect structural breaks, we employ the Cross-Entropy
method, which is a fast and precise algorithm. We apply the proposed methodology to a
sample of Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) from April 2013 to December 2023. Specifically,
we investigate structural changes in the effects of sustainability on the market value of the
sampled ETFs. We find that ESG factors have a time-varying effect on Tobin’s Q values.
This effect is found heterogeneous accross sectors amoung the U.S. ETFs. This highlights
the dynamic nature of how sustainability factors are incorporated into market valuations
and the importance of accounting for structural breaks.

AI.findings: ESG因素对托宾Q值具有时变效应，这种效应在美国ETF中呈现行业异质性，表明可持续性因素融入市场估值的动态性质。

title: Too Scared to Use: Living Wills and Orderly Liquidation of Too-Big-to-Fail Financial Institutions
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Too Scared to Use: Living Wills and Orderly Liquidation of Too-Big-to-Fail Financial Institutions

publicationDetails.detailsText: U of Michigan Law & Econ Research Paper No. 25-014
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Law School, Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The term “too big to fail” became ubiquitous following the 2007-2008 Global Financial Crisis. Lawmakers, regulators, and scholars wondered if there was a better way forward than issuing an array of ad hoc bailout packages to large financial institutions. Congress, in enacting the Dodd-Frank Act, sought to address the concern by creating a new regulatory framework to resolve large financial institutions in an orderly manner.

First, Congress required too-big-to-fail institutions to file “living wills,” essentially planning documents that describe the institution’s path to a safe failure under the Bankruptcy Code—a failure that would not impact system-wide financial stability. Second, Congress gave “orderly liquidation authority” to the FDIC, allowing the agency to take over a too-big-to-fail institution with emergency funding if necessary. Over the past fifteen years, large financial institutions, their lawyers, and regulators have spent countless hours navigating these two hefty provisions of the Dodd-Frank Act in order to prepare for the next crisis-like event. Yet, during the March 2023 panic that started with a run on Silicon Valley Bank, nobody seemed to bother with either living wills or orderly resolution.

Why not? Leveraging financial history and economic theory, this Article illustrates the substantive and procedural flaws of the Dodd-Frank resolution regime. First, it does not offer system-wide assurance during a system-wide panic. It was designed to deal with the idiosyncratic risk associated with a single institution’s distress, not the systemic risk associated with crises. Second, to the extent that regulators wish to mitigate idiosyncratic risk, they are too hesitant to use the resolution regime when uncertainty is high during a panic, further eroding the regime’s credibility. If Congress wishes to save this resolution regime, lawmakers should consider expanding its coverage to include almost-too-big-to-fail institutions so that agencies can begin to build expertise and credibility.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《多德-弗兰克法案》中"大到不能倒"金融机构处置机制的缺陷，指出该机制无法应对系统性风险，且在危机中监管机构过于犹豫使用该机制，建议扩大覆盖范围以建立专业知识和可信度。

title: Robust Bounds on Optimal Tax Progressivity
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis - Department of Economics, New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics and University of Kent

detail.title: Robust Bounds on Optimal Tax Progressivity
detail.abstract: This paper studies optimal tax design when the cross-sectional distribution of types may be misspecified, and the government acts cautiously vis-à-vis these misspecifications. In models without such concerns, fat-tailed distributions imply positive-often high-top marginal tax rates. We demonstrate that even vanishingly small misspecification concerns overturn this finding, driving top marginal tax rates to zero. Calibrating concerns to observed variation in income distributions shows that taxes for below-average incomes remain essentially unchanged, while progressivity for highincome earners is substantially reduced.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在类型分布可能存在错误设定时的最优税收设计，政府对这些错误设定采取谨慎态度。在没有这种担忧的模型中，肥尾分布通常意味着正的高边际税率。但研究表明，即使极小的错误设定担忧也会推翻这一结论，将最高边际税率降为零。校准到观察到的收入分布变化后，低于平均收入者的税收基本不变，而高收入者的累进性大幅降低。
AI.research_question: 当类型分布可能存在错误设定时，政府应如何设计最优税收政策？
AI.motivation: 现有税收模型通常假设类型分布是准确已知的，但实际中分布可能存在错误设定。政府需要在这种不确定性下制定稳健的税收政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最优税收理论和稳健控制理论，考虑分布错误设定下的谨慎税收设计框架
AI.method: 理论建模分析，结合校准方法将担忧程度与观察到的收入分布变化相匹配
AI.findings: 即使极小的分布错误设定担忧也会导致最高边际税率降为零；低于平均收入者的税收基本不受影响，而高收入者的税收累进性显著降低
AI.theory_contributions: 将稳健控制理论引入最优税收分析，揭示了分布不确定性对税收设计的重大影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在分布不确定性下设计稳健税收政策的理论依据，特别是对高收入群体的税收设计具有重要启示

title: Precautionary Savings and Financial Frictions
affiliations: Banco de España

detail.title: Precautionary Savings and Financial Frictions
detail.abstract: Banks provide households with liquid deposits-the dominant liquid asset in households' portfolios-and channel these into credit to firms. This paper shows both of these roles of the financial system are key to understanding how financial frictions amplify downturns. Empirically, I document that tighter financial conditions deepen the recessionary impact of an income-risk shock that raises households' liquid asset demand, while contracting lending and dampening liquid deposit accumulation. I rationalize this in a two-asset New Keynesian model with heterogeneous households and banks. Constrained lending reduces investment and therefore household income. Lower income reduces households' consumption and limits savings in liquid bank deposits. Lower liquidity pushes households toward borrowing constraints, leaving them more exposed to the income fall and heightening precautionary motives, further deepening the consumption drop. An accommodative monetary policy relaxes banks' leverage constraint, supports both lending and endogenous liquidity creation, and stabilizes the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证和理论模型证明，金融摩擦通过限制银行放贷和流动性创造，放大了收入风险冲击对经济的负面影响，而宽松货币政策可以缓解这种放大效应。
AI.research_question: 金融摩擦如何放大收入风险冲击对经济的负面影响？

AI.method: 实证分析结合理论建模，实证部分记录了金融条件收紧对收入风险冲击的放大效应，理论部分构建了两资产新凯恩斯模型进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 金融条件收紧会加深收入风险冲击的衰退影响，同时收缩贷款并抑制流动性存款积累；受约束的贷款减少了投资和家庭收入，进而降低消费和流动性储蓄，使家庭更容易面临借贷约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含银行流动性创造和信贷渠道的完整理论框架，解释了金融摩擦放大经济冲击的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了重要启示：宽松的货币政策可以通过放松银行杠杆约束来支持贷款和内生流动性创造，从而稳定经济。

title: Correlation through Language Games *
affiliations: University of Arizona - Department of Economics

detail.title: Correlation through Language Games *
detail.abstract: A language game is a finite complete-information game preceded by public pre-play communication with constraints on players' ability to produce and understand messages and on their knowledge of each other's constraints. The paper gives conditions under which it is possible to induce correlated equilibria outside the convex hull of the set of Nash equilibria through simple language games with only a few communication rounds. This is especially relevant for two-player games, in which unmediated communication is necessarily public. In the game of Chicken one can induce the entire set of correlated equilibria via a language game.

detail.abstract: On 23 July 2025, the Seventh Chamber of the European Union's (EU) General Court rendered its judgment in Bloom v Commission. In this case, the French NGO Bloom sought the annulment of a European Commission decision rejecting as inadmissible a previous request of Bloom for internal review, under the EU's Aarhus Regulation, of an earlier Commission decision to object to a conservation and management measure of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission. The General Court held that decisions of the European Commission to use the objection procedures of Regional Fisheries Management Organisations (RFMOs) can constitute "administrative acts" subject to internal review under the Aarhus Regulation, and, by extension, are subject to (indirect) judicial review by the General Court. This case note analyses the judgment and discusses its significance for the future internal and judicial review of the legality of such decisions in the framework of RFMOs and other ocean governance institutions with a law-making competence. Keywords Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU); Aarhus Regulation; internal and judicial review; Regional Fisheries Management Organisations (RFMOs); conservation and management measures (CMMs); objection procedures * This case note is partly based on a legal report prepared for Sustainable Fisheries and Communities Trust (SFACT) in 2025, which has been expanded and revised for publication. Funding by SFACT for this purpose is gratefully acknowledged. The views expressed in this case note are those of the author and are not necessarily shared by SFACT.

title: Malfunctioning Democracies: Understanding Accountability Failures in Developing Countries
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - Vancouver School of Economics and University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics

detail.title: Malfunctioning Democracies: Understanding Accountability Failures in Developing Countries

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This chapter examines why democracies in the developing world frequently underperform in providing effective governance. We argue that these shortcomings stem from weaknesses in accountability mechanisms, which leave governments vulnerable to corruption, clientelism, and elite capture. Our framework distinguishes three accountability channels: vertical (citizens’ control over politicians), horizontal (checks and balances across state institutions), and diagonal (oversight by media and civil society). We synthesize the recent theoretical and empirical literature to assess how each channel operates, the conditions under which it succeeds, and why it often fails. A central finding is that accountability institutions rarely fail on their own; instead, they are actively undermined by political actors seeking to preserve rents and entrench power. This dynamic weakens electoral competition, erodes judicial independence, and curtails media freedom, producing a mutually reinforcing cycle of weak accountability. Additionally, we argue that sustainable reforms cannot be achieved by strengthening any single channel in isolation. Since vertical, horizontal, and diagonal accountability are interdependent, effective reform requires bolstering all three simultaneously. We conclude by discussing the implications of this perspective for future research, including the role of new technologies, political polarization, and candidate selection in reshaping accountability in developing democracies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Brief for Nat’l Rifle Ass’n et al. as Amici Curiae Supporting Petitioner, Smith & Wesson Brands v. Estados Unidos Mexicanos, 605 U.S. 280 (2024)
affiliations: National Rifle Association - Institute for Legislative Action, University of Wyoming - Firearms Research Center and University of Wyoming College of Law

detail.title: Brief for Nat’l Rifle Ass’n et al. as Amici Curiae Supporting Petitioner, Smith & Wesson Brands v. Estados Unidos Mexicanos, 605 U.S. 280 (2024)

keywords: Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act

detail.abstract:
Mexico has extinguished its constitutional arms right and now seeks to extinguish America’s. Mexico seeks to bankrupt the American firearms industry by making American firearms manufacturers liable for violence perpetrated by Mexican drug cartels in Mexico—despite failing to allege that the manufacturers violated any law, were aware of any unlawful sale, or took any affirmative act intended to further a crime. If Mexico can overcome a motion to dismiss on such a weak foundation, the proliferation of meritless Mexico-style cases could destroy the firearms industry solely through litigation costs.

In the 1980s and 90s, anti-gun lobbies and some governments weaponized baseless lawsuits to bankrupt firearms manufacturers or coerce them to self-impose extreme gun controls. Defending against the suits bankrupted several manufacturers and drove others to the brink. Congress halted the abusive litigation by enacting the Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act (PLCAA), citing the threat the suits posed to the Second Amendment, Fourteenth Amendment, separation of powers, and national security.

This case exemplifies why PLCAA was enacted. Mexico seeks billions in damages and the imposition of extensive gun controls in America while relying on shoddy data and false allegations to exaggerate the impact of Petitioners’ firearms on Mexican homicides. The complaint alleges that Mexican homicides increased due to Petitioners manufacturing so-called “assault weapons” after the 2004 sunset of the U.S. ban. In fact, Mexico’s homicide rate was higher during the ban than after its expiration. More Mexican homicides were committed with firearms during the ban than after its expiration.

Mexico’s claim that 70% to 90% of firearms seized in Mexico are trafficked from the U.S. refers only to firearms successfully traced by the ATF—a small, skewed sample. Of the total crime guns seized in Mexico, only a small fraction conclusively come from the U.S. And the average age of those firearms is 15 years, indicating that many were stolen from their lawful owners before becoming crime guns. Mexico’s homicides increased not when the U.S. statute sunset in 2004, but when President Calderón deployed 30,000 soldiers and federal police to battle cartels, creating military confrontations and turf wars among cartels. The Mexican military’s harsh domestic law enforcement techniques, the government’s failure to prosecute violent criminals, and the government’s human rights violations have also fueled violence. The Mexican government seeks to hold Petitioners responsible for its own domestic failings.

The Mexican government claims that Petitioners intend to appeal to Mexican cartels by depicting their firearms in patriotic advertisements featuring the American military, law enforcement, and American flags. But in America, the right to keep and bear arms has always been aligned with military and law enforcement firearms use. 

This Court halted similar lawsuits threatening the First Amendment in New York Times v. Sullivan. Before and during the Civil Rights movement, abusive tort actions were used to silence newspapers that exposed abuses in the Jim Crow South. The black press in the South had been targeted for decades and could not afford to litigate. When the national media began significant coverage of Southern civil rights abuses, it too was targeted. This Court had to quell such strike suits, starting with Sullivan
