title: Why do Unfairly Paid Trainees Persist? Pay Fairness and Human Capital Investment In
affiliations: University of Florida and

detail.title: Why do Unfairly Paid Trainees Persist? Pay Fairness and Human Capital Investment In

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Sport Management, volume 37, issue 2, 2023[10.1123/jsm.2021-0125]

detail.abstract: Pay fairness and human capital theories make different predictions about trainees' occupational turnover in situations where trainees perceive unfair pay but receive huge potential returns from training. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to examine how pay fairness and human capital investments combined to explain why trainees are motivated to persist in employment when they perceive unfair pay. Cross-sectional survey data from 144 minor league baseball players showed that athletes perceived unfair pay but had low occupational turnover intentions because they perceived high learning achievement and expected to play in Major League Baseball (MLB) eventually. Perceptions of unfair pay only increased occupational turnover intentions under certain conditions, such as when athletes had low expectations of playing at least one game in MLB in the next three years. Theoretically, the results showed that unfairly paid trainees persisted because they had optimistic expectations about returns from training investments, which is consistent with a theoretical framework that combines human capital theory and pay fairness theories to explain boundary conditions for trainee motivation.

title: Long-Term Care Insurance Policy and Development of Elderly Care Enterprises in China
affiliations: and Institute for the Study of Labor (IZA)

detail.title: Long-Term Care Insurance Policy and Development of Elderly Care Enterprises in China

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on the development of elderly care enterprises in China. Employing a policy shock and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the implementation of LTCI significantly promotes the the number of new entries and survival rate of elderly care enterprises, particularly for individual businesses, enterprises in the health and social work industry, and those located in eastern regions. Notably, service-only LTCI policy exhibits stronger effect on the development of elderly care enterprises compared to policy combining service and cash benefits. Mechanism analysis suggests that LTCI stimulates market demand for formal elderly care services and increases government expenditures on social security and healthcare, both of which drive the development of elderly care enterprises. We also find that LTCI policy boosts labor demand in the elderly care industry. Overall, our empirical findings suggest that LTCI can help address the shortage of long-term care services and enhance family welfare.

title: Comparative Study of Intellectual Property Rights in the Sports Industry: A Case Study on Broadcasting Rights of Sporting Events
affiliations: Payame Noor University, Payam-e-Noor University and Payam-e-Noor University

detail.title: Comparative Study of Intellectual Property Rights in the Sports Industry: A Case Study on Broadcasting Rights of Sporting Events
detail.abstract: In the digital era, the increasing value of media within the sports industry has made the management and protection of intellectual property rights, particularly broad-casting rights of sporting events, a critical challenge for nations and sports organizations. Despite diverse legal frameworks, inconsistent enforcement threatens economic interests and diminishes investment incentives. This study aims to comparatively analyze selected legal systems regarding intellectual property rights and examine mechanisms ensuring broadcasting rights protection on an international scale. Using a comparative-analytical approach, the research reviews the regulatory frameworks of the European Union, the United States, and Iran, with insights drawn from successful case studies. Data were col-lected through document analysis, library research, and expert interviews. Qualitative content analysis and the Chi-square test were employed to evaluate correlations between effective law enforcement and broadcasting revenue outcomes. Findings reveal that coun-tries with robust legal and enforcement mechanisms experience significant increases in broadcasting revenue and reduced intellectual property infringements. Additionally, ad-vancements in Digital Rights Management (DRM) technologies play a vital role in con-trolling and legitimizing event broadcasts. This study concludes by emphasizing the need for global regulatory harmonization and enhanced enforcement guarantees to efficiently protect intellectual property rights in the sports industry.

title: Reorienting Global Value Chains under AfCFTA: The Role of SEZs and Emerging Technologies in Boosting Value-Added Trade and Firm Upgrading
affiliations: African Leadership University, African Leadership University, African Leadership University, African Leadership University, African Leadership University and Open Christian University

detail.title: Reorienting Global Value Chains under AfCFTA: The Role of SEZs and Emerging Technologies in Boosting Value-Added Trade and Firm Upgrading
detail.abstract: This study examines how Special Economic Zones (SEZs) and cuttingedge technologies can reposition Africa in global value chains (GVCs) under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) (Mondaq, 2023). Africa's intracontinental trade remains low (≈15% of total exports), and its GVC participation (≈5%) and export value-added (≈14%) are far below other regions. SEZs-over 200 currently active in Africa-offer a policy vehicle to boost manufacturing and export diversification. We develop a conceptual framework combining Global Value Chain theory, Institutional theory, and Innovation Diffusion theory to analyze firm upgrading, trade composition, and technology adoption in SEZs. Drawing on a mixed-methods approach (trade data analysis, policy document review, and case studies of Rwanda (Kigali Innovation City), Nigeria, Kenya, and Ethiopia), we find that well-designed SEZs can enable capability upgrading (especially via skill development and local linkages), modestly shift exports toward higher-value manufactures, and attract investment if backed by strong institutions. However, many SEZs remain "enclaves" with limited spillovers. Emerging technologies (blockchain, AI, IoT, 5G, additive manufacturing) show promise for enhancing SEZ operations by improving supplychain transparency, productivity, and efficiency, but their adoption is hampered by infrastructure gaps, high costs, and skills shortages. We conclude with tiered policy recommendations (zone-level, national, and AfCFTA-level) to foster tech-enabled SEZs that promote value addition and regional integration, and outline areas for future research and long-run trends (e.g. digital GVC platforms and green value chains).

detail.title: Sustainability of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises in Hong Kong: Drivers and the Moderating Role of Social Network

publicationDetails.detailsText: Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Management, volume 32, issue 4, 2025[10.1002/csr.3207]

detail.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are major economic actors and employers; they play a vital role in societies all over the world. Their participation and involvement are thus essential to the pursuit of sustainability. Over the past decade, academic and policy analysts have explored how to persuade or incentivize SMEs to join the sustainability bandwagon. Understanding what motivates them to pursue sustainability has important policy implications. This study advances this strand of research by identifying internal and external drivers of SMEs' sustainability practices-particularly whether (and how) their social networks might condition the impact of these drivers on the enterprises' sustainability practices. This study is conducted in Hong Kong, an important financial center in Asia; its conclusions have valuable insights for other countries in the region.

AI.method: 在香港进行的实证研究，香港是亚洲重要的金融中心。
AI.findings: 识别了中小企业参与可持续发展的内部和外部驱动力，并发现社会网络对这些驱动力的影响具有调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了中小企业可持续发展理论，特别强调了社会网络在调节驱动力影响方面的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了有价值的见解，帮助设计更有效的激励措施来促进中小企业参与可持续发展，对亚洲其他国家和地区具有参考价值。

title: Pricing Parametric Policy for Drought Risk in Garda Lake
affiliations: University of Verona

detail.title: Pricing Parametric Policy for Drought Risk in Garda Lake
detail.abstract: The increasing frequency and severity of natural disasters have intensified the demand for risk transfer mechanisms. Traditional indemnity-based insurance models struggle to provide timely and adequate financial relief due to high transaction costs, delayed claim processing, and moral hazard. Parametric insurance, which triggers payouts based on predefined indices such as weather conditions or seismic activity, has emerged as a promising alternative. This paper examines the evolution, structure, and pricing methodologies of parametric insurance, with a particular focus on its application in climate risk management and financial protection. The research further explores empirical case studies, such as agricultural and flight delay insurance, to assess the effectiveness of parametric models. Given the growing impact of climate change and catastrophic risks, parametric insurance represents a crucial advancement in global risk mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了参数保险在自然灾害风险管理中的发展、结构和定价方法，重点分析了其在气候风险管理和金融保护中的应用，并通过农业和航班延误保险等实证案例评估参数模型的有效性。
AI.research_question: 参数保险如何作为传统赔偿型保险的替代方案，在自然灾害风险管理中提供更及时和充分的财务救济？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害频率和严重性的增加加剧了对风险转移机制的需求，传统赔偿型保险因高交易成本、理赔延迟和道德风险等问题难以提供及时充分的财务救济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于参数保险理论、风险转移机制理论、气候风险管理理论和金融保护理论，探讨参数保险的触发机制和定价模型。
AI.method: 文献综述结合实证案例分析，重点研究农业保险和航班延误保险等参数保险应用案例。
AI.findings: 参数保险通过预定义指数（如天气条件或地震活动）触发赔付，能够提供更及时和充分的财务救济，是应对气候变化和灾难性风险的重要风险管理工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对参数保险机制的理论理解，完善了参数保险定价方法论，推动了风险转移理论在气候变化背景下的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司开发参数保险产品提供实践指导，为政策制定者设计气候风险缓解策略提供参考，帮助企业和个人更好地管理自然灾害风险。

title: Sticky Asset Prices
affiliations: Oslo and Akershus University College - Oslo Metropolitan University, University of Oxford and Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)

detail.title: Sticky Asset Prices
detail.abstract: We exploit an unexpected, geographically confined, and persistent increase in residential electricity prices to test whether real estate prices adjust quickly to their new fundamental value or whether they are downward sticky. We find that home prices in treated areas fall by 4.0-6.7% following the shock compared to controls, while sales volume declines by 5.7-10.0%. The drop in volume is driven by fewer listings, longer time-on-market, and increased unsold inventory-patterns consistent with downward price rigidity. We show that owners of houses whose market price falls below the outstanding mortgage and those who would realize a nominal loss are significantly less likely to sell and are more reluctant to lower prices. We conclude that housing prices are sticky, and discuss implications for macro models and for household mobility.

AI.tldr: 利用电力价格意外上涨的自然实验，研究发现房地产价格存在向下粘性，房价下跌4.0-6.7%，交易量下降5.7-10.0%，主要原因是房主不愿在名义亏损或负资产情况下出售和降价
AI.research_question: 房地产价格是否会快速调整到新的基本面价值，还是存在向下价格粘性？
AI.motivation: 理解房地产市场的价格调整机制，特别是价格向下调整的阻力，这对宏观经济模型和家庭流动性有重要影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的损失厌恶理论和名义价格粘性理论，探讨房主在面对价格下跌时的决策行为
AI.method: 利用地理上局限且持续性的居民电力价格上涨作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法比较处理组和对照组的房价和交易量变化
AI.findings: 处理区域房价下降4.0-6.7%，交易量下降5.7-10.0%；交易量下降主要由挂牌量减少、在售时间延长和未售库存增加驱动；负资产房主和面临名义损失的房主更不愿意出售和降价
AI.theory_contributions: 为房地产价格向下粘性提供了实证证据，支持行为经济学中的损失厌恶理论，丰富了名义价格粘性理论在房地产市场中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 对宏观经济政策制定有重要启示，说明房地产市场调整可能较慢，影响家庭流动性和资源配置效率，为房地产市场监管提供参考

title: Labour’s Tax Attack on UK Private School Education-  Interim Evaluation Update August 2025
affiliations: St Cross College - University of Oxford

detail.title: Labour’s Tax Attack on UK Private School Education-  Interim Evaluation Update August 2025
detail.abstract:
As of 1 January 2025, UK private school pupil numbers had already pre-emptively fallen by 11,000 i.e. c.2%, from one year before.

On 1 January 2025, in line with Labour’s manifesto, VAT on fees charged by private schools rose from 0% to 20%, reducible to some extent by offsetting input VAT.

On 1 April 2025, charitable relief on non-domestic rates paid by private schools in England was reduced from -80% to 0%.

On 6 April 2025, employer’s national insurance contributions for private school employees rose by 1.2% from 13.8% to 15%.

In early May 2025, state school teachers were allocated a c.4% pay rise, increasing salary pressure on private schools.

On 13 June 2025, the High Court delivered a unanimous judgment in the test case of ALR v Chancellor of the Exchequer, hearing and dismissing a judicial review of the new legislation on the claimed grounds of breaching the human rights of special needs SEND students at private schools.

As of 14 August 2025, at least 32 UK independent schools had announced closure plans since January 1 2025, with a number of others undergoing restructuring.

These key facts are dissected and analysed in detail in the paper below.

Interim conclusion: It will take a few years for the full impacts of these tax changes to become clear, but early signs are that the Labour’ government’s strategy, paraphrasing former chancellor Dennis Healey, of “squeez[ing] [private schools] until the pips squeak" seems to working, politically, in both extracting tax revenue and suppressing and shrinking this important knowledge sector of the UK economy.

In turn this is likely to affect the breadth and type of private education delivered, the onshore, offshore and physical and virtual splits in UK private education provision. And whether charitable status is still sensible and optimal and the availability of scholarships, bursaries and free resource provision such as shared sports facilities provided to the external community.

Other key questions are how long it will be for a change of governing party e.g. to Liberal, Conservative or Reform, and how quickly and how extensively if at all, any such new government would seek to reverse or ameliorate the Labour anti-private education tax changes set out above?

AI.tldr: 英国工党政府对私立学校实施了一系列税收政策改革（增值税从0%增至20%、取消慈善税率减免、提高雇主国民保险缴费等），导致私立学校学生人数减少2%、至少32所学校关闭，政策效果显著但长期影响仍需观察。
AI.research_question: 英国工党政府2025年对私立学校实施的税收政策改革对私立教育部门产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 分析新税收政策对私立学校运营、学生人数、学校关闭情况的影响，评估政策效果及其对英国教育体系的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政政策效应理论、教育经济学和制度变迁理论，分析税收政策变化对私立教育市场的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用事件分析法和实证数据分析，跟踪2025年1月至8月期间关键政策实施时间点与私立学校相关指标的变化。
AI.findings: 政策实施后私立学校学生人数减少11,000人（约2%），至少32所学校宣布关闭计划，税收政策对私立教育部门产生了显著挤压效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为税收政策对教育市场的影响提供了实证证据，丰富了财政政策与教育供给关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了税收改革对教育部门影响的实时评估，为未来教育政策调整提供参考依据。

title: Amicus brief in Cox Communications v. Sony Music Entertainment
affiliations: University of Richmond School of Law and George Washington University - Law School

detail.title: Amicus brief in Cox Communications v. Sony Music Entertainment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: As legal scholars with expertise in copyright law, amici’s sole interest is the proper application of the statutory and case law of copyright for the benefit of society, particularly the correct interpretation and application of contributory copyright liability in the context of conduit service providers. Amici’s university affiliations are for identification purposes only; amici present these arguments on their own behalf, not that of their respective universities.
declarations.funderStatement: No party, counsel for any party, or any person other than amici and their counsel authored this brief in whole or in part or made any monetary contribution for its preparation or submission.

detail.abstract:
The Fourth Circuit’s decision to impose contributory liability Cox Communications, Inc. rests on a fundamental misapprehension of Cox’s role as a “conduit” Internet Service Provider. Conduits merely transmit data between endpoints; unlike content-hosting platforms like YouTube or search engines like Google, conduits do not store, curate, or control user content. They merely transmit data on behalf of third parties, and they have no ability to monitor the data they transmit. By treating Cox’s passive provision of Internet access and data transmission as a knowing, material contribution to infringement, the Fourth Circuit collapsed the crucial legal distinction between conduits and hosts, extending contributory liability into an area where no court or legislature has ever placed it.

This unprecedented step disregards decades of precedent that establishes only two bases for contributory liability. First, traditional contributory liability involves ongoing infringement, and it turns on a defendant’s actual ability to prevent or remediate the infringement while it is occurring. Second, inducement liability involves future infringement, and it turns on the defendant’s active inducement of such infringement. Neither applies here.

The Fourth Circuit compounded this error by conflating certain requirements of the safe harbors from the DMCA with the elements of contributory liability. The DMCA’s safe harbor regime sets conditions for immunity, but it does not define the baseline scope of liability. By treating Cox’s alleged failure to meet DMCA conditions—such as terminating repeat infringers—as substantive evidence of contributory infringement, the Fourth Circuit improperly converted a limitation on statutory immunity into a standard for fault. That reasoning erases the distinction between the availability of a statutory defense and the existence of underlying liability, effectively imposing obligations on conduits that Congress chose not to impose.

Finally, the Fourth Circuit’s approach risks destabilizing copyright law by vastly expanding secondary liability without clear doctrinal or practical limits. If simply providing Internet access with knowledge of past infringement leads to contributory liability, then every conduit—including broadband providers, cell phone carriers, and even electric or utility companies that facilitate network use—could face liability whenever users misappropriate copyrighted works. That result is incompatible with this Court’s clear requirement that contributory liability rest on affirmative steps to foster such infringement, not on mere failure to terminate service.

Accordingly, the Court should reverse on Question One and reaffirm that conduits do not contribute to infringement merely by providing Internet access, absent inducement or other affirmative conduct.

AI.tldr: 第四巡回法院错误地将Cox通信公司作为'管道'ISP的互联网接入服务认定为帮助侵权责任，混淆了管道服务商与内容托管平台的法律区别，错误地将DMCA安全港条件转化为侵权责任标准，这一判决可能破坏版权法的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 第四巡回法院对Cox通信公司施加帮助侵权责任的法律依据是否正确？管道ISP是否应为其用户通过其网络传输的侵权内容承担帮助侵权责任？
AI.motivation: 第四巡回法院的判决开创性地将互联网接入服务提供商的被动数据传输行为认定为帮助侵权，这可能颠覆既有的版权法判例和立法意图，对互联网基础设施提供商造成不合理的法律责任负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统帮助侵权责任理论、诱导侵权责任理论以及DMCA安全港条款的法理分析，区分管道服务商与内容托管平台的法律责任边界。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和判例比较法，通过对第四巡回法院判决理由的逐条批判性分析，对比传统侵权责任理论与DMCA立法意图。
AI.findings: 第四巡回法院错误地：1）混淆了管道ISP与内容平台的本质区别；2）将DMCA安全港条件错误转化为侵权责任标准；3）扩大了帮助侵权责任的适用范围而无明确理论或实践限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了管道ISP在版权法中的法律地位，明确了帮助侵权责任需要基于积极促进侵权的行为而非单纯的网络接入服务，维护了侵权责任理论的界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院推翻错误判决提供法律依据，保护互联网基础设施提供商免受不合理的侵权责任风险，确保互联网服务的稳定发展和创新。

title: Race, Gender, and Careers in Asset Management: Evidence from U.S. Administrative Data
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA) - D’Amore-McKim School of Business, Peking University HSBC Business School, University of Central Florida, University of Florida and University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate

detail.title: Race, Gender, and Careers in Asset Management: Evidence from U.S. Administrative Data
detail.abstract: Using confidential administrative data from the U.S. Census Bureau, we examine whether race and gender affect compensation and career outcomes in the U.S. asset management industry. We document substantial compensation gaps: female portfolio managers earn 27% less than male peers, and minority managers earn 20% less than White peers. Female and minority managers also face significantly higher rates of forced turnover, and female managers are less likely to be rehired following job separations. These gaps can not be explained by differences in qualifications: minority managers are more likely to attend elite schools and hold advanced degrees. Nor do they reflect differences in performance: we find no systematic disparities in investment performance or in the ability to attract investor flows. Importantly, we show that greater diversity among asset management firm owners helps mitigate these disparities. Together, these findings challenge the notion that meritocratic industries are immune to discrimination and raise concerns about taste-based discrimination and potential talent misallocation in an industry central to capital markets.

AI.tldr: 美国资产管理行业存在显著的种族和性别薪酬差距：女性基金经理比男性同行低27%，少数族裔比白人低20%。这些差距无法用资质或业绩差异解释，但公司所有者多样性有助于缓解这些不平等。
AI.research_question: 种族和性别是否影响美国资产管理行业的薪酬和职业发展结果？
AI.motivation: 检验所谓精英行业是否真正免于歧视，探讨资产管理这一资本市场核心行业中的潜在歧视问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场歧视理论，包括统计歧视和偏好歧视理论框架。
AI.method: 使用美国人口普查局的机密行政数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 发现显著的薪酬差距（女性-27%，少数族裔-20%），更高的强制离职率，且这些差距无法用资质（少数族裔教育背景更好）或业绩差异解释。公司所有者多样性有助于减少这些不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了精英行业免于歧视的观念，为劳动力市场歧视理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了资产管理行业的系统性不平等问题，提出了通过增加公司所有者多样性来缓解歧视的实践方案。

title: The Impact of Income Smoothing on Accounting Aggregates: The Case of the Property-Casualty Industry
affiliations: Austin Peay State University, Lingnan University, St. John's University - Peter J. Tobin College of Business, University of Alabama - Culverhouse College of Commerce & Business Administration, University of Alabama - Department of Economics, Finance and Legal Studies and University of Alabama - Department of Economics, Finance and Legal Studies

detail.title: The Impact of Income Smoothing on Accounting Aggregates: The Case of the Property-Casualty Industry
detail.abstract: We study U.S. property-casualty loss reserve accruals, comparing simple actuarial estimates based on individual company data to actual company reports and to ultimate loss reports. We find that individual company accruals track with estimates produced by Bayesian methodologies designed to smooth results over time, rather than methodologies that leverage current results. Company accruals also feature smoothing relative to the baseline of the Bayesian actuarial estimates. Smoothing delivers higher forecast accuracy at the company level, but aggregated company accruals perform poorly relative to aggregates from actuarial methodologies that leverage current results. These findings suggest that smoothing is individually rational but suppresses company information that would otherwise contribute to the "wisdom of crowds" in aggregate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国财产损失准备金提取，发现公司使用平滑化方法来提高预测准确性，但这种个体理性行为在聚合层面反而导致信息损失，抵消了"群体智慧"效应。
AI.research_question: 企业财产损失准备金提取是否存在平滑法行为？这种平滑如何影响个体公司和行业聚合层面的预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 探索企业在准备金提取中的行为动机和对信息传递的影响，理解个体理性选择与群体效益之间的微妙关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯统计方法和平滑法理论，结合"群体智慧"概念分析个体与聚合信息效果的差异。
AI.method: 对比分析个体公司数据的简单精算估计、实际公司报告和最终损失报告，使用贝叶斯方法进行时间平滑和当前结果利用的对比研究。
AI.findings: 公司准备金提取与贝叶斯平滑方法一致，并在基础估计上进一步平滑；平滑提高个体公司预测准确性，但聚合数据表现较差，压制了群体智慧效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了个体理性选择与群体信息效果相互作用的理论见解，丰富了会计估计和信息传递理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者提供了关于准备金提取行为的实证见解，有助于改善行业信息质量和投资决策效果。

title: Project Portfolio Management and Optimization Models: Process Sequencing for Maximized Outcomes
affiliations: University of Johannesburg, Johannesburg, South Africa and University of Johannesburg, Johannesburg, South Africa

detail.title: Project Portfolio Management and Optimization Models: Process Sequencing for Maximized Outcomes
detail.abstract: Project portfolio management (PPM) and optimization models are increasingly adopted to address the dual challenges of resource allocation, strategic alignment, and uncertainty in complex, multi-project environments. Despite significant methodological advances, the extent of their effectiveness, application domains, and limitations has not been comprehensively synthesized. A systematic review was conducted following PRISMA guidelines. Publications between 2015 and 2025 were retrieved from Google Scholar, Web of Science, and Scopus. A total of 1,947 records were identified, of which 40 studies met the inclusion criteria. Data were extracted on year of publication, industry context, methodological models, computational approaches, risk/uncertainty dimensions, reported impacts, and barriers to implementation. The review highlights three temporal phases of research: an initial surge in 2015, steady contributions between 2017-2020, and a tapering after 2021. Construction (30%) dominated industry applications, followed by project management (15%) and cross-industry domains (12.5%). Methodologically, resource-constrained scheduling frameworks (≈15%) and portfolio-level models integrating financial/strategic criteria (≈10%) were most common. Metaheuristics (17.5%), mathematical programming (12.5%), and AI-based methods (12.5%) emerged as leading computational approaches, though 22.5% of studies lacked methodological transparency. Risk dimensions centered primarily on resource availability (22.5%) and project duration uncertainty (12.5%), with limited integration of advanced risk modeling (e.g., Monte Carlo, ANN, fuzzy sets). Reported impacts included improved resource utilization (20%), enhanced strategic alignment (17.5%), and better project delivery outcomes (15%). However, barriers were significant, led by complexity and uncertainty in multi-project environments (32.5%), resource constraints (20%), organizational inertia (15%), and persistent technical/data limitations (12.5%). While PPM and optimization models have demonstrated measurable benefits in resource efficiency, alignment, and delivery performance, their practical application is constrained by methodological opacity, organizational resistance, and limited integration of uncertainty modeling. Greater emphasis on hybrid and AI-enhanced frameworks, standardized reporting, and sector-specific adaptations is needed to bridge the gap between theoretical innovation and real-world adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述分析了2015-2025年间项目组合管理优化模型的研究现状，发现这些模型在资源效率、战略对齐和交付绩效方面有显著效益，但受限于方法不透明、组织阻力和不确定性建模不足等障碍。
AI.research_question: 项目组合管理优化模型的有效性、应用领域和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管项目组合管理优化模型在方法论上有显著进展，但其有效性、应用领域和局限性尚未得到全面综合评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目组合管理理论、资源约束调度理论、多项目环境不确定性理论
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述方法，从Google Scholar、Web of Science和Scopus检索2015-2025年间的文献，最终纳入40项研究进行分析
AI.findings: 研究发现建设行业应用最多（30%），资源约束调度框架（≈15%）和组合级模型（≈10%）最常见。元启发式算法（17.5%）、数学规划（12.5%）和AI方法（12.5%）是主要计算方法。主要障碍包括多项目环境复杂性（32.5%）、资源约束（20%）和组织惯性（15%）
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了项目组合管理优化模型的研究脉络，识别了三个研究阶段和发展趋势，为理论发展提供了综合视角
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了实践应用中的主要障碍，提出了需要加强混合和AI增强框架、标准化报告和行业特定适应性的建议，以弥合理论创新与实际应用之间的差距

title: Picking Hedge Funds with Information Updating
affiliations: National Tsing Hua University - Department of Quantitative Finance, University of Nottingham, University of Edinburgh Business School and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Picking Hedge Funds with Information Updating
detail.abstract: This paper develops the family-wise error rate plus (fwer+) method, which incorporates informative covariates into the control of the family-wise error rate (FWER) in multiple hypothesis testing. FWER control ensures that the risk of selecting a non-performing predictor or asset remains low, while fwer+ allows rejection thresholds to depend on informative covariates, capturing additional information to achieve higher statistical power in detecting outperforming predictive models or assets. These features make fwer+ particularly suitable for evaluating hedge fund performance. We apply our method to a large set of hedge funds and covariates, demonstrating that it is sufficiently powerful to identify a substantial number of outperforming funds each year while maintaining a very low FWER. Using this approach, we construct annually rebalanced hedge fund portfolios that outperform various passive benchmarks, beat portfolios formed using existing methods, and generate a significant alpha of 7% per annum. Further analysis suggests that the informative covariates are largely driven by a small number of latent factors, with hedge funds' exposures to macroeconomic variables playing the dominant role.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了fwer+方法，将信息性协变量纳入多重假设检验中的家族错误率控制，提高了统计功效，在识别优异对冲基金方面表现突出，构建的投资组合年化alpha达7%。
AI.research_question: 如何将信息性协变量纳入多重假设检验中的家族错误率控制，以提高在评估对冲基金表现时的统计功效？
AI.motivation: 传统FWER控制方法在多重假设检验中虽然能控制错误发现风险，但未能充分利用协变量信息，导致统计功效不足，特别是在对冲基金绩效评估中需要更强大的检测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家族错误率(FWER)控制理论，扩展为fwer+框架，允许拒绝阈值依赖于信息性协变量，结合多重假设检验和协变量调整理论。
AI.method: 开发fwer+方法，将协变量信息整合到FWER控制中，应用于大规模对冲基金数据集，使用信息性协变量构建投资组合并进行年度再平衡。
AI.findings: fwer+方法能够每年识别大量优异对冲基金，同时保持极低FWER；构建的投资组合显著超越各种被动基准和现有方法，年化alpha达到7%；信息性协变量主要由少量潜在因子驱动，对冲基金对宏观经济变量的暴露起主导作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将协变量信息纳入FWER控制的理论框架fwer+，扩展了多重假设检验理论，为协变量调整的假设检验提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为对冲基金绩效评估提供了更强大的统计工具，能够构建显著超越市场基准的投资组合，为投资实践提供了有效的基金筛选和组合构建方法。

title: Banks' Inflation Expectations and Credit Allocation: the Fisher Effect
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Finance and Universidad Torcuato di Tella

detail.title: Banks' Inflation Expectations and Credit Allocation: the Fisher Effect
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how lenders' inflation expectations shape credit allocation. Banks expecting higher inflation reallocate credit towards ex-ante leveraged firms, which benefit from a reduction in real debt burdens. To test this hypothesis, we combine individual bank macroeconomic forecasts for developed economies with syndicated loan data from 1991 to 2021. We show that banks expecting a 1 percentage point higher inflation over the next year extend loans that are 15% larger and 17 basis points cheaper to firms with high long-term leverage, relative to banks with lower inflation expectations. Importantly, the effects are not present for firms with high short-term leverage, whose real value is harder to reduce. Consistent with this pattern, firms receiving loans from banks with higher inflation expectations increase their capital expenditure relative to otherwise similar firms borrowing from banks with lower expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，银行对通胀的预期会影响信贷分配。预期通胀更高的银行会向高杠杆企业提供更多、更便宜的贷款，因为这些企业能从实际债务负担减少中获益。
AI.research_question: 贷款人的通胀预期如何影响信贷分配？
AI.motivation: 理解银行通胀预期对信贷流向的影响机制，特别是对高杠杆企业的信贷可获得性和成本的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀预期理论，高通胀预期会降低实际债务负担，使得银行更愿意向高杠杆企业提供信贷
AI.method: 结合发达经济体个体银行的宏观经济预测数据（1991-2021年）和银团贷款数据，进行实证分析
AI.findings: 预期通胀高1个百分点的银行向高长期杠杆企业提供的贷款规模大15%，利率低17个基点；对高短期杠杆企业无此效应；获得此类贷款的企业资本支出增加
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行通胀预期通过实际债务负担机制影响信贷分配的微观机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者理解信贷市场动态提供洞见，帮助监管机构预测信贷周期变化

title: Capital Efficiency and Liquidity-Driven Valuation: Evaluating Alba and Alcoa using AEVM v1.0
affiliations: Institute of Certified Public Accountant ( ICPAP)

detail.title: Capital Efficiency and Liquidity-Driven Valuation: Evaluating Alba and Alcoa using AEVM v1.0

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive personal data. All financial data analyzed were obtained from publicly available corporate reports and market databases.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study introduces the Alaali Economic Value Model (AEVM v1), a foundational valuation framework developed under the emerging scientific discipline of Dynamic Financial Applied Science (DFAS) and documented within the Alaali Financial Models Meta-Framework (AFMF). AEVM addresses structural limitations in legacy valuation models such as DCF, EVA, and FCF by directly integrating capital efficiency, liquidity constraints, and sector-specific adjustments. Applied to Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) and Alcoa Corporation, AEVM v1 demonstrates how traditional models often fail to capture real-world valuation distortions in capital-intensive and illiquid environments. The model’s emphasis on internal financial fundamentals offers a more stable and decision-relevant assessment of firm value. AEVM is governed by the principles of the (DFAS-FEP) Financial Engine Protocol (Alaali, 2025), a formal doctrine that ensures ethical transparency, model auditability, and responsible disclosure in AI-enhanced financial systems. While this manuscript presents AEVM in its original linear form, the model has since been structurally upgraded with a nonlinear engine that enhances its responsiveness to capital inefficiencies and liquidity shocks. This case study therefore serves as a validation of AEVM v1 and as a methodological foundation for the forthcoming nonlinear version (AEVM v2), which will be detailed in future research. The findings reinforce AEVM’s role as a next-generation valuation engine within DFAS and highlight its strategic relevance for capital-intensive sectors under financial stress.

AI.tldr: 本研究介绍了Alaali经济价值模型(AEVM v1)，这是一个基于动态金融应用科学(DFAS)的新兴科学学科开发的估值框架。该模型通过直接整合资本效率、流动性约束和行业特定调整，解决了传统估值模型(DCF、EVA、FCF)的结构性局限。在巴林铝业和Alcoa公司的应用表明，AEVM能更好地捕捉资本密集和流动性不足环境中的估值失真。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够克服传统估值模型局限，更好地捕捉资本密集和流动性不足环境中企业真实价值的新一代估值框架？
AI.motivation: 传统估值模型(DCF、EVA、FCF)在资本密集和流动性不足的环境中存在结构性局限，无法准确反映企业真实价值，需要开发更先进的估值方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态金融应用科学(DFAS)理论框架和Alaali金融模型元框架(AFMF)，采用DFAS-FEP金融引擎协议原则确保模型透明度、可审计性和负责任披露。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，将AEVM v1模型应用于Aluminium Bahrain (Alba)和Alcoa Corporation两家铝业公司，与传统估值模型进行对比分析。
AI.findings: AEVM v1模型能够更准确地捕捉资本密集和流动性不足环境中的估值失真，提供更稳定和决策相关的企业价值评估，传统模型在这些环境下往往失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新一代估值理论框架AEVM，建立了动态金融应用科学(DFAS)的理论基础，为金融估值领域提供了新的理论视角和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资本密集型行业在财务压力环境下提供了更有效的估值工具，帮助投资者和企业做出更准确的投资和财务决策，模型具有实际应用价值。

title: Fed-President Pressure Index (FPPI)
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Fed-President Pressure Index (FPPI)
detail.abstract: We introduce the Fed-President Pressure Index (FPPI), a monthly measure of presidential influence on the Federal Reserve from 1980 to 2025. Constructed from 68,850 newspaper articles and validated against FOMC minutes, the FPPI captures measurable political pressure on monetary policy. The index shows that presidential pressure increases consensus in FOMC voting, raises uncertainty and expected inflation, and is stronger under Republican administrations. Empirical analyses indicate that higher pressure induces shifts in both the federal funds effective rate and its target. These findings highlight the significant role of political dynamics, particularly presidential influence, in shaping U.S. monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了Fed-President Pressure Index (FPPI)来衡量1980-2025年间总统对美联储的影响，发现政治压力会增加FOMC投票共识、提高通胀预期，且在共和党政府下更强。
AI.research_question: 总统对美联储的政治压力如何影响美国货币政策？
AI.motivation: 理解政治因素特别是总统影响力在货币政策制定中的作用机制和实际影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、中央银行独立性理论、货币政策传导机制
AI.method: 基于68,850篇报纸文章构建FPPI指数，并与FOMC会议纪要进行验证，进行实证分析
AI.findings: 总统压力增加FOMC投票共识、提高不确定性和预期通胀，共和党政府下压力更强，影响联邦基金有效利率和目标利率
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了量化政治压力的新方法，揭示了政治因素对货币政策的具体影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和研究人员提供了衡量政治干预货币政策的新工具和洞察

title: Disparate Financial Distress while Sustaining Homeownership
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of Virginia - McIntire School of Commerce

detail.title: Disparate Financial Distress while Sustaining Homeownership
detail.abstract: Using linked property transaction data and credit records, we document group-level differences in financial distress before and after transitioning into homeownership. Black and female borrowers experience larger increases in post-purchase delinquency relative to White and male borrowers, respectively, as measured by 30+ day and 90+ day delinquency rates, even after accounting for stringent controls, credit score, and income-at-purchase. Post-purchase, Black and female borrowers also accumulate more student debt, while credit card balances rise for everyone, but faster for Black borrowers. Understanding disparities in sustaining homeownership informs our assessment of racial and gender disparities in the financial benefits of homeownership.

AI.tldr: 通过连接房地产交易数据和信用记录，研究发现黑人和女性借款人在购房后财务困境更差，违约率和学生债务增长都高于白人和男性借款人，显示了购房收益的种族和性别差异。
AI.research_question: 黑人和女性借款人在转向房业主后的财务困境与白人和男性借款人存在什么差异？
AI.motivation: 理解维持房业主身份时的财务差异，有助于评估房地产投资带来的财务收益在种族和性别上的不平等性。

AI.method: 使用连接的房地产交易数据和信用记录进行实证分析，包括严格的控制变量、信用分数和购房时收入
AI.findings: 黑人和女性借款人违约率增长更高，黑人借款人学生债务积累更多，信用卡余额增长速度更快

title: How Do Individual Investors Learn?

detail.title: How Do Individual Investors Learn?

declarations.funderStatement: This research has benefited from the OP Research Foundation.

detail.abstract: I decompose the realized net returns of a large sample of retail investors over 15 years to examine what they learn from their stock trading experience. I find that retail investors improve their returns through better stock selection, reduced trading frequency, and slightly improved execution timing, with the relative importance of these factors evolving over time. Stock selection is the main source of return improvements, particularly during the early stages of an investor's trading experience. Most learning occurs within the first 50 trades and diminishes significantly, nearly ceasing after 100 trades. Importantly, my findings indicate that faster learners remain active in the market, while slower learners tend to quit trading.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分解零售投资者15年间的实际净收益，发现投资者从股票交易经验中学习，主要通过改善选股能力、降低交易频率和略微改善执行时机来提高收益。学习主要发生在前50次交易中，100次交易后基本停止。学习速度快的投资者继续交易，而学习慢的投资者倾向于退出市场。
AI.research_question: 零售投资者从股票交易经验中学到了什么？
AI.motivation: 了解零售投资者如何通过交易经验学习并改善投资表现，以及学习过程的时间动态特征
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、学习理论、投资者行为理论
AI.method: 分解分析法，分析大量零售投资者15年间的实际净收益数据
AI.findings: 投资者通过改善选股（主要因素）、降低交易频率和略微改善执行时机来提高收益；学习主要发生在前50次交易中；学习速度快的投资者继续交易，学习慢的退出市场
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了零售投资者学习过程的时间动态特征和不同学习维度的相对重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者教育提供实证依据，帮助投资者理解学习曲线和改善投资决策

title: Art as Collateral: Toward an International Register for Artwork
affiliations: Fordham University School of Law and International University of Monaco (IUM)

detail.title: Art as Collateral: Toward an International Register for Artwork

keywords: UNI-DROIT Convention on Stolen or Illegally Exported Cultural Objects value

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Berkeley Business Law Journal, vol. 26, iss. 2
Fordham Law Legal Studies Research Paper;
publicationDetails.journalName: Fordham Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the last decades, a trend of art being used as a security in finance has emerged. The use of art as collateral for loans has become widespread, especially in the United States. However, this market practice is not without challenges. The valuation of art is often unstable and hard to predict, thus creating uncertainty for lenders. Buyers and lenders frequently must contend with unclear chains of title, thus exposing them to the risk of loss of value in artwork and even loss of legal title. This article explores the advantages and disadvantages of the rising use of art as collateral and proposes reforms to help the market reach higher levels of transparency, efficiency, and stability. Overall, the benefits of arts as collateral are manifold, including capitalization of the art market, expanding the art clientele as well as pushing technical boundaries in the securitization of art. At the same time, in light of a lack of legal certainty across borders, we propose the introduction of an obligatory international register for artwork that would record transactions in valuable art when security interests are at stake. A register should specify the artwork in detail and record documents conferring title, establishing security interests, and the basis for valuation. Such a register would have three significant advantages for the art market. First, it would improve legal certainty for art buyers and lenders accepting art as collateral. Second, it would standardize pricing of art by facilitating comparisons across time and between different works of art, but also around the globe. Thus, valuation would become simpler and subject to less uncertainty. Third, it would make it easier for governments to locate valuable national heritage in art for regulatory purposes and hinder money laundering and tax evasion.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨艺术品作为金融抵押品的利弊，分析估值不稳定和所有权链不明确等挑战，提出建立国际艺术品登记制度以提高市场透明度、效率和稳定性。
AI.research_question: 艺术品作为抵押品的优势和劣势是什么？如何改革艺术品抵押市场以提高其透明度、效率和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 近年来艺术品作为金融抵押品的趋势日益明显，但存在估值不稳定、所有权链不明确等问题，需要系统性研究并提出改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融抵押品理论、艺术品估值理论和国际登记制度理论，分析艺术品作为特殊抵押品的独特属性和风险特征。
AI.method: 采用理论分析和政策建议的方法，通过分析现有市场实践和问题，提出建立国际艺术品登记制度的改革方案。
AI.findings: 艺术品作为抵押品具有资本化艺术市场、扩大艺术客户群和推动证券化技术发展等优势，但面临估值不确定性和法律确定性不足等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了艺术品金融化理论，提出了艺术品作为特殊抵押品的风险评估框架和国际登记制度的理论模型。

title: From Cooperation to Anomie and Transaction in the Transatlantic Relationship? A View from Europe on the Trump Administration 2.0

detail.title: From Cooperation to Anomie and Transaction in the Transatlantic Relationship? A View from Europe on the Trump Administration 2.0

declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation

detail.abstract: This paper discusses a European view on the Trump Administration 2.0 actions in the international realm. The focus is on the structural issues that affect Europe deeply. Although the whole world is concerned by these actions, for Europe, having been a close U.S. partner in the last eighty years, this is especially disappointing and disrupting. Not only is there disappointed trust but also a realization that formerly common shared values are no more. I focus on three themes: (1) U.S. actions paralyzing multilateralism, demonstrating a zero-sum thinking and free-riding on the provision of global public goods and commons; (2) U.S. ignoring central pillars of international law; and (3) U.S. destabilization of Europe itself through political meddling.

AI.tldr: 本文从欧洲视角分析特朗普政府第二任期在国际事务中的行动，重点关注对欧洲产生深远影响的结构性问题，包括破坏多边主义、无视国际法和干涉欧洲政治。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府第二任期在国际事务中的行动如何影响欧洲，以及这些行动揭示了哪些结构性问题和价值观变化？
AI.motivation: 欧洲作为美国过去八十年的紧密伙伴，对特朗普政府的行动感到特别失望和不安，不仅信任受损，还意识到曾经共同的价值观已不复存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、多边主义理论、全球公共产品理论、国际法理论
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，聚焦三个主题领域的政策行动分析
AI.findings: 特朗普政府行动在三个主要方面对欧洲产生负面影响：(1)瘫痪多边主义，展现零和思维并在全球公共产品方面搭便车；(2)无视国际法核心支柱；(3)通过政治干涉破坏欧洲稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对美国外交政策转变对传统盟友影响的理论理解，特别是价值观分歧和结构性信任危机的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者提供应对美国政策转变的战略见解，帮助欧洲重新评估与美国的关系并制定相应的外交政策。

detail.title: Evaluating the Implementation of the 20-Valent Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccine for Paediatric Immunization in Australia
detail.abstract: Objective: In Australia, the paediatric national immunization programme (NIP) currently includes 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV13) under 2+1 schedule. The 15-valent (PCV15) and 20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCV20) are available in Australia but not yet NIP funded. This cost-effectiveness analysis compared the public health and economic impact of implementing PCV20 into the Australian paediatric NIP versus PCV13 and PCV15.Methods: We conducted the cost-effectiveness analysis from the payer perspective using a population-based multi-cohort model with a 10-year horizon and a 5% annual discount rate for costs and benefits. The model considered direct vaccine effects in the vaccinated cohort aged <2 years and indirect effects in unvaccinated individuals of all ages. Input data for epidemiology, costs, and utilities were obtained from Australia-specific sources. Vaccine effectiveness inputs were derived from PCV13 real-world effectiveness data, 7-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV7) efficacy data, and PCV13 impact data. Model estimated pneumococcal disease cases (invasive pneumococcal disease, pneumonia, and otitis media), deaths, costs, and quality-adjusted life years (QALY) for each vaccination strategy, which were used to calculate incremental cost-effectiveness ratios. Sensitivity analyses were conducted to test uncertainty in input parameters and examine model robustness.Results: Model estimated that PCV20 implementation would prevent more disease cases and deaths than PCV13 (642,804 and 8,308, respectively) and PCV15 (290,943 and 3,730, respectively) over 10 years. PCV20 was associated with QALY gains of 117,417 and 55,279, and total cost-savings of AUD 668,174,379 and AUD 312,296,604 versus PCV13 and PCV15, respectively. Therefore, PCV20 was predicted to be the dominant vaccination strategy versus both comparators. PCV20 was also dominant versus PCV13 in 97.40% of probabilistic sensitivity analysis iterations and versus PCV15 in 85.70% of iterations.Conclusions: This cost-effectiveness analysis estimated that adoption of PCV20 into the Australian paediatric NIP would be dominant versus PCV13 and PCV15, leading to health benefits and cost-savings.

AI.tldr: 澳大利亚儿童免疫计划中，PCV20相比PCV13和PCV15具有成本效益优势，10年内可预防更多疾病病例和死亡，并节省大量医疗费用
AI.research_question: PCV20疫苗在澳大利亚儿童国家免疫计划中相比PCV13和PCV15的成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚目前使用PCV13疫苗，但PCV15和PCV20疫苗已上市但尚未纳入国家免疫计划资助，需要评估这些新疫苗的成本效益
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架，从支付方角度评估疫苗接种策略的经济性和公共卫生影响
AI.method: 基于人群的多队列模型，10年时间跨度，5%年贴现率，考虑直接疫苗效果和间接群体免疫效果，使用澳大利亚本地流行病学、成本和效用数据
AI.findings: PCV20相比PCV13可预防642,804例疾病和8,308例死亡，相比PCV15可预防290,943例疾病和3,730例死亡，分别节省6.68亿和3.12亿澳元，是主导策略
AI.theory_contributions: 为高价值疫苗的成本效益评估提供了方法论框架，特别是在考虑直接和间接免疫效果的多队列建模方面
AI.practical_contributions: 为澳大利亚政府决策提供证据支持，建议将PCV20纳入国家免疫计划，可实现更好的健康产出和成本节约

title: Nonlinear Environmental Impacts of Information Infrastructure: From Initial Pollution to Green Tech Gains
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Nonlinear Environmental Impacts of Information Infrastructure: From Initial Pollution to Green Tech Gains
detail.abstract: This study assesses the environmental impacts of information infrastructure development, specifically analyzing its effect on air pollution indicators such as carbon emissions and PM2.5 levels. Initial findings indicate that while early stages of infrastructure development tend to increase pollution due to industrial expansion, the adoption of advanced, eco-friendly technologies eventually leads to notable environmental improvements. The research highlights significant regional differences; energy-exporting regions experience reduced pollution with infrastructure improvements, whereas energy-importing areas see immediate reductions in PM2.5 during initial stages. These strategies aim to harmonize infrastructure development with environmental sustainability objectives, providing a strategic framework for mitigating pollution while fostering technological advancement.

AI.tldr: 信息基础设施建设初期会增加污染，但采用环保技术后能显著改善环境质量，且存在显著的区域差异性能源出口地区基础设施改善后污染减少，能源进口地区初期PM2.5立即下降
AI.research_question: 信息基础设施建设对环境 impacts 的影响，特别是对碳排放和PM2.5等空气污染指标的影响
AI.motivation: 评估信息基础设施发展与环境可持续性目标之间的协调关系，为在促进技术进步的同时减轻污染提供战略框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施发展与环境影响的阶段性理论，区域差异理论，技术采纳与环境改善的关系理论
AI.method: 环境 impact 评估分析，区域对比研究，污染指标监测
AI.findings: 1. 基础设施建设初期因工业扩张增加污染；2. 采用先进环保技术后环境显著改善；3. 能源出口地区基础设施改善后污染减少；4. 能源进口地区初期PM2.5立即下降
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信息基础设施发展与环境影响的阶段性理论框架，揭示了区域差异在环境效应中的重要作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了协调基础设施发展与环境保护的战略框架，支持在技术进步的同时实现污染减排

title: Multi-time Scale Optimal Dispatching of Integrated Energy in the Industrial Park Considering Green Certificate-carbon Collaborative Trading
affiliations: Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd., Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd., Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd., Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd., Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd. and Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd.

detail.title: Multi-time Scale Optimal Dispatching of Integrated Energy in the Industrial Park Considering Green Certificate-carbon Collaborative Trading
detail.abstract: Renewable energies have become the core driver of energy transition within industrial parks. However,their inherent uncertainties plus load fluctuation pose major challenges to the dispatch of integrated energy.Though carbon emission trading (CET) and green certificate trading (GCT) serve as key tools to curbexcessive energy use and emissions, thereby supporting energy transition, the coordinated optimization of their economic benefits and emission-reduction effects remains underexplored. This study proposes a multi-timescale optimal dispatching framework that integrates GCT-CET synergy and comprehensive demand response (DR), featuring a three-stage implementation scheme: day-ahead optimization, intra-day adjustment, and real-time correction. In the day-ahead scheduling phase, the GCT-CET collaborative trading and price-based DR are combined to optimize unit output and reduce carbon emissions. In the intra-day scheduling phase, incentive-based DR is used to further smooth load fluctuations. In the real-time scheduling phase, the deviation from the intra-day plan is corrected. Results demonstrate that day-ahead scheduling reduces total park costs by 4.2% and carbon emissions by 50.7%. Intra-day scheduling lowers contact line power fluctuation by 5.2%. Real-time scheduling corrects deviations, validating uncertainty mitigation. This multi-timescale optimization strategies enhances hybrid storage responsiveness, mitigates uncertainties, bridges gaps in standalone CET/GCT and fragmented DR, enriching industrial parks’economic-environmental optimization theories.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个整合绿色证书交易-碳交易协同和需求响应的多时间尺度优化调度框架，通过日前、日内和实时三阶段调度方案，有效降低了工业园区成本和碳排放，平滑了负荷波动。
AI.research_question: 如何在工业园区综合能源系统中协调优化碳交易和绿色证书交易的经济效益与减排效果？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源的不确定性和负荷波动给综合能源调度带来挑战，碳交易和绿色证书交易作为关键工具，但其协同优化经济效益和减排效果的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多时间尺度优化调度理论，整合绿色证书交易-碳交易协同机制和综合需求响应理论。
AI.method: 提出三阶段实施方案：日前优化（GCT-CET协同交易和价格型DR）、日内调整（激励型DR）、实时校正（偏差修正）。
AI.findings: 日前调度降低园区总成本4.2%，碳排放50.7%；日内调度降低联络线功率波动5.2%；实时调度有效校正偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了工业园区经济-环境优化理论，弥补了单独碳交易/绿色证书交易和碎片化需求响应的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的多时间尺度优化策略增强了混合储能响应能力，缓解了不确定性，为工业园区能源调度提供了实用框架。

title: Walter Lippmann: A Proto-Public Choice Theorist
affiliations: Northwood University and Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Walter Lippmann: A Proto-Public Choice Theorist

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no dedicated funding for this project.

detail.abstract: This article explores Walter Lippmann’s intellectual contributions in light of public choice theory. We argue that Lippmann’s approach to politics challenges the common romantic views of his time by offering a pragmatic perspective in which politics is understood as an imperfect process, with unintended consequences and the self-interest of political actors playing a major role in creating the resulting order. Hence, Lippmann can be seen as a proto-public choice theorist, anticipating key insights later developed and formalized by James Buchanan, Gordon Tullock, and others. This perspective provides a framework to interpret the trajectory of Lippmann’s thinking on political economy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为李普曼的政治观点可被视为公共选择理论的先驱，他挑战了当时浪漫化的政治观，提出了强调政治过程不完美性、意外后果和政治行动者自利行为的实用主义视角。
AI.research_question: 沃尔特·李普曼的知识贡献如何与公共选择理论相关联？
AI.motivation: 重新评估李普曼的政治思想，揭示其作为公共选择理论先驱的地位，挑战当时对政治的浪漫化看法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共选择理论、实用主义政治哲学、政治经济学
AI.method: 理论分析和思想史研究，通过文本分析探讨李普曼著作与公共选择理论的关联
AI.findings: 李普曼的政治观点预见了布坎南、塔洛克等人的关键见解，强调政治过程的不完美性、意外后果和政治行动者的自利行为
AI.theory_contributions: 将李普曼定位为公共选择理论的先驱，拓展了该理论的思想史渊源
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实政治过程提供了更现实的框架，有助于政策制定者认识政治决策的复杂性和局限性

title: Not Just Who Wins, But by How Much: Electoral Decisiveness and Market Outcomes
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Not Just Who Wins, But by How Much: Electoral Decisiveness and Market Outcomes
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how the margin of victory (MoV) in U.S. presidential elections influences stock market outcomes. We hypothesize that a larger MoV makes households less averse to risk and more optimistic, thereby boosting returns. At the same time, a decisive victory reduces political and regulatory uncertainty, lowering market volatility. To address potential endogeneity, we exploit election-day weather shocks across the 50 largest U.S. cities as an instrumental variable. The effects of MoV vary across sectors and firm sizes, with the strongest impact on small-cap stocks. Results remain robust across political contexts, showing that markets respond not only to who wins, but also to the scale of their victory, reflecting investor confidence in the president's mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现美国总统选举的胜选优势幅度通过影响家庭风险偏好和减少政治不确定性，对股市回报产生正向影响，对小盘股影响最显著。
AI.research_question: 美国总统选举的胜选优势幅度如何影响股票市场结果？
AI.motivation: 探究选举结果明确性对投资者信心和市场表现的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论（家庭风险偏好和乐观情绪）、政治不确定性理论
AI.method: 利用美国50个最大城市选举日天气冲击作为工具变量，解决内生性问题
AI.findings: 较大的胜选优势幅度会降低家庭风险厌恶、增加乐观情绪，从而提高股市回报并降低市场波动性；对小盘股影响最显著；结果在不同政治背景下均稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了政治选举结果对金融市场影响的理论框架，强调胜选规模的重要性而不仅仅是获胜者身份
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供选举结果解读的新维度，帮助理解市场对政治确定性的反应模式

title: The Microsoft Formula For Platform Power: Do Significant Network Effects Inevitably Generate Winnder-Takes-All Dynamics?
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School and University of Haifa - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Microsoft Formula For Platform Power: Do Significant Network Effects Inevitably Generate Winnder-Takes-All Dynamics?
detail.abstract:
• This article contests Microsoft's popular assertion that markets driven by significant network effects lead to a winner-takes-all outcome. Specifically, it disputes the doctrinal "Formula" for establishing monopoly power in platform markets that has stemmed from this assertion: that demonstrating the presence of network effects and substantial market share is sufficient to show that a platform incontrovertibly holds entrenched monopoly power.
• It explains that Microsoft's reasoning crystallized nascent economic theories regarding network effects into an actionable legal doctrine broadly applicable across diverse platform settings. Yet the mid-1980s scholarship that informed these theories forced pioneering economists to adopt simplifying assumptions in their models. • Since then, dramatic advances in network science have provided far more sophisticated analytical tools. Rudimentary theoretical abstractions have evolved into highly sophisticated computational models, bolstered by data-based empirical research. Accordingly, antitrust no longer needs to be confined by such overly simplistic assumptions.
• The article explores several blind spots in Microsoft's reasoning on network effects, acknowledging existing criticisms while highlighting newer insights drawn from network science's more advanced understanding of platform dynamics. • It then proposes an enhanced framework for evaluating the impact of network effects on a platform's market power-one that better integrates modern theory, methodological capabilities, and the goals of antitrust.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战微软关于网络效应导致赢家通吃的流行观点，指出其反垄断分析框架过于简化，并提出基于现代网络科学的增强分析框架
AI.research_question: 网络效应是否必然导致平台市场出现赢家通吃的垄断格局？如何构建更科学的反垄断分析框架来评估网络效应对平台市场力量的影响？
AI.motivation: 微软案件形成的网络效应分析框架基于1980年代简化的经济学假设，而现代网络科学提供了更复杂的分析工具，需要更新反垄断分析方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络效应理论、平台经济学、网络科学、反垄断法理论
AI.method: 理论分析、文献综述、网络科学模型分析、法学推理
AI.findings: 网络效应不一定导致垄断，微软的分析框架存在盲点，现代网络科学提供了更精确的分析工具
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合现代网络科学理论的反垄断分析新框架，挑战了传统的赢家通说理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法提供了更科学的分析工具，避免过度简化网络效应对市场竞争的影响评估

title: Estimating the Impact of the Pay-As-You-Throw Program on Waste Reduction: Using MTE Analysis
affiliations: , Yamanashi Eiwa College and

detail.title: Estimating the Impact of the Pay-As-You-Throw Program on Waste Reduction: Using MTE Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the waste reduction effect of the pay-as-you-throw (PAYT) program, which charges households for non-recyclable household waste, while accounting for self-selection into treatment. To address self-selection bias and heterogeneous treatment effects related to municipalities' willingness to adopt PAYT, we estimate the marginal treatment effect (MTE) using the fiscal condition of municipalities as an instrumental variable, since fiscally constrained municipalities tend to adopt PAYT even though residents' waste disposal behavior is not directly influenced by fiscal condition. By estimating the MTE, we find that PAYT promotes recycling and reduces household waste, but the magnitude of these effects depends on municipalities' adoption propensity. We also find that PAYT does not reduce total waste when business-related waste is considered, because PAYT induces immoral disposal: residents facing PAYT discard household waste as business-related waste at shops and firms with public trash cans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了按量收费垃圾处理项目(PAYT)的减废效果，通过边际处理效应(MTE)方法解决自选择偏差问题，发现PAYT能促进回收和减少家庭垃圾，但效果取决于市政当局的采纳倾向，且当考虑商业垃圾时PAYT不会减少总垃圾量，因为居民会将家庭垃圾作为商业垃圾丢弃。
AI.research_question: 按量收费垃圾处理项目(PAYT)对垃圾减少的实际效果如何？在考虑市政当局自选择偏差和异质性处理效应的情况下，PAYT是否能有效减少总体垃圾量？
AI.motivation: 传统评估方法可能因市政当局自选择采纳PAYT而产生偏差，需要更准确的方法来评估PAYT的真实效果，同时考虑可能出现的道德风险行为（如将家庭垃圾作为商业垃圾丢弃）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际处理效应(MTE)理论，使用市政财政状况作为工具变量来解决自选择偏差问题，分析不同采纳倾向下的异质性处理效果。
AI.method: 采用边际处理效应(MTE)估计方法，以市政财政状况作为工具变量，分析PAYT项目对家庭垃圾减少和回收促进的效果，同时考察对总体垃圾量的影响。
AI.findings: 1) PAYT促进回收并减少家庭垃圾，但效果大小取决于市政当局的采纳倾向；2) 当考虑商业垃圾时，PAYT不会减少总垃圾量；3) PAYT引发不道德处置行为，居民将家庭垃圾作为商业垃圾丢弃。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次使用MTE方法评估环境政策效果，为解决政策评估中的自选择偏差问题提供了新的方法论框架，揭示了环境政策的异质性效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了PAYT项目效果的真实评估，指出需要配套措施防止道德风险行为，建议在实施垃圾收费政策时考虑总体垃圾管理体系的完整性。

title: Balancing Transparency in FinTech Regulatory Sandboxes: Best Practices for Financial Regulators Regarding Intellectual Property, Data Privacy, and Administrative Burden Mitigation
affiliations: Auckland Institute of Studies

detail.title: Balancing Transparency in FinTech Regulatory Sandboxes: Best Practices for Financial Regulators Regarding Intellectual Property, Data Privacy, and Administrative Burden Mitigation
detail.abstract: This research project investigates just how financial regulators are able to improve transparency in FinTech regulatory sandboxes as well as how they are able to safeguard intellectual property (IP), ensure data privacy, and reduce administrative burdens, a challenge conceptualised as the "transparency trilemma." Through a qualitative comparative case study of five jurisdictions: the United Kingdom, Singapore, Colombia, Kenya, and Canada, this study analyses sandbox frameworks right across common law and civil law traditions. Within each jurisdiction, transparency practices were assessed systematically by way of a novel Transparency Evaluation Rubric. Alongside this, a tiered disclosure model was also developed. Findings reveal that the UK and Singapore excel in transparency and data governance because of structured public reporting and strong IP and privacy protections, yet civil law jurisdictions like Colombia stress statutory control, frequently costing agility. In the meantime, Kenya and Canada strive for innovation, achieving rather mixed outcomes in terms of their transparency and their stakeholder engagement. Sandbox frameworks are important for reaching a dynamic balance among regulatory integrity, innovation, and transparency, being iterative, adaptive and rooted in context-specific legal and regulatory capabilities, the study concludes. The research contributes toward global financial governance discourse. As this research provides actionable recommendations and a functional assessment resource, regulators may nurture innovation without affecting key regulatory aims.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨金融监管机构如何在监管沙盒中提升透明度、保护知识产权、确保数据隐私并减少行政负担，提出了'透明度三难困境'概念。通过对五个司法管辖区的比较案例研究，发现英国和新加坡在透明度和数据治理方面表现优异，而民法法系国家更注重法定控制但缺乏灵活性。研究提出了分层披露模型和透明度评估框架，为监管机构提供了实用工具。
AI.research_question: 金融监管机构如何在金融科技监管沙盒中提升透明度，同时保护知识产权、确保数据隐私并减少行政负担？
AI.motivation: 金融科技监管沙盒面临透明度、知识产权保护和数据隐私之间的平衡难题，即'透明度三难困境'，需要研究如何在不同法律传统下实现有效平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 透明度三难困境理论、比较法研究框架、金融监管治理理论
AI.method: 定性比较案例研究法，选取英国、新加坡、哥伦比亚、肯尼亚和加拿大五个司法管辖区，运用新颖的透明度评估量表进行系统分析
AI.findings: 英国和新加坡因结构化公开报告和强大的知识产权与隐私保护而在透明度和数据治理方面表现优异；民法法系国家如哥伦比亚强调法定控制但往往牺牲灵活性；肯尼亚和加拿大追求创新但在透明度和利益相关者参与方面结果参差不齐
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'透明度三难困境'概念框架，发展了分层披露模型，为全球金融监管治理理论提供了新的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的监管建议和功能性评估工具，帮助监管机构在不影响关键监管目标的前提下培育创新，开发了透明度评估量表供实践使用

title: The Economic Gains from Renewable Energy: Evidence from China's Land Market
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE), Lanzhou University, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Economics, Business School, National University of Singapore, Lanzhou University and National University of Singapore

detail.title: The Economic Gains from Renewable Energy: Evidence from China's Land Market
detail.abstract: Renewable energy is widely recognized as an effective solution to environmental challenges, yet its economic benefits remain underexplored. Leveraging granular data on power plant installations and land transactions in China, we estimate the impacts of newly opened power plants across various energy types on land values using a difference-in-differences framework. The findings highlight the economic benefits of renewable energy. Introducing a coal-fired power plant reduces land prices within 1.5 km by 12.99%, whereas renewable power plants have no such negative effect. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the price discount from coal-fired power plants is particularly pronounced for non-industrial land parcels and those located in richer cities. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that transitioning to renewable energy infrastructure could yield land value gains of 9.56 billion RMB per year, accounting for 2.28‰ of annual total land revenues.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国发电厂安装和土地交易的细粒度数据，通过双重差分框架估计了不同类型新建发电厂对土地价值的影响，发现可再生能源具有显著的经济效益。燃煤电厂使1.5公里内土地价格降低12.99%，而可再生能源电厂无此负面效应。向可再生能源基础设施转型每年可带来95.6亿元的土地价值增益。
AI.research_question: 新建不同类型发电厂（特别是可再生能源与传统燃煤电厂）对周边土地价值的影响差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源被广泛认为是解决环境挑战的有效方案，但其经济效益尚未得到充分探索，需要实证研究来量化其经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和房地产经济学理论，特别是负外部性理论（燃煤电厂的环境污染对周边地产价值的负面影响）和绿色溢价理论（可再生能源的环保属性可能带来的正向价值效应）。
AI.method: 采用双重差分（DID）框架，利用中国发电厂安装和土地交易的细粒度数据进行实证分析，考察不同类型发电厂对周边1.5公里范围内土地价格的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 燃煤电厂使1.5公里内土地价格降低12.99%；2) 可再生能源电厂无负面价格效应；3) 燃煤电厂的负面效应在非工业用地和较富裕城市更为显著；4) 向可再生能源转型每年可带来95.6亿元的土地价值增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了不同类型发电厂对土地价值的差异化影响，为环境外部性理论和绿色基础设施价值评估提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可再生能源经济价值的量化依据，支持能源转型决策，估算显示可再生能源基础设施每年可产生相当于土地总收入2.28‰的价值增益。

title: An Analysis of Agricultural Crop Residue Burning and Urban Air Pollution in New Delhi, India
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology and University of Texas at San Antonio - College of Business - Department of Economics

detail.title: An Analysis of Agricultural Crop Residue Burning and Urban Air Pollution in New Delhi, India
detail.abstract: A farmer in Haryana, a state neighboring the capital city of New Delhi, India, burns agricultural crop residue which leads to an increase in air pollution and gives rise to extra costs for a small business owning representative citizen in New Delhi. We theoretically analyze this farmer/citizen interaction. We first determine the optimal amount of crop produced when the farmer disregards the negative externality he imposes on the representative New Delhi citizen. Second, we study the equilibrium that emerges when the farmer must pay a fine to compensate the New Delhi citizen for the negative externality he causes. Finally, we compare the outcomes in the preceding two cases and then explain the differences that arise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论模型分析印度哈里亚纳邦农民焚烧秸秆对德里市民造成的负外部性，比较无管制和罚款补偿两种情境下的均衡结果差异
AI.research_question: 农民焚烧秸秆产生的负外部性如何影响社会最优产出？罚款补偿机制能否有效解决这一外部性问题？
AI.motivation: 印度哈里亚纳邦农民焚烧农业残留物导致新德里空气污染加剧，给当地小企业主带来额外成本，需要理论分析这种农民与市民的互动关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部性理论、福利经济学、博弈论框架下的生产者-消费者互动模型
AI.method: 理论建模分析，首先确定农民忽视负外部性时的最优产量，然后研究支付罚款补偿市民时的均衡，最后比较两种情境的结果差异
AI.findings: 无管制时农民产量高于社会最优水平；罚款补偿机制能内部化外部成本，使产量趋近社会最优，但具体差异取决于罚款额度设计
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业负外部性问题提供理论分析框架，扩展了外部性理论在发展中国家环境问题中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度等发展中国家制定秸秆焚烧管理政策提供理论依据，建议采用经济补偿机制解决跨区域环境污染问题

title: Assessing Dianov's "Harmonious Worldview": Demarcation, Method, and Misuse of Physics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Assessing Dianov's "Harmonious Worldview": Demarcation, Method, and Misuse of Physics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or case studies requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper critically evaluates Vyacheslav Dianov's Harmonious Worldview, a sixty-page essay that proposes a spiritual alternative to materialist science. While the text presents itself as a scientific framework, its claims fail to meet basic criteria of scientific inquiry. Drawing on Popper's principle of falsifiability and Kuhn's paradigm theory, I assess the work through textual analysis and a review of its frequently cited empirical references, including the "soul weight" hypothesis, torsion field theory, and Kirlian photography. The analysis demonstrates that Dianov's arguments are unfalsifiable, methodologically unsupported, and conceptually inconsistent, often conflating scientific concepts such as "energy" and "field" with metaphysical or spiritual meanings. Rather than constituting a viable scientific theory, Harmonious Worldview functions as a spiritual manifesto cloaked in scientific terminology. The critique situates this case within broader patterns of pseudoscientific discourse, in which the authority of physics is invoked rhetorically while its empirical standards are abandoned.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了Vyacheslav Dianov的《和谐世界观》，指出其虽然自称科学框架，但不符合科学探究的基本标准，实际上是用科学术语包装的精神宣言。
AI.research_question: Vyacheslav Dianov的《和谐世界观》是否构成一个可行的科学理论？
AI.motivation: 评估自称科学框架但可能属于伪科学论述的精神性著作的科学有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波普尔的可证伪性原则和库恩的范式理论
AI.method: 文本分析和对其经常引用的经验参考文献的审查，包括"灵魂重量"假说、扭转场理论和基尔良摄影
AI.findings: Dianov的论点不可证伪、方法上缺乏支持且概念上不一致，经常将科学概念与形而上学或精神含义混为一谈
AI.theory_contributions: 为识别和批判伪科学论述提供了理论框架和分析方法
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助读者辨别真正的科学理论与用科学术语包装的非科学主张，促进科学素养

title: Removing Barriers to Investment, Competition, and Movement: A Historical Lesson
affiliations: George Mason University - Department of Economics and Mount Allison University

detail.title: Removing Barriers to Investment, Competition, and Movement: A Historical Lesson
detail.abstract: During the Canadian Wheat Boom (1896–1913), Canada experienced remarkable economic growth on both the intensive and extensive margins. Canada’s economic growth at this time outpaced most of the rest of the world, and was higher than Canada has ever seen before or since. In this policy report, we provide historical evidence suggesting that the “Wheat” Boom had less to do with wheat and agricultural exports, and more to do with a government allowing (and even encouraging) the free flow of foreign capital and labour into the country. Guided by this historical case study, we recommend that today’s policymakers re-embrace openness and remove artificial barriers to investment, competition, and movement (of both capital and labour), if their goal is to achieve more robust economic growth in Canada.

AI.tldr: 加拿大小麦繁荣期（1896-1913）的经济快速增长主要归因于资本和劳动力的自由流动，而非小麦出口本身。政策建议重新拥抱开放政策以促进经济增长。
AI.research_question: 加拿大小麦繁荣期经济快速增长的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解历史上加拿大经济快速增长的根本原因，为当前政策制定提供借鉴
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济理论，资本和劳动力流动对经济增长的影响
AI.method: 历史案例研究，政策分析
AI.findings: 小麦繁荣期的经济增长主要得益于外国资本和劳动力的自由流入，而非农业出口本身
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统认为农业出口驱动经济增长的观点，强调开放政策的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前政策制定者提供建议：移除投资、竞争和人员流动的人为障碍以促进经济增长

title: The Theory of Artificial Intelligence Innovation
affiliations: goldennanox and goldennanox

detail.title: The Theory of Artificial Intelligence Innovation
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the Theory of Artificial Intelligence Innovation, which systematically elaborates the fundamental laws of artificial intelligence in three aspects: knowledge acquisition, path exploration, and continuous innovation. The first law states that artificial intelligence has the potential ability to read, write, and understand the entirety of human knowledge, encompassing multimodal information such as literature, language, and video, thereby becoming a "hypothetical human" mastering all human knowledge. The second law emphasizes that artificial intelligence can discover and apply previously unknown rules and knowledge of the world by traversing possible paths and combining them with feedback verification, where the results are scored and optimized for validity. The third law asserts that the innovative capacity of artificial intelligence is theoretically unlimited, constrained only by computing power and storage; as innovation continues to expand, the demands for computation and storage will grow exponentially. This theory provides a foundational framework for understanding the knowledge boundaries, innovative potential, and future development trends of artificial intelligence, and offers new perspectives for its strategic deployment in scientific research, industrial applications, and social governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了人工智能创新理论，系统阐述了AI在知识获取、路径探索和持续创新三个方面的基本规律，为理解AI的知识边界、创新潜力和未来发展趋势提供了理论框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能的基本创新规律是什么？AI在知识获取、路径探索和持续创新方面遵循哪些基本法则？
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏对人工智能创新能力的系统性理论阐述，需要建立统一的理论框架来理解AI的知识边界、创新潜力和发展趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能创新理论，包含三大基本定律：第一定律（知识获取能力）、第二定律（路径探索能力）、第三定律（持续创新能力）。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过系统性的理论分析和逻辑推演，提出人工智能创新的三大基本定律。
AI.findings: 1）AI具有掌握全人类知识的潜力；2）AI能够发现和应用未知规则；3）AI创新能力理论上无限，仅受算力和存储限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了系统的人工智能创新理论框架，提出了三大基本定律，为AI理论研究提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI在科研、产业应用和社会治理中的战略部署提供了理论指导，有助于制定AI发展策略和资源配置。

title: Abolishing the Color Line: W. E. B. Du Bois's Theory of Dynamic Social Equilibrium
affiliations: Department of Economics, Colorado State University, Fort Collins and

detail.title: Abolishing the Color Line: W. E. B. Du Bois's Theory of Dynamic Social Equilibrium
detail.abstract: This article explores the political economy of W. E. B. Du Bois drawing on the mathematical analogies and theoretical insights presented in "The Future of the Negro Race in America," a rarely discussed essay that examines the conditions for "the abolition of the colour line." The term expresses Du Bois's demand for "full rights and citizenship"–namely, "full and fair equality" for Black Americans. We argue that Du Bois put forward a dynamic model of social equilibrium that sheds brighter light on the factors that affect the socioeconomic advancement of Black Americans. The main feature of the model is the interdependence between the social condition of a marginalized group and public opinion. We develop a formal Du Boisian model that distinguishes between four regimes. A shock to education improves the social condition of the Black community. This will then affect public opinion, which in turn will change social conditions, and the process will continue until a new steady state is reached at a higher value of education. A shock to integration creates a similar process. Du Bois's framework is then compared with Gunnar Myrdal's model of dynamic causation. We contend that Du Bois should be considered a major theorist of social dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析杜波依斯鲜为人知的文章《美国黑人种族的未来》，探讨其政治经济学思想，提出了一个关于社会均衡的动态模型，强调边缘化群体社会状况与公众舆论的相互依存关系。
AI.research_question: 杜波依斯如何通过动态社会均衡模型解释影响美国黑人社会经济进步的因素？
AI.motivation: 挖掘杜波依斯被忽视的政治经济学思想，特别是他对"废除肤色界限"条件的理论分析，以重新评估其作为社会动态理论家的地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 杜波依斯的动态社会均衡理论，强调边缘化群体社会状况与公众舆论的相互依存关系，以及教育冲击和融合冲击对社会进步的动态影响。
AI.method: 文本分析和理论建模方法，基于杜波依斯的原著文章发展形式化的杜波依斯模型，并与默达尔动态因果关系模型进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 杜波依斯提出了包含四种制度的社会动态模型，教育冲击和融合冲击都能通过影响公众舆论进而改善黑人社区的社会条件，最终达到更高教育水平的新稳态。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了杜波依斯作为社会动态主要理论家的地位，提出了独特的动态社会均衡模型，丰富了政治经济学理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解种族平等和社会进步提供了理论框架，对制定促进社会公平的政策具有指导意义。

title: Constrained Optimization or Observation? On What Economists Take as Primary
affiliations: Chapman University - Smith Institute for Political Economy and Philosophy

detail.title: Constrained Optimization or Observation? On What Economists Take as Primary
detail.abstract: Economists differ on what they take as primary when constructing the problem of a rational economic order: constrained optimization or observation. The general starting point is to frame the problem with four key assumptions-scarcity, fixed preferences, complete information, and selfinterest-so that the optimization problem yields a clear prediction. Observation enters only after the fact, to repair the model when predictions fail. F. A. Hayek and Vernon Smith instead begin with what people actually know and do, making observation primary to economic inquiry. Humanomics extends this stance by grounding human conduct in Adam Smith's astute observations of fellow-feeling, moral sentiments, and a sense of propriety. Economics as an observational science takes human conduct, not constrained optimization, as primary.

AI.tldr: 本文批判传统经济学以约束优化为出发点的方法，主张将观察作为经济学研究的主要方法，继承哈耶克和弗农·史密斯的传统，并以亚当·斯密的道德情感理论为基础，提出人类行为学（Humanomics）作为替代框架。
AI.research_question: 经济学研究应该以约束优化还是观察作为主要出发点？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学过度依赖约束优化和四大假设（稀缺性、固定偏好、完全信息、自利），而忽视了人类实际行为和道德情感的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈耶克的知识分散理论、弗农·史密斯的实验经济学、亚当·斯密的道德情感理论和fellow-feeling概念。
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述，比较不同经济学方法论的基础假设和研究路径。
AI.findings: 以观察为基础的经济学方法能更好地解释真实人类行为，特别是道德情感和社会规范在经济决策中的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Humanomics作为新的经济学研究框架，强调观察优先于优化，道德情感与经济行为的整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学研究提供了更贴近现实的方法论基础，有助于更好地理解和预测真实经济行为，特别是在非自利行为和社会规范影响下的决策。

reference: Journal of Business Venturing, volume 40, issue 6, 2025[10.1016/j.jbusvent.2025.106527]
title: Cognitive Origins of Entrepreneurial Action: How Venture-Specific Knowledge Drives Financial Investments
affiliations: Loyola University Chicago and Loyola University Chicago

detail.title: Cognitive Origins of Entrepreneurial Action: How Venture-Specific Knowledge Drives Financial Investments

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Business Venturing, volume 40, issue 6, 2025[10.1016/j.jbusvent.2025.106527]

detail.abstract:
Entrepreneurial action under uncertainty requires resource commitment, yet the cognitive mechanisms enabling such decisions remain underexplored.
This study investigates the role of venture-specific knowledge (VSK) in entrepreneurial action, focusing on two distinct cognitive pathways:
refinement, which enhances understanding to address ignorance, and conviction, which strengthens confidence to overcome doubt. Using a causal
map representation of VSK, we demonstrate that refinement and conviction independently drive personal financial investment, while also acting as
substitutes when one pathway reaches its limits. Our findings extend entrepreneurial action theory by highlighting the distinct cognitive processes
underlying VSK. Furthermore, we examine how these pathways interact with individual traits such as entrepreneurial self-efficacy (ESE) and uncertainty
avoidance, revealing nuanced moderating effects. These insights advance understanding of entrepreneurial decision making under irreducible
uncertainty and provide implications for both theory and practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了创业特定知识通过精炼和确信两条认知路径如何影响创业行动，发现两者独立驱动个人财务投资并具有替代效应，同时考察了创业自我效能和不确定性规避的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 创业特定知识如何通过精炼和确信两条认知路径影响创业行动？这些路径如何与个体特质相互作用？
AI.motivation: 创业行动在不确定性下需要资源承诺，但支持此类决策的认知机制研究不足，需要深入探索创业特定知识的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创业行动理论、认知决策理论和不确定性下的资源承诺理论，构建了创业特定知识通过精炼和确信路径影响创业决策的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用因果映射方法表示创业特定知识，通过实证研究分析精炼和确信路径对个人财务投资的影响，并考察创业自我效能和不确定性规避的调节作用。
AI.findings: 精炼和确信两条路径独立驱动个人财务投资；当一条路径达到极限时，两者具有替代效应；创业自我效能和不确定性规避对这些路径具有细微的调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了创业行动理论，揭示了创业特定知识的独特认知过程；深化了对不可减少不确定性下创业决策机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了认知决策的实践指导；帮助投资者理解创业者的决策逻辑；为创业教育和培训提供了理论依据。

title: Retaliatory Recognition: A New Paradigm in Diplomatic Recognition
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Law School

detail.title: Retaliatory Recognition: A New Paradigm in Diplomatic Recognition
detail.abstract: The belated recognition of Palestine by France, the UK, Canada, and Australia arguably represents a new paradigm of diplomatic recognition, one which could be described as “retaliatory recognition” or “offensive recognition.” Under this paradigm, the recognition of a country is not primarily based on the Montevideo Convention, or on the legitimacy or illegitimacy of the state’s formation, or even on a material change in political reality such as a declaration of independence. Instead, diplomatic recognition is used as an offensive tactic and a diplomatic rebuke against a third party, without the intention of breaking off ties with that third party altogether. This is quite a novel phenomenon in international relations that has rarely been encountered before, in part because relatively few countries have intentionally withheld recognition of a sovereign state on political grounds. Even when this has been the case, countries have been reluctant to shift their position in the absence of a change in the political reality, such as an overthrow of the old regime. Thus, it is possible that the world is entering a new era in which diplomatic recognition can be used to not only promote ties between two states but also to protest the behavior of a third party, which this party will analyze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型外交承认范式——"报复性承认"或"进攻性承认"，即国家承认不再基于蒙特维多公约或政治现实变化，而是作为针对第三方的外交抗议手段。
AI.research_question: 法国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚延迟承认巴勒斯坦是否代表了一种新的外交承认范式？这种"报复性承认"或"进攻性承认"的本质特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统外交承认基于蒙特维多公约和国家形成的合法性，但近期西方国家延迟承认巴勒斯坦的行为似乎违背了这一传统模式，需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的外交承认理论、国家主权理论、蒙特维多公约框架
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究（巴勒斯坦承认案例）、比较历史分析
AI.findings: 识别出"报复性承认"新范式，其特征是：承认作为外交抗议工具、不意图完全断绝与第三方关系、不基于政治现实变化
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了外交承认的新理论范式，拓展了国际关系中承认政治的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代外交实践提供新视角，有助于政策制定者识别和应对这种新型外交策略

title: Systemic Financial Vulnerabilities and the Japanese Debt Crisis: An Empirical Analysis of Global Contagion Mechanisms in Bond Market Disruption
affiliations: Randolph College

detail.title: Systemic Financial Vulnerabilities and the Japanese Debt Crisis: An Empirical Analysis of Global Contagion Mechanisms in Bond Market Disruption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author acknowledges valuable research assistance from the Bank of Japan's Financial Markets Department, the International Monetary Fund's Monetary and Financial Systems Department, the Bank for International Settlements' Monetary and Economic Department, the Federal Reserve Board's Division of Monetary Affairs, and the University of Michigan Survey Research Center.
