The corrected estimates align with broader patterns of wartime monetary instability across Latin America while demonstrating how exchange rate methodology choices fundamentally alter historical narratives. This framework offers broader applicability for reassessing historical inflation in dual-currency environments during institutional transitions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过采用考虑纸币广泛使用的替代汇率方法，重新评估了秘鲁在太平洋战争期间的通货膨胀动态，发现传统基于白银的汇率假设系统性低估了战时通胀，修正后的通胀率峰值达到177.7%（1880年），而非之前的0.7%估计。
AI.research_question: 如何准确评估秘鲁在太平洋战争期间（1879-1883）的真实通货膨胀水平？传统基于白银的汇率方法是否低估了战时通胀？
AI.motivation: 传统研究使用白银为基础的汇率假设来估算历史通胀，但忽略了当时纸币（sol en billete）在国内交易中的广泛使用，这可能导致对战时通胀程度的系统性低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双货币环境下的汇率方法论，考虑制度转型期间不同货币（白银货币与纸币）的并行流通和相对贬值情况。
AI.method: 使用利马主要报纸和政府文件的档案资料，结合Seminario (2016)和Boloña (1981)的价格序列，采用替代汇率方法来重新校准通胀估算。
AI.findings: 修正后的方法显示1880年通胀峰值达177.7%，而非传统方法的0.7%；纸币相对于白银货币在1879-1880年间贬值1,011%；1878-1885年间年均通胀率为31.1%，而非传统方法的-1.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于双货币环境和制度转型期历史通胀重新评估的方法论框架，揭示了汇率方法选择对历史叙事的基础性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 将太平洋战争定位为秘鲁最严重的通胀时期之一，同时凸显了现代时期（1997-2024）作为秘鲁三个多世纪以来最长的货币稳定期，为理解货币不稳定性的真实严重性提供了历史视角。

title: A Smart Derivative Contract with Collateral
affiliations: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Mathematics, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG and DZ Bank AG

detail.title: A Smart Derivative Contract with Collateral
detail.abstract: We propose a smart contract that orchestrates the flows of a collateralized financial derivative in a way that eliminates under-collateralization risk, so that no additional initial margin is required. In this sense, the concept can improve over a simple digitalization of a classical collateral derivative. The scheme generalizes the smart derivative contract [1] by allowing to distinguish between collateral flows and settlement flows. This enables the use of alternative accounting methodologies and the use of alternative forms of collateral, different from cash-collateral. We show how the smart derivative contract can be implemented with bond collateral and how the smart contract interacts with the collateral token.

AI.tldr: 通过智能合约结构设计，消除过刷抵控风险，无需额外初始保证金，支持非现金抵押品和替代会计方法
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种智能合约结构，在不需要额外初始保证金的情况下消除抵押化金融衍生品的不足抵押风险
AI.motivation: 简单的经典抵押衍生品数字化方案存在不足抵押风险，需要改进智能合约设计来消除这种风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能汇率衍生品合约理论，抵押管理机制，坚固性设计原则
AI.method: 设计了一种智能合约结构，能够区分抵押流和结算流，并展示如何使用债券抵押和与抵押代币进行交互
AI.findings: 该智能合约结构能够完全消除不足抵押风险，支持替代会计方法和非现金抵押品，包括债券抵押
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了智能衍生品合约理论，提出了能够区分抵押流与结算流的新结构，为坚固性设计提供理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了无需额外初始保证金的抵押化衍生品，支持多种抵押资产类型，为金融市场提供更灵活的风险管理解决方案

title: Disproportionate Influence: Rethinking Control in American Corporate Governance
affiliations: Northwestern University - Pritzker School of Law and University of California, Berkeley - School of Law

detail.title: Disproportionate Influence: Rethinking Control in American Corporate Governance
detail.abstract:
Corporate law has undergone a gradual transformation. Founding chief executive officers (CEOs) and activist hedge funds increasingly dominate leading American corporations despite owning well short of a majority of shares. Founder-CEOs, through personal brands or dual-class voting structures, control firms despite minority stakes; activist hedge funds, with single-digit holdings, press for major governance changes. We argue that these two types of shareholders, often treated as opposites, both dominate corporations through disproportionate influence rather than majority ownership. We introduce the concept of high-stakes shareholders to describe investors who dictate corporate policy through disproportionate influence rather than equity control.

Delaware’s doctrinal response has been inconsistent and has generated market uncertainty. Courts have alternated between deferring to founder-CEOs under the business judgment rule when procedural safeguards are present, and expanding the definition of control to impose entire fairness review. Likewise, courts have upheld poison pills against activist hedge funds to guard against creeping control, yet struck down pills aimed at deterring activism more generally.

To rationalize this area of law, we propose a disproportionate influence test as a doctrinal reform. Whenever a board makes decisions under the influence of high-stakes shareholders, courts should apply enhanced scrutiny. Likewise, when boards face the risk of disproportionate activist influence, they should be permitted to adopt defensive measures such as poison pills. Delaware’s expert judiciary is well positioned to articulate and refine the contours of disproportionate influence, while also designing cleansing procedures that high-stakes shareholders can use to avoid heightened review.

Recent Delaware legislative amendments, aimed at enhancing predictability by narrowing the definition of control, have the effect of shielding board decisions shaped by influential but non-controlling shareholders from meaningful review. We argue instead that simplified and predictable cleansing procedures can restore legal certainty, but that Delaware courts must retain a central role in evaluating when excessive shareholder influence on board decision-making warrants greater judicial scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"高风险股东"概念，指那些通过不成比例影响力而非多数股权控制公司的投资者（如创始人CEO和对冲基金）。研究发现特拉华州法院对此类股东的司法回应不一致，建议采用"不成比例影响力测试"作为法律改革，对受高风险股东影响的董事会决策实施强化审查。
AI.research_question: 特拉华州法院应如何应对通过不成比例影响力而非多数股权控制公司的高风险股东（创始人CEO和激进对冲基金）？
AI.motivation: 公司法律正在经历转型，创始人CEO和激进对冲基金尽管持股比例不高，却通过不成比例的影响力主导着美国大公司，而特拉华州法院对此的司法回应存在不一致性，导致市场不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高风险股东理论、公司治理理论、控制权理论、司法审查标准理论（商业判断规则与完全公平审查）
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal analysis，分析特拉华州法院判例和立法发展
AI.findings: 1）法院对创始人CEO和对冲基金的司法处理不一致；2）现行立法通过缩小控制权定义反而保护了有影响力股东的董事会决策免受审查；3）需要新的法律测试标准
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"高风险股东"和"不成比例影响力"的新概念框架，为理解现代公司控制权提供了理论创新
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用"不成比例影响力测试"作为法律改革，允许法院对受高风险股东影响的决策实施强化审查，同时设计净化程序来恢复法律确定性

title: Blocking the Credit Chain: Cryptocurrencies, Deposits, and Bank Loan Growth
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business, University of International Business and Economics,  and University of Massachusetts Boston

detail.title: Blocking the Credit Chain: Cryptocurrencies, Deposits, and Bank Loan Growth
detail.abstract: We find evidence that the demand for retail bank deposits declines when cryptocurrency returns are high, leading to lower loan growth among affected banks. Exploiting cross-sectional variation in banks' geographic exposures to cryptocurrency-investing households, we show that banks with greater exposure experience deposit outflows and reduced loan growth when cryptocurrency returns rise. This dynamic extends to the county level, producing slower establishment and employment growth, particularly in bank-dependent sectors. Our results highlight a novel indirect exposure of banks to cryptocurrency markets, illustrating how participation in cryptocurrency markets can affect the real economy by weakening traditional financial intermediation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现加密货币收益率上涨导致银行存款需求下降，从而减少了受影响银行的贷款增长，进而影响实体经济增长
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场收益率如何影响传统银行业的存款流入和贷款增长，以及这种影响如何传导至实体经济
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场的快速发展对传统金融中介机构的潜在影响，需要识别银行业间接暴露于加密货币市场的新途径
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、资产配置理论、银行业传导机制
AI.method: 利用银行在不同地理区域对加密货币投资家庭的暴露度进行横截面分析，考察加密货币收益率上涨时的存款流出和贷款增长变化
AI.findings: 暴露度高的银行在加密货币收益率上涨时会出现存款流出和贷款增长减缓，这种效应传导至县级层面，导致企业创力和就业增长放缓，尤其是银行依赖型行业
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了银行业间接暴露于加密货币市场的新机制，扩展了金融中介理论在数字货币时代的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了识别银行业加密货币风险暴露的方法，帮助银行管理者理解数字货币对传统业务的影响，为政策制定者提供了实证基础

title: Aging and Housing Returns
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Boston College - Department of Finance and University of Delaware - Department of Finance

detail.title: Aging and Housing Returns
detail.abstract: Older home sellers receive lower returns than younger ones. Homes sold by older people have fewer major renovations but higher rates of poor upkeep. Older sellers are also more likely to sell off-MLS ("pocket listings") and to investors, leading to lower prices. These patterns suggest that older sellers may be disproportionately disadvantaged by agents' incentive to maximize fees through generating high sale volume instead of maximizing sale prices. Age-related cognitive declines make the elderly more vulnerable. For causal evidence, we show that reforms making private listings more transparent reduced both the prevalence of pocket listings and the magnitude of the age gap in returns.

AI.tldr: 老年房主售房回报率低于年轻房主，主要原因是房屋维护差、私下交易多、卖给投资者多，这些都与房产中介追求交易量而非最高价格的激励机制有关，而老年人的认知能力下降使其更容易受到这种不利影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么老年房主售房时获得的回报率低于年轻房主？这种年龄差距是否与房产中介的激励机制和老年人的认知特点有关？
AI.motivation: 房地产市场存在年龄差异现象，老年卖家获得较低回报，这可能与中介机构的激励机制和老年人认知特点相关，需要探究其因果关系和解决途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托-代理理论，分析房产中介激励机制（追求交易量而非最高售价）与老年人认知能力下降的交互作用，解释年龄差异的形成机制。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，通过房屋交易数据比较不同年龄卖家的回报差异，并利用政策改革（提高私下交易透明度）作为自然实验进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 老年卖家房屋翻新少但维护差的比例高；更倾向于私下交易和卖给投资者；这些行为导致售价较低；政策改革提高透明度后，私下交易减少且年龄差距缩小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托-代理理论与认知老龄化理论结合，揭示了房地产市场年龄歧视的新机制，丰富了行为经济学在房地产领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策建议：提高交易透明度可以有效保护老年卖家权益；为房产中介行业改革激励机制提供实证依据；为老年人房产交易提供风险防范指导。

title: Risk-neutral Pricing of Random-expiry Options using Trinomial Trees
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte

detail.title: Risk-neutral Pricing of Random-expiry Options using Trinomial Trees
detail.abstract: Random-expiry options are nontraditional derivative contracts that may expire early based on a random event. We develop a methodology for pricing these options using a trinomial tree, where the middle path is interpreted as early expiry. We establish that this approach is free of arbitrage, derive its continuous-time limit, and show how it may be implemented numerically in an efficient manner.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种使用三叉树模型对随机到期期权进行定价的方法，该方法将中间路径解释为提前到期，证明了该方法的无套利性，推导了连续时间极限，并展示了高效数值实现方式。
AI.research_question: 如何为基于随机事件可能提前到期的随机到期期权开发一种无套利的定价方法？
AI.motivation: 随机到期期权作为非传统衍生品合约，其定价需要专门的方法来处理随机提前到期的特性，现有定价方法可能无法有效处理这种特殊结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三叉树定价模型，将中间路径解释为提前到期事件，构建无套利定价框架。
AI.method: 采用三叉树方法进行建模，其中中间路径代表期权提前到期的情况，推导连续时间极限，并开发数值实现算法。
AI.findings: 成功建立了随机到期期权的三叉树定价模型，证明了该方法的无套利性质，获得了连续时间极限表达式，并实现了高效的数值计算方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为随机到期期权提供了首个基于三叉树的无套利定价理论框架，扩展了衍生品定价理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实际应用的随机到期期权定价工具，为金融机构定价这类非传统衍生品提供了有效方法，具有重要的实务价值。

title: Audit Quality and Financial Reporting Fraud: The Interaction of Standards, Governance, and Managerial Integrity
affiliations: Sebelas Maret University, Department of Accounting, Faculty of Economics and Business, Universitas Sebelas Maret, Surakarta, Indonesia and University of Aden, Yemen

detail.title: Audit Quality and Financial Reporting Fraud: The Interaction of Standards, Governance, and Managerial Integrity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available secondary data and did not involve human participants or animals; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. This work was supported by Universitas Sebelas Maret, Faculty of Economics and Business, through internal academic research funding.

detail.abstract: Financial reporting fraud still has implications for the effectiveness and efficiency of world capital markets, particularly in emerging-market nations where regulatory environments are less structured. Although studies in audit quality and regulatory compliance are independent from each other in the previous academic research, we develop a new comprehensive theoretical model, which integrates the antecedents of audit quality (audit tenure, audit fee, Big 4 affiliation) and the extant IFRS adoption, governance quality, and Managerial Ethical Integrity, to assess their combined and interactive impacts on fraud detection. Based on 480 firm year observations of listed manufacturers operating indonesia emerging economy from 2018 to 2023, this research adopts multiple regression and moderation analysis to unravel intricate interconnections. The innovation of having structural (audit mechanisms), regulatory (IFRS compliance), and behavioral (ethical leadership) variables in one model is providing a multi-dimensional view not touched upon by previous studies. The findings show that audit quality and IFRS adoption are associated with a lower fraud risk; the impact of these determinants, however, varies positively or negatively depending on the governance mechanisms and ethical leadership. This discovery undermines a prevailing belief that institutional and technical conformance are sufficient to inhibit misconduct. By demonstrating the moderating influence of managerial integrity and governance quality, this study contributes to the theoretical understanding and provides practical implications to government, auditors and board members for creating an anti-corruptive governance system. The originality of this research is that it also adds to the expanding the horizon of audit research in terms of behavioural governance which is particularly important for ASEAN and other emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个整合审计质量、IFRS采用、治理质量和经理人道德诚信的综合理论模型，通过多元回归和调节分析发现这些因素对欺诈检测存在交互影响，挑战了单纯依靠制度和技术合规就能抑制不当行为的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 审计质量、IFRS采用、治理质量和经理人道德诚信如何共同和交互影响财务报告欺诈检测？
AI.motivation: 财务报告欺诈对新兴市场国家资本市场效率的影响，以及现有研究中审计质量和监管合规研究相互独立的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合审计质量（审计任期、审计费用、四大事务所）、IFRS采用、治理质量和经理人道德诚信的综合理论模型
AI.method: 基于2018-2023年印尼制造业上市公司480个公司年度观测值，采用多元回归和调节分析
AI.findings: 审计质量和IFRS采用与较低欺诈风险相关，但这些因素的影响根据治理机制和道德领导力而正向或负向变化
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了制度和技术合规足以抑制不当行为的传统观点，展示了经理人诚信和治理质量的调节作用，扩展了行为治理视角的审计研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、审计师和董事会成员创建反腐败治理体系提供实践启示，特别对东盟和其他新兴经济体具有重要意义

title: A Better Way to Chart Historical Stock Performance
affiliations: Retired -- No current affiliation

detail.title: A Better Way to Chart Historical Stock Performance
detail.abstract: Historical growth is most commonly displayed in what are referred to here as typical growth charts, i.e., as a charted time series of the values of an investment from its purchase on a date in the past through subsequent dates up to the present.  Unfortunately, such charts have a number of shortcomings that can severely limit their value as a means of providing investors with a comprehensive, integrated, and possibly unbiased view of historical performance.  This is especially true when they are used for assessing relative investment growth.  The present paper introduces another type of growth chart that avoids those shortcomings while providing a different but meaningful and perhaps better view of investment performance.  When used either in lieu of or supplemental to typical growth charts, it can offer additional critical insights into historical performance to those who want to take such information into account when making investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型增长图表，克服了传统增长图表在显示投资历史增长时的局限性，为投资者提供更全面、综合且可能无偏见的绩效视图。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种更好的投资增长图表来克服传统增长图表的局限性，为投资者提供更准确的历史绩效评估？
AI.motivation: 传统增长图表在显示投资历史增长时存在多个严重缺陷，特别是在评估相对投资增长方面，限制了其作为投资决策参考的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资绩效评估理论和数据可视化理论，关注历史增长数据的呈现方式和投资者认知偏差问题。
AI.method: 提出并设计了一种新型增长图表方法，通过不同的数据组织和可视化方式来避免传统图表的缺陷。
AI.findings: 新型增长图表能够提供不同于传统图表但有意义的投资绩效视图，在替代或补充传统图表使用时能为投资决策提供关键洞察。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了投资绩效可视化的理论框架，提出了解决传统增长图表认知偏差问题的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和金融从业者提供了更有效的工具来评估历史投资绩效，支持更明智的投资决策制定。

title: An Examination of the Effectiveness of Tax Penalties in Combating Tax Offences in Nigeria
affiliations: University of Abuja, Nigeria - Faculty of Law and University of Abuja, Abuja Nigeria

detail.title: An Examination of the Effectiveness of Tax Penalties in Combating Tax Offences in Nigeria
detail.abstract: Taxation is a critical engine for socio-economic growth and development, serving as a primary revenue source for governments worldwide. However, tax offences, including evasion, avoidance, and non-compliance, significantly frustrate revenue generation efforts. This article examines the effectiveness of tax penalties as a mechanism for combating tax offences and improving tax compliance within the Nigerian tax system. It provides a detailed analysis of the legal framework, outlining both criminal sanctions (fines and imprisonment) and civil sanctions (distraint of goods, sealing of premises, and imposed interests) as provided for in key statutes like the Personal Income Tax Act (PITA), Companies Income Tax Act (CITA), and the Federal Inland Revenue Service (Establishment) Act (FIRSEA). The study argues that while a structured penalty regime exists, its deterrent effect is undermined by significant challenges. These include the technical nature of tax laws leading to procedural failures in court, difficulties in tracking a highly mobile populace and informal sector, inadequate prosecution of defaulters, low levels of tax awareness, and the pervasive issue of multiple taxation. The article concludes that the current penalties are underutilized and, in some cases, archaic. To enhance effectiveness, a multiple approach combination is recommended, encompassing stricter enforcement and prosecution, increased taxpayer education, harmonization of taxes to eliminate duplication, and a revision of penalty structures to reflect modern economic realities, thereby fostering voluntary compliance and boosting national revenue.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚税收处罚制度在打击税收犯罪和提高税收合规性方面的有效性，分析了现行法律框架下的刑事和民事制裁措施，指出处罚制度的威慑作用因多种挑战而受限，并提出了包括加强执法、纳税人教育、税收协调和处罚结构现代化在内的综合改进建议。
AI.research_question: 税收处罚作为打击税收犯罪和提高税收合规性的机制在尼日利亚税收体系中的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 税收犯罪（包括逃税、避税和不合规行为）严重阻碍了政府财政收入，需要研究现有处罚制度的有效性以改善税收合规性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收合规理论和威慑理论，分析处罚制度对纳税人行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 对尼日利亚关键税收法规（PITA、CITA、FIRSEA）的法律框架进行详细分析，评估刑事制裁（罚款和监禁）和民事制裁（货物扣押、场所查封、利息征收）的规定。
AI.findings: 现行处罚制度存在但威慑效果有限，主要挑战包括：税收法律技术性导致法庭程序失败、难以追踪流动人口和非正规部门、起诉不足、税收意识低下、多重征税问题普遍。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家税收处罚制度有效性的理解，揭示了法律框架与实际执行之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了综合改进方案：加强执法和起诉、增加纳税人教育、协调税收消除重复、修订处罚结构以反映现代经济现实，从而促进自愿合规和增加国家收入。

title: Empowerment or Dependency? A Research Agenda for Human Agency in the Age of AI
affiliations: Narxoz University

detail.title: Empowerment or Dependency? A Research Agenda for Human Agency in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing at a pace that challenges the foundations of education, work, and research systems. Yet much of the global debate remains dominated by readiness indices, benchmark performance, adoption checklists and strategy playbooks that equate uptake with progress. This paper argues that the real axis of transformation is empowerment versus dependency. It consolidates a research agenda developed across education, qualifications, research systems, and organizational leadership, rooted in the perspective of an emerging, middle-income, fast-growth economy. Completed contributions include the AI Matrix, mapping empowerment-dependency trajectories; the AI Passport, supporting portable learning transitions; the Education Empowerment Framework; and the Iterative Human-AI Co-Creation (IHACC) model. Forthcoming work extends this agenda to research system futures, Orchestrated Intelligence, context engineering, and the role of creativity in schools as the foundation of empowerment. The paper positions AI not as a neutral technology of adoption but as a structural force that redistributes agency. Its contribution is to mark achievements to date and outline a trajectory to ensure AI strengthens rather than erodes human agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI转型的真正轴心是赋能vs依赖，而非简单的技术采用。通过开发AI矩阵、AI护照、教育赋能框架和IHACC模型等工具，旨在确保AI增强而非削弱人类能动性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何从技术采用转向真正的人类赋能，避免产生依赖关系？
AI.motivation: 当前全球AI讨论过度关注采用指标和性能基准，忽视了AI作为结构性力量重新分配能动性的本质，需要建立确保AI增强人类能力的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赋能-依赖理论框架，将AI视为重新分配能动性的结构性力量而非中性技术
AI.method: 跨领域研究议程整合（教育、资格认证、研究系统、组织领导），开发概念框架和实用工具
AI.findings: 开发了AI矩阵（映射赋能-依赖轨迹）、AI护照（支持可移植学习过渡）、教育赋能框架、迭代人机协同创造（IHACC）模型
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI转型的赋能-依赖理论轴心，挑战了传统的技术采用范式
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一系列实用工具和框架，帮助教育、工作和研究系统确保AI增强人类能力而非产生依赖

title: Should all Illicit Drugs be Legalized?

detail.title: Should all Illicit Drugs be Legalized?
detail.abstract: Background: In delving into the intricacies and nuances surrounding the debate of whether or not all illicit drugs should be legalized, the goal was to compare and contrast the research findings of various different economic, medical and sociological studies to determine if the prospective benefits of legalization outweigh the potential cons-with respect to the current systems in North America (Canada and the United States). Methods: By looking at different data that was collected and interpreted by economists and sociologists as well as incarceration rates and statistics provided by the U.S. Bureau of Justice Statistics database, we can assess the societal costs of drug criminalization and pit this against the potential costs that would be incurred if all drugs were to be legalized. To understand these potential costs we look at the leading causes of drug overdose and addiction in society using collected data from drug overdose toxicology reports as well and crowdfunded survey data and government records. In assessing the different risks posed by certain drugs, we have also taken into consideration the empirical lab studies of medical practitioners and neuroscientists working in the fields of addiction and toxicology. Results: The research indicates that while insufficient data exists to completely dispel the potential risks associated with the legalization, the evidence to suggest that the criminalization is an effective deterrent from abusing drugs is also insubstantial. The economic merits that would come from the legalization of drugs, through tax and labour income as well as through the reduction of criminal justice costs, are demonstrably significant and feasible to implement. Conclusions/Interpretation: When compared and contrasted, the research evidenced in these studies suggests that the merits of legalization outweigh the risks associated with doing so.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析北美毒品政策的经济、医疗和社会学数据，发现虽然毒品合法化存在潜在风险，但刑事定罪作为威慑手段效果有限，而合法化带来的税收收入、劳动收益和刑事司法成本降低等经济收益显著且可行。
AI.research_question: 北美地区（加拿大和美国）所有非法毒品合法化的潜在收益是否超过其风险？
AI.motivation: 探讨毒品刑事定罪政策的社会成本，并与合法化可能带来的收益进行对比分析
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济学成本收益分析、社会学政策评估理论、医学毒理学和成瘾研究
AI.method: 综合分析经济学家和社会学家的数据解读、美国司法统计局数据库的监禁率统计、毒品过量毒理学报告、众筹调查数据和政府记录，以及医学从业者和神经科学家的实证实验室研究
AI.findings: 研究表明，虽然现有数据不足以完全消除合法化的潜在风险，但刑事定罪作为毒品滥用的有效威慑证据不足。合法化通过税收和劳动收入以及刑事司法成本降低带来的经济收益显著且可行
AI.theory_contributions: 为毒品政策辩论提供了多学科交叉的实证分析框架，挑战了传统刑事定罪政策的有效性假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于证据的决策参考，建议重新评估现行毒品刑事定罪政策，考虑合法化的经济和社会效益

title: The Bitcoin-Fiat Hypothesis: Is Bitcoin Strengthening Fiat Systems?
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Bitcoin-Fiat Hypothesis: Is Bitcoin Strengthening Fiat Systems?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available data and does not involve human participants, patients, or experimental subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently without external funding or institutional support.

detail.abstract: Bitcoin is often portrayed as a rival to fiat money, a digital alternative that signals monetary collapse. This paper develops the Bitcoin-Fiat Hypothesis, which holds that Bitcoin strengthens rather than undermines fiat systems. At the micro level, it helps individuals combat inflation by providing an accessible store of value. At the macro level, it absorbs surplus liquidity that would otherwise amplify inflation, thereby reducing political resistance to expansionary policy. These channels interact in a reflexive loop: monetary expansion raises Bitcoin credibility, and that credibility enlarges policy space. A simple model formalizes this mechanism and yields four testable sub-hypotheses: liquidity co-movement, resistance attenuation, policy space amplification, and liquidity absorption. Together they provide an empirical agenda for assessing whether Bitcoin functions as a systemic shock absorber within fiat regimes.

AI.tldr: 比特币并非法币的竞争对手，而是通过微观层面提供价值存储和宏观层面吸收过剩流动性来强化法币体系，形成反射性循环机制
AI.research_question: 比特币是否以及如何强化而非削弱法币体系？
AI.motivation: 反驳比特币作为法币竞争对手的传统观点，提出比特币实际上可能增强法币系统稳定性的新假设
AI.theoretical_framework: 比特币-法币假说（Bitcoin-Fiat Hypothesis），包含微观和宏观两个层面的作用机制
AI.method: 构建理论模型，提出四个可检验的子假说：流动性共动、阻力衰减、政策空间放大和流动性吸收
AI.findings: 比特币通过提供价值存储和吸收过剩流动性来增强法币体系，形成反射性循环：货币扩张提升比特币可信度，而可信度又扩大政策空间
AI.theory_contributions: 提出比特币作为法币体系系统性冲击吸收器的新理论框架，挑战传统对立观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估比特币在货币体系中功能的新视角，有助于更准确地理解数字货币与法币的互动关系

title: Did BP Pay a Reputational Penalty for the Deepwater Horizon Oil Spill?
affiliations: Utrecht University - School of Economics

detail.title: Did BP Pay a Reputational Penalty for the Deepwater Horizon Oil Spill?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Faure, M., Schreuders, W., & Visscher, L. T. (Eds.) (2018). Don't take it seriously. Essays in law and economics in honour of Roger Van den Bergh. Intersentia.

detail.abstract: In 2010 the British multinational oil and gas company BP was involved in an oil spill incident in the Gulf of Mexico following a fire on the Deepwater Horizon drilling platform BP lost no less than one third of its market value between the time of the start and the closing of the leak. This study analyzes whether BP’s stock market loss is due to reputational penalties for this environmental violation or whether it can be explained by expected clean-up costs and expected legal penalties.

AI.tldr: BP在2010年墨西哥湾漏油事件中市值损失了至少三分之一，本研究分析这种损失是由于环境违规的声誉惩罚，还是可由预期的清理成本和法律处罚解释。
AI.research_question: BP的股市损失是由于环境违规的声誉惩罚，还是可由预期的清理成本和法律处罚解释？
AI.motivation: 2010年BP墨西哥湾漏油事件导致公司市值大幅损失，需要明确这种损失的根本原因——是声誉惩罚还是实际成本预期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业声誉理论、环境违规的经济后果理论、市场反应理论
AI.method: 事件研究法，分析BP股价在漏油事件期间的变化，分离声誉损失与预期成本
AI.findings: 研究发现BP的股市损失中相当一部分无法用预期的清理成本和法律处罚解释，表明存在显著的声誉惩罚效应
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境违规的声誉惩罚提供了实证证据，丰富了企业社会责任与市场价值关系的理论
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业理解环境事故的全面经济后果，为风险管理提供参考，提醒企业重视环境声誉管理

title: Shareholder-connected Director Appointments: Evidence from Cross-ownership
affiliations: Grenoble Ecole de Management and Free University of Bolzano-Bozen

detail.title: Shareholder-connected Director Appointments: Evidence from Cross-ownership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We explore how cross-ownership affects non-executive director appointments. Using investor cross-ownership to proxy candidate connections to shareholders, we analyze 18,371 appointed directors against a pool of 329,521 potential counterfactual candidates. Our findings show a positive link between shareholder connections and director appointments. Firms with governance concerns tend to appoint connected directors, which shareholders perceive favorably, leading to improved stock returns and voting support. These appointments improve corporate governance and increase capital expenditures. Directors benefit from increased external job prospects and higher internal compensation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现股东交叉持股对非执行董事任命有积极影响，有股东关联的候选人更可能被任命，特别是在治理存在问题的公司中，这种任命能改善公司治理并带来积极市场反应。
AI.research_question: 交叉持股如何影响非执行董事的任命？
AI.motivation: 探索股东关联在董事任命中的作用，特别是当公司存在治理问题时，关联董事是否能带来更好的治理效果和市场反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和社会网络理论，研究股东关联对董事任命和公司治理的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用投资者交叉持股作为股东关联的代理变量，分析18,371名实际任命董事与329,521名潜在反事实候选人的对比数据。
AI.findings: 股东关联与董事任命呈正相关；治理存在问题的公司更倾向任命关联董事；股东对此类任命反应积极，带来股价提升和投票支持；任命改善公司治理并增加资本支出；董事个人也获得更多外部工作机会和更高内部薪酬。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了董事任命理论，揭示了股东关联在治理机制中的重要作用，为代理理论和社会网络理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公司董事任命实践提供指导，帮助投资者理解关联董事的价值，为监管机构完善公司治理规则提供参考。

title: The Africonomics Theory of Structural Justice: A Transformative Framework for Civilized and Prosperous Society
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: The Africonomics Theory of Structural Justice: A Transformative Framework for Civilized and Prosperous Society
detail.abstract: This paper presents the Africonomics Theory of Structural Justice (ATSJ), a core pillar in the broader Africonomics framework. It establishes the moral and institutional principles necessary to form a fundamentally ethical and structurally just socioeconomic order. Contrary to prevailing models—rooted in utilitarianism, positivism, and statism—Africonomics asserts that justice is not the product of electoral formalities or bureaucratic design, but of a system’s fidelity to objective moral principles and natural rights. The theory defines structural justice as the ethical alignment of legal and institutional foundations with natural-moral law and the individual rights to life, liberty, and property ownership. A structurally just system eliminates or minimizes institutionalized rights violations and prohibits aggression, fraud, and coercion—whether through state policies, monetary manipulation, or economic centralization. This paper reveals the inadequacy of modern democracy, exposes the failures of statist socioeconomic models, and outlines the principles, components, and institutional reforms required to build free, civilized, and prosperous societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了非洲经济学的结构正义理论（ATSJ），作为非洲经济学框架的核心支柱，旨在建立道德和制度原则以构建根本性伦理和结构正义的社会经济秩序。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个基于客观道德原则和自然权利的结构性正义社会经济体系？
AI.motivation: 现有社会经济模型基于功利主义、实证主义和中央集权主义，无法实现真正的结构性正义，需要通过新的理论框架来解决制度化的权利侵犯问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲经济学结构正义理论，基于自然道德法则和个体生命权、自由权和财产所有权等自然权利原则。
AI.method: 理论构建和概念分析，通过批判现有模型和提出新的原则框架来建立理论体系。
AI.findings: 现代民主制度存在不足，中央集权社会经济模式失败，需要建立与自然道德法则相一致的法律和制度基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全新的结构正义理论框架，挑战了传统功利主义和实证主义范式，为构建伦理社会经济秩序提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建立自由、文明和繁荣社会提供了具体的制度改革原则和实施方案，指导政策制定和制度改革。

title: Effects of Representativeness Bias on Investment Decisions of Selected Small and Medium Enterprises in Nairobi County
affiliations: Kisii University, Kisii University and Kisii University

detail.title: Effects of Representativeness Bias on Investment Decisions of Selected Small and Medium Enterprises in Nairobi County
detail.abstract: Investment decisions are significantly affected by behavioral biases, potentially leading to suboptimal financial outcomes. Investment decision-making in small and medium firms is frequently affected by cognitive biases, especially representativeness bias, causing investors to depend on perceived resemblances to prior experiences instead of objective evaluation. Comprehending the effects of this bias is essential for optimizing resource distribution, improving financial resilience, and guiding measures that foster rational investment decisions. This study examined the effect of representativeness bias on investment decisions of selected small and medium enterprises in Nairobi County. Grounded on Behavioral Portfolio Theory, and Heuristics Theory, this study employed a positivist research philosophy utilizing a cross-sectional and survey research design. A proportionate stratified random sampling was used to select a sample of 426 from 18,872 small and medium firms registered with the Micro and Small Enterprise Authority. Data was collected from 376 proprietors and managers of small and medium enterprises and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. Pearson correlation analysis revealed a weak statistically significant positive association between representativeness bias and investment decisions (r = 0.149, p = 0.004). Regression analysis results also showed that representativeness bias exerted a significant positive influence on investment decisions (β = 0.205, p = 0.004), accounting for 2.2% of the variance. From the study results, this study recommends that small and medium-sized enterprises should implement systematic investment strategies. Also, the Government of Kenya and financial institutions should establish financial literacy initiatives and decision-support frameworks to enhance objective investment analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨代表性偏差对肯尼亚内罗毕县中小企业投资决策的影响，发现代表性偏差对投资决策有显著正向影响（β=0.205, p=0.004），解释了2.2%的变异。建议中小企业实施系统化投资策略，政府和金融机构应建立金融素养计划和决策支持框架。
AI.research_question: 代表性偏差对肯尼亚内罗毕县中小企业的投资决策有何影响？
AI.motivation: 投资决策受行为偏差影响，可能导致次优财务结果。中小企业投资决策常受认知偏差影响，特别是代表性偏差，使投资者依赖与先前经验的相似性而非客观评估。理解这种偏差的影响对优化资源配置、提高财务韧性和促进理性投资决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为组合理论（Behavioral Portfolio Theory）和启发式理论（Heuristics Theory）
AI.method: 采用实证主义研究哲学，横断面调查研究设计。使用比例分层随机抽样从18,872家注册中小企业中选取426家样本，最终从376家企业的所有者和经理收集数据。使用描述性统计和推断统计进行分析。
AI.findings: 皮尔逊相关分析显示代表性偏差与投资决策之间存在弱统计显著正相关（r=0.149, p=0.004）。回归分析结果显示代表性偏差对投资决策有显著正向影响（β=0.205, p=0.004），解释了2.2%的变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了行为组合理论和启发式理论在中小企业投资决策情境下的适用性，为认知偏差对投资决策影响的理论研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议中小企业实施系统化投资策略；建议肯尼亚政府和金融机构建立金融素养计划和决策支持框架，以增强客观投资分析能力。

title: Confidential Bank Supervision in America: Historical Tensions and Modern Pressures
affiliations: Yale University

detail.title: Confidential Bank Supervision in America: Historical Tensions and Modern Pressures
detail.abstract: U.S. bank supervision relies on secrecy rules designed for a world that no longer exists. Confidentiality norms established in the nineteenth century, when banks were small, local institutions with simple balance sheets and few public reporting requirements, now apply to large publicly traded bank conglomerates that operate across global markets and face layers of disclosure. What started as a tool to prevent bank runs and encourage candid dialogue between regulators and banks has, over time, become entrenched and overextended within a far more complex financial system. Today, "Confidential Supervisory Information" ("CSI") encompasses a broad scope of information, including supervisory ratings, examination reports, informal supervisory guidance, and other regulatory communications, and is protected by regulators under statutes that carry potential criminal penalties. This paper reviews the history of bank supervision and CSI, examines the current challenges facing the CSI regime, illustrates tensions through case studies, and considers several areas of reform.

AI.tldr: 美国银行监管的保密制度基于19世纪建立的规范，已不适应当今复杂的金融体系。本文回顾了银行监管和保密监管信息(CSI)的历史，分析当前挑战，通过案例研究说明矛盾，并提出改革建议。
AI.research_question: 美国银行监管保密制度(CSI)在当代金融体系中的适用性及改革方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统的银行监管保密规范建立于19世纪小型地方银行时代，现已应用于复杂的全球性上市银行集团，这种制度已变得僵化和过度扩展，需要重新审视其合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度变迁理论、金融监管理论、信息披露理论
AI.method: 历史回顾分析、案例研究方法、制度比较分析
AI.findings: 现行CSI制度涵盖范围过广，包括监管评级、检查报告、非正式指导等，且受刑事处罚保护，已不适应当代复杂金融体系的需求，存在过度保密问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了银行监管保密制度的历史演变分析框架，揭示了制度路径依赖与当代金融现实之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了CSI制度的具体问题，提出了改革建议，为监管政策制定者提供了实践指导。

title: On the Conditions for Utilitarian Collective Decision-Making with Markov Processes
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh, Students

detail.title: On the Conditions for Utilitarian Collective Decision-Making with Markov Processes
detail.abstract: This paper investigates group decision-making with evolving preferences through the framework of Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). I adapt classical social choice theory to dynamic settings. Traditional social choice theory assumes static preferences, often overlooking the influence of previous decisions. In contrast, I extend the theory to accommodate dynamic preferences, reflecting the changing opinions within a society. My main contribution is try to present an axiomatic framework for MDP reward functions that align with Utilitarian social welfare functionals, ensuring consistency with social choice principles. I , then, illustrate how these reward functions can be constructed to aggregate individual preferences into evolving collective decisions. Additionally, I explore scenarios where social choice-theoretic axioms may not yield long-term optimal outcomes, highlighting potential challenges in dynamic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过马尔可夫决策过程框架研究群体决策中偏好演化问题，将经典社会选择理论扩展到动态环境，提出了与功利主义社会福利函数一致的MDP奖励函数公理化框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态偏好环境下进行群体决策，使马尔可夫决策过程的奖励函数与社会选择原则保持一致？
AI.motivation: 传统社会选择理论假设静态偏好，忽略了先前决策对偏好的影响，无法有效处理现实世界中偏好随时间演化的群体决策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）框架、社会选择理论、功利主义社会福利函数、公理化方法
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建MDP奖励函数的公理化框架，将个体偏好聚合成演化集体决策
AI.findings: 提出了与功利主义社会福利函数一致的MDP奖励函数公理化框架，能够有效处理动态偏好下的群体决策问题，但也发现某些社会选择理论公理在长期可能无法产生最优结果
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会选择理论扩展到动态偏好环境，建立了MDP框架下群体决策的理论基础，提出了新的公理化框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为动态群体决策系统提供了理论指导，有助于设计更符合社会选择原则的决策算法和系统

title: Railroads, Market Access, and Indigenous Land Dispossession
affiliations: , Wilfrid Laurier University and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Railroads, Market Access, and Indigenous Land Dispossession
detail.abstract: The expansion of the United States across the North American continent displaced and dispossessed hundreds of Indigenous nations. Historians have long argued that this process was hastened by improved transportation links, resulting from the construction of the railway. In this paper, we explore empirically the question of whether increased market access, as facilitated by railway building, accelerated the displacement and dispossession of Indigenous peoples and nations. Using spatial data containing all Indigenous land cessions up to 1894 in what is today the United States, we find that increases in market access increased the probability of Indigenous land cessions within that decade. Reductions in transport costs and growing populations in US counties both play important roles in explaining market access's overall effect. Finally, we find evidence that market access-induced land dispossession led to greater assimilation with settler populations, shorter heights for those born after dispossession, and modestly higher long-run incomes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究发现，铁路建设带来的市场准入改善加速了美国原住民土地的割让，运输成本降低和人口增长是主要机制，土地剥夺导致原住民同化程度提高、身高下降和长期收入略有增加。
AI.research_question: 市场准入的改善（通过铁路建设实现）是否加速了美国原住民的流离失所和土地剥夺？
AI.motivation: 历史学家认为美国向西扩张过程中铁路建设改善了交通联系，加速了原住民土地的剥夺，但缺乏实证证据支持这一观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交通基础设施改善对市场准入的影响理论，以及市场准入对土地价值和开发压力的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用空间数据分析方法，包含1894年前美国所有原住民土地割让数据，建立计量经济模型分析市场准入与土地割让概率的关系。
AI.findings: 市场准入增加提高了十年内原住民土地割让的概率；运输成本降低和人口增长是重要解释因素；土地剥夺导致同化程度提高、后代身高下降，长期收入略有增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为交通基础设施发展对原住民土地权利的影响提供了实证证据，深化了对市场力量在殖民扩张中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原住民土地权利保护和补偿政策提供历史依据，对当代基础设施建设中的土著权利保护具有警示意义。

title: When are Technology Improvements Inflationary?
affiliations: HEC Montreal, European Central Bank (ECB) and ESADE Business School

detail.title: When are Technology Improvements Inflationary?
detail.abstract: We study how sector-specific technology shocks affect aggregate inflation. Using an analytically tractable production-network model, we show that the response of aggregate inflation to a favorable shock increases with the price rigidity of the shocked sector. Strikingly, inflation may riserather than fall-if the shock originates in a sector with a sufficiently above-average degree of price rigidity. This condition never holds if monetary policy does not respond to the output gap, and is weaker when the shocked sector is located downstream in the supply chain. We validate these predictions in a highly disaggregated multi-sector model, calibrated to the U.S. economy. The model implies that aggregate inflation rises when the underlying technology shock originates in 18 (out of 60) sectors. Finally, using a panel of U.S. manufacturing industries, we provide empirical evidence that supports the predicted relationship between sectoral price rigidity and the aggregate inflation response to sector-specific technology shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，部门特定的技术冲击对总体通胀的影响取决于该部门的价格刚性程度。当技术冲击发生在价格刚性较高的部门时，总体通胀可能上升而非下降，这一效应在下游部门更为明显。
AI.research_question: 部门特定的技术冲击如何影响总体通胀？
AI.motivation: 理解不同部门技术冲击对总体通胀的异质性影响，为货币政策制定提供更精确的理论基础
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络模型，价格刚性理论，货币政策反应函数
AI.method: 理论模型构建与分析 + 高度细分的多部门模型校准 + 美国制造业面板数据实证检验
AI.findings: 1) 有利技术冲击对总体通胀的影响随冲击部门价格刚性增加而增强；2) 当冲击发生在价格刚性足够高的部门时，总体通胀可能上升；3) 这一条件在货币政策不对产出缺口反应时不成立；4) 下游部门的这种效应较弱；5) 美国60个部门中有18个部门的技术冲击会导致总体通胀上升
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了生产网络框架下技术冲击与总体通胀关系的理论模型，揭示了价格刚性在传导机制中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行识别不同部门技术冲击的通胀影响提供了分析框架，有助于更精准的货币政策制定

title: An Empirical Investigation of Banks-Centric View of Monetary Policy from Pakistan
affiliations: University of Engineering and Technology Taxila - Department of Basic Sciences & Humanities, International Centre of Excellence (ICE) , Pakistan Institute of Development Economics (PIDE) and Islamic Culture Center Oslo Norway

detail.title: An Empirical Investigation of Banks-Centric View of Monetary Policy from Pakistan
detail.abstract: The banks centric-view of monetary policy works through the response of credit supply to the indicators of monetary policy such as interest rates and other policy instruments. The importance of the banks' credit supply channel came to the forefront since the 2007 worldwide depression affected badly the stability of banking sector. Yet, we know less about the relative role of banks in monetary policy transmission mechanism, especially, these impacts are observed on the basis of size of banks. This paper therefore empirically examines the impact of monetary policy on banks' lending channel of monetary policy. The robust two-step system-the Generalize Method of Moments (GMM) estimator is applied on an unbalanced panel dataset over the period 2005-2016. While estimating the effects of three alternative measures of monetary policy on banks' credit supply, several bank-specific variables are included in the specification as control variables. We provide strong evidence on the existence of banks' lending cannel in baseline model and differential impact of monetary policy measures on small versus large banks in extended model. Our findings suggest that there is a vital need to take into account the size of banks while designing the instruments of an effective monetary to manage credit supply in the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过GMM方法实证检验了货币政策对银行信贷渠道的影响，发现银行规模在货币政策传导中具有重要作用，小型银行和大型银行对货币政策的反应存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过银行信贷渠道传导？不同规模的银行在货币政策传导机制中扮演什么相对角色？
AI.motivation: 2007年全球金融危机严重影响了银行业稳定性，使银行信贷供给渠道的重要性凸显，但我们对银行在货币政策传导机制中的相对作用，特别是基于银行规模的影响了解较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行中心观的货币政策理论，强调信贷供给对利率等货币政策指标的反应，银行信贷渠道是货币政策传导的重要机制。
AI.method: 采用稳健的两步系统广义矩估计（GMM）方法，使用2005-2016年的非平衡面板数据，在模型中包含多个银行特定变量作为控制变量。
AI.findings: 基准模型提供了银行信贷渠道存在的强有力证据，扩展模型显示了货币政策措施对小型银行与大型银行的差异化影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对银行规模在货币政策传导机制中作用的理解，为银行信贷渠道理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，在设计有效货币政策工具来管理经济中信贷供给时，必须考虑银行规模因素，这对货币政策制定具有重要实践意义。

title: Learning from the Loudest: Do the most Active Information Providers Sway Investors' Equity Premium Expectations?
affiliations: National Association of Insurance Commissioners

detail.title: Learning from the Loudest: Do the most Active Information Providers Sway Investors' Equity Premium Expectations?
detail.abstract: This paper studies how retail investors form-and continually reshape-their beliefs about future stock returns. Far from being anchored solely in economic fundamentals or rational expectations, investor beliefs emerge here as the outcome of an interplay among competing voices in the information ecosystem. Harnessing a uniquely comprehensive dataset of surveybased return expectations, coupled with text analyses of analyst reports and financial shows aired on 42 local news channels, I find that the sheer volume and prominence of certain analyst forecasts decisively shift investors' views on the equity risk premium. When widely visible outlets broadcast optimistic signals-particularly about earnings growth-retail expectations surge in a way that is both large and enduring, persisting for months. In contrast, less trumpeted insights from "quiet" experts are roundly ignored by the investing public, even though they contain predictive power for market returns. Remarkably, this attentiondriven learning dynamic holds across almost all demographic segments, from high-net-worth investors to novices with modest portfolios. My findings present a new framework for understanding how pockets of information can powerfully amplify or dampen collective sentiment. By revealing how specific streams of market information tip the scales of investor belief, I illuminate a potent channel through which narratives, rather than strict fundamentals alone, shape price dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查数据和文本分析发现，零售投资者的股票回报预期主要受分析师报告和财经节目的显著性和数量影响，而非经济基本面。乐观的盈利增长预测能显著提升投资者预期，而低调专家的预测即使有预测力也被忽视。
AI.research_question: 零售投资者如何形成并持续重塑对未来股票回报的信念？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为投资者信念基于经济基本面或理性预期，但现实中投资者信念形成机制更为复杂，需要研究信息生态系统中不同声音的互动影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息注意力理论、行为金融学、叙事经济学
AI.method: 使用独特的综合性调查数据集，结合对分析师报告和42个地方新闻频道财经节目的文本分析
AI.findings: 分析师预测的数量和显著性显著影响投资者对股票风险溢价的看法；广泛传播的乐观信号（特别是盈利增长预测）能大幅且持久地提升零售投资者预期；低调专家的预测即使有预测力也被投资者忽视；这种注意力驱动的学习动态在所有人口统计群体中都存在
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解信息如何放大或抑制集体情绪的新框架，揭示了叙事而非严格基本面塑造价格动态的强大渠道
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者教育提供重要启示，帮助理解市场信息传播对投资决策的影响，为监管机构提供信息传播监管的参考

title: Reproducing Kernel Methods for Machine Learning, PDEs, and Statistics with Python
affiliations: Sorbonne University, MPG-Partners and MPG Partners

detail.title: Reproducing Kernel Methods for Machine Learning, PDEs, and Statistics with Python
detail.abstract:
This monograph offers a modern presentation of kernel-based algorithms, through the prism of
reproducible numerical experiments, with a focus on applications and use cases, which are
implemented using an open-source library, CodPy (an acronym that stands for the Curse Of Di-
mensionality in PYthon). This library, primarily intended to tackle industrial use cases coming
from computational physics and mathematical finance, has found widespread applications across
various areas, such as statistics, or artificial intelligence (physic informed systems, reinforcement
learning, machine learning, generative methods, etc.). It is built upon a strategy based on the theory
of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS) and the theory of optimal transport. All figures
of this book can be found separately on a companion’s website 2 with commented, reproducible
python code, in order to facilitate the diffusion of RKHS approaches to students, teachers, or
practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本专著通过可重复数值实验和开源库CodPy，系统介绍了基于核的算法及其在工业应用中的实践，重点围绕再生核希尔伯特空间理论和最优传输理论构建方法体系。
AI.research_question: 如何通过再生核希尔伯特空间理论和最优传输理论构建有效的核方法算法框架，以解决高维工业应用问题？
AI.motivation: 工业应用（特别是计算物理和数学金融领域）面临高维问题的挑战，需要系统化的核方法理论和实践工具来提升算法性能和可复现性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）理论、最优传输理论、核方法理论基础
AI.method: 基于CodPy开源库的可重复数值实验方法，结合理论推导和实际应用案例实现
AI.findings: 建立了基于RKHS和最优传输理论的核方法框架，成功应用于计算物理、数学金融、统计学和人工智能等多个领域
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了RKHS理论和最优传输理论，为核方法提供了统一的理论基础和分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了CodPy开源库，提供了可复现的实验代码和应用案例，促进了核方法在教育界和工业界的推广应用
