title: Superstar Firms through the Generations
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Notre Dame - Department of Economics, London Business School and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: Superstar Firms through the Generations

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-118
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We present new facts about the largest American companies over the past century. In manufacturing, top firms in the 1910s, 1950s, and 2010s predominantly date back to around 1900. Even as this special generation persists, turnover among top firms has been substantial. In contrast, in retail and wholesale, we do not observe a special generation among top firms. We show in a model of firm dynamics that a special generation can arise from an industrial revolution, through the adoption of a scalable technology and learning-by-doing. Top firm turnover is matched by standard idiosyncratic productivity shocks. Time-varying market size growth rates or entry costs are not sufficient to explain the facts. Among retailers and wholesalers, learning appears absent, so a special generation would be harder to sustain. Our results highlight the potential for lasting nonstationarity among the dynamics of top firms, which can result from the long echoes of technological change.

title: Analysis of Crash Contributing Factors in Worker-Involved Crashes in Ohio Work Zones: A Topic Modeling Approach
affiliations: University of Cincinnati and University of Cincinnati

detail.title: Analysis of Crash Contributing Factors in Worker-Involved Crashes in Ohio Work Zones: A Topic Modeling Approach
detail.abstract: Nationwide, work zone-related crashes have shown a rising trend since 2013. In 2022 alone, there were 37,701 injuries in work zones, with 891 fatalities - an increase from 845 in 2019 and 863 in 2020. A similar pattern is evident in Ohio, which recorded 29,000 work zone crashes between 2019 and 2024. This study seeks to uncover contributing factors to worker-involved crashes in work zones by analyzing unstructured crash narratives using various text mining techniques: word cloud visualization, Yet Another Keyword Extractor (YAKE), Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers for Topic Modeling (BERTopic). Another objective is to compare LDA and BERTopic in their ability to extract coherent and distinct topics from crash narratives. The word cloud emphasized frequent mentions of vehicle-worker interactions and traffic control features. YAKE identified “stop sign” as a key term, suggesting issues with temporary traffic control. LDA’s inter-topic distance map showed overlapping themes, indicating semantic similarity. In contrast, BERTopic generated eight well-separated topics, highlighting its strength in distinguishing detailed crash contexts. LDA modeling identified six key topics, including interstate incidents, flagger operations, intersection-related crashes, marked zone areas, worker-vehicle interactions, and documentation aspects. BERTopic provided greater detail, distinguishing eight distinct topics such as signage-related crashes, traffic direction issues, and utility-related incidents. These findings highlight the need for improved traffic control measures and policy revisions to protect workers. This research offers a foundation for targeted safety interventions based on specific crash scenarios derived from narrative analysis, enhancing the operation of safer work zones.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用文本挖掘技术分析工作区事故叙述，发现BERTopic比LDA能更好地区分事故主题，识别出标志相关事故、交通引导问题等8个关键主题，强调需要改进交通控制措施以保护工人安全。
AI.research_question: 工作区涉及工人的事故有哪些促成因素？LDA和BERTopic在从事故叙述中提取连贯且独特主题方面的能力如何比较？
AI.motivation: 全国工作区相关事故自2013年以来呈上升趋势，2022年有37,701人受伤，891人死亡。俄亥俄州在2019-2024年间记录了29,000起工作区事故，迫切需要识别事故因素以改善安全措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本挖掘理论，包括词云可视化、YAKE关键词提取、LDA主题建模和BERTopic主题建模方法。
AI.method: 使用多种文本挖掘技术分析非结构化事故叙述：词云可视化、YAKE关键词提取器、LDA和BERTopic主题建模方法。
AI.findings: 词云显示车辆-工人互动和交通控制特征的频繁提及；YAKE识别"停车标志"为关键术语；LDA识别6个重叠主题；BERTopic生成8个区分良好的主题，包括标志相关事故、交通引导问题等。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了BERTopic在从事故叙述中提取连贯和独特主题方面优于LDA，为文本挖掘在交通安全领域的应用提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为基于特定事故情景的有针对性安全干预提供了基础，强调了改进交通控制措施和政策修订的必要性，以增强工作区安全运营。

title: Is Beta Busted?
affiliations: , , University of Technology Sydney and University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - School of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Is Beta Busted?
detail.abstract: The Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) is one of the most widely used tools in finance, linking expected returns to market risk. Yet the way beta is typically estimated can produce misleading results. We show that using standard market indexes as proxies introduces a systematic bias and propose a measure of its severity, the Beta Mismatch Error. Analysing 30 years of U.S. equity data, we find that OLS betas understate theoretical betas by around 50% on average. Extending to portfolios, we show that the size and value premiums largely reflect this mismatch, casting doubt on many findings based on CAPM estimates.

AI.tldr: CAPM模型中传统beta估计方法存在系统性偏差，使用标准市场指数作为代理变量会产生Beta错配误差，导致OLS beta平均低估理论beta约50%，规模和价值溢价很大程度上反映了这种错配
AI.research_question: 标准市场指数作为CAPM beta估计的代理变量是否存在系统性偏差？这种偏差对资产定价实证研究有何影响？
AI.motivation: CAPM作为金融学最广泛应用的工具之一，其beta估计方法的准确性对资产定价理论和实证研究至关重要，但传统估计方法可能存在未被识别的系统性问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型(CAPM)，市场组合理论，代理变量偏差理论
AI.method: 使用30年美国股票数据进行分析，比较OLS估计beta与理论beta，提出Beta错配误差度量指标，扩展到投资组合分析
AI.findings: OLS beta平均低估理论beta约50%，规模溢价和价值溢价很大程度上反映了beta估计的错配问题
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CAPM beta估计中的系统性偏差机制，提出了Beta错配误差的概念和度量方法
AI.practical_contributions: 对基于CAPM估计的许多实证研究结果提出质疑，为资产定价模型的正确应用提供了方法学改进

title: Which is Better: Democracy, Monarchy, or Other Types of Government? A Comparative Study of Governance Models Across History and Nations
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Which is Better: Democracy, Monarchy, or Other Types of Government? A Comparative Study of Governance Models Across History and Nations
detail.abstract: The question of which form of government best serves society-democracy, monarchy, or alternative systems such as authoritarianism, socialism, or theocracy-remains one of the most enduring debates in political philosophy and practice. At the same time, democracy is often heralded as the pinnacle of governance in the modern world; however, history and contemporary case studies reveal that no single model guarantees prosperity, stability, or justice in all contexts. This paper examines the origins, philosophical underpinnings, and historical evolution of major governance systems, beginning with classical monarchy and its variants, progressing through the rise of democracy, and extending to authoritarian, socialist, and hybrid regimes. Using comparative case studies-including the economic modernization of constitutional monarchies like the United Kingdom, the democratic resilience of India, the authoritarian stability of China, and the hybrid theocratic-monarchic structure of Saudi Arabia-this research evaluates governance models through the lenses of social development, political stability, and economic performance. The analysis highlights the trade-offs inherent in each system: democracy's inclusivity versus inefficiency, monarchy's continuity versus lack of accountability, authoritarianism's efficiency versus repression, and socialism's equality versus rigidity. Ultimately, this paper argues that no system is universally "best"; rather, effectiveness depends on historical, cultural, and socioeconomic contexts. By situating governance within both theory and practice, the paper contributes to the broader debate on how nations can adapt political systems to achieve sustainable progress in the 21st century. This research provides a comprehensive analysis of twenty-three types of governance systems spanning historical, contemporary, and niche models, including democracy, monarchy, technocracy, autocracy, anarchism, and transitional governments. Each system is examined in depth, covering historical origins, core features, political structures, economic and social implications, and illustrative case studies. The study further provides a comparative analysis to evaluate the effectiveness, strengths, weaknesses, and situational suitability of these systems, emphasizing lessons for modern governance. By integrating historical context with contemporary relevance, this research offers a holistic guide for understanding how diverse governance structures shape societal outcomes, inform policy-making, and influence development trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较分析23种治理体系，认为没有普遍最优的政府形式，治理效果取决于历史、文化和社会经济背景。民主、君主制、威权主义等各有利弊，需根据具体情境选择。
AI.research_question: 哪种政府形式最能服务社会？民主、君主制还是其他替代体系？
AI.motivation: 治理体系选择是政治哲学和实践中最持久的辩论之一，但现实中没有任何单一模式能在所有情境下保证繁荣、稳定或正义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较政治学、政治哲学、治理理论，涵盖民主理论、君主制理论、威权主义理论、社会主义理论等。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，包括英国宪政君主制、印度民主韧性、中国威权稳定、沙特混合神权-君主制等案例。
AI.findings: 每种治理体系都存在权衡：民主的包容性vs低效、君主制的连续性vs缺乏问责、威权主义的效率vs压制、社会主义的平等vs僵化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了治理体系的综合比较框架，强调情境依赖性和历史文化因素的重要性，挑战了普遍最优治理模式的观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供选择治理体系的实用指南，帮助各国根据自身条件调整政治体系以实现可持续发展。

title: Magnetic Fluctuations and Neutral Current Features: From the 21-cm Hydrogen Line to Neurobiological Mechanisms
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Magnetic Fluctuations and Neutral Current Features: From the 21-cm Hydrogen Line to Neurobiological Mechanisms
detail.abstract:
This study explores the potential for a fundamental connection between quantum phenomena at the cosmic scale and neurobiological processes, based on the underlying physical mechanisms of hydrogen 21-cm emission in the interstellar medium. We propose a unified theoretical framework linking the hyperfine transitions responsible for this cosmic emission to potential quantum processes in neuronal tissue.

The analysis draws upon an extension of Weinberg angular parameters and experimental measurements of neutral currents obtained at CERN, revealing that these currents can be up to ten times stronger than primary currents in atomic nuclei. We present computational calculations for various atomic species (hydrogen, helium, lithium) and develop a complex mathematical formalism to describe neutral current interactions in biological systems.

A crucial distinction emerges between these two quantum environments: in the interstellar medium, the massive bosons responsible for quantum coordination exhibit spin states of ±2 or 0, consistent with graviton-like particles and scalar field interactions, as demonstrated by our 4D superstring formulations (dE ≈ 125.57 GeV for spin-2 bosons). In contrast, in the neuronal environment, the mediating massive bosons are virtual W bosons of variable masses M_W-k, possessing spin ±1 and charges proportional to their masses, derived from the modified Weinberg angle θ_W-k where sin²θ_W-k = ±Ln(P)/(π + 4k3²π³/(Ln(P))²), with M_W ≈ 79.48 GeV.

The neuronal environment, rich in magnetically active ions (K⁺, Ca²⁺) and containing approximately 50 million hydrogen atoms per neuron, could theoretically support quantum magnetic resonance phenomena analogous to those observed in interstellar space. The endogenous electromagnetic fields generated by neuronal activity (10⁻¹⁵ to 10⁻¹² Tesla) could modulate nuclear spin states via electromagnetic coupling mediated by these ±1 spin massive bosons.

We examine glutamatergic and GABAergic neurotransmission mechanisms from the perspective of quantum coordination, proposing that glutamate-mediated excitation may promote coordinated spin states, while GABAergic inhibition may promote quantum decoherence. A computational algorithm adapted from particle physics is presented to detect signatures of neutral currents in biological systems.

The critical analysis acknowledges major physical constraints, notably the challenge posed by body temperature (26 meV) compared to the hyperfine transition energy (5.9 μeV), and decoherence timescales (femtoseconds to picoseconds) compared to neuronal processes (milliseconds). Nevertheless, quantum protection mechanisms analogous to those found in photosynthesis may preserve transient coherences in highly organized molecular structures.

Experimental implications include the use of high-resolution NMR spectroscopy, quantum magnetoencephalography, and tailored quantum correlation experiments in neurons. If confirmed, these phenomena could revolutionize our understanding of neural information processing, synaptic plasticity, and potentially contribute to quantum theories of consciousness.

This research proposes a bold conceptual bridge between astrophysics and neurobiology, suggesting that fundamental quantum principles may operate across radically different scales and environments—from interstellar space to biological neural networks—distinguished primarily by the spin characteristics of their respective mediating particles.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个连接宇宙尺度量子现象与神经生物学过程的统一理论框架，基于氢21厘米发射的物理机制，探讨了星际介质和神经元组织中量子过程的相似性与差异。
AI.research_question: 宇宙尺度的量子现象（如氢21厘米发射）与神经生物学过程之间是否存在根本性的物理联系？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Weinberg角参数扩展和CERN中性电流实验，构建了连接宇宙量子现象与神经量子过程的统一理论框架，涉及超弦理论和修正的Weinberg角。
AI.method: 计算分析氢、氦、锂等原子物种，开发复杂数学形式描述生物系统中的中性电流相互作用，采用粒子物理学算法检测生物系统中的中性电流特征。
AI.findings: 发现两种量子环境的关键区别：星际介质中的玻色子具有±2或0自旋（类似引力子），而神经元环境中的虚拟W玻色子具有±1自旋；神经元环境理论上可支持类似于星际空间的量子磁共振现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接天体物理学与神经生物学的概念桥梁，建立了跨尺度量子统一理论框架，为量子意识理论提供了新的物理基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了使用高分辨率NMR光谱、量子脑磁图和定制量子相关实验来验证理论，可能革新神经信息处理和突触可塑性的理解。

title: Gender and Tax Scholarship as Critical Method
affiliations: Pace University - School of Law

detail.title: Gender and Tax Scholarship as Critical Method
detail.abstract:
This Essay introduces the Pittsburgh Tax Review's issue featuring scholarship from the American Tax Policy Institute's October, 2024 symposium, "It's a Man's World: Revealing and Addressing Hidden Gender Bias in Tax Law and Policy." In reading the symposium papers together, this Essay advances a central claim: gender-aware tax analysis is not merely a topic but a method. Part I situates contemporary work within five decades of scholarship, tracing a shift from identifying overt statutory bias to interrogating how ostensibly neutral rules produce gendered and racialized outcomes. Part II maps the symposium's six panels that deployed diverse methods-doctrinal excavation, empirical measurement, comparative and constitutional analysis, and intersectional critique-to examine marriage and filing status, the production of legislative "evidence," care work and refundable credits, retirement and wealth-building, employment incentives and incarceration's collateral tax harms, and the tension between formal neutrality and measured effects. Part III looks forward, outlining research agendas on intersectional race-gender questions; immigrants and the tax state; transgender and nonbinary taxpayers; queer families; wealth transfers and trusts; capital gains and gendered asset patterns; entrepreneurship; exempt organizations; reproductive justice; and digital and algorithmic taxation. 

Across these contributions, the Essay identifies a common move in gender and tax scholarship to test neutrality empirically, read design choices against distributional facts, and center lived experience in policy architecture. The collective result is work that takes the form of both diagnosis and blueprint, offering tools for exposing hidden hierarchies in tax and for building systems that more accurately recognize work, caregiving, and diverse household forms.

AI.practical_contributions: 提供了诊断隐藏税收等级制度的工具和构建更公平税收体系的蓝图，为政策制定者提供了具体的改革方向和实施路径。

title: Does the Social Security Tax Violate Rule of Law Principles?
affiliations: Saint Louis University - School of Law

detail.title: Does the Social Security Tax Violate Rule of Law Principles?

declarations.funderStatement: Saint Louis University Grant (in part)

detail.abstract: The Rule of Law as applied to taxation assumes primarily procedural form. If tax rules have developed through adequate legislative and administrative procedures and been applied to taxpayers by unbiased administrators and an unbiased judiciary, they are facially neutral and procedurally rule of law compliant. Yet, the rule of law also has a substantive aspect that focuses on equality in the outcome of the procedures. It asks whether the tax rules as enacted and applied consistently with rule of law procedural criteria nevertheless result in unequal or biased outcomes? If they do, they must change to meet thicker understandings of the rule of law. This chapter applies this substantive concept to the U.S. social security tax and argues the tax fails to meet rule of law fairness criteria even if it might have met those criteria when first enacted. The chapter argues that the rule of law is dynamic, and the payroll tax has become obsolete, harmful, regressive, and inconsistent with the substantive rule of law. While public retirement systems are firmly embedded in and critical to the modern economies that characterise the developed world, they should be funded from general revenue rather than a limited, targeted tax that cannot be adequate to the job as the size of the retired population grows.

detail.title: Job Satisfaction Impact of Technological Change on Women Garment Workers in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of technological change on job satisfaction of women garment workers in Bangladesh. A set of job satisfaction variables was developed from the Technological Change Survey (Slem and Levi, 1995). The specific relationship between job satisfaction and the overall satisfaction shows that fair pay, task significance, bureaucracy, conflicts, and information sharing are significantly related. Task significance and information sharing are positively related to the overall impact. Fair pay, bureaucracy and conflicts are negatively and significantly related to the overall impact.

title: The Great Digital Decoupling: An Existential Challenge for Economics and Economists
affiliations: Human Information Technology Laboratory, founded 2008, Finland

detail.title: The Great Digital Decoupling: An Existential Challenge for Economics and Economists
detail.abstract: The economics profession is facing an existential paradox: intellectual output has surged while its practical impact has collapsed. This study presents the first robust empirical evidence of this Great Digital Decoupling, a two-stage process eroding the discipline's relevance. Analyzing data from 2013-2023, we document an ~80% increase in publications, patents, and economics graduates, which correlates with stagnating productivity growth, soaring debt-to-GDP ratios exceeding 300%, and persistent labor market fragility. Multivariate regression and citation analysis reveal a concerning negative feedback loop: rising research volume is associated with a ~38% decline in the policy influence of academic work within IMF and World Bank reports. We argue this decoupling is not cyclical but structural and accelerating, driven by a fundamental epistemological mismatch. Traditional economic models, designed for a stable, industrial era, are incapable of capturing the network effects, data-as-capital, and algorithmic dynamics of the 21stcentury digital economy. Our findings demonstrate that incremental reform is futile. We conclude by proposing a paradigm shift to a Digital Sustainable Growth Model (DSGM) as the foundation for a "3D Economy." The DSGM provides a synthesizing framework-integrating complexity science, digital-native principles, and socio-ethical metrics-to realign economic knowledge production with tangible human prosperity and systemic resilience. This is not an option but an imperative for a discipline at a crossroads.

title: Notions of Rank Efficiency for the Random Assignment Problem *
affiliations: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, Iran

detail.title: Notions of Rank Efficiency for the Random Assignment Problem *

declarations.funderStatement: I gratefully acknowledge support from the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNFS) through Project 100018_212311.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Public Economic Theory, volume 26, issue 6, 2024[10.1111/jpet.70008]

detail.abstract: An assignment is rank efficient if there is no other assignment where the expected number of agents who received one of their top choices is weakly higher. We introduce new notions of rank efficiency for the random assignment problem and illustrate a hierarchy between them. In a rank-minimizing assignment, agents receive objects with a minimum rank on average. An ex-post rank efficient random assignment has at least one lottery over only rank efficient deterministic assignments. Thus, it could still have another lottery with some rank-dominated deterministic assignments in its support. If each deterministic assignment in any decomposition of a random assignment is rank efficient, we call it a robust ex-post rank efficient assignment. We demonstrate that rank-minimizing implies rank efficiency, which indicates (robust) ex-post rank efficiency. Moreover, we introduce a mechanism that provides an expost rank efficient random assignment. We also prove that ex-post rank efficiency is incompatible with strategyproofness or fairness in the sense of weak envy-freeness and equal division lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机分配问题中的新秩效率概念，建立了概念间的层次关系，证明了秩最小化分配蕴含秩效率，进而蕴含(稳健)事后秩效率，并构造了事后秩效率机制，同时证明了事后秩效率与策略证明性或公平性不相容。
AI.research_question: 随机分配问题中不同秩效率概念之间的关系是什么？是否存在满足事后秩效率的机制？事后秩效率与策略证明性和公平性是否相容？
AI.motivation: 现有随机分配理论主要关注效率、公平性和策略证明性，但对基于排序的秩效率研究不足，需要建立系统的秩效率概念框架并探讨其性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机分配理论，引入秩效率、事后秩效率、稳健事后秩效率等新概念，建立概念间的蕴含关系层次结构。
AI.method: 理论证明和构造性方法，通过数学推导证明概念间的蕴含关系，构造满足事后秩效率的机制，并证明不相容性定理。
AI.findings: 1) 秩最小化分配蕴含秩效率，进而蕴含(稳健)事后秩效率；2) 存在提供事后秩效率随机分配的机制；3) 事后秩效率与策略证明性或弱无嫉妒性、均等分割下界等公平性概念不相容。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了随机分配中秩效率概念的系统理论框架，明确了不同秩效率概念间的层次关系，丰富了分配理论的研究维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际分配机制设计提供了理论指导，明确了追求秩效率时可能需要在策略证明性或公平性方面做出权衡，具有机制设计实践意义。

title: Rushing to the Altar? Same-sex Marriages When Rights Feel at Risk
affiliations: University of Tübingen, EBS Universität für Wirtschaft und Recht and University of Valencia

detail.title: Rushing to the Altar? Same-sex Marriages When Rights Feel at Risk
detail.abstract: The literature on same-sex marriage has primarily focused on the effects of legal recognition, overlooking the factors that influence marriage decisions among samesex couples. This study provides novel evidence on the role of political context by analyzing how the election of a homophobic leader affects these decisions. Using the case of Brazil, we examine the effect of revealed local support for the openly homophobic Jair Bolsonaro in the presidential elections on same-sex marriage dynamics. To estimate this effect, we apply a difference-indifferences approach with varying treatment intensity. The results show a significant increase in same-sex marriages in municipalities with higher support for Bolsonaro during the period between the election and the start of his mandate. These findings suggest that perceived threats of rights restrictions can play a critical role in shaping personal decisions among minority groups, even in the absence of legal changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在巴西总统选举中，对恐同候选人博索纳罗支持率较高的城市，同性婚姻数量在其当选后至就职前期间显著增加，表明权利受限的感知威胁会影响少数群体的个人决策。
AI.research_question: 恐同领导人的当选如何影响同性伴侣的婚姻决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注同性婚姻合法化的影响，而忽视了影响同性伴侣婚姻决策的因素，特别是政治背景的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于威胁感知理论，认为少数群体在面临权利可能被限制的威胁时，会采取行动来保护自身权益。
AI.method: 采用差异中的差异方法（Difference-in-Differences）结合变强度处理，分析巴西各城市对博索纳罗的支持率与同性婚姻动态的关系。
AI.findings: 在博索纳罗当选后至就职前的期间，对其支持率较高的城市中同性婚姻数量显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为威胁感知理论提供了实证支持，表明政治环境变化可以影响少数群体的个人决策，即使在没有实际法律变化的情况下。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者理解政治言论和领导人的立场如何影响少数群体的行为决策，为保护少数群体权利提供参考。

title: Fuzzy Decision-Making in Asset Markets
affiliations: University of Scranton - Kania School of Management and CUNY - Baruch College

detail.title: Fuzzy Decision-Making in Asset Markets
detail.abstract: This paper develops an infinite-horizon, Lucas-type general equilibrium model of asset markets with a fuzzy decision-making investor. The model yields closed-form solutions for the equilibrium equity premium and risk-free rate. The resulting solutions imply that a pessimistic outlook reduces the risk-free rate and increases the equity premium. Under reasonable parameterizations, the model generates the long-run first moments of the U.S. risk-free rate and equity premium. This work contributes to the asset pricing literature by demonstrating that fuzzy sets and membership functions offer a tractable and flexible framework for modeling approximate decision-making in asset markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个无限期模糊决策的资产市场一般均衡模型，得出了股权溢价和无风险利率的闭式解，证明悲观预期会降低无风险利率并提高股权溢价，模型能够匹配美国市场长期数据。
AI.research_question: 模糊决策如何影响资产市场的均衡定价？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型假设投资者完全理性，但现实中投资者往往基于模糊信息和不精确判断进行决策，需要开发能够捕捉这种近似决策行为的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lucas型一般均衡模型，结合模糊集合理论和隶属函数来建模投资者的模糊决策过程。
AI.method: 构建无限期模糊决策的一般均衡资产定价模型，推导闭式解析解，并进行参数化校准。
AI.findings: 悲观预期会降低无风险利率并提高股权溢价；在合理参数设定下，模型能够复现美国市场风险利率和股权溢价的长期一阶矩特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将模糊集合理论引入资产定价的一般均衡框架，为建模近似决策提供了可处理且灵活的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解投资者情绪和行为偏差对资产价格的影响提供了新的理论解释，对实际投资决策和风险管理具有指导意义。

title: Africa's Blue Economy: Ocean Resources for Sustainable Development and Low-Carbon Energy Transition
affiliations: Plousios Law Practice

detail.title: Africa's Blue Economy: Ocean Resources for Sustainable Development and Low-Carbon Energy Transition
detail.abstract: Africa's blue economy offers a critical pathway to achieve the dual objectives of sustainable development and decarbonisation. This study investigates how ocean-based renewable energy systems, blue carbon ecosystems, and sustainable marine resource management can collectively reduce continental carbon emissions while addressing energy poverty. Through analysis of policy frameworks and continental datasets, the research identifies three underexploited decarbonisation levers: (1) offshore renewable energy potential, (2) coastal wetland conservation for carbon sequestration, and (3) climate-smart fisheries practices. The findings demonstrate that integrated blue economy strategies could contribute up to 30% of coastal African nations' NDC targets (based on AU 2022 estimates) through two mechanisms: • Direct mitigation: Ocean energy displaces CO2 generation • Indirect mitigation: Mangrove protection, avoiding CO2 emissions from degradation Methodologically, the study combines policy analysis with emissions data from the African Natural Resources Centre, proposing a governance framework to align blue economy development with national decarbonisation commitments under the Paris Agreement.

AI.tldr: 非洲蓝色经济通过海洋可再生能源、蓝碳生态系统和可持续海洋资源管理三大杠杆，可为沿海国家贡献30%的国家自主减排目标，实现可持续发展与脱碳双重目标
AI.research_question: 海洋可再生能源系统、蓝碳生态系统和可持续海洋资源管理如何共同减少非洲大陆碳排放并解决能源贫困问题
AI.motivation: 非洲蓝色经济为实现可持续发展和脱碳双重目标提供关键路径，但目前相关脱碳潜力尚未充分开发
AI.theoretical_framework: 蓝色经济理论、脱碳理论、生态系统服务理论
AI.method: 政策框架分析和大陆数据集分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 识别出三大未充分利用的脱碳杠杆：近海可再生能源潜力、沿海湿地碳汇保护和气候智能型渔业实践；集成蓝色经济战略可为非洲沿海国家贡献高达30%的国家自主减排目标
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了蓝色经济与脱碳目标整合的理论框架，丰富了可持续发展理论在海洋领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家提供了具体的蓝色经济脱碳实施路径和政策建议，支持巴黎协定国家自主减排承诺的实现

title: Inventory Competition and the Cost of a Stockout
affiliations: Arizona State University W. P. Carey School of Business, California State Polytechnic University, San Luis Obispo and Arizona State University - W.P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Inventory Competition and the Cost of a Stockout
detail.abstract: Problem definition: The economic cost of lost or wasted food at the groceryretail level is well documented. We analyze how much of this loss results from grocers competing in both price and inventory as these retailers overorder to avoid stockouts. Methodology/results: We use grocery retail data to estimate a model of spatial demand, and competition in prices and inventories, among competing retailers to examine stockout costs and retail food loss. We find that prices and inventories are strategic complements in the sense that when retailers increase inventory levels to avoid stockouts, doing so softens price competition so prices rise accordingly in Bertrand-Nash equilibrium. Moreover, because we account for the reverse effect as well-the feedback effect between prices and inventories-we find that higher prices in turn lead to higher inventory levels. We find that, at the Bertrand-Nash equilibrium, retailers over-order relative to their baseline demand so that they waste some 13% of retail sales, on average, over multiple categories. We also find higher stockout costs than in the prior literature, and excess ordering of some 17% relative to noncompetitive-retailer levels. Managerial implications: Retail competition in inventory appears to be an important driver of excess food stocks and an overlooked market failure contributing to overall food waste in the supply chain. This explains why retailers waste so much food, as holding excess inventories is profit-maximizing when there is a low-cost way of moving excess inventories out the back of the stores without incurring tipping fees. Public policies like higher tipping fees or taxes on waste may raise the cost of holding excess inventories, thereby limiting the incentive to over-order.

AI.tldr: 研究发现零售商的库存竞争是导致食品浪费的重要原因，零售商为避免缺货而过度订购，这种策略性行为导致平均13%的零售销售额被浪费。
AI.research_question: 零售竞争如何通过价格和库存策略导致食品浪费？
AI.motivation: 食品浪费在零售环节的经济成本已被充分记录，但缺乏对零售商竞争行为如何导致过度订购和浪费的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间需求模型和Bertrand-Nash均衡理论，分析价格与库存的战略互补关系。
AI.method: 使用杂货零售数据估计空间需求模型，分析竞争零售商在价格和库存方面的策略互动。
AI.findings: 价格和库存是战略互补的，库存增加会软化价格竞争导致价格上涨；反过来价格上涨又导致库存水平提高；零售商平均浪费13%的零售销售额。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了价格与库存之间的双向反馈效应，提供了零售竞争导致食品浪费的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供干预措施建议（如提高垃圾处理费或浪费税），帮助零售商减少过度订购行为。

title: Regulatory Sandboxes as a Bridge Between AI And Cybersecurity: Exploring the Interplay Between the AI Act and the Cyber Resilience Act
affiliations: IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca

detail.title: Regulatory Sandboxes as a Bridge Between AI And Cybersecurity: Exploring the Interplay Between the AI Act and the Cyber Resilience Act
detail.abstract: The contribution examines the role of regulatory sandboxes in the context of the Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), highlighting their key features, objectives, and potential benefits. Through a comparative analysis, the paper explores the interactions between the two pieces of legislation, with a particular focus on cybersecurity requirements for AI systems. It argues that regulatory sandboxes can facilitate dialogue and coordination between the AI Act and the CRA, ultimately improving regulatory compliance. The analysis has a dual scope: to identify similarities and differences between the two regulations, and to highlight the critical role of cybersecurity in the context of AI systems and regulatory sandboxes. The findings suggest that regulatory sandboxes have the potential to play a crucial role in promoting a safe, fair, and healthy digital ecosystem in Europe. The contribution highlights the importance of dedicated cyber resilience sandboxes and proposes the development of a comprehensive framework of regulatory sandboxes for AI and cybersecurity, which could foster innovation and experimentation at both European and national levels.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨监管沙盒在AI法案和网络安全法案中的作用，通过比较分析强调监管沙盒在促进法规协调、改善合规性方面的潜力，并提议建立AI和网络安全的综合监管沙盒框架。
AI.research_question: 监管沙盒在AI法案和网络安全法案背景下扮演什么角色？如何通过监管沙盒促进两个法规之间的协调与合规？
AI.motivation: 随着AI法案和网络安全法案的出台，需要探索有效的监管工具来协调两个法规的要求，促进创新同时确保安全合规。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管沙盒理论、法规协调理论和网络安全治理理论，构建分析框架。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，对AI法案和网络安全法案进行系统性对比，重点分析网络安全要求对AI系统的影响。
AI.findings: 监管沙盒能够促进AI法案与网络安全法案之间的对话协调，改善监管合规；网络安全在AI系统和监管沙盒中具有关键作用；需要建立专门的网络弹性沙盒和综合监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了监管沙盒理论在AI和网络安全交叉领域的应用，提出了法规协调的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了建立AI和网络安全监管沙盒框架的具体建议，有助于在欧洲和国家层面促进创新实验。

title: Revisit labor market concentration under Work-From-Home: An Integration of Labor Market Boundaries
affiliations: University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Revisit labor market concentration under Work-From-Home: An Integration of Labor Market Boundaries
detail.abstract: Post-COVID work-from-home (WFH) policies have reduced geographic constraints, enabling workers to access remote job opportunities across regions. This shift has expanded local labor market boundaries and altered labor market concentration levels. In this study, I adjust a traditional concentration measurement to include remote job postings and analyze the impact of WFH on labor market concentration using the difference-indifferences (DID) approach. I find that excluding remote jobs significantly biases the concentration estimate. Additionally, I re-estimate the effect of concentration on wages using the two-stage least squares (2SLS) method, finding that concentration exerts downward pressure on wages for occupations with lower education requirements. In contrast, wages for occupations with higher education requirements increase with concentration. These results suggest supply-side shifts in the labor market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，后疫情时代远程工作政策扩大了劳动力市场边界，排除远程职位会显著高估市场集中度。市场集中度对工资的影响因教育要求而异：低教育要求职业的工资受压，高教育要求职业的工资反而上升。
AI.research_question: 远程工作政策如何影响劳动力市场集中度的测量？市场集中度对不同教育要求职业的工资有何差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代远程工作政策打破了地理限制，使劳动者能够跨地区获取远程工作机会，这改变了传统劳动力市场的边界和集中度测量方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场集中度理论、远程工作经济学、工资决定理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID）分析WFH对市场集中度的影响，使用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）重新估计集中度对工资的影响
AI.findings: 1. 排除远程职位会显著偏差集中度估计；2. 市场集中度对低教育要求职业的工资产生向下压力；3. 高教育要求职业的工资随集中度上升而增加
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含远程职位的市场集中度测量方法，揭示了WFH背景下劳动力市场集中度对工资的差异化影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的市场集中度测量框架，有助于理解远程工作时代劳动力市场的新特征和工资决定机制

title: Policy Endogeneity and Economic Recovery in China, Insights from 2010
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Policy Endogeneity and Economic Recovery in China, Insights from 2010
detail.abstract: The paper is a transcript of a speech delivered by Dong Xian'an, Chief Macro Analyst at Industrial Securities, on September 15, 2010, at Tsinghua University. It discusses China's economic trajectory amid global stagnation, emphasizing month-on-month (MoM) data analysis to identify turning points. The speech underscores the endogenous nature of Chinese policy—meaning policies are not imposed externally but respond dynamically to domestic economic indicators like industrial activity, inflation, and corporate confidence. 1. Economic Recovery in 2010: Signs of Stabilization and Upward Momentum; 2. Inflation and Monetary Conditions: Low Pressure, No Immediate Hikes; 3. Policy Endogeneity: Rational Responses to Economic Signals. Dong's analysis captures the endogenous, adaptive nature of policymaking, which has been a hallmark of post-2008 reforms—responding to data like MoM indicators to avoid hard landings.

AI.tldr: 该演讲分析了2010年中国经济在全球停滞背景下的复苏态势，强调环比数据分析对识别经济转折点的重要性，并阐述了中国政策的内生性特征——政策根据国内经济指标动态调整而非外部强加。
AI.research_question: 在全球经济停滞背景下，中国经济如何通过内生性政策调整实现稳定复苏并避免硬着陆？
AI.motivation: 理解中国经济的独特复苏路径和政策制定机制，为分析中国经济周期转折点提供方法论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生性政策理论、环比数据分析框架、宏观经济周期转折点识别理论
AI.method: 基于环比数据的宏观经济指标分析，包括工业活动、通胀水平和企业信心等关键指标的动态监测
AI.findings: 2010年中国经济呈现稳定复苏态势；通胀压力较低，无需立即加息；政策制定具有内生性特征，能够理性响应经济信号
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于环比数据分析的经济转折点识别方法，深化了对中国内生性政策制定机制的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了识别经济周期转折点的实用分析框架，有助于避免经济硬着陆风险

title: Foot-in-the-Door and Door-in-the-Face: Persuasion with Imperfect Memory
affiliations: The University of Technology Sydney

detail.title: Foot-in-the-Door and Door-in-the-Face: Persuasion with Imperfect Memory
detail.abstract: This paper studies a sequential persuasion game with imperfect memory. A persuader makes a request in period 1 and may revise it in period 2. The decision maker (DM) privately values completion of the request, forgets this valuation by period 2, and infers it from his period 1 decision. In any perfect Bayesian equilibrium, the ex ante probability of a sincere outcome, defined as an immediate truthful request followed by the efficient decision given the DM's valuation, is zero. Within a single model, two opposite persuasion techniques arise endogenously: door-in-the-face (DITF, start high) and foot-in-the-door (FITD, start low). Whenever they appear on the equilibrium path, less demanding types use DITF and more demanding types use FITD. The paper characterizes the induced partition of persuader types and the associated cutoffs and establishes the existence of an equilibrium that exhibits both techniques. The results require neither behavioral preferences nor commitment and are robust to standard refinements and richer memory processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个具有不完美记忆的顺序说服博弈，发现任何完美贝叶斯均衡中真诚结果的先验概率为零，并在单一模型中内生地产生了两种相反的说服技巧：门面技巧（DITF，高开）和得寸进尺技巧（FITD，低开）。
AI.research_question: 在具有不完美记忆的顺序说服博弈中，说服者如何策略性地调整请求，以及决策者如何从自身行为中推断私人估值？
AI.motivation: 研究现实世界中说服策略的动态性，特别是当决策者会忘记自己的私人估值时，说服者如何利用这种信息不对称来优化说服效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于顺序博弈理论和完美贝叶斯均衡框架，结合不完美记忆和信息不对称的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用博弈论建模方法，构建两期顺序说服博弈模型，分析完美贝叶斯均衡条件下的策略行为。
AI.findings: 在任何完美贝叶斯均衡中，真诚结果的先验概率为零；模型中内生地产生两种说服技巧：DITF（高开）和FITD（低开）；较不苛刻的类型使用DITF，较苛刻的类型使用FITD。
AI.theory_contributions: 在单一模型中统一解释了两种看似相反的说服技巧，证明了其内生性出现，且不需要行为偏好或承诺假设，对标准精炼和更丰富的记忆过程具有稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际说服策略提供了理论指导，帮助理解在不同情境下何时采用高开或低开的说服策略，对营销、谈判等领域具有实践意义。

title: Microfoundations of Link Formation in Supply Networks
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School and Emory University - Goizueta Business School

detail.title: Microfoundations of Link Formation in Supply Networks
detail.abstract: Supply networks are endogenous constructs that are shaped by firms' strategic decisions under economic incentives and frictions. Credible empirical research on non-experimental networks, therefore, requires carefully modeling how supply networks form. In this paper, we examine how and why links form in supply networks and their implications for network evolution. We begin by noting the challenges in estimating the drivers of network formation, including data sparsity at the dyad level, dependence across dyads, endogeneity, and the computational burden of vast graph spaces. Traditional approaches to model supply network formation, like edge-independent models (e.g., Erdős–Rényi, random geometric graphs), miss interdependencies such as capacity constraints and signaling. Similarly, while preferential-attachment models introduce dependence, they lack firm agency and exogenous heterogeneity. To overcome these gaps, we develop a dynamic, random-utility framework that (a) microfounds link formation in exogenous (productivity, geography, size) and endogenous (local structure, homophily) factors, (b) allows correlated decisions across dyads, and (c) is estimated on temporal network data from FactSet Revere. We employ progressively sophisticated approaches—a dyad-level probit with correlated random effects estimated on 160 million observations; network instruments for endogeneity; and a structural dynamic model distinguishing formation/dissolution—to address selection, endogeneity, and non-independence. Our results show that both supplier and buyer productivity raise formation probabilities, with buyer productivity being more influential; link initiation is primarily buyer-driven and more likely after buyer-side shocks; familiarity via shared partners increases link formation likelihood with diminishing returns that plateau around five partners; geographic proximity aids formation; and dissimilar firm sizes are more likely to match. Using the model, we perform counterfactual analyses (e.g., boosting supplier productivity in Arizona through state-targeted programs like the semiconductor push, and seeding intra-state links in California motivated by EV supply-chain initiatives), showing how targeted interventions reshape network structure and enhance productivity. To our knowledge, this is the first operations-management study to estimate supply-network formation at scale, offering a tractable framework that addresses selection and endogeneity and yields actionable guidance for supply chain partner search and brokerage.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个动态随机效用框架来建模供应链网络形成，解决了传统模型忽略的相互依赖性和内生性问题，通过大规模实证分析揭示了生产力、地理邻近性、熟悉度等因素对链接形成的影响，并为供应链干预政策提供了可操作的指导。
AI.research_question: 供应链网络中的链接是如何形成的？其形成机制对网络演化有何影响？
AI.motivation: 供应链网络是企业在经济激励和摩擦下战略决策形成的内生结构，传统网络形成模型（如边独立模型、优先连接模型）无法充分捕捉容量约束、信号传递等相互依赖性，且缺乏企业主体性和外生异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机效用框架，将链接形成微观基础建立在外部因素（生产力、地理、规模）和内部因素（局部结构、同质性）上，允许跨节点对的相关决策。
AI.method: 使用FactSet Revere的时间序列网络数据，采用渐进复杂的方法：包含相关随机效应的节点对水平probit模型（1.6亿观测值）、网络工具变量处理内生性、区分形成/解散的结构动态模型。
AI.findings: 供应商和买家生产力都提高形成概率（买家生产力影响更大）；链接发起主要是买家驱动且更可能在买家侧冲击后发生；通过共享伙伴的熟悉度增加链接形成可能性（收益递减，约5个伙伴后趋于平稳）；地理邻近有助于形成；不同规模企业更可能匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在运营管理领域大规模估计供应链网络形成，提供了处理选择性和内生性的可处理框架，为网络形成理论提供了新的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过反事实分析（如亚利桑那州供应商生产力提升计划、加州内部链接培育）展示了针对性干预如何重塑网络结构和提升生产力，为供应链伙伴搜索和经纪提供了可操作的指导。

title: Do Seasonal Work Visas Suppress the Earnings of Incumbent Farm Workers?
affiliations: Australian National University (ANU) - Development Policy Centre and Independent

detail.title: Do Seasonal Work Visas Suppress the Earnings of Incumbent Farm Workers?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was supported by the Pacific Research Program, with funding from the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, received ANU Human Ethics approval under protocol 2022/491 and was conducted in the Australian Bureau of Statistics DataLab under approved project 2022023. Views and errors are our own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received ANU Human Ethics approval under protocol 2022/491
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Pacific Research Program, with funding from the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade.

detail.abstract: This paper uses comprehensive tax and visa records to examine the impact of seasonal work visas on the earnings of incumbent farm workers in the context of Australia's Seasonal Worker Program (SWP). Using a triple-difference approach to exploit differences in earnings growth across different low-skilled occupations within localities, we find no convincing evidence that SWP visas reduced farm worker earnings. Our main null result is robust to alternative specifications and approaches, including regional and national (skill-cell) difference-indifferences , and is consistent with the long term population decline in agricultural regions and a growing inability or unwillingness of the domestic workforce to fill short-term agricultural roles.

AI.tldr: 使用三重差分法分析澳大利亚季节性工人计划对农场工人收入的影响，发现该签证计划并未显著降低农场工人的收入
AI.research_question: 季节性工作签证是否降低了现有农场工人的收入？
AI.motivation: 研究季节性工人计划对本地农场工人收入的影响，以评估该移民政策的经济效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场经济学、移民经济学、三重差分方法
AI.method: 使用综合税收和签证记录数据，采用三重差分法分析不同低技能职业在地区间的收入增长差异
AI.findings: 没有确凿证据表明季节性工人计划签证降低了农场工人的收入
AI.theory_contributions: 为移民政策对本地工人收入影响的理论提供了实证证据，挑战了传统认为移民会降低本地工人工资的观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于季节性工人计划对本地劳动力市场影响的实证依据，支持该计划的继续实施

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-043
title: Support for Renewable Energy: The Case of Wind Power
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, MINES ParisTech and University of Mannheim - Department of Economics

detail.title: Support for Renewable Energy: The Case of Wind Power

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-043
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The rise of societal goals like climate change mitigation and energy security calls for rapid capacity growth in renewable electricity sources, yet citizens' support is put to a test when such technologies emit negative local externalities. We estimate the impact of wind turbine deployment on granular measures of revealed preferences for renewable electricity in product and political markets. We address potentially endogenous siting of turbines with an IV design that exploits quasi-experimental variation in profitability induced by subsidies. We find that wind turbines significantly reduce citizens' support locally, but this effect quickly fades with distance from the site. We assess policy instruments for enhancing citizens' support for renewable energy in light of our results.

AI.tldr: 风力涡轮机部署对当地居民支持可再生能源的意愿产生显著负面影响，但这种影响随距离快速衰减。研究利用补贴政策带来的准实验变异解决选址内生性问题，并评估了提升公民支持度的政策工具。
AI.research_question: 风力涡轮机部署如何影响公民在产品和政治市场上对可再生能源的显示性偏好？
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化和能源安全需要快速增加可再生能源容量，但当地负外部性可能削弱公民支持，需要实证评估这种影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论和显示性偏好理论，分析可再生能源设施的本地负外部性对公民支持行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用工具变量设计，利用补贴政策引起的准实验变异来解决风力涡轮机选址的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 风力涡轮机显著降低了当地公民对可再生能源的支持度，但这种负面影响随距离增加而快速衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可再生能源设施的本地外部性提供了实证证据，拓展了环境经济学中关于设施选址与公众接受度的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何设计补偿机制和选址策略以增强公民对可再生能源支持的实际建议。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-046
title: Hybrid Contracting in Repeated Interactions
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research - Junior Research Group Competition and Innovation, University of Mannheim - Department of Economics and Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business

detail.title: Hybrid Contracting in Repeated Interactions

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-046
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many business relationships begin with informal interactions and later transition to formal contracts. Using a repeated-games model with a finite horizon, we show that this hybrid-contracting approach can both prolong cooperation (intensive margin) and enable it across a broader range of settings (extensive margin). We model the contract as a "smooth-landing contract" that limits actions only near the end of the relationship. We show that this flexible design supports early cooperation and outperforms rigid contracts. Our findings are robust to changes in contracting costs and timing, with optimal contract length balancing profitability and implementability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过有限重复博弈模型证明，从非正式互动过渡到正式合同的混合契约方法能够延长合作时间（集约边际）并扩大合作范围（广延边际）。提出的"平滑着陆合同"仅在关系末期限制行动，这种灵活设计优于刚性合同。
AI.research_question: 混合契约方法（从非正式互动过渡到正式合同）如何影响商业关系的合作持续时间和范围？
AI.motivation: 许多商业关系始于非正式互动而后转为正式合同，但现有研究对这种混合契约方法的优势和机制缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限重复博弈理论，重点分析混合契约的动态效应和合同设计的最优化问题。
AI.method: 构建有限重复博弈模型，分析平滑着陆合同的设计原理和绩效表现，并进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 混合契约方法能延长合作时间并扩大合作范围；平滑着陆合同在关系末期限制行动的灵活设计优于刚性合同；最优合同长度需平衡盈利性和可实施性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了混合契约理论，提出了平滑着陆合同的新概念，丰富了有限重复博弈框架下的契约设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在不同关系阶段设计最优契约结构提供指导，帮助管理者平衡正式与非正式契约的使用时机和程度。

title: Cross-Curve Interest Rate Stress Testing With Endogenous Curve Dynamics
affiliations: , University of California Santa Barbara and Institut Pasteur

detail.title: Cross-Curve Interest Rate Stress Testing With Endogenous Curve Dynamics
detail.abstract: Developing accurate and comprehensive understanding of interest rate risk exposure is crucial for well-developed risk assessment and management practices across regulatory organizations and financial institutions. To further understanding in this area, we study the problem of modeling crosscountry dependencies across multiple sovereign yield curves. A novel dynamic extension of the classical Nelson-Siegel model is proposed alongside a flexible covariance regression framework to construct a multi-yield curve model capable of characterizing cross-curve dependencies over the term structures of multiple yield curves. A key innovation in the proposed approach is the use of novel feature extraction techniques to describe cross-curve dynamics using only covariates reflecting information endogenous to the underlying yield curves of interest. Furthermore, we develop a comprehensive multi-yield curve stress testing framework that enables structurally interpretable stress testing and allows for rigorous statistical classification of different shock structures based on their aggregate crosscurve effects. Efficacy of the framework is demonstrated through empirical application of sovereign yield curves of eight different countries. The methodology successfully captures cross-curve dependencies and shows effective stress testing capabilities in a variety of different shock scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的多国主权收益率曲线建模方法，通过动态扩展Nelson-Siegel模型和灵活的协方差回归框架，能够有效捕捉跨曲线依赖关系，并开发了结构可解释的压力测试框架。
AI.research_question: 如何建模多个主权收益率曲线之间的跨国依赖关系，并开发有效的压力测试框架？
AI.motivation: 准确理解利率风险敞口对监管机构和金融机构的风险评估和管理实践至关重要，需要研究跨国主权收益率曲线的依赖关系建模问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典的Nelson-Siegel模型的动态扩展，结合灵活的协方差回归框架，构建多收益率曲线模型。
AI.method: 提出新颖的特征提取技术，仅使用反映基础收益率曲线内生信息的协变量来描述跨曲线动态；开发全面的多收益率曲线压力测试框架。
AI.findings: 通过对八个不同国家主权收益率曲线的实证应用，该方法成功捕捉了跨曲线依赖关系，并在各种冲击情景下显示出有效的压力测试能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了动态扩展的Nelson-Siegel模型和协方差回归框架，创新性地使用内生信息协变量进行特征提取，为多收益率曲线建模提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了结构可解释的压力测试框架，能够对不同冲击结构进行严格的统计分类，为监管机构和金融机构提供了实用的风险管理工具。

title: Adapting for scale: Experimental Evidence on Technology-aided Instruction in India
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of Oxford

detail.title: Adapting for scale: Experimental Evidence on Technology-aided Instruction in India

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Many interventions that “work” in small-scale trials often fail at scale, highlighting the centrality of effective scaling for realizing the promise of evidence-based policy. We study the scaling of a personalized adaptive learning (PAL) software that was highly effective in a small-scale trial. We adapt the PAL implementation for scalability by integrating it into public school schedules, and experimentally evaluate this adaptation in a more representative sample over 20 times larger than the original study. After 18 months, treated students scored 0.22σ higher in Mathematics and 0.20σ higher in Hindi, a 50–66% productivity increase over the control group. Learning gains were proportional to student time on the platform, providing a simple, low-cost metric for monitoring implementation quality in future scale-ups. The adaptation was cost effective, and its key design features make it widely scalable across diverse settings.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 个性化自适应学习软件在小规模试验中有效，但大规模推广时经常失败。本研究通过将软件整合到公立学校课表中进行适应性调整，并在比原研究大20倍的代表性样本中进行实验评估，发现该调整方案在数学和印地语成绩上分别带来0.22σ和0.20σ的提升，成本效益高且具有广泛可扩展性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效规模化推广在小规模试验中证明有效的个性化自适应学习软件？
AI.motivation: 许多在小规模试验中有效的干预措施在大规模推广时经常失败，这突显了有效规模化对于实现循证政策承诺的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育技术规模化理论和适应性实施框架，关注如何将有效的教育干预措施整合到现有教育系统中。
AI.method: 实验研究方法，将个性化自适应学习软件整合到公立学校课表中进行适应性调整，并在比原研究大20倍的代表性样本中进行评估，跟踪18个月。
AI.findings: 经过18个月，接受干预的学生在数学成绩上提高0.22σ，印地语成绩提高0.20σ，比对照组生产率提高50-66%。学习收益与学生在平台上的使用时间成正比。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了教育技术规模化实施的理论框架，证明了通过适应性调整可以将小规模有效的干预成功推广到大规模环境。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种简单、低成本的实施质量监控指标（学生使用时间），设计特征使其能够在多样化环境中广泛扩展，具有成本效益。

title: A Discrete Choice Analysis of Consumer Decisions: Nicotine Products in an Illicit Market
affiliations: TOBB University of Economics and Technology, University of Houston, TOBB University of Economics and Technology, TOBB University of Economics and Technology, Cornell University and Cornell University - Department of Policy Analysis & Management (PAM)

detail.title: A Discrete Choice Analysis of Consumer Decisions: Nicotine Products in an Illicit Market

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This study investigates consumer stated preferences for manufactured cigarettes, roll-your-own tobacco, and vapes in Türkiye, with a focus on how product attributes shape choices of adult consumers. A discrete choice experiment embedded in an online survey examines the role of prices of these products, flavor availability, and most importantly the legal status of vapes. Results indicate strong price sensitivity, both to own prices and to the prices of substitutes. In addition, legal status emerges as a critical factor that shapes stated preferences: consumers exhibit a marked aversion to products that are banned or sold illegally. However, scenario analyses suggest that vapes would capture a substantial market share even under strict prohibition. The hypothetical scenario of a complete ban would likely have a modest effect on the cessation of nicotine products while shifting choices toward traditional combustible tobacco products. These findings highlight the limits of prohibition and underscore the importance of regulatory design. In particular, the treatment of legal status, together with pricing and taxation policies, plays a decisive role in shaping consumer behavior and public health outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过离散选择实验调查土耳其消费者对香烟、自制烟和电子烟的偏好，发现价格敏感性和法律状态是影响选择的关键因素。即使严格禁止，电子烟仍会占据可观市场份额，而全面禁令可能促使消费者转向传统烟草产品。
AI.research_question: 土耳其消费者对制造香烟、自制烟草和电子烟的偏好如何，以及产品属性（特别是价格、口味可用性和法律状态）如何影响成年消费者的选择？
AI.motivation: 了解不同烟草产品的消费者偏好，特别是法律状态对选择行为的影响，为烟草监管政策设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择理论和消费者行为理论，分析产品属性对消费者偏好的影响。
AI.method: 在线调查中嵌入离散选择实验，考察价格、口味可用性和法律状态等产品属性对消费者选择的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 消费者对价格高度敏感（包括自身价格和替代品价格）；2. 法律状态是关键因素，消费者明显回避被禁止或非法销售的产品；3. 即使在严格禁止情况下，电子烟仍能获得可观市场份额；4. 全面禁令对尼古丁产品戒断效果有限，但会促使消费者转向传统可燃烟草产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了离散选择理论在烟草产品监管中的应用，揭示了法律状态作为产品属性的重要性，深化了对禁止政策效果边界的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：监管设计（特别是法律状态处理）与定价税收政策共同决定消费者行为和公共健康结果，禁止政策效果有限，需要更精细的监管策略。

reference: 6 European Review of Digital Administration and Law (ERDAL) 163 (2025)
title: Normalizing Facial Recognition Technology and The End of Obscurity
affiliations: Boston University School of Law, Rochester Institute of Technology - Department of Philosophy and Duke University

detail.title: Normalizing Facial Recognition Technology and The End of Obscurity

publicationDetails.detailsText: 6 European Review of Digital Administration and Law (ERDAL) 163 (2025)

detail.abstract: This article argues that facial recognition technology is the most dangerous surveillance tool ever invented. Given the unique threats this morally suspect tool poses to privacy, civil liberties, human flourishing, and democracy, the only appropriate response is a ban. To justify our position, we explain why facial recognition is distinctive among biometrics, clarify how even seemingly benign and positive uses of the technology can trigger dangerous normalization dynamics, and pinpoint why current United States laws (with reverberations in the EU's AI Act) are designed to accelerate a slippery slope that makes mass surveillance nearly inevitable. Our most fundamental contribution lies in demonstrating how the concept of "obscurity" connects all three arguments: facial recognition algorithms technologically eviscerate obscurity, normalization psychologically undermines it, and the law doctrinally abandons it-a perfect storm that only prohibition can stop.

AI.tldr: 本文认为人脸识别技术是最危险的监控工具，主张全面禁止使用，因为它对隐私、公民自由、人类福祉和民主构成独特威胁，且现有法律无法有效规制。
AI.research_question: 人脸识别技术为何应该被全面禁止？
AI.motivation: 人脸识别技术作为最具侵入性的生物识别技术，对个人隐私和公民自由构成严重威胁，现有法律框架无法有效应对其带来的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"模糊性"（obscurity）概念的理论框架，分析人脸识别技术如何从技术、心理和法律三个层面破坏隐私保护。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念论证，通过解释人脸识别技术的独特性、正常化动态的危险性以及法律缺陷来支持禁止立场。
AI.findings: 人脸识别算法技术性地消除模糊性，正常化过程心理上削弱模糊性，法律学说上放弃模糊性保护，形成只能通过禁止来阻止的完美风暴。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"模糊性"作为连接技术、心理和法律三个层面的核心概念，为人脸识别技术的伦理和法律分析提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了禁止人脸识别技术的理论依据，警示现有法律框架的不足，推动更严格的监管措施。

title: Robust AI Personalization Will Require a Human Context Protocol
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - MIT Media Laboratory, Persona Labs, Oxford Internet Institute, Google DeepMind, Plural Technology Collaboratory, Microsoft Research Special Projects and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Robust AI Personalization Will Require a Human Context Protocol
detail.abstract: Robust AI personalization will require a Human Context Protocol (HCP): a user-owned, secure, and interoperable preference layer that grants individuals granular, revocable control over how their data steers AI systems. By replacing siloed, behavior-inferred signals with direct preference articulation, HCP unifies fragmented data, lowers switching costs, and enables seamless portability across AI services, fostering a more competitive ecosystem. This paper outlines core design principles-natural-language preference storage, scoped sharing, and strong authentication with revocation-that extend earlier personal-data architectures to the scale and stakes of modern generative AI. Centering control in users, HCP is not merely a technical convenience but a necessary foundation for AI systems that are genuinely personal, interoperable, and aligned with diverse human values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人类情境协议（HCP）作为AI个性化的重要基础，通过用户拥有、安全、可互操作的偏好层，让个人能够精细控制其数据如何引导AI系统。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个用户拥有、安全、可互操作的偏好协议，使个人能够对AI系统的个性化行为进行精细控制和撤销？
AI.motivation: 当前AI个性化依赖于孤立的行为推断信号，导致数据碎片化、切换成本高，缺乏用户对AI系统如何利用其数据的控制权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于个人数据架构理论，扩展到现代生成式AI的规模和重要性，强调用户中心控制原则。
AI.method: 提出核心设计原则：自然语言偏好存储、范围限定共享、强认证与撤销机制，构建统一的偏好层架构。
AI.findings: HCP能够替代孤立的行为推断信号，统一碎片化数据，降低切换成本，实现跨AI服务的无缝可移植性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将个人数据控制理论扩展到生成式AI时代，提出了用户拥有偏好层的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建真正个性化、可互操作且符合多样化人类价值观的AI系统提供了必要技术基础，促进更具竞争力的AI生态系统。

title: Deep Multi-Objective Multi-Stakeholder Recommendations in the Media Industry
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Coller School of Management, Georgia Institute of Technology - IT Management Area, Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University, Spotify and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Deep Multi-Objective Multi-Stakeholder Recommendations in the Media Industry
detail.abstract: In this paper, we argue that it is more beneficial to consider the objectives of multiple stakeholders (i.e., users and artists) simultaneously when producing media recommendations, which leads to significant improvements not only in the overall recommendation performance, but also in the welfare of both users and artists. To achieve this goal, we propose a novel multiobjective multi-stakeholder recommendation framework, where we capture the unique properties of two-sided media markets and incorporate them into our model. Specifically, we utilize state-of-the-art deep learning techniques to build multiple “tower” neural networks, where each tower learns one particular stakeholder objective based on the media interaction records. These towers are then connected through a “knowledge bridge” architecture, which bidirectionally shares latent information across the towers to capture heterogeneous relationships between different stakeholders. To identify the optimal location of the bridge, we present a Shapley-value-based approach that maximizes the effectiveness of the information-sharing process. Finally, media recommendations are produced by aggregating the predicted objective values through a neural network-based approach to select the optimal objective weights. We empirically demonstrate the benefits of our proposed framework through extensive offline evaluations on four industrial-scale media streaming datasets. Our proposed model achieves significant performance improvements across all objectives for both stakeholders (users and artists) across all four datasets compared to the state-of-the-art media recommendation models, multi-objective models, and multi-stakeholder models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的多目标多利益相关者推荐框架，通过深度学习技术和知识桥架构同时考虑用户和艺术家的目标，在四个工业级媒体流数据集上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在媒体推荐中同时考虑用户和艺术家等多个利益相关者的目标，以提升整体推荐性能和各方福利？
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统通常只关注单一利益相关者（如用户）的目标，忽视了媒体市场的双边性质，无法同时优化用户和艺术家的利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多目标优化理论和多利益相关者理论，结合深度学习和博弈论中的Shapley值概念。
AI.method: 使用多个塔式神经网络分别学习不同利益相关者的目标，通过知识桥架构双向共享潜在信息，采用Shapley值方法确定最佳桥接位置，通过神经网络聚合预测目标值选择最优权重。
AI.findings: 在四个工业级媒体流数据集上的实验表明，所提框架在所有目标和所有数据集上均显著优于现有最先进的媒体推荐模型、多目标模型和多利益相关者模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个同时考虑多目标和多利益相关者的推荐框架，发展了知识桥架构和Shapley值桥接定位方法，丰富了推荐系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体平台提供了同时优化用户满意度和艺术家收益的实用解决方案，提升了整体推荐系统性能和各方福利。

title: Architecture of Assurance: The EU Wallet and the Future of Banking
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Indore

detail.title: Architecture of Assurance: The EU Wallet and the Future of Banking
detail.abstract: This essay traces the historical and architectural journey of digital identity systems in the Nordic and Baltic banking landscape, culminating in the European Union’s forthcoming Digital Identity Wallet. Drawing on Cold War resilience strategies, banking scandals, and pioneering digital governance experiments such as Estonia’s X-Road, the narrative illustrates how regional experiences shaped current enterprise architecture practices. It highlights the failures of oversight in the Danske Bank and Swedbank cases, showing how weak identity governance undermined trust despite advanced infrastructures. The essay argues that the European Digital Identity Wallet is not merely a convenience tool but an architectural safeguard aligned with frameworks like TOGAF, embedding modularity, transparency, and resilience into banking systems. By blending design theory, psychology, and lived history, the essay presents digital wallets as both technological innovation and cultural archive, marking a decisive step in making trust portable across Europe.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了北欧和波罗的海地区数字身份系统的历史和架构发展历程，分析了从冷战韧性策略、银行丑闻到爱沙尼亚X-Road等数字治理实验如何塑造当前的企业架构实践，并论证欧盟数字身份钱包作为架构保障工具的重要性。
AI.research_question: 北欧和波罗的海地区的数字身份系统发展历程如何影响了欧盟数字身份钱包的设计？这些历史经验对当前银行系统的信任架构有何启示？
AI.motivation: 探讨数字身份系统在银行领域的演进过程，理解历史经验（包括银行丑闻和成功案例）对现代数字身份架构设计的影响，为欧盟数字身份钱包的实施提供理论支持和实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合设计理论、心理学和架构理论（如TOGAF框架），构建数字身份系统的多学科分析框架，强调模块化、透明度和韧性在信任构建中的重要性。
AI.method: 采用历史追溯和案例分析方法，研究北欧和波罗的海地区的数字身份系统发展历程，包括Danske Bank、Swedbank丑闻案例和爱沙尼亚X-Road成功经验。
AI.findings: 1）弱身份治理会破坏信任，即使基础设施先进；2）地区经验塑造了当前企业架构实践；3）欧盟数字身份钱包是架构保障工具而不仅仅是便利工具；4）数字钱包兼具技术创新和文化档案双重功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字身份系统作为文化档案的理论视角，建立了历史经验与架构设计之间的理论联系，丰富了数字信任构建的多学科理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟数字身份钱包的实施提供了历史经验借鉴，强调了模块化、透明度和韧性的重要性，为银行系统数字身份治理提供了实践指导。

title:
Sustainable development and gender equality, from feminist and socioeconomic perspectives - Ecuador.
Desarrollo sostenible y la igualdad de género, desde las corrientes feministas y las perspectivas socioeconómicas-Ecuador.
affiliations: Universidad Tecnológica Empresarial de Guayaquil

detail.title:
Sustainable development and gender equality, from feminist and socioeconomic perspectives - Ecuador.
Desarrollo sostenible y la igualdad de género, desde las corrientes feministas y las perspectivas socioeconómicas-Ecuador.
detail.abstract:
Abstract: This article explores current debates on the intersection of development and gender, with a particular focus on the global context and the context of Ecuador, focusing on feminist movements and social and economic perspectives. Its objective is to analyze how feminist movements have influenced the perception and implementation of public policies that seek to promote gender equity. The research was conducted through a theoretical bibliographic analysis, utilizing development theories, the evolution of the gender approach, and development models in the region, seeking to understand how public policies can promote gender equity and social justice. The article examines the contributions of feminist economics, the challenges of implementing gender policies, emerging perspectives, gender inequalities, and public policies implemented to promote gender equity. It addresses the impact of feminist theories on the understanding and transformation of social and economic structures in the region. She concludes by emphasizing that, although significant progress has been made, the structural transformation of gender inequalities requires an intersectional approach and the active participation of all sectors of society.

Abstract Español: Este artículo explora los debates actuales sobre la intersección entre el desarrollo y el género, con un enfoque particular en el contexto Mundial y particular del Ecuador, particularizando en las corrientes feministas y las perspectivas sociales y económicas. Tiene como objetivo analizar cómo las corrientes feministas han influido en la percepción y en la implementación de políticas públicas que buscan promover la equidad de género. La investigación se realizó a través de un análisis teórico bibliográfico, utilizando las teorías del desarrollo, la evolución del enfoque de género y los modelos de desarrollo en la región, buscando comprender cómo las políticas públicas pueden promover la equidad de género y la justicia social. Se examinaron las contribuciones de la economía feminista, los desafíos de la implementación de políticas de género, las perspectivas emergentes, las desigualdades de género y las políticas públicas implementadas para promover la equidad de género. Aborda el impacto de las teorías feministas en la comprensión y transformación de las estructuras sociales y económicas en la región. Concluye enfatizando que, aunque se han logrado avances significativos, la transformación estructural de las desigualdades de género requiere un enfoque interseccional y la participación activa de todos los sectores de la sociedad.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献分析探讨发展理论与性别研究的交叉，聚焦厄瓜多尔案例，分析女权主义运动如何影响促进性别平等的公共政策的制定与实施。
AI.research_question: 女权主义运动如何影响促进性别平等的公共政策的认知与实施？
AI.motivation: 探讨发展与性别议题的交叉点，特别是在全球和厄瓜多尔背景下，分析女权主义思潮对社会经济政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展理论、性别研究方法演进、区域发展模式、女权主义经济学
AI.method: 理论文献分析法
AI.findings: 虽然取得了显著进展，但性别不平等的结构性转变需要交叉性方法和全社会各阶层的积极参与
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对女权主义理论在理解和转变社会经济结构方面影响的认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定促进性别平等和社会公正的公共政策提供了理论依据和实践指导
