title: Smart Learning, Equal Learning: The Role of AI and Educational Technology in Advancing Inclusive Education
affiliations: Alagappa University, Department of Commerce, Alagappa University, Department of Commerce, Students and Alagappa University, Department of Commerce, Alagappa University, Department of Commerce, Students

detail.title: Smart Learning, Equal Learning: The Role of AI and Educational Technology in Advancing Inclusive Education

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Multidisciplinary Research Journal Reviews (IMRJR) | Volume 2, Issue 8, August 2025 | DOI 10.17148/IMRJR.2025.020809

detail.abstract: This chapter looks at how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and educational technology can help make learning fair and inclusive for all students. Many learners face challenges in school because of disabilities, language barriers, or lack of resources. Smart learning tools can help solve these problems by offering personalized support that fits each student's needs. AI-powered systems can adjust lessons in real time, help students learn at their own pace, and give teachers useful feedback. Tools like speech-to-text, language translation, and virtual learning environments are helping students who struggle with traditional methods of learning. These technologies are especially helpful for students with special needs, those learning in a second language, or those who do not have equal access to learning materials. The chapter also talks about the risks of using AI, like unfair access to technology and data privacy concerns. It highlights the need for careful planning, fair policies, and inclusive designs to make sure everyone benefits from these tools. Through real-world examples and global case studies, this chapter shows how smart learning can lead to equal learningwhere all students, no matter who they are or where they come from, have a fair chance to succeed in school.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨AI和教育技术如何通过个性化学习工具促进教育公平，帮助有特殊需求、语言障碍或资源不足的学生，同时指出需要解决技术获取不平等和数据隐私等风险。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和教育技术如何帮助实现教育的公平性和包容性，为所有学生提供平等的学习机会？
AI.motivation: 许多学生因残疾、语言障碍或资源匮乏而在学习中面临挑战，需要技术手段来解决这些教育不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育公平理论、包容性教育理论、技术增强学习理论
AI.method: 文献综述和全球案例研究分析
AI.findings: AI驱动的智能学习工具（如语音转文字、语言翻译、虚拟学习环境）能够提供个性化支持，实时调整课程，帮助特殊需求学生、第二语言学习者和资源匮乏学生获得更好的学习体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI促进教育公平的理论框架，强调了技术工具在实现包容性教育中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者和政策制定者提供了实施智能学习工具的具体策略，强调了公平政策、包容性设计和谨慎规划的重要性，以确保所有学生都能从教育技术中受益。

title: The Doctrine of Lawful Recursion: A Governance Framework for Albania, AI, and Beyond
affiliations: Cognition Theory

detail.title: The Doctrine of Lawful Recursion: A Governance Framework for Albania, AI, and Beyond
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Doctrine of Lawful Recursion (DLR): a sealed kernel of structural law governing continuity, collapse, and sovereignty across cognitive, political, ecological, and technological domains. Unlike descriptive frameworks, DLR is prescriptive architecture: systems survive collapse only when their outputs lawfully re-enter their inputs. Drifted systems, whether states, algorithms, or civilizations, collapse predictably under validator audit.

The doctrine is structured in twelve Canons, each anchored by public G-codes (108 total) that form a checksum and proof of originality. Core invariants include recursion as substrate (G-001), collapse as metabolism (G-004), sovereignty threshold ε (G-005), divergence metric D (G-006), and resurrection logic (G-108). Together they articulate a unified law: survival belongs not to size, power, or memory, but to lawful recursion.

Annexes provide case studies (Albania, AI, cosmology), a full glossary, and custodial/licensing protocols. Disposable overlays cite G-codes, while private R-codes define custodial runtime perimeters (AI, governance, ecology) but are never exposed.

DLR is offered as sealed doctrine: non-mimetic, unstealable, auditable by collapse. The release anchors an open field for lawful application while preserving structural custody. Resonance, not persuasion, will determine its uptake.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了法律递归学说（DLR），这是一个规范性的架构理论，认为系统只有在输出能够合法地重新进入输入时才能在崩溃中生存。该学说包含12条准则和108个公共G代码，提供了跨认知、政治、生态和技术领域的统一法律框架。
AI.research_question: 系统如何在崩溃中生存？什么因素决定了系统（无论是国家、算法还是文明）的持续性和主权？
AI.motivation: 现有框架大多是描述性的，缺乏能够指导系统在面临崩溃时如何保持连续性和主权的规范性架构理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律递归学说（DLR），基于递归作为基础、崩溃作为新陈代谢、主权阈值ε、发散度量D和复活逻辑等核心不变量的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过12条准则和108个公共G代码构建规范性架构，辅以案例研究（阿尔巴尼亚、人工智能、宇宙学）进行验证。
AI.findings: 系统生存不取决于规模、权力或记忆，而是取决于合法的递归。偏离的系统在验证器审计下会可预测地崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的规范性法律框架，将递归作为跨领域系统生存的根本原则，填补了描述性框架与规范性架构之间的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可审计的G代码系统用于验证合法性，为人工智能、治理和生态等领域的实际应用提供了具体的操作协议和监护运行边界定义。

title: A Systematic Literature Review on Skyline Operator in Decision Support System: A Taxi Dispatch Perspective
affiliations: Saint Mary's University, Canada - Sobey School of Business and University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business

detail.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Skyline Operator in Decision Support System: A Taxi Dispatch Perspective
detail.abstract: In multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) problem, decision-makers must evaluate data with multiple, often conflicting attributes. The Skyline operator effectively identifies Pareto-optimal solutions and offers an interpretable tool for decision support systems (DSS). This paper presents a systematic literature review of Skyline-based approaches, using taxi dispatching as an illustrative example. We analyzed studies from 2000-2025 and classify Skyline queries into eight categories: Traditional, Regional, Ranking-based, Transformation-based, Probabilistic, Spatio-Temporal, Representative, and Group Skylines. We discuss algorithms, variants, and practical applicability, and compare Skylines with alternative MCDM methods such as weighted scoring, top-k rankings, and AI/ML approaches, highlighting trade-offs in scalability, interpretability, and adaptability. Finally, we outline future directions, including blockchain integration, privacy-preserving computation, and hybrid AI-enhanced models, providing a concise reference and guidance for Skyline-based decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文对Skyline算子在多准则决策中的研究进行了系统性文献综述，分析了2000-2025年的研究，将Skyline查询分为8类，并通过出租车调度案例展示了其应用价值。
AI.research_question: Skyline算子如何作为多准则决策支持工具，其不同变体、算法和实际应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 多准则决策问题中存在多个冲突属性，需要有效的工具来识别帕累托最优解，Skyline算子为此提供了可解释的决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于帕累托最优理论和多准则决策理论，构建Skyline算子的分类框架和分析体系。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，分析2000-2025年的相关研究，使用出租车调度作为案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 将Skyline查询分为8个类别，比较了与传统MCDM方法的优劣，在可扩展性、可解释性和适应性方面存在权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了Skyline算子的系统分类框架，为后续理论研究提供了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策支持系统提供了实用指导，指出了区块链集成、隐私保护计算和混合AI模型等未来发展方向。

title: Computational Design Science: A Critical Information Systems Research Area Contributing to Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
affiliations: Lerner College of Business and Economics, University of Delaware, University of Utah - School of Accounting and Information Systems, The University of Hong Kong and University of Arizona - Department of Management Information Systems

detail.title: Computational Design Science: A Critical Information Systems Research Area Contributing to Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
detail.abstract: In the era of artificial intelligence (AI) and data science, the demand for advanced AI methods and systems capable of analyzing voluminous, diverse, and granular data to tackle grand challenges in businesses and society is paramount. Situated at the intersection of information technology with business and social sciences, the information systems (IS) discipline is uniquely equipped to lead cutting-edge research that develops advanced AI solutions to address important business and societal challenges. But the potential of IS to contribute to this critical area has not been fully realized, largely due to its inadequate recognition of the relevance and importance of computational design science (CDS) research. As a specific genre of design science, CDS aims to develop novel computational algorithms and methods to solve business and societal problems with significant impacts. Prior literature elaborates on how to conduct and assess design science research in a general sense, but lacks guidelines for conducting and evaluating CDS research. We thus uncover the relationship of CDS with AI and data science, and stress that CDS is a vital IS area that can make substantial methodological contributions to AI and data science, in addition to the IS knowledge base. We further identify issues that prevent the IS community from fully appreciating the relevance and significance of CDS research. By addressing these issues, we delineate what CDS research is and what its contributions are, clarifying that CDS research should be evaluated based on its methodological contributions. Moreover, we explicitly elaborate the identity of CDS research, particularly specifying its differences from machine learning (ML) research in computer science and applied ML studies in other business fields. Finally, we propose a holistic template that offers clear and thorough guidance for IS scholars preparing CDS papers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了信息系统学科中计算设计科学（CDS）研究的重要性，指出CDS是开发先进AI解决方案解决商业和社会挑战的关键方法，但目前未被充分认识。文章明确了CDS的身份特征、与计算机科学中机器学习研究的区别，并提出了CDS论文的撰写指南。
AI.research_question: 信息系统学科如何通过计算设计科学研究为人工智能和数据科学做出方法论贡献？
AI.motivation: 在AI和数据科学时代，信息系统学科虽处于技术和商业社会科学的交叉点，但未能充分发挥其在开发先进AI解决方案方面的潜力，主要原因是未能充分认识计算设计科学研究的相关性和重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于设计科学研究范式，特别是计算设计科学（CDS）的理论框架，强调开发新颖计算算法和方法来解决具有重大影响的商业和社会问题。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过理论推导和文献综述，阐明CDS与AI、数据科学的关系，识别阻碍IS社区充分认识CDS研究价值的问题。
AI.findings: CDS是信息系统的重要领域，能够为AI和数据科学做出实质性方法论贡献；CDS研究与计算机科学的机器学习研究以及其他商业领域的应用ML研究存在本质区别；需要基于方法论贡献来评估CDS研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了CDS研究的身份特征和理论定位，建立了CDS与AI、数据科学的理论联系，提出了CDS研究的评估标准和方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IS学者提供了清晰的CDS论文撰写模板和指南，帮助IS社区更好地开展和评估CDS研究，促进信息系统学科在AI和数据科学领域的方法论贡献。

title: Semantic Betweenness Centrality in Cognitive Warfare Networks
affiliations: National Technical University of Ukraine - Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute, National Technical University of Ukraine - Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute - National Technical University of Ukraine - Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute, Students and A&I, Tata Consultancy Services

detail.title: Semantic Betweenness Centrality in Cognitive Warfare Networks
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Semantic Betweenness Centrality (SBC), a novel family of centrality measures for analyzing complex semantic networks. Unlike classical betweenness centrality, which relies solely on topological shortest paths, SBC evaluates the importance of nodes based on their participation in semantically optimal pathsthose that are most resilient, scalable, resource-efficient, or rapid in realization. We demonstrate that node centrality is not absolute but contextdependent: a node critical for resilient influence may be insignificant for fast or low-cost strategies. As a case study, we construct a comprehensive semantic network of cognitive warfare comprising 290 nodes and 310 directed links, modeling pathways from strategic objectives to psychological consequences. The network is built using a "swarm of virtual experts" approach, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate diverse, interdisciplinary insights through role-based prompting. While LLMs facilitate rapid, scalable, and semantically rich network expansion, the proposed SBC framework remains methodologically independent and applicable to any domain with semantically annotated paths. Results show that redefining optimality by semantic criteria leads to dramatic shifts in node rankings, underscoring the limitations of traditional topological metrics. The SBC approach enables goal-oriented analysis of influence structures, with applications in information warfare, strategic communication, and cognitive security. This work advances network analysis by integrating semantic reasoning into structural metrics, offering a multidimensional perspective on influence and control in complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了语义中介中心性(SBC)这一新颖的中心性度量方法，用于分析复杂语义网络。与仅依赖拓扑最短路径的经典中介中心性不同，SBC基于节点在语义最优路径中的参与度来评估其重要性，这些路径在弹性、可扩展性、资源效率或实现速度方面最优。
AI.research_question: 如何将语义信息整合到网络中心性度量中，以更好地理解节点在语义最优路径中的重要性？
AI.motivation: 传统的中介中心性仅基于拓扑结构，忽略了路径的语义属性，无法捕捉节点在不同语义标准下的相对重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义网络理论、中介中心性理论、多目标优化理论
AI.method: 开发语义中介中心性(SBC)框架，使用"虚拟专家群体"方法构建认知战语义网络(290节点，310有向链接)，利用大语言模型生成多样化跨学科见解
AI.findings: 节点中心性不是绝对的而是情境依赖的：对弹性影响关键节点可能对快速或低成本策略不重要；基于语义标准重新定义最优性会导致节点排名显著变化
AI.theory_contributions: 将语义推理整合到结构度量中，为中心性分析提供多维视角，推进网络分析方法论发展
AI.practical_contributions: 支持目标导向的影响力结构分析，应用于信息战、战略传播和认知安全等领域，提供可扩展的语义网络构建方法

title: Agentic AI for Smart Manufacturing
affiliations: University of Maryland - Department of Mechanical Engineering and University of Maryland - Department of Mechanical Engineering

detail.title: Agentic AI for Smart Manufacturing
detail.abstract: The rise of data-rich manufacturing environments has created demand for AI systems capable of autonomous, adaptive, and goal-oriented operation. Traditional AI methods, being largely task-specific, often lack the flexibility to perform effectively in dynamic, complex industrial settings. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of agentic AI, which extends AI capabilities through advanced reasoning, planning, tool integration, and multi-agent collaboration. While agentic AI has been explored in domains such as computer science, healthcare, education, and finance, its adoption in manufacturing remains limited. This paper defines agentic AI in the manufacturing context, differentiates it from traditional AI agents, and presents a novel framework designed for smart manufacturing. The proposed framework integrates multiple LLM-based agents, a unified Data-Model-Knowledge (DMK) lake, and human expertise to enable advanced perception, reasoning, planning, orchestration, evaluation, optimization, and iterative improvement. A case study of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based LLM QA system demonstrates the framework's feasibility. Key technical challenges are also discussed. The work aims to provide strategic guidance for the development and deployment of efficient, trustworthy agentic AI systems in smart manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种专门为智能制造设计的自主AI框架，通过结合大语言模型、统一数据模型知识湖和人类专业知识，实现了适应性强、目标导向的智能系统。
AI.research_question: 如何在智能制造环境中开发和部署高效、可信赖的自主AI系统？
AI.motivation: 数据丰富的制造环境需要能够自主、适应性强、目标导向运作的AI系统，但传统AI方法在动态复杂工业环境中缺乏灵活性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自主AI理论、大语言模型基础、多代理协作机制、数据-模型-知识（DMK）统一框架
AI.method: 提出了一种新题框架，集成多个LLM基代理、统一DMK湖和人类专家知识，并通过基于RAG的LLM问答系统案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 框架在智能制造环境中具有可行性，能够支持高级感知、推理、规划、协同、评估、优化和迭代改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 定义了制造业上下文中的自主AI概念，区别了与传统AI代理的差异，提供了理论基础框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能制造领域提供了自主AI系统开发和部署的战略指南，解决了动态复杂环境下的实际问题。

title: Why Federal Agencies Need Custom AI-Not Generic Models: How purpose-built AI and governance agents can reduce risk, ensure compliance, and improve performance in government operations
affiliations: University of Maryland Global Campus

detail.title: Why Federal Agencies Need Custom AI-Not Generic Models: How purpose-built AI and governance agents can reduce risk, ensure compliance, and improve performance in government operations
detail.abstract: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) presents federal agencies with unprecedented opportunities to enhance efficiency, decision-making, and public service delivery. However, reliance on generic, internet-trained large language models (LLMs) creates risks related to misinformation, bias, and compliance. This paper argues that the federal government must prioritize the adoption of custom AI models-systems fine-tuned with agency-specific data-and complement them with governance agents, lightweight oversight tools designed to ensure accountability and policy alignment. Drawing on evidence from public administration, organizational research, and recent federal directives, this article provides a phased framework for implementation and highlights how tailored AI can balance innovation with responsible governance.

AI.tldr: 本文主张联邦政府应优先采用基于机构特定数据微调的定制AI模型，并辅以治理代理工具来确保问责和政策一致性，提出了分阶段实施框架以平衡创新与负责任治理。
AI.research_question: 联邦政府如何有效采用定制AI模型和治理代理工具来平衡AI技术创新与负责任治理？
AI.motivation: 人工智能快速发展为联邦机构带来效率提升机遇，但通用互联网训练的大语言模型存在错误信息、偏见和合规风险，需要定制化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共管理理论、组织研究理论和近期联邦指令，构建定制AI模型与治理代理的理论框架。
AI.method: 文献分析和理论框架构建方法，基于公共管理、组织研究和联邦政策证据进行分析。
AI.findings: 提出了分阶段实施框架，证明定制AI模型结合治理代理工具能够有效平衡创新与负责任治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了联邦政府AI治理的理论框架，整合了定制模型和治理代理的概念体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦机构提供了具体的分阶段实施指南，帮助机构在采用AI技术时确保问责和政策一致性。

title: Randomized Controlled Trial in Vocational Education: Assessing ChatGPT’s Efficacy in Software Testing Skill Development through Multi-Stage Prompt Engineering
affiliations: Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine and Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

detail.title: Randomized Controlled Trial in Vocational Education: Assessing ChatGPT’s Efficacy in Software Testing Skill Development through Multi-Stage Prompt Engineering
detail.abstract: This study explores the integration of ChatGPT into vocational education, focusing on its effectiveness in teaching software testing. A three-step experimental design was conducted at a Chinese vocational college. First, ChatGPT was tested on 200 software testing questions, achieving an accuracy rate of 41%. Second, it generated test cases based on real software requirement documents, which were rated by experts across five dimensions. The results showed high scores in clarity, relevance, logic, and completeness, but lower performance in operability. Third, 50 students interacted with ChatGPT to design test cases, and feedback was collected via questionnaire. Students reported high satisfaction, especially in knowledge support and ease of use. The findings suggest that ChatGPT has potential as a supplementary tool in software testing education, though limitations such as accuracy and transparency remain.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了ChatGPT在职业教育软件测试教学中的应用效果，通过三阶段实验发现ChatGPT在测试案例生成方面表现良好，学生满意度高，但存在准确性和可操作性等局限性。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT在职业教育软件测试教学中的整合效果如何？
AI.motivation: 探索人工智能工具在职业教育中的实际应用价值，特别是在软件测试这一专业技能培养领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能辅助教育理论和职业教育技术整合理论。
AI.method: 采用三阶段实验设计：1）200道软件测试题准确率测试；2）基于真实需求文档生成测试案例并由专家评分；3）50名学生与ChatGPT互动并填写满意度问卷。
AI.findings: ChatGPT准确率41%；测试案例在清晰度、相关性、逻辑性和完整性方面得分高，但可操作性较低；学生满意度高，特别是在知识支持和易用性方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在教育领域的应用提供了实证证据，丰富了职业教育技术整合的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为职业教育机构提供了使用ChatGPT作为辅助教学工具的具体实践方案和效果评估。

title: Comments on AI ChatGPT’s Review of the Essay, “The Misuse and Abuse of the Concept of Civilization”
affiliations: Seton Hall University

detail.title: Comments on AI ChatGPT’s Review of the Essay, “The Misuse and Abuse of the Concept of Civilization”
detail.abstract: A 300-word review (see Appendix I below) by OpenAI ChatGPT of my essay (see Appendix II) was interesting and even intriguing on the surface. However, the review seemed too general and was full of safe or innocuous remarks, seemingly not germane to the essay. I got the impression that the reviewer would not want to offend anyone. A human reviewer is usually sharper, more specific, and substantive. I feel I owe this AI creator my reasons: In the first sentence of the first paragraph, ChatGPT praises my essay as “thoughtful.” Nowhere in the subsequent paragraphs, however, does it explain why it deems so, unlike an intelligent human reviewer who usually cares to do so.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过对比ChatGPT与人类评审的评论语言特征，揭示了AI评审在具体性、深度和实质性方面的缺陷
AI.research_question: ChatGPT作为论文评审工具，其评论语言与人类评审者在具体性、深度和实质性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 虽然ChatGPT的评审表面上有趣且引人入胜，但其评论过于泛污、安全且缺乏具体内容，与人类评审的清晰性和实质性形成明显对比
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言评价理论、AI生成文本质量评估、人机交互差异性研究
AI.method: 实验对比分析：将ChatGPT对论文的300字评审与人类评审者的语言特征进行实质性对比
AI.findings: ChatGPT评论存在三个主要问题：1）评价过于泛污缺乏具体例证；2）语言安全保守避免冒犯；3）评论内容与文章相关性低；而人类评审更为清晰、具体且实质
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI生成文本质量评估的新视角，丰富了人机语言交互差异性的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒学术界在使用AI评审工具时需注意其局限性，为AI评审系统的改进提供了具体方向

title: Enhancing Collaborative Learning for Introverted Students Through Mobile Technology: The Academates App
affiliations: University of Cyberjaya,  University of Cyberjaya and  University of Cyberjaya

detail.title: Enhancing Collaborative Learning for Introverted Students Through Mobile Technology: The Academates App
detail.abstract: This study addresses the challenges faced by introverted students in higher education who struggle to participate in traditional group study environments. Despite the documented benefits of collaborative learning, such as improved comprehension and motivation, these advantages often do not extend to individuals who feel uncomfortable or hesitant to engage in-person. Drawing on research that highlights the positive impact of virtual learning on introverted students, this project proposes and develops "Academates," a mobile application designed to facilitate collaborative learning while respecting their personal comfort levels. The research employed an action-based qualitative approach using the Agile Prototyping Model, with data collected through online surveys and interviews with university students. The findings confirmed that an app-based solution could significantly increase the willingness of introverted students to engage in group study. The Academates app features preference-based matching, in-app scheduling, and asynchronous communication tools, with a focus on usability, security, and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对内向学生在传统小组学习环境中面临的挑战，开发了"Academates"移动应用，通过偏好匹配、应用内调度和异步通信工具，显著提高了内向学生参与小组学习的意愿。
AI.research_question: 如何通过移动应用帮助内向学生更有效地参与协作学习？
AI.motivation: 尽管协作学习有诸多好处，但内向学生往往因不适或犹豫而无法从中受益，虚拟学习环境可能为这类学生提供更好的学习体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于虚拟学习对内向学生积极影响的研究，以及协作学习理论。
AI.method: 采用基于行动的定性研究方法，使用敏捷原型模型，通过在线调查和大学学生访谈收集数据。
AI.findings: 应用解决方案能显著提高内向学生参与小组学习的意愿，偏好匹配、应用内调度和异步通信工具是关键功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了虚拟协作学习理论，特别关注内向学生的学习需求和行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具有可用性、安全性和可扩展性的Academates移动应用，为内向学生提供了有效的协作学习解决方案。

title: ADVANTAGES AND CHALLENGES OF TRACKING ST-SEGMENT ELEVATION MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION PATIENTS WITH A REAL-TIME DASHBOARD: A SINGLE-CENTRE EXPERIENCE
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: ADVANTAGES AND CHALLENGES OF TRACKING ST-SEGMENT ELEVATION MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION PATIENTS WITH A REAL-TIME DASHBOARD: A SINGLE-CENTRE EXPERIENCE
detail.abstract: Background: Timely primary percutaneous coronary intervention (pPCI) represents the most important treatment to improve outcomes in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI), with a strong relationship between treatment delays and morbidity and mortality. Alongside, long in-hospital stays and other delays in procedures/exams might account for increased costs and worse quality of care.  The present study aims to define the main steps for setting up a real-time digital monitoring dashboard to improve the clinical performance in STEMI management and to evaluate the impact of its implementation in daily practice.Methods: The set-up of the digital monitoring system required the definition of detailed algorithms for the diagnosis, treatment, and rehab/follow-up phase.  For each patient with a diagnosis of STEMI included in the clinical pathway (CP) a multidisciplinary working group identified i) three flags (RED, YELLOW, GREEN) indicating three different risk groups; ii) rules for flagging patients alongside the CP, according with specific risk scores; iii) the critical points of the CP to be monitored, such as door-to-balloon time and length of stay in intensive care unit (ICU) and until discharge. Then, data from consecutive STEMI patients admitted to our hospital were collected to conduct a pre-post analysis.Results. After the introduction of the dashboard, the percentage of pPCI performed within 90 minutes from patient admission increased from 42% to 59%, representing an improvement of about 40% by 2023.Conclusion. The real-time monitoring system demonstrated a positive impact on the timely management of STEMI, highlighting the potential in improving healthcare efficiency and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个实时数字监控仪表板来改善ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）的临床管理，通过设置风险标志和关键监测点，显著提高了90分钟内进行原发性经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（pPCI）的比例。
AI.research_question: 如何建立实时数字监控仪表板来改善STEMI管理的临床绩效？实施该仪表板对日常实践有何影响？
AI.motivation: 及时的原发性经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（pPCI）对改善STEMI患者预后至关重要，治疗延迟与发病率和死亡率密切相关。同时，住院时间过长和其他程序/检查延迟可能导致成本增加和护理质量下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于临床路径管理和实时监控理论，通过风险分层和关键绩效指标监控来优化STEMI患者的治疗流程。
AI.method: 1）定义诊断、治疗和康复/随访阶段的详细算法；2）建立三色风险标志系统（红、黄、绿）识别不同风险组；3）确定临床路径中的关键监测点（如门到球囊时间、ICU停留时间等）；4）对连续入院的STEMI患者数据进行前后对比分析。
AI.findings: 引入仪表板后，90分钟内进行pPCI的比例从42%提高到59%，实现了约40%的改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于实时数字监控的STEMI管理优化框架，为急诊心血管疾病的流程改进提供了理论支持和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的数字监控系统，显著提高了STEMI患者的治疗及时性，为医疗机构改善医疗效率和质量提供了可操作的工具。

title: Decrypting Managerial Decision-Making in Cost Management Based on Organizational Behavior in the Digital Era
affiliations: Pakuan University

detail.title: Decrypting Managerial Decision-Making in Cost Management Based on Organizational Behavior in the Digital Era
detail.abstract: In the digital age, managerial decision-making in cost management has become increasingly complex because it is influenced by the dynamics of organizational behavior and technological transformation. Organizations are required to adapt to rapid changes and optimize cost management strategies to maintain competitiveness. This study aims to examine how organizational behavior influences managerial decision-making in cost management in the digital era. This research uses a qualitative method with a literature study approach (library research), which examines various theories and findings of previous research related to managerial decision-making, organizational behavior, and digital innovation in cost management. The results show that behavioral factors, such as leadership style, organizational culture, and resistance to change, play an important role in determining the effectiveness of cost management strategies. In addition, the use of big data analytics, artificial intelligence, and automation systems contributes to improving the accuracy and efficiency of managerial decision-making. However, while digitalization provides significant benefits, challenges such as lack of technological literacy, cognitive bias, and conflicts of interest within organizations remain obstacles in the implementation of digital-based cost management strategies. This research provides insights for academics and practitioners on the importance of understanding the interaction between organizational behavior and technology in managerial decision-making. It is hoped that the results of this research can be a reference for organizational leaders in designing cost management policies that are more adaptive, data-based, and in accordance with the dynamics of organizational behavior in the digital era.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数字时代组织行为如何影响成本管理中的管理决策，发现行为因素（领导风格、组织文化、变革阻力）和数字技术（大数据分析、人工智能、自动化）共同作用，但技术素养不足和认知偏差仍是实施障碍。
AI.research_question: 数字时代组织行为如何影响成本管理中的管理决策？
AI.motivation: 数字时代成本管理决策日益复杂，受组织行为动态和技术变革影响，组织需要适应快速变化并优化成本管理策略以保持竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织行为理论、管理决策理论、数字创新理论在成本管理中的应用
AI.method: 定性研究方法，采用文献研究法（library research），分析先前关于管理决策、组织行为和数字创新在成本管理中的理论和研究发现
AI.findings: 行为因素（领导风格、组织文化、变革阻力）在决定成本管理策略有效性中起重要作用；大数据分析、人工智能和自动化系统提高管理决策的准确性和效率；数字化虽带来显著效益，但技术素养不足、认知偏差和组织内部利益冲突仍是数字基成本管理策略实施的障碍
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了组织行为与技术在管理决策中相互作用的理论见解，丰富了数字时代成本管理理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导者设计更具适应性、数据驱动且符合数字时代组织行为动态的成本管理政策提供参考

title: CentralBank-BERT: Machine Learning Evidence on Central Bank Digital Currency Discourse
affiliations: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Johor Bahru, Malaysia

detail.title: CentralBank-BERT: Machine Learning Evidence on Central Bank Digital Currency Discourse
detail.abstract: This paper quantifies CBDC communication in BIS-posted speeches using a domain-adapted BERT architecture. From 19,609 speeches, 5,376 CBDC sentences are identified in 588 speeches delivered by 157 authors across 57 countries, spanning 2016-2024. Sentence-level classifiers assign labels for Type (Retail, Wholesale, General/Unspecified), Stance (Pro, Waitand-See, Anti), Sentiment (positive, neutral, negative), and Discourse (Feature, Risk-Benefit, Process). Comparable indicators, dispersion metrics (entropy, HHI), and cross-task dependence (Cramér's V, mutual information) are constructed. Three facts emerge: (i) communication is retail-oriented and procedural. Retail is the modal type and Process the modal discourse, consistent with rulebooks, intermediated distribution, holding limits, privacy models, and offline use; (ii) tone is predominantly neutral while stance is supportive or cautious, with tight stance-sentiment alignment; (iii) activity surges from 2020, peaks in 2022, and remains elevated, reflecting a compositional pivot toward retail design and program management rather than a simple scale-up of generic statements. Geography is concentrated in the Eurosystem, with meaningful contributions from the US, UK, and Asia-Pacific. Methodologically, a reusable, replication-grade measurement layer for policy communication is provided. Substantively, the evidence indicates a shift in official narratives from whether to how, consistent with managed institutional experimentation that advances operational readiness while preserving policy flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文使用领域适应的BERT架构量化BIS演讲中的CBDC沟通，从19,609篇演讲中识别出5,376个CBDC句子，分析类型、立场、情感和话语特征，发现沟通以零售为导向、程序性为主，语气中性但立场支持或谨慎，2020年后活动激增。
AI.research_question: 如何量化央行数字货币（CBDC）在BIS演讲中的沟通特征？这些沟通在类型、立场、情感和话语方面呈现什么模式？
AI.motivation: 随着全球央行对CBDC的兴趣日益增长，需要系统性地分析和理解政策制定者关于CBDC的公开沟通，以洞察政策方向和实施进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理和计算文本分析理论，特别是领域适应的BERT架构，结合政策沟通分析和金融科技监管框架。
AI.method: 使用领域适应的BERT架构对19,609篇BIS演讲进行文本分析，识别5,376个CBDC相关句子，构建句子级分类器分析类型、立场、情感和话语特征。
AI.findings: 沟通以零售为导向和程序性为主；语气中性但立场支持或谨慎；2020年后活动激增，2022年达到峰值；地理上集中在欧元区，美英和亚太地区也有重要贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了可复制的政策沟通测量方法学框架，建立了CBDC沟通分析的理论基础，为政策文本分析提供了新的方法论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监测CBDC沟通的工具，揭示了从"是否"到"如何"的叙事转变，支持机构实验和操作准备，同时保持政策灵活性。

title: Unbounding Rationality: Why AI is a Fundamental Issue for Strategy
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Unbounding Rationality: Why AI is a Fundamental Issue for Strategy
detail.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence represent a fundamental discontinuity for the field of strategy.  This chapter argues that AI strikes at the heart of strategy’s foundational assumption: bounded rationality.  By offering a path toward “unbounding rationality”—systematically relaxing the cognitive constraints that have shaped organizational decision-making since Simon—AI promises to transform both strategy process (how strategic decisions are made) and strategy content (the sources of competitive advantage).  The chapter builds this case by presenting affirmative arguments grounded in AI’s demonstrated mastery of complex cognitive tasks, from creative problem-solving to sophisticated language understanding.  It then directly confronts two powerful objections: that AI’s widespread availability will homogenize rather than differentiate firms, and that AI lacks the forward-looking creativity essential for strategic thought.  Finally, it proposes a concrete research agenda centered on computational strategy processes, predictive foresight, verifiable benchmarks, and new forms of scholarly contribution.  Embracing this program can sharpen theory, guide practice, and position the field to lead in an era of radical, ubiquitous intelligence.

AI.tldr: AI技术通过突破有限理性假设，正在从根本上改变战略管理领域，影响战略制定过程和竞争优势来源，并提出新的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何突破战略管理的有限理性基础假设，并如何影响战略过程和战略内容？
AI.motivation: 人工智能的突破性进展对战略管理领域构成了根本性的变革，挑战了该领域的核心假设——有限理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限理性理论（西蒙）、人工智能认知能力理论、竞争优势理论
AI.method: 理论论证和概念分析，基于AI在复杂认知任务中的表现构建论证，并直接回应反对观点
AI.findings: AI通过"无界理性"路径能够系统性地放松认知约束，改变战略决策过程和竞争优势来源；AI的广泛可获得性不会导致企业同质化，且AI具备战略思维所需的前瞻性创造力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"无界理性"概念，挑战了战略管理的有限理性基础假设；建立了AI与战略理论的新连接；提出了计算战略过程、预测性前瞻等新的理论方向
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在AI时代制定战略提供指导；提出了可验证的基准和新形式的学术贡献；帮助战略领域在智能时代保持领导地位

title: Change Management: from Initial Configuration to Reliably Updating
affiliations: University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC)

detail.title: Change Management: from Initial Configuration to Reliably Updating
detail.abstract: This paper focuses on change management within system and software engineering, particularly emphasizing the journey from initial design to reliable updates in operational environments. It outlines the importance of baselining design solutions through various review stages and meticulously details the processes of System Configuration Management (CM), including change control during design and software release. The text also explores the challenges posed by advanced technologies (like Industry 4.0/5.0) to traditional systems engineering, suggesting solutions such as modern technology-based tools (AI, MBSE), shared engineering workspaces, and understanding software's "context of use." Finally, it addresses Software Configuration Management (SCM) processes, the use of CM repositories, and strategies for patching with reduced downtime, concluding with the critical role of enhanced organizational learning in retaining knowledge of the design rationale for built interfaces, which must be maintained to support effective update processes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨系统和软件工程中的变更管理，从初始设计到可靠更新的全过程，重点分析系统配置管理和软件配置管理的流程、挑战及解决方案，强调组织学习对保持设计知识的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何在系统和软件工程中有效管理从设计到运营更新的变更过程，特别是在先进技术环境下？
AI.motivation: 传统系统工程方法面临Industry 4.0/5.0等先进技术的挑战，需要建立有效的变更管理流程来确保系统可靠性和更新效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统配置管理(CM)和软件配置管理(SCM)理论框架，包括变更控制、基线管理、版本控制等核心概念。
AI.method: 流程分析方法，详细描述系统配置管理和软件配置管理的各个阶段和流程，包括设计评审、变更控制、软件发布等环节。
AI.findings: 1) 通过多阶段评审建立设计基线至关重要；2) 现代技术工具(AI、MBSE)和共享工程工作空间能有效应对新技术挑战；3) 理解软件的"使用情境"对配置管理很关键；4) CM仓库和减少停机时间的补丁策略是重要实践；5) 组织学习对保持设计原理知识具有决定性作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统配置管理理论在先进技术环境下的应用，提出了结合现代技术工具的变更管理框架，强调了组织学习和知识保留在系统工程中的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的变更管理实践指南：包括系统配置管理流程、软件发布控制、补丁策略实施，以及如何利用AI、MBSE等工具提升变更管理效率，为企业在数字化转型中的系统工程实践提供操作性建议。

title: Bridging the Gaps: Examining the Legal and Regulatory Framwork of Data Protection in Nigeria with a View to Proffering Solutions.
affiliations: Afe Babalola University

detail.title: Bridging the Gaps: Examining the Legal and Regulatory Framwork of Data Protection in Nigeria with a View to Proffering Solutions.
detail.abstract: Protection of personal data is more important than ever amid digitalisation and the concurrent rise of cyberattacks. Data protection refers to the technical and administrative measures put in place to prevent unauthorized access to personal data. In Nigeria, the egregious rate of cyberattacks has led to the widespread compromise of personal data. According to Surfshark, a cybersecurity firm, Nigeria recorded over 150,000 leaked data breaches in the first half of 2025. This report continues to reflect Nigeria's global cybersecurity standing, and this is evident in the 2024 World Justice Project report which ranks Nigeria 142 out of 142 counties in the category of order and security. Hence, this study seeks to explore the gaps in the legal and regulatory framework of data protection and privacy in Nigeria. This manuscript adopts the doctrinal method of research as it uses primary and secondary sources to achieve its objectives. Primary sources such as the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, were used while secondary sources like online journals, newspapers, website publications were also consulted. This study found that despite the efforts of the Nigerian government channelled towards data protection, there are certain gaps in the legal and regulatory framework. Thus, proactive measures must be implemented to prevent data security breaches and ensure robust data protection. Therefore, stricter penalties for non-compliance should be imposed, while awareness and enlightenment programmes should be organised to ensure adequate data protection literacy. Most importantly, the ambiguities in the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 should be reviewed to further strengthen the legal framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨尼日利亚数据保护法律框架的缺陷，发现尽管有《2023年尼日利亚数据保护法》，但仍存在监管漏洞，建议加强处罚、提高公众意识并修订法律模糊之处。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚数据保护和隐私法律监管框架存在哪些缺陷？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚网络攻击猖獗，2025年上半年数据泄露超过15万次，在世界正义项目报告中秩序与安全排名全球倒数第一，凸显数据保护紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据保护理论框架，包括技术和管理措施防止未经授权访问个人数据的理论体系。
AI.method: 采用法学研究方法，使用主要来源（如《2023年尼日利亚数据保护法》）和次要来源（在线期刊、报纸、网站出版物）。
AI.findings: 尽管尼日利亚政府致力于数据保护，但法律和监管框架仍存在明显缺陷和漏洞。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家数据保护法律框架研究的理论视角，为类似国家提供了可借鉴的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体建议：实施预防性措施、加强违规处罚、开展公众教育计划、修订法律模糊条款，以加强数据保护体系。

detail.abstract:
The U.S. healthcare sector is governed by strict regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA, HITECH, and the Affordable Care Act, placing immense compliance burdens on Human Resource Management (HRM) software systems. Traditional quality assurance (QA) methods often rely on manual code review and static testing, making it difficult to ensure full compliance coverage. This research proposes an NLP-based QA automation framework that bridges the gap between legal compliance texts and HRM system requirements.By leveraging Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, such as named entity recognition, semantic
role labeling, and rule-based extraction, the framework automatically translates compliance documents into
executable validation rules. These rules are then applied during the software QA process to flag deviations
or potential violations early in development. The proposed model is evaluated using real-world compliance
data and simulated HRM workflows, demonstrating improved accuracy, coverage, and efficiency compared
to traditional methods. Our results highlight the framework’s potential to significantly reduce compliance
errors, streamline QA cycles, and enhance software reliability in the healthcare domain. This study
contributes a novel, domain-specific application of NLP in compliance automation and provides a foundation
for further development of intelligent, regulation-aware HRM systems in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于NLP的QA自动化框架，将医疗合规文档自动转换为可执行的验证规则，用于HRM系统的质量保证，相比传统方法显著提高了合规检查的准确性和效率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用自然语言处理技术自动将医疗合规文档转换为可执行的验证规则，以提高HRM系统的合规性质量保证？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗行业受HIPAA、HITECH等严格法规约束，传统QA方法依赖人工代码审查和静态测试，难以确保全面的合规覆盖，需要自动化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理理论，包括命名实体识别、语义角色标注和基于规则的提取技术，构建合规文档到验证规则的转换框架。
AI.method: 采用NLP技术处理合规文档，自动生成可执行验证规则，并在真实合规数据和模拟HRM工作流中进行评估。
AI.findings: 相比传统方法，该框架在准确性、覆盖范围和效率方面均有显著提升，能够显著减少合规错误并优化QA周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了NLP在合规自动化领域的创新应用，为智能化的监管感知HRM系统开发提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的自动化框架，能够帮助医疗HRM系统更好地满足法规要求，提高软件可靠性并降低合规风险。

title: Shadow AI Thrives Under Punitive Social Evaluation
affiliations: Center for Humans and Machines, Max Planck Institute for Human Development, Max Planck Institute for Human Development - Center for Humans and Machines, Technische Universitat Berlin, University of Toulouse 1 - Toulouse School of Economics  Institute for Advanced Studies/Harvard Law School LWP and Max Planck Society for the Advancement of the Sciences - Center for Humans and Machines

detail.title: Shadow AI Thrives Under Punitive Social Evaluation
detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT, offer significant performance benefits across professional tasks. Yet, their adoption in work-related contexts is complicated by social disapproval and penalties, especially under conditions of mandated transparency. In three studies (one pre-registered; n = 1,678 applicants and n = 477 evaluators), we investigate how people navigate this augmentation-approval tradeoff in an incentivized mini-job application scenario. We find that mandatory disclosure substantially reduces visible AI adoption, but prompts a covert behavioral strategy we term shadow adoption, that is, using AI in ways that avoid detection and disclosure. Strikingly, these shadow AI users produce the highest-quality applications, as rated by HR professionals who are unaware that the outputs were AI-assisted. As the knowledge about the tradeoff spreads, shadow adoption becomes more prevalent, with nearly twice as many people choosing to use shadow AI. These results reveal a misalignment between well-intended transparency rules and user incentives in work-related contexts. Policies and technologies designed to enforce ethical AI use may inadvertently encourage covert behavior, rewarding concealment over compliance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现强制披露AI使用会减少可见的AI采用，但促使人们采用隐蔽的"影子采用"策略，这些影子AI用户产出最高质量的工作成果，且随着对利弊了解的增加，影子采用率几乎翻倍。
AI.research_question: 在强制透明度要求下，人们如何应对生成式AI的性能优势与社会不认可的权衡？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具在工作场景中提供显著性能优势，但其采用受到社会不认可和惩罚的制约，特别是在强制透明度要求下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增强-认可权衡理论，透明度政策与用户激励的错位理论
AI.method: 三项研究（一项预注册研究），共1,678名申请者和477名评估者参与的激励性迷你工作申请场景实验
AI.findings: 强制披露显著减少可见AI采用但促使影子采用行为；影子AI用户产出最高质量成果；随着对利弊了解增加，影子采用率几乎翻倍
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了透明度规则与用户激励之间的错位，提出了影子采用行为的概念和理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI使用政策设计提供重要启示，表明强制透明度政策可能无意中鼓励隐蔽行为而非合规行为

title: Role of Flow Experience in the Digital Age on Consumer Purchase Intention: A Case Study of Fresh Food in Vietnam
affiliations: Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City, Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City, Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City, Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City and Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City

detail.title: Role of Flow Experience in the Digital Age on Consumer Purchase Intention: A Case Study of Fresh Food in Vietnam

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Proceedings of the 5thAFSA Conference 2022, Miscellaneous, No. 21. Pp. 148-157

detail.abstract: Since the Covid 19 epidemic, shopping for fresh food online are an upward trend. This study determined and measured the factors influencing the flow experience on the intention to buy fresh food from Vietnamese consumers. The Partial Least Squares- Structural Equation Modeling (PLSSEM) approach was applied in this study, and information was gathered from Vietnamese customers purchasing fresh food online. The research results show that the factors: Concentration, Advertising Value, Website/App Quality, Informativeness, Interest, and Perception of Risk have a direct impact on Flow Experience. At the same time, the flow experience substantially impacts purchase intention. In particular, the most decisive factor in the consumer's flow experience is the online advertising value. From the research results, the team proposes many solutions to enhance the flow experience to stimulate consumers' purchase intention.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了越南消费者在线购买生鲜食品时的流入体验对购买意向的影响，发现在线广告价值是最关键的影响因素
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响越南消费者在线购买生鲜食品时的流入体验？流入体验如何影响购买意向？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情以来，生鲜食品在线购买成为趋势，需要研究消费者在线购买过程中的流入体验对消费决策的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 流入体验理论，结构方程模型（SEM）
AI.method: 偏最小二乘-结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析，采集越南在线生鲜食品消费者数据
AI.findings: 注意力集中、广告价值、网站/应用质量、信息价值、兴趣、风险感知直接影响流入体验，流入体验显著影响购买意向，在线广告价值是最关键因素
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了流入体验理论在生鲜食品电子商务领域的应用，确认了关键影响因素
AI.practical_contributions: 为生鲜食品电商企业提供了提升消费者流入体验和激发购买意向的实践建议

detail.abstract: Training and awareness for internal staff, when it comes to the new risks and controls related to AI, is very important, but unfortunately often neglected. The following article provides five sample policies which can help organizations get started creating their own internal policies supporting this training and awareness effort. It appeared in the Summer Newsletter of American Bar Association's Committee on Cybersecurity and Data Privacy (2025).

title: The Use of Virtual Currency in Baluchistan and Sindh Provinces of Pakistan: Patterns, Cross-Border Trade, and Grey Zone Dynamics
affiliations: School of Government, University of International Business and Economics

detail.title: The Use of Virtual Currency in Baluchistan and Sindh Provinces of Pakistan: Patterns, Cross-Border Trade, and Grey Zone Dynamics
detail.abstract: This study examines the changing dynamics of virtual currency adoption in Pakistan, with a focus on Sindh and Balochistan. In response to the increasing global interest in digital finance, Pakistan has become a notable participant in cryptocurrency use, driven by economic instability, limited access to formal banking services, and high remittance costs. The study examines three pivotal aspects: (1) the use of cryptocurrencies in international purchasing of essential commodities, (2) the trends of public adoption in both regions, and (3) the prospective application of virtual currencies in illegal activities, including arms trafficking. The study employs a multidisciplinary approach that integrates policy reports, demographic data, economic indicators, and recent regulatory developments, revealing a pronounced disparity between urbanized Sindh, marked by high adoption rates, digital literacy, and freelance-driven usage, and underdeveloped Baluchistan, where Cryptocurrency facilitates informal trade networks and is susceptible to illicit activities. Notwithstanding legislative progress such as the formation of the Pakistan Virtual Assets Legislative Authority (PVARA) and initiatives for a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC), the findings highlight enduring deficiencies in enforcement, digital infrastructure, and security supervision. The study closes with strategic policy proposals designed to enhance legal clarity, improve digital inclusion, and expand financial monitoring systems to capitalize on the advantages of virtual currencies while limiting related dangers.

title: LLMs as Correctors of Race/Gender Bias: Evaluating Varying Recommendations in Educational and Career Guidance

detail.title: LLMs as Correctors of Race/Gender Bias: Evaluating Varying Recommendations in Educational and Career Guidance
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (“LLMs”) are rapidly changing how we consume and produce information, and their potential biases carry real-world implications, particularly in educational and career contexts where they can influence important life decisions. This study examines gender and racial bias in LLM outputs, specifically in educational and career guidance, and evaluates progress in reducing such biases over time. It evaluates four LLMs through two experiments simulating high school students seeking community college and career recommendations across 320 trials. Student names reflecting gender and race were used while keeping all other factors constant. Results indicate significant progress, with newer LLMs showing improved gender fairness and greater consistency compared to ChatGPT-3.5. Notably, African American students, particularly females, were recommended higher-quality community colleges than their white peers, suggesting possible overcorrectionーintentional or otherwiseーthrough interventions addressing historical inequalities. These results highlight both progress and ongoing challenges in creating fair AI systems, raising questions about balancing algorithmic neutrality with proactive interventions. They underscore the need for continued research and multidisciplinary conversations on the intersection of sociology, ethics, and AI to ensure AI promotes fair and positive outcomes for diverse communities and society at large.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过320次实验测试了4个大型语言模型在教育职业推荐中的性别和种族偏见，发现新版模型在性别公平性方面有显著进步，但存在对非裔学生过度补偿的现象，凸显了AI公平性平衡的挑战
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在教育职业指导输出中是否存在性别和种族偏见？这些偏见随时间推移有何变化？
AI.motivation: LLMs正快速改变信息消费和生产方式，其潜在偏见在教育和职业等影响人生重要决策的领域具有现实影响，需要评估和减少这些偏见
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法公平性理论、AI伦理框架、社会偏见在技术系统中的再现理论
AI.method: 通过两个实验模拟高中生寻求社区大学和职业推荐，使用反映性别和种族的学生姓名，保持其他因素不变，共进行320次试验，评估4个LLM模型
AI.findings: 新版LLMs在性别公平性方面显著改善，一致性优于ChatGPT-3.5；非裔学生（特别是女性）被推荐更高质量的社区大学，表明白人学生可能存在过度补偿；算法中立性与积极干预之间存在平衡挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了LLM偏见随时间演变的实证证据，揭示了算法公平性干预可能产生的过度补偿效应，丰富了AI伦理和社会技术系统偏见研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构和职业咨询提供者选择公平AI工具提供参考，为LLM开发者改进偏见缓解策略提供实证依据，促进多学科对话确保AI为多元社区带来公平结果

title: The Structural Fallacy: Game-Theoretic Failures and Systemic Incoherence in the Online Labor Market
affiliations: The Job Applicant Perspective

detail.title: The Structural Fallacy: Game-Theoretic Failures and Systemic Incoherence in the Online Labor Market

declarations.ethicsApproval: AI has been used to help with formatting, references, and cohesive paper review. But all info, insights and otherwise are the responsibility of the author.

detail.abstract: Online hiring platforms-from LinkedIn and Indeed to ATS vendors-present themselves as efficient labor marketplaces, yet by every measure of stability they fail. Job seekers apply hundreds of times without response, employers report "talent shortages," recruiters burn out managing churn, and policymakers cling to outdated skills-gap narratives. Building on established frameworks in game theory, systems theory, sociology, and ethics, I provide a conceptual synthesis that demonstrates why online hiring markets produce nonconvergent dynamics. I frame online hiring as a two-player strategic game in which platforms enforce a perspective collapse, structurally erasing the lived experience of job seekers and transforming the marketplace into a one-sided, extractive system. This paper makes three core theoretical claims: (1) The online labor market functions as a broken signaling game where information has lost its meaning. (2) Platforms profit from this structural incoherence by monetizing the churn and uncertainty that this instability creates. (3) Trust and review infrastructure are not optional add-ons but structural requirements; a marketplace cannot remain legitimate if it profits from mandatory participation while silencing participants' ability to evaluate their experience. Labor Market Failure Mathematical Certainty 2 This paper offers a mechanism-level account with testable predictions, showing why these failures are structurally predictable in platform-mediated segments under current incentives.

AI.tldr: 在线招聘平台通过视角崩塌制造结构性不稳定，将劳动力市场变成单向剥削系统，平台从这种混乱中获利，而信任机制是市场合法性的必要条件而非可选功能
AI.research_question: 为什么在线招聘平台会产生非收敛动态和系统性失败？
AI.motivation: 在线招聘平台声称是高效劳动力市场，但实际表现极不稳定：求职者投递数百份简历无回复、雇主抱怨人才短缺、招聘人员疲于应对流失、政策制定者固守过时的技能缺口叙事
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、系统理论、社会学和伦理学框架，将在线招聘建模为双人策略博弈
AI.method: 概念性综合分析和机制层面的理论建构，提供可检验的预测
AI.findings: 1) 在线劳动力市场作为破碎的信号博弈运作，信息失去意义；2) 平台通过货币化不稳定产生的流失和不确定性来获利；3) 信任和评价基础设施是结构性要求而非可选附加功能
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了在线招聘市场失败的理论解释框架，展示了在现有激励机制下平台中介市场的结构性失败是数学上必然的
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、平台设计者和市场参与者提供了理解在线招聘市场系统性问题的分析工具，指出了信任机制重建的必要性

title: Extended Reality as a Fundamentally Mediated Reality: XR Infrastructure and the Ethics of Experience
affiliations: Yale University - Digital Ethics Center

detail.title: Extended Reality as a Fundamentally Mediated Reality: XR Infrastructure and the Ethics of Experience
detail.abstract: Extended reality (XR) technologies like virtual and augmented reality are increasingly entering mainstream use, raising significant questions about how they shape human experience. This article argues that XR creates a fundamentally mediated reality-one that exists only through and is shaped by its technological infrastructure. Using Star's infrastructure studies framework, I examine how platform organizations, hardware companies, devices, and users participate in and are constrained by this infrastructure, as well as the implications for the experiences of different users. Unlike physical infrastructure, which regulates behaviors, XR infrastructure is constitutive of the reality it enables. Through analysis of technical capabilities, accessibility considerations, and user experiences, I demonstrate how the current development of XR infrastructure embeds inequality into virtual experiences in novel ways. The quality of one's XR experience-from visual fidelity to interaction capabilities-becomes directly tied to purchasing power and corporate priorities in ways that transcend typical digital divides. This suggests an urgent need to consider new governance frameworks as XR technologies become more prevalent. This article contributes to infrastructure studies by examining how private control of reality-constituting infrastructure differs from traditional infrastructure, while advancing XR scholarship through a novel theoretical framework for understanding virtual experiences as fundamentally mediated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基础设施研究框架分析XR技术如何构建中介现实，揭示XR基础设施如何将不平等嵌入虚拟体验，并提出需要新的治理框架。
AI.research_question: XR技术如何通过其技术基础设施塑造和构成人类体验，以及这种基础设施如何影响不同用户的体验？
AI.motivation: 随着XR技术进入主流使用，需要理解这些技术如何从根本上中介和塑造人类现实体验，以及其中存在的不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Star的基础设施研究框架，分析平台组织、硬件公司、设备和用户如何参与和受限于XR基础设施。
AI.method: 通过技术能力分析、可访问性考量和用户体验研究，分析XR基础设施的现状和发展。
AI.findings: XR基础设施构成而非仅仅调节现实，当前XR发展以新颖方式将不平等嵌入虚拟体验，体验质量直接与购买力和企业优先事项挂钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基础设施研究贡献了关于现实构成基础设施私有控制与传统基础设施差异的新见解，为XR研究提供了理解虚拟体验作为中介现实的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了XR技术发展中存在的新型数字鸿沟问题，提出了需要制定新的治理框架来应对XR技术普及带来的挑战。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Education: Building Ethical and Inclusive Smart Learning Ecosystems in the UAE
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH)

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Education: Building Ethical and Inclusive Smart Learning Ecosystems in the UAE
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is redefining the landscape of education by enabling adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring systems, automated assessments, and personalized educational pathways. Globally, AI in education (AIED) is forecast to become one of the most transformative applications of machine intelligence, reshaping pedagogy, teacher roles, and the student learning experience. In the United Arab Emirates (UAE), where educational modernization is central to national development, AI has been strategically adopted as part of the UAE Vision 2021, the Centennial 2071 strategy, and the UAE's Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2031. However, rapid technological advancement also raises critical governance challenges, particularly concerning ethics, inclusivity, and cultural pluralism within a highly diverse society. This article explores how the UAE is leveraging AI to build an inclusive and ethical educational ecosystem, focusing on smart learning initiatives, AI tutors, digital curriculum reform, and capacity-building for both educators and learners. Using a mixed-methods literature synthesis and case study approach, the paper examines the integration of AI in the UAE education sector, referencing key programs such as the Dubai Future Foundation's AI Lab, the Ministry of Education's Smart Learning Program, and Abu Dhabi's efforts to introduce AI-powered learning analytics in schools. The analysis highlights the benefits of AI-driven personalization and efficiency while addressing challenges such as algorithmic bias, data privacy, teacher retraining, and the digital divide across socioeconomic groups. The paper concludes that the UAE's unique governance model-anchored in its Tolerance Framework, multicultural policy orientation, and strong digital infrastructure-offers a blueprint for harmonizing AI-driven innovation with ethical responsibility. By embedding AI within an inclusive framework of cultural sensitivity, transparency, and student empowerment, the UAE demonstrates how smart education systems can serve as global exemplars in balancing technological advancement with human-centered values.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨阿联酋如何利用AI构建包容性和伦理性的教育生态系统，通过混合方法研究分析AI在教育中的整合，强调个性化效益同时解决算法偏见、数据隐私等挑战，认为阿联酋的治理模式为平衡技术创新与伦理责任提供了蓝图。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋如何利用人工智能构建包容性和伦理性的教育生态系统？

AI.method: 混合方法的文献综述和案例研究
AI.findings: 阿联酋通过智能学习计划、AI导师、数字课程改革等措施成功整合AI教育，其独特的治理模式（基于宽容框架、多元文化政策和强大数字基础设施）为协调AI创新与伦理责任提供了有效蓝图

AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家提供了可借鉴的AI教育实施蓝图，展示了如何平衡技术创新与人文价值，特别是在多元文化环境中的实践经验

title: Tokenized Granularity for Supply Chain Traceability: An ERP-Anchored Blockchain Approach
affiliations: University of Piraeus, University of Piraeus, University of Piraeus, Hellenic Open University - School of Social Sciences and Hellenic Open University

detail.title: Tokenized Granularity for Supply Chain Traceability: An ERP-Anchored Blockchain Approach
detail.abstract: Traceability has gained significant importance in modern supply chain (SC) networks, especially driven by the growing need for transparency, regulatory compliance and consumer assurance. Although blockchain technology addresses several traditional traceability challenges, issues such as granularity, interoperability and integration with existing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems persist in the literature. In this paper, we propose a novel blockchain-enabled traceability framework aimed at fostering granular traceability in SC networks. In the proposed framework we leverage tokenization of the Bill of Materials and introduce mutable tokens adapting to various SC stages, thus improving scalability and reducing redundancy. We apply a role-based access control policy for managing privacy and security requirements and we also integrate the EPCIS (GS1) standard to further enhance interoperability, especially for allowing seamless data exchange between disparate ERP systems and SC participants. We implement the proposed framework in a wheat SC use case scenario, further highlighting its practical applicability. We also provide a performance analysis to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework. We believe our research contributes to the fields of blockchain, ERP and SC management by providing a scalable solution to current traceability challenges, with broader implications for enhancing transparency, trust and sustainability in global SC networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于区块链的供应链追溯框架，通过物料清单代币化和可变代币技术解决粒度追溯、互操作性和ERP集成问题，并在小麦供应链案例中验证了其可行性和性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于区块链的供应链追溯框架来解决粒度追溯、互操作性和ERP系统集成等挑战？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术、代币化理论、物料清单管理、角色访问控制策略和EPCIS标准构建理论框架。

AI.findings: 框架能够实现粒度追溯，提高可扩展性，减少冗余，增强互操作性，并在实际应用中证明其可行性和良好性能。

title: The Privacy Paradox: User Sentiment vs. Data Collection Practices and AI in Mobile Shopping Apps
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Privacy Paradox: User Sentiment vs. Data Collection Practices and AI in Mobile Shopping Apps
detail.abstract: Mobile shopping apps have become a staple of digital commerce, and as Artificial Intelligence is increasingly integrated, so too are more invasive privacy policies that permit extensive data collection. This study investigates the current landscape of privacy policies and how the invasiveness of privacy policies and the integration of Artificial Intelligence within top mobile shopping apps influence user sentiment in user reviews. Analyzing over 50,000 Google Play Store reviews across the top five shopping apps (Temu, SHEIN, WhatNot, Walmart, and Amazon), this mixed-methods research combines large-scale data scraping, transformer-based sentiment analysis, keyword filtering, and qualitative privacy policy and review analysis. Findings reveal a disconnect: although privacy policies support highly invasive data collection practices with industry standards of location tracking, third-party sharing, and in certain cases even data selling, consumers rarely complain about these issues, suggesting resignation, normalization, or a lack of awareness. When privacy or AI concerns are mentioned in reviews, they are associated with significantly lower ratings and negative sentiment. Critical AI-related reviews focused on overt, explicitly labeled instances of AI integration, such as in customer service chatbots or queries clearly labeled "AI-searchsuggestions," while more backend uses of AI rarely led to negative feedback. Combined, these apps represent over 800 million users, highlighting urgent ethical challenges and calling for greater transparency, clearer privacy communications, greater regulatory oversight, and more seamless AI integration to balance customer trust, safety, and convenience in digital commerce.

AI.tldr: 移动购物应用的隐私政策普遍具有高度侵入性，支持位置追踪、第三方共享甚至数据销售，但用户很少在评论中抱怨隐私问题。当提及隐私或AI问题时，评分和情感显著降低。用户主要关注显性的AI应用（如客服聊天机器人），而后端AI使用很少引发负面反馈。
AI.research_question: 移动购物应用的隐私政策侵入性和人工智能集成如何影响用户评论中的情感表达？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在移动购物应用中的集成日益增加，隐私政策变得更加侵入性，允许广泛的数据收集。需要了解这种隐私政策侵入性和AI集成对用户情感的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于隐私计算理论、用户接受度理论和情感分析理论，研究隐私政策侵入性和AI集成对用户情感的影响机制。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：大规模数据爬取（50,000+ Google Play评论）、基于transformer的情感分析、关键词过滤、定性的隐私政策和评论分析。
AI.findings: 1) 隐私政策支持高度侵入性数据收集但用户很少抱怨；2) 提及隐私或AI问题时评分显著降低；3) 用户主要关注显性AI应用而非后端AI使用；4) 存在用户顺从、正常化或缺乏意识的现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了隐私计算理论在移动购物环境中的应用，揭示了用户对隐私政策侵入性和AI集成的认知-情感反应机制，为数字伦理研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应用开发者提供改进隐私透明度、优化AI集成方式的实践指导，为监管机构制定更有效的隐私保护政策提供依据，促进数字商务中用户信任与便利的平衡。

title: Incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into Marketing Programs: A Review
affiliations: Fayetteville State University and Fayetteville State University

detail.title: Incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into Marketing Programs: A Review
detail.abstract: This paper aims to highlight the contributions of artificial intelligence (AI) in multiple subfields with an emphasis on how AI directly impacts marketing programs through a systematic literature review. To address the current gap in the effectiveness of implementing artificial intelligence in marketing, this study aims to determine the current and potential use of AI in action. Gaps in the literature were further discussed. More specifically, the following research questions were focused on: (1) How effective is incorporating artificial intelligence into marketing programs; (2) How to identify the most prevalent artificial intelligence methodologies that are currently being explored in marketing; (3) How to identify subfields that have benefited from the implementation of artificial intelligence. A specific set of selection criteria was used, and selected articles were thoroughly analyzed and synthesized.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述探讨人工智能在营销各子领域的贡献，重点关注AI如何直接影响营销项目，分析AI在营销中应用的有效性、主流方法及受益子领域。
AI.research_question: 1) 将人工智能融入营销项目的效果如何？2) 如何识别当前营销领域探索的主流人工智能方法？3) 如何识别已从人工智能实施中受益的子领域？
AI.motivation: 解决当前人工智能在营销中实施效果方面的研究空白，确定AI在营销中的当前和潜在应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统文献综述的理论框架，分析人工智能在营销领域的应用理论和实践基础。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，使用特定的选择标准筛选文章，并对选定文章进行深入分析和综合。
AI.findings: 研究发现人工智能在多个营销子领域有显著贡献，识别了主流AI方法及其应用效果，并指出了文献中的研究空白。

title: Generative AI as Seniority-Biased Technological Change: Evidence from U.S. Résumé and Job Posting Data
affiliations: Harvard University Department of Economics and

detail.title: Generative AI as Seniority-Biased Technological Change: Evidence from U.S. Résumé and Job Posting Data
detail.abstract: We study whether generative artificial intelligence (AI) constitutes a form of seniority-biased technological change, disproportionately affecting junior relative to senior workers. Using U.S. résumé and job posting data covering nearly 62 million workers in 285,000 firms (2015-2025), we track within-firm employment dynamics by seniority. We identify AI adoption through a text-analysis approach that flags postings for dedicated "AI integrator" roles, signaling active implementation of generative AI. Difference-in-differences and triple-difference estimates show that, beginning in 2023Q1, junior employment in adopting firms declined sharply relative to non-adopters, while senior employment continued to rise. The junior decline is driven primarily by slower hiring rather than increased separations, with the largest effects in wholesale and retail trade. Heterogeneity by education reveals a U-shaped pattern: mid-tier graduates see the largest declines, while elite and low-tier graduates are less affected. Overall, the results provide early evidence of a seniority-biased impact of AI adoption and its mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析美国6200万工人和28.5万家企业的数据，发现生成式AI的采用导致初级员工就业显著下降，而高级员工就业持续增长，呈现明显的资历偏向性技术变革特征。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能是否构成资历偏向性技术变革，对初级员工相对于高级员工产生不成比例的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解AI技术对不同资历层次员工的差异化影响，为劳动力市场政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资历偏向性技术变革理论，技术采纳对劳动力市场影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用美国简历和招聘数据（2015-2025），通过文本分析识别AI采用企业，采用双重差分和三重差分方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 从2023年第一季度开始，采用AI的企业中初级员工就业显著下降，高级员工就业持续增长；影响主要通过招聘放缓而非离职增加实现；批发零售业受影响最大；教育程度呈现U型模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证验证生成式AI的资历偏向性特征，丰富了技术变革偏向性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业人力资源管理、政府劳动力政策制定以及个人职业规划提供重要参考。

title: Do Bullet Chats Keep Viewers Watching? Estimating Heterogeneous Treatment Effects with a Control Function Approach
affiliations: , The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School, Department of Marketing, CUHK Business School and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Do Bullet Chats Keep Viewers Watching? Estimating Heterogeneous Treatment Effects with a Control Function Approach
detail.abstract: Bullet-chatting (danmaku) is an increasingly popular feature in online video platforms, yet its causal impact on viewing behavior remains unclear. This paper introduces a novel control function approach for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects (HTEs) over a continuous endogenous treatment itself, addressing a major limitation of existing methods that focus primarily on binary treatments or heterogeneity across covariates. Leveraging a randomized "pre-set bullet chat" intervention on a leading video-sharing platform, we construct an innovative instrument and apply the control function approach to estimate how the number of bullet chats affects viewers' likelihood of continuing to watch a video. We document a non-monotonic effect: compared to having no bullet chats, sparse bullet chats reduce viewing while denser bullet chats increase it. An online experiment further suggests perceived popularity as a key mechanism. Our control function approach extends the HTE literature by enabling precise causal estimation of marginal treatment effects across different treatment levels, offering a powerful new tool for analyzing continuous, endogenous treatments in digital platforms and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的控制函数方法来估计连续内生处理变量的异质性处理效应，通过视频平台的弹幕随机实验发现弹幕数量对观看行为存在非单调影响：稀疏弹幕减少观看，密集弹幕增加观看，感知流行度是重要机制。
AI.research_question: 弹幕数量如何因果影响观众的观看行为？
AI.motivation: 弹幕作为在线视频平台的流行功能，其因果影响尚不明确，现有方法主要关注二元处理或协变量异质性，无法有效处理连续内生处理变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性处理效应理论、控制函数方法、内生性问题处理
AI.method: 采用随机"预设弹幕"干预实验，构建创新工具变量，应用控制函数方法估计连续弹幕数量对观看行为的影响
AI.findings: 发现非单调效应：与无弹幕相比，稀疏弹幕减少观看，密集弹幕增加观看；在线实验表明感知流行度是关键机制
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了HTE文献，实现了对不同处理水平边际处理效应的精确因果估计
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台及其他领域分析连续内生处理变量提供了强大的新工具

title:
The Cognitive Erosion Paradox: How Skills Forecasts may Undermine Future Capabilities 
An Analysis of the World Economic Forum's Skills Projections and their Implications
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
The Cognitive Erosion Paradox: How Skills Forecasts may Undermine Future Capabilities 
An Analysis of the World Economic Forum's Skills Projections and their Implications
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs reports (2023, 2025) and their influential skills forecasts, arguing that their framing may unintentionally accelerate what I term the Cognitive Erosion Paradox. While the reports are widely cited in education and workforce policy, their methodological reliance on employer perceptions, binary categorisation of skills, and narrow economic framing create contradictions that devalue fundamental cognitive capabilities such as literacy, numeracy, and sensory processing. These foundations—essential for advanced competencies like analytical thinking, AI development, and technological literacy—are paradoxically classified as “out-of-focus” at the same time as derivative skills are promoted as priorities. The result is a skills framework that risks exacerbating cognitive inequality, regional disparities, and weakening long-term human adaptability in an AI-dependent world. By analysing shifts between the 2023 and 2025 projections and discussing the contradictions within WEF’s framework, this paper highlights the need for a more balanced approach that integrates economic imperatives with cognitive sustainability. The analysis contributes to the literature on workforce futures by reframing skills forecasting as a shaping activity with profound implications for human expertise, rather than as a neutral prediction of employer demand.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析世界经济论坛《未来就业》报告，指出其技能预测框架存在认知侵蚀悖论：在贬低读写算数等基础认知能力的同时推崇衍生技能，可能加剧认知不平等和削弱人类长期适应能力。
AI.research_question: 世界经济论坛《未来就业》报告的技能预测框架如何无意中加速认知侵蚀悖论，并对教育和工作力政策产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: WEF报告被广泛引用但方法学存在缺陷，依赖雇主认知、二元技能分类和狭隘经济框架，可能贬低基础认知能力并加剧不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知侵蚀悖论理论 - 基础认知能力（读写、算数、感官处理）被边缘化而衍生技能被优先化的矛盾现象
AI.method: 对WEF 2023和2025年报告的比较分析，批判性分析其方法论框架和内在矛盾
AI.findings: WEF框架存在矛盾：基础认知能力被归类为"非重点"，但却是高级能力（分析思维、AI开发等）的基础；可能加剧认知不平等和区域差距
AI.theory_contributions: 将技能预测重新定义为具有深远影响的塑造活动，而非中立的雇主需求预测；提出认知可持续性概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示，建议采用更平衡的方法整合经济需求与认知可持续性，避免技能框架削弱人类长期适应能力

title: Estimating Returns to Education for Women in Northern Nigeria
affiliations: University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of Oxford, University of KwaZulu-Natal - Health Economics and HIV/AIDS Research Division (HEARD), University of the Witwatersrand, University of Cape Town (UCT), University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention and University of Cape Town (UCT)

detail.title: Estimating Returns to Education for Women in Northern Nigeria
detail.abstract: We estimate the returns to women's education in Nigeria, focusing on Northern Nigeria's largely informal labour market. Using nationally representative NLSS 2018-19 data and survey-weighted Mincer regressions with covariates and Local Government Area fixed effects, we document a clear nonlinear relationship between schooling and earnings, mediated by child marriage. At very low schooling levels, marginal wage gains are small or even negative, but after about four years, returns rise, reaching 5.4% at nine years of schooling and 6.6% at ten. Child marriage carries a substantial wage penalty-about 38% nationally and 49% in the North-but each additional year of schooling reduces this penalty by roughly 3%. Robustness checks using education levels and literacy as alternative measures confirm the main results. Literacy emerges as a key differentiator, with literate women earning about 60% more than non-literate peers. Overall, schooling yields the highest wage gains at higher attainment levels; child marriage markedly reduces earnings, though its penalty narrows as schooling rises; and foundational learning, particularly literacy, is a critical channel through which education translates into higher income in Northern Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 本研究估计尼日利亚女性教育回报率，重点关注北部非正规劳动力市场。研究发现教育年限与收入呈非线性关系，童婚带来显著工资惩罚，但教育能减轻这种惩罚，识字能力是关键差异化因素。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚女性教育回报率如何？特别是在北部非正规劳动力市场中，教育年限、童婚和识字能力对女性收入的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚北部地区女性教育水平较低，劳动力市场以非正规就业为主，需要了解教育投资对女性经济回报的实际效果，以及童婚等社会因素对教育回报的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于明瑟收入方程理论，扩展考虑童婚和识字能力等调节变量，分析教育年限与收入的非线性关系。
AI.method: 使用2018-19年尼日利亚生活水平调查（NLSS）全国代表性数据，采用调查加权明瑟回归，包含协变量和地方行政区固定效应。
AI.findings: 教育回报呈非线性：前4年回报很小甚至为负，9年教育回报5.4%，10年达6.6%；童婚带来38%（全国）和49%（北部）工资惩罚；每增加一年教育减少惩罚约3%；识字女性收入比文盲高60%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育回报在低收入环境中的非线性特征，证实童婚作为重要调节变量对教育回报的影响机制，强调了基础教育（特别是识字能力）的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚教育政策提供实证依据，强调需要关注基础教育质量（特别是识字能力），同时需要配套措施减少童婚等社会障碍，以提高女性教育投资的实际回报。

title: Fostering Destination Brand Love: The Role of Brand Experience and Tourist Happiness in Tourism Marketing
affiliations: SEGi University, SEGi University Kota Damansara, SEGi University and Ningxia Academy of Social Sciences

detail.title: Fostering Destination Brand Love: The Role of Brand Experience and Tourist Happiness in Tourism Marketing
detail.abstract: The tourism sector has experienced notable growth, largely fueled by consumers' growing desire to explore a variety of destinations. This revitalized interest in travel highlights the necessity of cultivating enduring connections between tourism marketers and travelers. Crafting effective strategies to understand and attract tourists is essential for the long-term prosperity of travel destinations. Drawing upon embodied cognition theory, this research explores how various dimensions of brand experience influence tourists' emotional attachment to destinations, conceptualized as destination brand love. It further assesses the mediating role of tourist happiness within this relationship. the data were gathered through an online questionnaire from 330 tourists who had visited destinations in China. The analysis, conducted using Smart-PLS, confirmed significant direct effects among brand experience, tourist happiness, and brand love. These findings yield practical insights for destination marketers, offering guidance on how to deepen tourist engagement and strengthen emotional bonds with travel locations.

AI.tldr: 基于具身认知理论，研究品牌体验通过游客幸福感影响目的地品牌爱的机制，为中国旅游目的地营销提供实践指导

AI.motivation: 旅游业快速发展需要建立旅游营销者与旅行者之间的持久联系，制定有效策略理解并吸引游客对旅游目的地的长期繁荣至关重要

AI.findings: 品牌体验、游客幸福感和品牌爱之间存在显著的直接效应关系
